title: AI Developer
description: We're looking for an AI-first developer who genuinely loves building and shows up with the plan. If you light up when you talk about wiring agents together, shipping internal tools fast, and using AI as a daily working partner, and you'd rather drive the build strategy than wait for a spec, we'd love to hear from you. The Role This is a gig-based, project-driven build role focused on internal tooling. Here's what you'd actually be doing: - Building agents and automations from the ground up, including wiring up MCP servers and Claude Code workflows - Building a range of internal tools for the team, the kind of things that remove manual work and speed up how we operate - Working across APIs and integrations, including GoHighLevel, to connect the systems we run on - Partnering with the team on what gets built and why. We work as a team to win, and you'd own the technical thinking on your side of it Within the first 30 to 60 days, success looks like you showing up with the plan. You should be telling us what we should build next, how to approach it, and in what order. You should have a clear point of view on what's worth automating, what isn't, and what you want to ship first. The bar here is strategic ownership of the build, not waiting for a backlog to be handed to you. Schedule Work hours are flexible but need to overlap with our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST during active project work. Just want to make sure you can meet inside that window. What We're Looking For - An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work. - Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before shipping anything. - A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be building, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work. - Deep comfort with Claude Code, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, working with APIs, and the GoHighLevel API. We're also genuinely interested in whatever else you've built your workflow around. - A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified. How to Apply A few things we'd love you to do, in order: 1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application. 2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think. 3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need: - Claude Code /10 - GitHub /10 - Supabase /10 - Vercel /10 - Working with APIs /10 - GoHighLevel API /10 Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with /10. Include AI tools, frameworks, automation platforms, niche services, spreadsheets you've built, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are. 4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts: - What size was the company or account when you started (team size, what they were running, what was manual before you came in, whatever metric fits)? - What did you build for them? - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now? - If you have current clients, where are those projects today? We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better. 5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above. How You Use AI In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better: - Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally - A specific example of a build task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it - A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it - Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story. A Few Questions for Your Video Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally. 1. If you came on next week and we asked you to build out our internal tooling, walk us through your first 30 days. What would you want to look at, what would you build first, and how would you d ---------- the order? 2. We hand you a vague request like "we need something to make X less painful," with no spec. Walk us through how you go from that sentence to a shipped tool. 3. An automation you built has started silently failing in production. Walk us through what you check first and how you track it down. 4. Why do you love building this kind of thing? Tell us about a recent tool or automation you shipped that reminded you why you do this work. 5. What's something about building with Claude Code, MCP, or agentic workflows that's changed in the last year that you've actually adjusted your approach around?

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Luxury Automotive Reels & Instagram Stories
job_title: Short-Form Video Editor — Luxury Automotive Reels & Instagram Stories
description: Supreme Wraps Orlando is a premium automotive customization and protection company specializing in paint protection film (PPF), window tint, vehicle wraps, commercial wraps and other automotive services. We regularly work with Ferrari, McLaren, Lamborghini, Porsche, Tesla and other premium vehicles. We're looking for a long-term short-form video editor who can take raw iPhone footage from our shop and transform it into polished, high-retention Instagram Reels and Stories. This is not simply a cutting-and-trimming position. We want someone who understands social-media storytelling and viewer retention and can look at raw footage, identify the story, create a strong opening hook, select the best clips and turn them into content people actually want to watch. What you'll be responsible for - Editing 15–45 second Instagram Reels - Creating Instagram Stories from existing footage - Finding the strongest 1–3 second opening shot - Developing text/video hooks when appropriate - Creating alternate hooks for Trial Reels - Selecting the strongest clips from raw footage - Color correcting and grading automotive footage - Working with Apple Log footage when supplied - Creating clean animated captions and typography - Music selection - Automotive sound design - Speed ramps and transitions when appropriate - Creating before/after transformations - Creating educational and talking-head content - Exporting everything ready to upload to Instagram - Maintaining a consistent Supreme Wraps visual identity Our goal is premium—not over-edited. Ferraris and McLarens should look cinematic and sophisticated. We do not want every video filled with unnecessary transitions, effects or giant animated captions. You'll receive footage involving: Ferrari • McLaren • Lamborghini • Porsche • Tesla • BMW • Mercedes-Benz • Corvette • luxury/exotic vehicles • PPF installations • window tint • color-change wraps • commercial vehicle wraps • customer testimonials • before/after transformations • behind-the-scenes footage You'll also receive footage of the owner speaking directly to camera. Your job is to turn those assets into compelling social content. Software Experience with one or more of the following is required: Adobe Premiere Pro • DaVinci Resolve • After Effects • CapCut Experience properly grading Apple Log footage is strongly preferred. What we're looking for: You should understand that a successful Reel isn't simply a beautiful video. It needs to make someone stop scrolling. You should understand concepts such as: Hooks → curiosity → retention → payoff → CTA For example, instead of starting a video with: “Today we're installing PPF on this Ferrari…” You should recognize that something such as: “You probably haven't seen one of these in person yet.” could be a substantially stronger opening. We're looking for someone who thinks this way. Compensation Starting target: $6–$8 USD/hour Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially, with the potential to increase hours and compensation if the relationship works well. We're looking for a long-term team member, not someone to complete a few videos and disappear. Application instructions Please do NOT send a generic application. Start your application with the words: “PERFECTION HAS A FINAL STEP...SUPREME WRAPS” Then answer the following: 1. Send links to your 3 best short-form videos. 2. Send your best automotive video, if you have one. 3. What do you think makes someone stop scrolling during the first 3 seconds of a Reel? 4. What software do you primarily edit in? 5. Can you properly color-grade Apple Log footage? 6. Do you use DaVinci Resolve? 7. How would you approach editing a Ferrari differently from an ordinary vehicle? 8. How many 20–40 second Reels could you realistically produce each week? 9. What is your hourly rate? 10. Are you willing to complete a paid editing test using our raw footage? Applications that don't begin with “PERFECTION HAS A FINAL STEP...SUPREME WRAPS” will not be considered.

description: You’ve proven you can find profitable products for Amazon. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR • A proven Amazon product sourcer who can demonstrate and explain past results. • Strong Keepa analysis skills and sound purchasing judgment. • The ability to source efficiently without sacrificing lead quality. • A dependable, organized person who takes ownership and follows through. • A team player who welcomes feedback and helps colleagues succeed. • Someone seeking a long-term career with opportunities for greater responsibility. WHAT WE OFFER • Very competitive pay based on demonstrated experience and ability. • Performance bonuses that reward meaningful results. • Opportunities to advance into greater responsibility and leadership as your performance and company growth support them. • Friendly colleagues and a supportive remote working environment. • Fair and generous leadership that recognizes excellent work. • An opportunity to help grow an established seven-figure business. We want someone who is excited to help build a bigger business and grow with it. Advancement is earned through proven performance, reliability, initiative, and contributions to the team. HOW TO APPLY Use this subject line: Experienced Amazon Sourcer – [Your Name] Please include all of the following: 1. YOUR EXPERIENCE Summarize your hands-on Amazon sourcing experience, including the sourcing methods and marketplaces you have worked with. 2. YOUR TOOLS AND BUYING CRITERIA Tell us which tools you use and how you d ---------- whether a product is worth purchasing. 3. YOUR PROVEN RESULTS Share specific results from your previous work, such as qualified leads submitted, purchasing approval rates, actual profitability, or successful replenishable products. Clearly distinguish actual results from estimates. 4. A SHORT LOOM VIDEO Introduce yourself and walk us through how you evaluate a product using Keepa. Explain what you look for and what would cause you to approve or reject the opportunity. 5. YOUR TYPICAL DAILY SOURCING FLOWCHART Outline an average workday as a simple flowchart, from starting your day to submitting your final leads. Show how you find opportunities, analyze products, reject or qualify leads, and organize follow-up. Include approximate time spent at each stage and the number of qualified leads you typically submit per day. We want to understand your actual workflow and how you maintain both productivity and quality. A simple text flowchart is fine. 6. PAY AND AVAILABILITY Include your desired pay, available working hours and time zone, and earliest start date. Please protect previous employers’ confidential information. Anonymized examples are welcome. Applications must include the Loom video and daily sourcing workflow to be considered. If you have the experience, results, and ambition to grow with us, we’d love to hear from you.

description: We run a small, deliberately exclusive holiday property in western Germany — one house, three apartments around a courtyard, near the Dutch border. Website: secretgarden.nrw We want to build an audience on Instagram and TikTok and turn it into direct bookings. How this works in practice: **we film, you make it good.** We are on site, so we shoot the raw footage on a phone — rooms, courtyard, breakfast, the light in the morning, the village. You edit it into short vertical videos, write the hooks and captions, pick the sound, and post on a regular schedule. You will never need to be here. What we need: - Short-form editing for Reels and TikTok (CapCut or similar), with a feel for pacing and hooks - Caption and hook writing in natural English - A posting schedule you keep to without being chased - Simple graphics for stories and highlights - Telling us what footage to shoot next, and how to shoot it Two things worth knowing before you apply. Our guests are mostly German and Dutch — tell us how you would handle content for an audience that does not speak English as a first language. And this property is premium and quiet, not loud and trend-driven; we would rather grow slowly with the right tone than fast with the wrong one. **How to apply.** Start your message with the word **COURTYARD** so we know you read this. Then send us: 1. Two or three links to videos you personally edited, and the accounts they were posted on. Not an agency showreel — your own work. 2. For one of them: what were you trying to achieve, and what happened? 3. Which account you grew, from what to what, over what period. If you cannot cleanly attribute the growth to your own work, say so — we would rather read an honest small example than an impressive number nobody can trace. Also tell us your rate expectation, your weekly availability and your time zone. Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test: we send you raw footage, you send back one finished video. --- Zwei Dinge, die ich bewusst so gesetzt habe: ein eigenes Codewort, damit sich die Bewerberpools nicht vermischen, und keine Honorarangabe — anders als in Anzeige 1, wo 5 $ pro Stunde steht und damit alle Bewerber verankert hat. Im Budgetfeld des Formulars tragen Sie „TBD / depending on experience" ein. Der Testauftrag ist hier bewusst winzig: Rohmaterial rein, ein fertiges Video raus. Das kostet Sie fast nichts und zeigt sofort, ob jemand es kann. Sagen Sie mir, wann Sie so weit sind, dann lege ich die Anzeige an — veröffentlicht wird erst auf Ihr ausdrückliches Ja.

description: Rate: Open to competitive rates / Name your price. (I pay well for top-tier quality, speed, and execution.) ABOUT THE ROLE I am looking for a skilled short-form video editor based in the Philippines to edit high-energy, fast-paced Reels/TikToks/Shorts for sports betting content. This is not standard "talking head" footage. You will be building dynamic, highly rhythmic, micro-action-driven edits inspired directly by Olivia Tiedemann’s signature style. The Edit Style Breakdown If you know Olivia Tiedemann's edits, you know the vibe: Cadence & Speed: Rapid cuts (every 0.5 to 1.5 seconds). Zero fluff or dead air. Audio-Driven Rhythm: Hard, punchy audio sync. Foleys, snaps, clicks, pops, and sound effects matching physical actions seamlessly. Vibe: Confident, deadpan, sarcastic, and sharp. Visual Density: Constant switching between extreme close-ups, medium shots, and direct-to-camera stares to keep retention maxed out. What You Will Receive (Unorganized Raw Footage) Sports betting is mostly digital, so I won't just sit at a desk. I will film and dump a massive batch of quick 5–10 second clips from multiple angles. Note: This footage will NOT be organized, labeled, or neatly arranged. Part of your job is sorting through the raw footage dump, finding the best micro-moments, and building a cohesive story. The raw dump will include: Setup & Micro-Actions: Close-ups of fingers tapping screens, opening laptops, cracking drinks, flipping pens, uncapping markers, scribbling metrics. Analytical Movement: Double-takes at screens, pacing, leaning into monitors, tossing on glasses, shifting posture. The "Lock-In": Close-ups of hovering over and tapping "Submit," followed by direct-to-camera smirks, nods, or deadpan stares. Camera Interaction: 2–3 second deadpan looks directly into the lens mid-action. COMPENSATION & TEST TRIAL (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY) Budget: Name your rate. I will pay top dollar for an editor who can execute this style flawlessly. The Requirement: Because this style requires precise timing, audio design, pacing, AND the ability to organize raw footage quickly, you must complete a short test edit using a raw footage sample package I provide. Payment Terms: The initial test trial is completely unpaid. I will not pay a single cent until you prove you can execute this specific style from an unorganized batch of footage. Once you pass the test, you will be hired immediately, paid competitively per video or on a monthly retainer, and given consistent ongoing work. HOW TO APPLY 1. Send a link to your portfolio or past work (specifically short-form content with fast cuts or strong sound design). 2. Confirm that you agree to the unpaid test trial requirement and are comfortable sorting through unorganized raw footage. 3. Include the confirmation word "PARLAY" in the subject line or top of your message so I know you read this entire post thoroughly. Applications without this word will be ignored.

title: YouTube Video Editor/Assistant
description: # Full-Time YouTube Video Editor for AI-Assisted Real Estate & Lifestyle Channel We are looking for a reliable, creative, full-time video editor from the Philippines to help produce high-quality YouTube videos for a Seattle-area real estate and lifestyle channel. This is not just basic editing. We are building a long-term content system using a mix of AI tools, real local knowledge, voiceover, b-roll, maps, stock footage, captions, and strong storytelling. The goal is to produce **2 polished YouTube videos per week**, along with occasional short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. ## About the Channel Our content helps people understand what it is really like to live in Seattle, the Eastside, Snohomish County, and nearby communities. Topics include: * Moving to Seattle * Best Seattle suburbs * Cost of living * Neighborhood and city guides * Real estate market insights * Downsizing and preparing homes for sale * Local lifestyle, parks, schools, commute, and community feel The tone is calm, trustworthy, helpful, and story-driven. We are not looking for hype, clickbait, or flashy editing that feels fake. We want videos that feel professional, clear, warm, and useful. ## Main Responsibilities You will help create **2 long-form YouTube videos per week**, usually 8–15 minutes each. Your work may include: * Editing long-form YouTube videos * Finding and organizing b-roll * Adding maps, labels, callouts, and simple motion graphics * Using AI video tools when needed * Editing AI avatar or AI voiceover footage * Adding music, pacing, captions, and visual interest * Creating short-form clips from long-form videos * Creating clean YouTube thumbnails or helping prepare thumbnail assets * Adding pattern interrupts every 20–30 seconds to improve retention * Making videos feel polished, natural, and easy to watch * Following a repeatable weekly production system ## Tools and Skills We Like You do not need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable learning new tools quickly. Helpful experience includes: * Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve * Canva * YouTube editing * AI video tools such as HeyGen, Runway, Pika, Kling, Synthesia, or similar * AI voiceover/video workflows * Google Drive * YouTube Shorts / Reels / TikTok editing * Basic thumbnail design * Basic map graphics or screen-recorded map editing * Good English comprehension ## What We Are Looking For We want someone who is: * Full-time and dependable * Detail-oriented * Good at following instructions * Creative but not overly flashy * Comfortable working with AI tools * Able to meet weekly deadlines * Honest about what they can and cannot do * Willing to learn our style * Able to communicate clearly in English * Looking for a long-term position, not just a short project ## Video Style Our videos should feel: * Professional * Local * Helpful * Clear * Trustworthy * Warm * Not too corporate * Not too salesy * Not overly dramatic We like storytelling, clean pacing, useful visuals, maps, neighborhood footage, and simple graphics that help the viewer understand the topic. ## Weekly Output Goal The target is: * 2 long-form YouTube videos per week * 2–6 short clips per week from those videos when needed * Thumbnail support when needed We will provide topics, direction, scripts, and guidance. You will help turn those ideas into finished videos. ## To Apply Please reply with: 1. Your video editing experience 2. Links to 3–5 videos you have edited 3. What editing software you use 4. Any AI video tools you have used 5. Your expected full-time monthly salary in USD 6. Your internet speed and computer specs 7. Your availability and preferred work hours 8. A short answer to this question: **What makes a YouTube video hold attention after the first 30 seconds?** Please include the word **SEATTLE** in the first line of your application so we know you read the full post. AI experience a plus. ## Trial Task Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a paid trial edit using provided footage, script, voiceover, and direction. We are looking for the right long-term tea ---------- mber who wants to grow with us.

title: E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist
description: Full-Time Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Australian E-Commerce & Subscription Business Paddock 2 Porch is an established Australian fresh fruit and vegetable home-delivery business servicing customers from the Gold Coast through Tweed and into the Northern Rivers. We are looking for an experienced E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist to join us full-time remotely and help take the business through its next stage of growth. This is NOT a social media manager or general VA role. We are not looking for someone to simply create Instagram posts, write captions or maintain a content calendar. We want someone who understands the technical and performance backend of an e-commerce business and can progressively take ownership of our digital growth ecosystem — WooCommerce, Meta, Google, tracking, analytics, CRO, SEO, Klaviyo, subscriptions and performance marketing. Our business is already established and generating significant recurring subscription revenue. We now want to build a stronger digital growth engine capable of acquiring more profitable customers — particularly weekly and fortnightly subscribers — while improving conversion, retention and measurement. THE INITIAL PROJECT Your first responsibility will be to thoroughly audit our existing digital ecosystem. We want you to identify: What is working What isn't working What has been configured incorrectly Where tracking or attribution is unreliable Where customers are dropping out of the funnel What opportunities we are currently missing What should be prioritised to improve profitable growth Importantly, we don't just want reports telling us there is a problem. We want someone capable of investigating the problem and actually implementing the solution. You will review and work directly with: WooCommerce / WordPress WooCommerce configuration WordPress website WooCommerce Subscriptions Plugins and integrations Checkout and customer journey Subscription purchase flow Mobile conversion Website speed and technical performance Product and category structure Technical issues affecting conversion Tracking implementation Meta Meta Business Manager Meta Ads Manager Meta Pixel Conversion API Events and conversion tracking Attribution Audiences Campaign structure Retargeting Facebook and Instagram ---------- Domain verification Product/catalogue integrations Creative performance and testing Google Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Tag Manager Google Search Console Google Merchant Center Google Ads Conversion tracking Product feeds Search campaigns Shopping/Performance Max where appropriate Organic search performance Klaviyo / Customer Retention Klaviyo integration with WooCommerce Email flows Customer segmentation New-customer journeys Subscription conversion Abandoned cart/checkout Post-purchase Win-back campaigns SMS Deliverability Revenue attribution Opportunities to improve customer LTV Analytics & Measurement We use several sources of business data, including WooCommerce, GA4, Meta, Klaviyo and Metorik. We want someone who understands that platform-reported ROAS is not necessarily the same as incremental business growth. We want to build reliable measurement around: Revenue | New Customers | New Subscribers | CAC | Subscription CAC | Conversion Rate | AOV | LTV | Contribution Margin | ROAS | MER | CTR | CPC | Retention | Churn | Returning Customers | Funnel Performance You should be comfortable reconciling differences between platforms and determining which numbers we can actually trust. THEN WE WANT TO GROW Once our digital foundations and measurement are correct, the role will increasingly focus on profitable growth. Our major growth priority is subscriptions. Paddock 2 Porch offers weekly and fortnightly fruit and vegetable box subscriptions alongside once-off purchases. We don't simply want more website traffic. We want more profitable, long-term customers. You should be capable of looking at our business performance and determining what is preventing growth, developing a hypothesis, testing it and measuring the result. That could involve: Restructuring Meta campaigns Developing a better creative-testing strategy Improving subscription offers Reducing customer acquisition cost Improving landing pages Improving mobile conversion Fixing tracking Improving checkout Developing Google campaigns Improving SEO Improving Klaviyo flows Identifying funnel leakage Improving subscription conversion Improving retention Testing offers Improving attribution Identifying opportunities we haven't considered We want someone who continually asks: "What is stopping this business from acquiring more profitable customers, and what should we test next?" PERFORMANCE MARKETING This role will progressively take significant responsibility for our paid acquisition. You should have genuine hands-on experience with Meta Ads and/or Google Ads for e-commerce businesses. We don't want someone who simply launches campaigns and reports ROAS every month. We want someone who understands: Creative → Click → Landing Page → Checkout → First Purchase → Subscription → Retention → LTV You should understand how all of those components affect the economics of customer acquisition. Our objective is not to maximise advertising spend. Our objective is to profitably scale customer and subscription acquisition. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR You should have genuine hands-on experience with several of the following: WooCommerce | WordPress | Meta Ads | Meta Business Manager | Meta Pixel | Conversion API | Google Ads | GA4 | Google Tag Manager | Search Console | Merchant Center | Klaviyo | Technical SEO | CRO | E-Commerce Analytics | Subscription E-Commerce WooCommerce experience is strongly preferred. Experience with subscription or recurring-revenue businesses is highly desirable. You don't need to be the world's leading expert in every platform. But you do need to understand how these systems connect and work together. We are looking for someone who: Is technically strong and enjoys solving problems Understands e-commerce economics Has genuine hands-on paid advertising experience Is highly analytical Can interpret data rather than simply produce reports Understands CAC and LTV Understands that Meta attribution isn't necessarily reality Can work independently Takes ownership Can identify problems and recommend solutions Is comfortable implementing fixes personally Can clearly explain what they have found and why it matters Documents changes Is organised Is commercially minded Wants to build something over time rather than complete isolated freelance tasks Above all, we want someone who is curious about why the numbers are doing what they're doing. WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This is not primarily: Social media management Posting to Instagram Writing captions Influencer management Graphic design General virtual assistant work Creative will be important to our advertising strategy, and you may help develop creative briefs and analyse creative performance. However, you are being hired primarily to understand, manage and improve the digital growth engine behind the business. THE OPPORTUNITY We are initially looking at approximately a 6-month full-time engagement, with the intention of creating a permanent long-term role for the right person. The first stage will focus heavily on: Audit → Repair → Measurement → Optimisation From there: Testing → Acquisition → Conversion → Subscription Growth → Retention → Scaling You will work directly with the owner and have significant visibility into the actual performance of the business. If you are successful, this role can grow significantly as the business grows. We care much more about capability, initiative, commercial thinking and results than qualifications. HOW TO APPLY Please do not send us a generic application. Start your application by briefly telling us about yourself and your experience. Then answer the following questions. 1. Tell us about a WooCommerce or subscription e-commerce business where you personally worked on performance or technical setup. What did you personally do, and what was the result? 2. You inherit a WooCommerce business where Meta reports strong ROAS, but total business revenue hasn't grown by anything close to the amount Meta claims it generated. How would you investigate whether Meta is actually producing incremental sales? 3. What are the first things you would audit inside Meta Business Manager and Ads Manager for an established e-commerce business? 4. Explain the difference between Meta Pixel tracking and Conversion API in simple terms. 5. An e-commerce business has reasonable website traffic but isn't acquiring enough new customers. Walk us through how you would diagnose the problem. 6. A business sells both once-off purchases and weekly/fortnightly subscriptions. Which customer would you be willing to pay more to acquire, and how would you determine how much more? 7. What are the five most important numbers you would want to see every Monday morning to determine whether an e-commerce business is growing profitably? Explain why you chose each one. 8. Meta ads have produced approximately a 1.0 ROAS recently. You inherit the account tomorrow. What information would you examine before changing anything, and what would determine your first three actions? 9. Which of these platforms would you consider yourself genuinely advanced in? WooCommerce / WordPress / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads / GA4 / GTM / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Klaviyo / Technical SEO / CRO Please rate yourself 1–10 for each one you have used professionally. 10. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position? 11. What country and city are you based in? 12. Please provide examples of e-commerce businesses you have previously worked with. For each example, briefly explain your personal involvement and, where possible, measurable results. 13. If you joined Paddock 2 Porch tomorrow, what information or access would you ask us for during your first week? We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of the digital engine of an established e-commerce business, understand the numbers, fix problems, run intelligent experiments and help us grow profitably.

title: U.S. Accounting Professional
description: Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Hours Immediate Opening We are looking for a full-time accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build a long-term career working with U.S.-based clients. This position is a little different from a typical bookkeeping role, so please read the entire description before applying. What the Role Looks Like For the first 1 to 3 months, a significant part of this position will involve high-volume data entry for one U.S. client. This client processes a large number of transactions, potentially 50 to 100+ invoices per day, across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. You need to be comfortable working accurately and efficiently with this level of volume. We want to be very clear about this upfront. If you dislike repetitive, high-volume transaction entry, this probably isn't the right position for you. However, the position will not stay this way. We are actively working to automate much of this process. Sales and AR activity will eventually flow from ServiceTitan into the accounting system, and AP invoices will increasingly be processed using OCR and automation tools. As those systems are implemented, your role will shift from primarily entering transactions to reviewing transactions, monitoring automated processes, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and working with additional U.S. clients. Our expectation is that this position will eventually support approximately 3 to 5 U.S. clients, starting with our less complicated accounts. As your skills and knowledge grow, there will be opportunities to take on more complex accounting responsibilities. What We're Looking For We would especially like to hear from candidates who have: * 2+ years experience working directly with U.S.-based clients, preferably multiple clients * Strong experience with QuickBooks Online * Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, AP and AR * Experience processing a high volume of invoices or other financial transactions * Strong attention to detail and accuracy * The ability to work efficiently with repetitive tasks without sacrificing quality * Good written and verbal English communication skills * A reliable, high-speed internet connection and dependable home work environment * An interest in learning new accounting systems and technology * A genuine interest in working with and eventually supporting multiple U.S. businesses Experience with ServiceTitan would be a major plus, but it is not required. Work Schedule This is a full-time, 8-hour-per-day position working U.S. hours. Your regular workday will end at 2:00 AM Pacific Time, so please make sure you are comfortable working this schedule on a long-term basis before applying. We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked a night or graveyard schedule for U.S. clients and already know that this schedule works for them. Where This Position Can Go We're not looking for someone just to enter invoices. We're looking for someone who can handle the high-volume work required at the beginning, learn our clients and systems, and then grow into a broader accounting and bookkeeping role. As we automate the repetitive work, we want to give you more responsibility and expose you to additional U.S. clients. For someone who wants to develop their U.S. accounting experience, there is significant room to grow. How to Apply Please submit both of the following: 1. Your resume 2. A short video introduction, approximately 1 minute In your video, please briefly tell us: * Your accounting/bookkeeping background * How much experience you have working with U.S. clients * Your QuickBooks Online experience * The highest volume of invoices or transactions you've handled * Whether you've previously worked a U.S. night/graveyard schedule * Why you're interested in working with more U.S.-based clients Applications without both a resume and video will not be considered.

title: Rostering & Operations Administrator
description: # We’re Hiring: Rostering & Operations Administrator We’re looking for an experienced **NDIS professional** who is highly organised, confident, and an excellent communicator to join our team as a **Rostering & Operations Administrator**. This role goes beyond rostering. You will be responsible for supporting staff, communicating with participants and prospective clients, managing NDIS documentation, coordinating participant onboarding, and helping ensure our daily operations run smoothly. We are looking for someone who is **exceptionally good at communicating in English, naturally builds rapport with people, and knows how to create positive working relationships with both staff and clients.** You must be someone who takes ownership of your work, follows through on commitments, and can be trusted to handle important operational responsibilities. ## What You’ll Do ### Rostering & Staff Coordination * Coordinate and maintain daily rosters for support workers and participants. * Publish accurate and timely rosters. * Manage shift changes, cancellations, call-offs, and urgent coverage requirements. * Communicate roster changes clearly and promptly to staff. * Build strong relationships with support workers and encourage cooperation and shift acceptance. * Follow up on unfilled shifts and roster issues. * Monitor staff availability, leave, attendance, and shift coverage. * Provide roster support on weekends when required. ### Participant Intake & Client Communication * Conduct intake calls with prospective participants and families. * Communicate confidently and professionally with potential clients. * Ask the right questions to understand participant needs, preferences, and service requirements. * Build rapport and make participants and families feel comfortable and listened to. * Assist with participant onboarding and ensure a smooth transition into services. * Prepare and manage Service Agreements, Consent Forms, and other NDIS documentation. * Coordinate information and handovers between participants, staff, rostering, and operations. ### Documentation & Filing * Manage a high volume of complex NDIS and operational documentation. * Maintain accurate and organised electronic filing systems. * Ensure documents are correctly named, filed, and easy to retrieve. * Review participant and operational files for missing, incomplete, or outdated information. * Follow up on outstanding documents. * Maintain confidential and audit-ready records. * Assist with NDIS audit preparation and evidence gathering. ### General Operations Administration * Provide administrative support to the Operations Manager. * Respond to staff and participant enquiries through **Conecteam, RingCentral, and email**. * Maintain accurate operational records. * Track outstanding tasks and follow up with relevant people. * Identify risks, delays, documentation gaps, or service issues and escalate them promptly. * Assist with audit preparation and other operational requirements. ## What We’re Looking For ### Essential * **Previous experience working within the NDIS sector is essential.** * Strong understanding of NDIS services, participant requirements, documentation, and compliance. * Excellent spoken and written **English**. * Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently. * Strong ability to **build rapport and develop positive relationships with support workers, participants, families, and colleagues**. * Confident conducting intake calls with prospective clients. * Strong understanding of NDIS rostering and staff coordination. * Good understanding of the SCHADS Award. * Excellent organisational and administrative skills. * Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling complex documentation. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. * Reliable computer and internet setup. * Availability to work Perth, Western Australia hours. * Availability to provide roster assistance on weekends when required. ## The Person We’re Looking For **You communicate exceptionally well.** You can speak naturally and confidently with Australian staff, participants, and families. Your English is clear, professional, and easy to understand. **You build rapport naturally.** You know how to have a conversation, listen to people, understand their concerns, and build trust. You can be professional without sounding robotic or overly formal. **You are people-oriented.** You understand that rostering isn't just about filling shifts. It is about working with people and maintaining relationships so that staff feel supported and participants receive consistent care. **You are organised.** You can manage rosters, participant documentation, service agreements, intake information, and filing without losing track of details. **You are reliable.** We need someone we can depend on. You follow through, respond promptly, and take responsibility for your work. **You are proactive.** You don't simply wait for instructions. If you notice a problem, missing document, roster gap, or potential risk, you take action or raise it promptly. **You are detail-oriented.** You are comfortable working with complex NDIS documentation and understand that small administrative errors can create larger operational or compliance issues. **You are calm under pressure.** Rostering can change quickly. You can deal with cancellations, staff concerns, urgent requests, and competing priorities while remaining professional and solutions-focused. ## Why Join Us? * Be part of a team supporting people living with disability. * Work across rostering, participant intake, documentation, and operations. * Work closely with the Operations Manager and leadership team. * Develop your NDIS operations and workforce coordination skills. * Opportunity to grow into a broader Operations or Workforce Coordination role. ## Only Apply If You Have What It Takes This is **not a role for someone looking to simply complete tasks and wait for instructions.** We are looking for someone with **real NDIS experience, excellent English, strong people skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to take ownership of their work.** If you are confident you can handle the responsibility, communicate effectively with staff and clients, work under pressure, and consistently deliver high-quality work, **we want to hear from you.** If this does not sound like you, please do not apply.

description: I'm Al DiGirolamo - a licensed Florida real estate broker with 20 years of experience and the founder of the DiGi Wealth Community, a growing online community teaching real estate and options trading. I'm building fast and I need someone who can make my content look and sound as good as the value it delivers. This is a content producer and social media manager role. I show up on camera and record. You turn those recordings into finished content across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, and you manage the entire posting and scheduling workflow. You'll also moderate the community, draft the weekly email newsletter, and help with basic ad creative. If you are a strong video editor who also knows social media, and you want a long-term role with a growing brand, keep reading. WHAT YOU'LL DO — Edit 2 YouTube videos per week (raw footage → finished video, 10-15 min, talking-head format with B-roll text overlays and captions) — Cut 2-3 short clips per video for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts (60-90 seconds, portrait format) — Design 1-2 Instagram carousel posts per week (Canva, brand template) — Write captions for all posts (you draft, I approve) — Schedule and publish all content on time using our social scheduler — Draft the weekly email newsletter from my video content (I edit and approve) — Moderate our online community — welcome new members, flag questions for me, keep things active — Design simple Meta ad creatives when needed (static images, basic Canva) — Track weekly performance: views, follower growth, engagement rate — send me a short summary every Friday WHAT YOU NEED Required: — Strong video editing in CapCut (primary) or DaVinci Resolve / Premiere — Canva proficiency (carousels, thumbnails, ad creatives) — Experience managing and scheduling content on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn — Strong written English — captions and newsletters will sound like you wrote them, not a template — Reliable internet. Consistent schedule. Communicates proactively if something is delayed. Nice to have: — Experience with GHL (GoHighLevel) for scheduling or community management — Background working with real estate, finance, or education brands — Experience cutting content for creator-style channels (talking head, educational) WHAT THIS IS NOT — This is not a graphic design role. The brand template exists. You work within it. — This is not a content strategy role. I set the direction. You execute. — This is not a 9-to-5. You work your own hours as long as deadlines are met. HOURS AND PAY 20-25 hours per week to start. This grows as the brand grows. Rate is $8-14/hour depending on your experience and test task quality. Pay is weekly via the platform. HOW TO APPLY Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with: 1. A brief intro — who you are and why this role fits you (3-5 sentences, no templates) 2. 1-2 examples of YouTube videos you have edited (links, not files) 3. 1-2 examples of social media content you have created or managed (links or screenshots) Applications without examples will not be reviewed. Top candidates will receive a paid test task ($25 one-time) before a final decision.

title: Sales Development Representative
description: Sales Development Representative – North America & Europe Location: Remote – Philippines-based preferred Employment: Part-time initially, approximately 4–5 hours per day, with the opportunity to increase hours based on performance and seasonal demand Working hours: Scheduled shifts aligned with North American afternoon and evening hours, including rotating coverage where required About Outdoor Norway Outdoor Norway is a premium adventure travel company based in Voss, in the heart of Fjord Norway. We create and operate unforgettable outdoor experiences—from daily adventures to multi-day journeys—with a strong commitment to safety, sustainability, quality and meaningful human connection. As we expand across Europe, North America and Asia, we are strengthening our commercial team so that every inquiry receives a fast, personal and professional response. Role Purpose The Sales Development Representative is the first commercial contact for potential Outdoor Norway guests. The mission is to respond quickly, speak directly with prospective guests, understand their needs, qualify their purchase potential and create momentum toward a booking. This is not initially an itinerary-building or closing role. Once an inquiry is properly qualified, it will be handed over to an experienced Sales Specialist who will prepare the itinerary, package or final proposal. The position offers a potential development path into Sales Executive responsibilities after strong performance and sufficient product knowledge, normally requiring six to twelve months of development. Key Responsibilities Rapid Lead Response Monitor new inquiries from the website, marketing campaigns, email and HubSpot CRM. Make the first contact attempt within five minutes for leads received during scheduled working hours. Prioritize telephone contact, supported by professional written follow-up. Maintain consistent follow-up until the lead advances, enters remarketing or is correctly disqualified. Work scheduled hours that allow contact with North American guests during suitable after-work periods. Lead Qualification Understand the guest’s travel dates, destination interests, group profile, budget, preferred activities and readiness to book. Identify whether the inquiry relates to FIT travellers, families, couples, groups, corporate clients, schools or universities. Assign the correct CRM status: Qualified: Genuine purchase potential with a clear requirement or next step. Remarketing: Interested but not yet ready to proceed. Disqualified: No longer interested, opted out, invalid or not a suitable fit. Identify special requirements, commercial opportunities, risks and urgent requests before handover. Sales Handover Transfer qualified inquiries promptly to the appropriate Sales Specialist. Provide a complete handover containing requirements, communication history, priorities, concerns and the agreed next step. Schedule the next sales conversation whenever appropriate. Remain responsible for CRM accuracy after the opportunity is handed over. HubSpot and Data Quality Complete every mandatory CRM property before changing a lead’s stage. Log calls, emails, notes, outcomes and next actions on the same working day. Keep lead ownership, status, source, activity history and follow-up dates accurate. Maintain a clear distinction between pre-sales inquiries, existing-booking support and other general requests. Follow Outdoor Norway’s privacy and GDPR procedures. Cross-Department Collaboration Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Support. Share feedback with Marketing regarding campaign quality and common guest questions. Request operational or product clarification when needed. Participate in product and destination training. Performance Measures Percentage of in-shift inquiries contacted within five minutes. Contact and conversation rate. Inquiry-to-qualified-lead conversion. Quality and accuracy of qualification. Speed and completeness of sales handovers. CRM completeness and same-day activity logging. Follow-up discipline and overdue-action rate. Contribution of qualified opportunities to completed bookings. Internal feedback from Sales, Marketing and Operations. Required Qualifications Excellent spoken and written English. Confident, warm and professional telephone communication. Experience in sales development, pre-sales, telesales, customer service, hospitality or travel. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Comfortable working with CRM systems; HubSpot experience is preferred. Reliable internet connection with electricity backup and a professional remote-working environment. Ability to work independently during North American coverage hours. Preferred Qualifications Experience serving North American or European customers. Background in tourism, adventure travel, hospitality or experience-based services. Experience qualifying inbound digital marketing leads. Additional languages are an advantage. Personal Attributes Proactive and comfortable taking ownership. Energetic and confident when making telephone calls. Service-minded and genuinely interested in people. Persistent without being aggressive. Calm and professional under pressure. Highly disciplined with follow-up and CRM administration. Curious, coachable and eager to develop into a broader sales role. Why Join Outdoor Norway? Be part of a purpose-driven adventure company Work with meaningful products that inspire people Grow into Sales, Account Management, or Revenue roles Collaborate with an international, passionate team Opportunity work remotely

title: Halloween 2026 Dropshipping Specialist
description: I’m planning to launch and grow a dropshipping business on Shopify for the upcoming Halloween season, and I’m looking for an experienced freelancer to work with me on the project. I’m looking for someone who understands dropshipping and can help turn product ideas into real sales opportunities in the US market. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON • Research the US market and identify promising Halloween products • Analyze trends, customer demand, competitors, pricing, and offers • Find products with good potential for dropshipping • Evaluate products based on demand, competition, pricing, and profit potential • Help select products to test in the Shopify store • Set up and optimize product pages and offers • Research and develop marketing angles for different products • Create product testing strategies • Manage and optimize Meta/Facebook Ads and/or Google Ads • Test different audiences, creatives, products, and offers • Monitor advertising performance and sales data • Identify winning products and campaigns • Recommend when to improve, pause, or scale campaigns • Continuously look for new Halloween product opportunities WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR I’m not looking for someone who simply uploads products and runs ads. I want someone who understands the full dropshipping process: Product Research → Market Analysis → Store → Creative → Advertising → Data → Sales The ideal candidate should be able to research independently, understand the numbers, identify opportunities, and explain why a product or campaign is worth testing. REQUIREMENTS • Previous dropshipping or e-commerce experience • Shopify experience • Experience with product research • Experience with competitor and market research • Experience with Meta/Facebook Ads and/or Google Ads • Ability to analyze advertising and sales data • Understanding of the US market is strongly preferred • Good communication and problem-solving skills • Able to work independently and meet deadlines HALLOWEEN EXPERIENCE IS A PLUS Experience with Halloween, Christmas, Black Friday, or other seasonal e-commerce campaigns is highly preferred, but not required. ABOUT THE PROJECT The initial focus will be the Halloween 2026 season. If we work well together and the project performs well, I’m interested in continuing the collaboration for future seasonal campaigns and other e-commerce projects. This is a paid freelance position. HOW TO APPLY Please answer the following: 1. How much dropshipping/e-commerce experience do you have? 2. How much Shopify experience do you have? 3. How do you normally research winning products? 4. What experience do you have with Meta Ads or Google Ads? 5. Have you worked with the US market before? 6. Tell me about one successful e-commerce or dropshipping project you worked on. 7. What was your role and what results did you achieve? 8. How many hours per week are you available? 9. What is your expected hourly rate? Please include examples of your previous work or relevant experience.

title: WANTED! The World's Most Relentless Remote Local SEO Specialist
job_title: WANTED! The World's Most Relentless Remote Local SEO Specialist
description: When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: "I actually read the instructions." WHO WE ARE We are ChiroX. We are a small, sharp search marketing agency that does one thing: we get chiropractic practices in front of people who are in pain and searching for help right now. Google Ads, SEO, Google Business Profile, landing pages, websites. That's it. We say no to everything else. We are US-based, headquartered in Austin, Texas, with a team spread across four countries. Small on purpose. Everybody here owns something real, nobody is a seat filler, and there is no layer of management between you and the person who runs the company (that's me, Corey). Our clients are established practices doing seven figures a year. They are smart, busy, skeptical business owners who can tell the difference between activity and results. So can we. Take a look: ---------- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We need someone to own SEO for our client practices. This is a remote (work-from-home) contract position. Right now we have a practice in Fayetteville, Arkansas that should be dominating its local market and isn't. That's your first problem to solve. From there you'd take on more of our client sites, one at a time, as you prove out. You will not be grinding out audits nobody reads. You will pick the two or three things that actually move a local practice up the map pack, spec them clearly, hand them to our developer, and then explain to a chiropractor in plain English why it worked. We also care a lot about AI search. Patients are asking ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews who the best chiropractor near them is, and we want our clients to be the answer. If you have been teaching yourself AEO, you are exactly who we want to talk to. WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO Own the SEO roadmap for each client site you're assigned, starting with one. Run a monthly cycle per site: technical check, on-page work on two priority pages, internal linking, local and Google Business Profile signal review. Set the keyword and content targets that feed our existing blog pipeline. Build the AEO layer: schema, entity consistency, and content structured so AI search engines cite it. Write the SEO section of each client's monthly report in language a chiropractor understands, not language an SEO understands. WHAT WE ACTUALLY NEED YOU TO BE GOOD AT Local SEO for service businesses. Dentists, med spas, law firms, HVAC, physical therapy, veterinary, home services. Any of it. We do NOT require chiropractic experience and honestly we don't care if you have it. Diagnosing why a site isn't ranking and being able to say which single fix you'd do first, and why. Writing page copy that reads like a human wrote it for a patient. Explaining technical things to non-technical people without condescending. Being genuinely curious about AI search, whether or not you're an expert yet. You do not need a degree, a certification, an agency background, or ten years of experience. We will trade all of that for someone sharp, hungry, and honest. PAY AND GROWTH SEO ownership starts at $250 USD per client site per month. Each new site also includes a one-time $300 audit and 90-day roadmap fee. You start with one site so we can both find our footing, and add sites as fast as you're comfortable. Bonus: $150 every time a designated primary keyword breaks into the top three, organic or map pack. Twice per site per quarter. Rate moves to $325 per site once two clients hold a top-three term for 60 days. You get first right of refusal on every new client site we sign. The path from here is SEO Lead, owning our whole fulfillment queue. We pay on time, every time, and we cover the transfer fees. Payoneer, Wise, or PayPal, whichever works where you live. WHO TENDS TO DO WELL HERE There's never one right way to do a job, but patterns show up. The people who thrive in this role are stubborn about evidence. They'd rather tell you a hard truth than a comfortable story. They get genuinely irritated by a page that should rank and doesn't, and they don't let it go. They're organized without being rigid, and they'd rather ask a blunt question than guess. What energizes them: a problem nobody's cracked yet, being trusted to decide, seeing a number move because of something they did. MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH THIS I'd rather scare you off now than disappoint you in month two. Remote work. If you don't have a quiet space with reliable power and internet, this isn't the right role. You will not have publish access to our sites. You spec the change, our developer implements it. If you need your hands on the code yourself, you'll hate this. Chiropractic is a slow, boring, regulated vertical. No viral plays, no linkbait. It's health content, so every claim needs a real citation. SEO results are slow and our clients are impatient. You will be asked to explain an eight-week lag to a frustrated business owner. More than once. Flat rate per site means some months are lighter and some are heavier. It averages out. If that variance would stress you, say so now. We're US Central time. You don't need to work our hours, but we need a few hours of overlap for questions. Every offer starts with a 60-day trial so we can both be sure. If you're in a stable job, please don't quit it until you're confident in this one. OUR VALUES Truth. We are data-driven marketers and data is truth. If something isn't working, we tell the client before they find out. If we make a mistake, we're the first to raise it. If we don't know, we say so and then go find out. If we disagree with each other, we say that too. Strategic pushback is not just allowed here, it's the job. Ownership. Nobody here says "that's not my job." If you see something broken, you either fix it or you flag it. We'd rather you overstep than stay quiet. Care. Our clients are real people who put their savings into a practice and hire staff and worry about payroll. When we get it right, someone in pain finds them. That's worth taking seriously. TO APPLY Please send the following: A link to your resume as a PDF, named exactly: Lastname.Firstname.SEO.pdf A short note on your local SEO experience and why you think you'd be good at this. One example of a local business you helped rank, what the problem was, and what you did about it. Two paragraphs is plenty. Your answer to this: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why? Your answer to this: "Work is love made visible." - Khalil Gibran. What does that mean to you? Send it all to: ---------- CLOSE We're eager to find the right person and we'll move quickly for the right one. If anything about this role or these instructions doesn't make sense, just ask. Include your question in your application and I'll answer it. Looking forward to reading yours. Corey Founder, ChiroX

title: Supplier Relations & Procurement Specialist
description: **About TrueBridge Logistics** TrueBridge Logistics LLC is a U.S.-based procurement, sourcing, and supply-chain company serving government and commercial customers. We work with manufacturers and distributors to source products and develop reliable supplier relationships. We are seeking a Supplier Relations & Procurement Specialist to support our growing government-contracting operations. **About the Role** In this role, you will communicate with U.S. manufacturers and distributors to obtain product pricing, availability, lead times, freight information, and other information needed for supplier quotations. You will send requests for quotation (RFQs), make outbound supplier calls, follow up on outstanding requests, review incoming quotes for completeness, and maintain accurate sourcing records. This is not a general Virtual Assistant or data-entry position. A significant part of this role involves outbound telephone communication. You should genuinely enjoy speaking with people, building professional relationships, and following up persistently. Management retains final supplier selection, government bid pricing, bid submission, purchasing authorization, and compliance decisions. **What You'll Do** - Prepare and send RFQs to manufacturers and distributors. - Make outbound telephone calls to U.S. suppliers. - Follow up consistently on unanswered quote requests and supplier commitments. - Obtain pricing, availability, lead times, freight charges, and other required quote information. - Review supplier quotes for completeness and request missing information. - Maintain accurate records of supplier communications, quotes, follow-up dates, and next actions. - Update sourcing opportunities in TrueBridge's procurement systems. - Prepare complete sourcing information for management review. - Assist with supplier and distributor account applications and documentation. - Build and maintain professional, long-term relationships with supplier representatives. **What We're Looking For** The ideal candidate: - Speaks and writes fluent, professional English. - Is confident and comfortable making outbound business calls. - Enjoys communicating with people and developing professional relationships. - Is persistent, resourceful, and comfortable following up multiple times when necessary. - Is organized and able to manage multiple open requests and deadlines. - Has excellent attention to detail and follow-through. - Can work independently while following established procedures. - Uses good judgment and knows when an issue should be escalated. Experience in B2B customer service, outbound calling, inside sales, procurement/purchasing, supplier or vendor relations, account management, logistics, supply-chain coordination, or a BPO/call-center environment is preferred. Previous U.S. government-contracting or Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) experience is helpful but not required. Training on TrueBridge's processes and systems will be provided. **Schedule & Compensation** This is a part-time position working: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET) 20 hours per week $7.00 USD per hour Training is paid. Applicants must be able to consistently work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule and have reliable high-speed internet, a computer, and a quiet professional environment suitable for business calls. This position is intended to be a long-term opportunity. As TrueBridge grows, there may be opportunities for additional hours, increased responsibilities, advancement, and compensation growth based on performance and business needs. **How to Apply** Please submit: - Your current résumé/CV. - A 2-3 minute voice recording introducing yourself and briefly describing your experience communicating with customers, suppliers, prospects, or businesses by telephone. Please also explain why you believe you would be successful in a position requiring regular outbound business calls and persistent follow-up. - Confirmation that you are available to consistently work Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET). Candidates selected to move forward will be invited to a virtual interview.

title: Meta Ads & E-commerce Creative Specialist – Shopify Brands
job_title: Meta Ads & E-commerce Creative Specialist – Shopify Brands
description: We are looking for a Meta Ads & E-commerce Creative Specialist to help manage advertising for our e-commerce clients. You will be responsible for creating high-converting ad creatives with the help of AI tools such as ChatGPT, preparing different creative angles, launching the ads inside Meta Ads Manager, and monitoring performance. We work mainly with Shopify e-commerce brands, so experience with direct-response advertising and understanding what makes people click and buy is very important. What you will do Create Meta ad creatives for our e-commerce clients Use ChatGPT and AI image tools to develop: Static ads UGC-style creatives Testimonial ads Review / social proof ads Before & after concepts Comparison ads Problem-solution ads Offer ads Ingredient / benefit ads Create multiple different hooks and creative angles for each product Make sure ads are designed for Meta, mainly in 4:5 format Use product images and brand guidelines correctly Write short ad copy, headlines and CTAs Upload creatives into Meta Ads Manager Build and launch campaigns, ad sets and ads Check tracking, pixel and conversion events Monitor metrics such as: CPA ROAS CTR CPC CPM Conversion rate Identify winning and losing creatives Create new variations based on performance Keep campaigns organized and clearly named Give short weekly updates on performance What we are looking for You should have experience with: Meta Ads Manager Facebook and Instagram advertising E-commerce advertising Shopify brands Creative testing Direct-response marketing Canva or similar design software ChatGPT / AI tools Basic ad performance analysis You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but you must understand what makes an e-commerce ad convert. We are especially looking for someone who understands that good advertising is not just about making something look nice. You need to understand: Hook → Problem / Desire → Product → Benefit → Proof → CTA Very important We do not want 20 ads that all look the same. You should be able to create clearly different creative concepts such as: UGC Lifestyle Product-focused Reviews Trust / social proof Before & after Comparison Educational Problem-aware Benefit-focused Offer-focused The goal is to give Meta enough creative diversity to find winning ads. Examples of your weekly work For one product, you may be asked to create: 5 different ad angles 3–5 creatives per angle Different hooks and layouts Launch them in Meta Monitor results Pause poor performers Create iterations of winners You will work with us using AI to speed up creative production. Who you are You are: Reliable Fast Detail-oriented Comfortable working independently Willing to learn Interested in e-commerce Able to follow brand guidelines Able to communicate clearly in English Experience working with an agency is a plus. Tools we use Meta Ads Manager Shopify ChatGPT Canva Google Drive Google Sheets Slack / WhatsApp Other AI creative tools Working arrangement This is a long-term position. We are looking for someone who can grow with our agency and eventually manage advertising for multiple e-commerce clients. Hours can start part-time and increase as we bring on more clients. Starting hours: [10–20 hours per week] Working days: Monday–Friday Salary: Based on experience There is room for increased hours and salary when you prove you can independently create, launch and optimize profitable campaigns. How to apply Please send: A short introduction about yourself Your experience with Meta Ads Your experience with e-commerce brands Examples of Meta ads or creatives you have made Screenshots or examples of campaigns you have managed Which Meta metrics you normally look at when deciding whether to pause an ad Your expected hourly/monthly salary Important: Start your application with the words: “CREATIVE TESTING” Applications without these words will not be considered. Extra application test Please answer this question: An e-commerce product has been running with 5 similar static ads. CTR is low and CPA is too high. What would you test next? Keep your answer short. And send to my whatsapp ---------- Regards, Niels Jansen Nextconvert E-commerce agency

title: Supplier & Production Coordinator
description: Anima is a premium wellness brand. We design crystal sets, candles and incense, sold on Amazon across the US, UK, Europe and Canada. Our products are made by around 11 suppliers in China and India, and we usually have many orders in production at once. We're a small, fast-moving team that works with AI in everything we do, with high standards, looking for a long-term team member. THE ROLE Right now the two founders read and manage every supplier message themselves. We want you to take that over. You become the person who knows the status of every order, every sample and every open issue, keeps the factories moving, and tells us clearly what needs our attention. Decisions, negotiations and pricing stay with the founders. Your job is to make sure nothing slips and nothing surprises us, six days a week, with flexibility on when you check in but never on whether you do. Day to day you will: - Read and manage all supplier messages daily on WeChat, reply on routine matters, and escalate anything that needs a founder - Keep one master status sheet of all orders, samples, payments due and shipping dates, updated every day - Follow up with factories on timelines and confirmations; chase before deadlines, not after - Send a short daily report in Slack: what moved, what's at risk, what needs a decision - Collect and organise supplier documents (quotes, PIs, invoices, packing lists, photos) into our shared drive - Use AI tools daily to summarise threads, draft follow-ups, translate, and keep reports sharp - Coordinate handoffs with our logistics and finance teammates in Slack YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU HAVE - 2+ years supporting suppliers, sourcing or production for an ecommerce or Amazon brand - Fluent, natural written English (you'll write to us and to factories daily) - Real working experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) as part of your daily workflow, not just occasionally - Serious organisation: you keep a tracker current without being asked, and you never lose a thread - Proactive communication: you flag problems early, in plain language - Comfort with WeChat, Slack, Google Sheets and Drive Strong plus: experience working with Chinese factories, and with packaging, gifting, candles or mineral products. ENGAGEMENT Fully remote, long-term, paid monthly. This role is less about hours and more about being on top of it, all the time. Suppliers message at any hour, and the job is to be the reliable bridge between them and the founders. That means checking WeChat and Slack several times a day, every day, six days a week (Monday to Saturday) as a minimum. Sundays can be off, but a light check-in on Sundays is a real plus. Total time is realistically around 1-2 hours a day spread across the day, not a single block. We'll calibrate the exact hours together in the first weeks based on the real workload. If you need fixed office hours or can't check messages on a Saturday, this isn't the right role. If you like being the person who always knows what's going on and keeps everything moving, it is. All internal communication runs on Slack. IMPORTANT: you must be independent. No commissions or payments from any supplier, and no existing relationship with our current suppliers. This goes in the contract. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word JADE so we know you read this. Then answer these three things, briefly and in your own words: 1. A scenario. A supplier tells you on WeChat that our order will be 10 days late because of a raw-material shortage. Write the exact reply you would send to the supplier, and the exact message you would post to the founders in Slack. 2. Your system. In 3-5 sentences, how would you track 11 suppliers and 20 open orders so nothing is missed, and where does AI fit into your setup? 3. Your background. Which brands or products have you done this for, and with factories in which regions?

title: B2B Sales Closer – Corporate Stress & Health Program
job_title: B2B Sales Closer – Corporate Stress & Health Program
description: Location: Remote, U.S.-based Hours: U.S. business hours Employment Type: Contract About the Role We are seeking an experienced B2B Sales Closer to own the full sales cycle for a corporate Stress & Health/EAP program designed to help organizations improve employee wellbeing while addressing the business costs associated with workplace stress. This is a hands-on closing role for a proven sales professional who is comfortable speaking with business owners, HR leaders, benefits teams, and enterprise decision-makers. You will manage opportunities from initial discovery through product demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and close. What You'll Do: Own the full B2B sales cycle from discovery through closing. Conduct consultative discovery calls to understand an organization's workforce, challenges, and employee wellbeing priorities. Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to the prospect's needs. Develop and present pricing proposals and navigate negotiations. Build the business case around both employee wellbeing and measurable business impact, including reduced absenteeism, disengagement, and "quiet quitting." Manage fast-moving SMB opportunities as well as longer, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles. Build relationships with CEOs, HR leaders, benefits professionals, and other key stakeholders. Maintain accurate pipeline activity, follow-ups, and deal progression. Represent the client professionally as an extension of their internal sales organization. About the Product The program uses a tiered, per-employee pricing model, beginning at approximately $95 per employee, with volume discounts available. The offering also includes Stress Coach Course credentials, typically provided at a ratio of approximately one credential per 15–20 employees. The sales process includes two primary deal profiles: SMB: 10–100 employees, typically with a CEO or owner as the primary decision-maker. Shorter sales cycles and faster closes. Enterprise: 10,000+ employees, involving multiple stakeholders and longer, committee-driven decision processes. What We're Looking For Proven experience closing B2B sales. Strong consultative and discovery-based selling skills. Experience selling to business owners, HR, benefits, or executive-level decision-makers. Ability to communicate both emotional/value-driven and financial/business cases. Comfortable managing both transactional and complex enterprise sales cycles. Excellent presentation, negotiation, follow-up, and relationship-building skills. Self-directed and comfortable working remotely. Track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. Why This Opportunity This is an opportunity for an experienced closer to represent a compelling corporate wellbeing solution without the constraints of a traditional full-time sales position. You'll become an extension of the client's team, leveraging your existing sales expertise to generate meaningful business results while helping organizations address one of today's most significant workplace challenges: employee stress and wellbeing.

title: Luxury Jewelry & Fashion Commercial Video Editor – Cinematic ReelsPart Time
job_title: Luxury Jewelry & Fashion Commercial Video Editor – Cinematic ReelsPart Time

We create short premium advertising videos featuring a model wearing jewelry. The footage is created with reference commercials from established jewelry and fashion brands as visual inspiration. You will receive organized raw footage containing multiple takes of individual scenes. Your job will be to select the best takes and create finished 10–20 second commercial reels with a polished, premium look. We are looking for an editor who understands: luxury and premium visual style jewelry and fashion advertising cinematic commercial editing pacing and rhythm professional color grading natural and attractive skin tones correct presentation of jewelry, metal, stones and small product details music synchronization sound design clean and effective transitions premium brand aesthetics commercial storytelling in short-form video The editing style should adapt to the specific concept and footage. Please apply only if you can show relevant work in at least one of the following areas: jewelry fashion beauty luxury products cosmetics premium product advertising commercial brand videos cinematic product videos Please include links to your 3 best and most relevant video examples.
