title: SENIOR GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER / HEAD OF GROWTH
job_title: SENIOR GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER / HEAD OF GROWTH
description: # SENIOR GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER / HEAD OF GROWTH **Full-Time | Remote | Singapore-Based Company | Singapore, Malaysia & Asia Markets** We are looking for an **exceptional marketer — not an average marketing executive.** This role is for someone who genuinely understands how to **build, grow and scale a brand**. You should be able to look at a business, understand the products, customers, competitors and numbers, then build a clear marketing strategy to increase **traffic, conversion, revenue, customer retention and brand growth**. We are not looking for someone who simply waits for tasks, schedules posts or follows instructions. We want someone who can **think, strategize, execute, analyse and improve.** ## WHAT YOU WILL OWN You will take ownership of our overall marketing and growth across: * Shopify * TikTok Shop * Shopee * Lazada * Meta / Facebook / Instagram * TikTok * Email / CRM * Affiliate & Creator Marketing * Influencer Marketing * Product Launches * Paid Advertising * Organic Content * Promotions & Campaigns * Customer Retention * Singapore, Malaysia and expansion into other Asian markets ## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You will be expected to: * Build the monthly, quarterly and annual marketing strategy. * Create a proper marketing calendar months ahead. * Plan campaigns, launches, promotions and sales periods. * Develop paid advertising strategies across Meta and TikTok. * Understand creative testing, hooks, offers, audiences and funnels. * Analyse ROAS, CAC, AOV, CVR, CTR, retention and other key growth metrics. * Identify why sales are increasing or declining and know what action to take. * Improve Shopify conversion and customer journey. * Grow TikTok Shop, Shopee and Lazada performance. * Build strong affiliate and creator programs. * Identify new marketing opportunities before being asked. * Research competitors and market trends across Singapore, Malaysia and Asia. * Work closely with designers and video editors to produce high-performing creatives. * Write strong creative briefs rather than simply saying, “We need more content.” * Plan product launches from pre-launch to launch and post-launch. * Build strategies for customer acquisition, repeat purchases and retention. * Track marketing performance and provide clear recommendations based on data. * Test aggressively, learn quickly and continuously improve. * Take responsibility for results. ## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR You are someone who: * Has a strong track record in **e-commerce and growth marketing**. * Understands both **brand building and performance marketing**. * Can show examples of brands, campaigns or businesses you have helped grow. * Understands numbers and makes decisions using data. * Knows how Meta Ads and TikTok Ads actually work. * Understands Shopify and e-commerce conversion. * Understands TikTok Shop, Shopee and/or Lazada. * Knows how to build campaigns around major sales periods and product launches. * Has excellent marketing instincts. * Can identify problems without waiting for management to point them out. * Is highly resourceful and learns fast. * Can work independently while leading and collaborating with a team. * Communicates clearly. * Takes ownership instead of making excuses. * Thinks commercially — not just creatively. Most importantly, you should be able to answer: **“If I gave you a good product today, how would you turn it into a successful brand?”** ## THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF You mainly: * Schedule social media posts. * Wait to be told what to do. * Depend completely on AI to create your strategies. * Cannot interpret marketing data. * Have never been responsible for revenue or growth. * Only know one marketing channel. * Copy competitors instead of developing original strategies. * Need constant supervision. * Send reports without explaining what the numbers actually mean. We use AI extensively within the company, and we expect you to use AI intelligently too — but **AI should amplify your talent, not replace your ability to think.** ## WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE Within your first few months, we expect you to: * Understand the business and customer deeply. * Establish a clear growth strategy. * Build a structured campaign calendar. * Identify major opportunities and weaknesses. * Improve our advertising and creative testing process. * Establish clear marketing KPIs and reporting. * Generate new ideas for customer acquisition and retention. * Build systems that allow the company to scale. We want someone who eventually knows the marketing side of the business so well that management does not need to constantly chase, remind or micromanage. ## HOW TO APPLY Please do **not** send us a generic copy-and-paste application. Start your application with: **“I BUILD GROWTH.”** Then send us: 1. A short introduction about yourself. 2. Your strongest marketing achievement. 3. Actual numbers/results from a campaign or brand you worked on. 4. Which platforms you are strongest in. 5. A brand or e-commerce business you personally helped grow and exactly what you did. 6. An example of a marketing campaign you created from strategy to execution. 7. Your experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Shopee and Lazada. 8. Your current availability and expected monthly salary. 9. Portfolio, case studies or supporting screenshots where available. **Final question:** Imagine you join a sports, nutrition and performance lifestyle brand selling in Singapore and Malaysia. You have **90 days to significantly grow revenue.** **What are the first 5 things you would do, and why?** We will prioritise applicants who give a thoughtful, commercially strong answer backed by real experience. ### THE PERSON WE WANT We are not hiring someone simply to “do marketing.” We are looking for someone with the potential to become a **key growth leader in the company** — someone who understands the vision, owns the numbers, builds the strategy and helps take the brand to the next level. If you are genuinely exceptional at marketing and want the opportunity to prove what you can do, we want to hear from you.

title: Inside Sales Advisor — Consultative Closer (Phone-Based)
description: About Us: Access Computer Training is a Florida-based, CIE-licensed technical training school with 12+ years in operation and 700+ graduates who have launched careers in IT, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Office Admin, and Project Management. Most of our students train through workforce grant funding, Vocational Rehabilitation, or VA benefits — so they don't pay out of pocket. Students who don't qualify for funding can self-pay in full or finance their training through Fortify, so there's a path for nearly every applicant we talk to. Job Summary: > We're hiring a closer, not a coordinator. You'll be on the phone with US-based leads who've already raised their hand for career training — your job is to qualify them fast, walk them through their funding options, handle objections, and get the enrollment agreement signed. > This is a sales role with a script foundation, not a scripted read-and-recite job — we need someone who can hear resistance and work it, not just push through a call flow. What you'll actually do: > Outbound and inbound calls to warm leads (not cold prospecting — these people already inquired) > Qualify leads against 4 funding paths in the first 5 minutes of a call > Run consultation calls and close on a signed enrollment agreement > Handle real objections — cost, timing, "I need to think about it," "I already talked to someone else" — without going off-script into guesses > Log every call and follow-up in our CRM (GoHighLevel) same-day, no exceptions How we actually run a call: We're not a hard-sell operation. Every real ACT call starts the same way: find out where this person actually is — their current skills, education, work history — and where they genuinely want to go, before naming a single program. Funding options get matched to their situation, not pitched as a one-size script. You'll still need to close — get to a signed enrollment agreement, handle real objections, keep a deal from going cold — but the close has to sit on top of real listening, not replace it. If your instinct is to pitch first and ask questions later, this isn't the right role, no matter how good you are at closing. You're a strong fit if: > You lead with genuine curiosity about a stranger's situation before you pitch anything — and you can still close once you understand what they actually need > You have real phone-sales closing experience — outbound sales, telemarketing, insurance sales (not claims/service), timeshare, solar, BPO sales campaigns, or similar > You're comfortable being told "no" multiple times a day and staying warm anyway > Your spoken English is clear and confident on a live call, not just written English > You've worked with a CRM before and you update it without being chased > You can commit to a graveyard shift — this is a US Eastern-time role This is not a fit if: // Your background is customer service, data entry, chat support, or general VA work with no sales/closing component // You've done appointment-setting but have never actually closed the deal yourself // You're looking for a quiet admin role — this is a talk-to-strangers-on-the-phone-all-day role To apply — this step is required, not optional: >> Send a 60-second voice recording (phone memo is fine) responding to this exact objection, as if you were on a live call: "I already talked to another school and I'm not sure yours is any different." >> We're listening for how you actually sound on a call, not for a perfect script (and your way of handling the objection stated above) >> Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. Compensation: $7.00 USD/hour base + performance bonus per enrollment, paid once your enrolled student reaches 40% course completion: == Enrollments 1–5 each month: $25 flat, each == Enrollments 6–9 each month: 2% of base tuition, each (programs range $5,000–$7,500, so roughly $100–$150 per enrollment at this tier) == Enrollments 10+ each month: 5% of base tuition, each (roughly $250–$375 per enrollment at this tier) *Bonus tier is locked in once you reach it that month — it doesn't drop if a student later withdraws for reasons outside your control *Enrollment count resets every calendar month *HOURS: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (this is a 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippines time shift)

title: PROJECT MANAGER / INTEGRATOR FOR FOUNDER-LED BUSINESS

description: PROJECT MANAGER / INTEGRATOR FOR FOUNDER-LED BUSINESS Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term 20 hours/week to start | $10-$15 USD/hour depending on experience ABOUT THE ROLE I am Bari, the founder of a growing relationship coaching and education company with multiple marketing, sales, content, launch, website and client projects moving at the same time. I am looking for a strong Project Manager / Integrator / Operations Coordinator who can take ownership of the entire operating picture. This is NOT a task-based VA role. This is NOT a role where I tell you what to do every day. This is NOT primarily a social media role. I need someone whose job is to know what is happening so I do not have to. I am a fast-moving, creative founder and thought leader. I generate ideas, content and opportunities quickly. Your strength should be turning that vision into an organized, executable plan and making sure the work actually gets across the finish line. WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS IN THIS ROLE If we have a launch six weeks away, you know what needs to happen this week, next week and the week after - and who owns every piece. If a team member misses a deadline, you notice and follow up. If a social post is scheduled and fails, you notice before I do and make sure it gets resolved. If a banner, link or page is outdated, you notice before I do. If I owe the team an article, video, approval, client story or decision, you tell me clearly what you need, why you need it and by when - and make sure it is on my calendar. If something is blocked, you solve what you can and escalate only what genuinely requires me. I should not have to ask, "What happened with that?" Your operating standard should be: See it -> own it -> communicate it -> solve it -> close the loop. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES - Own and maintain the master project plan and one source of truth for the business. - Turn meetings, conversations, WhatsApp messages and founder ideas into clear tasks, owners, priorities and deadlines. - Build realistic project plans and backward-plan launches from the launch date. - Track dependencies, deadlines and deliverables across multiple team members. - Follow up without waiting for me to ask. - Maintain a simple weekly priorities process. - Keep a highly visible "Founder Owes" list and put my deadlines on my calendar. - Coordinate writers, designers, social media support, technical contractors and VAs. - Identify gaps and risks before they become emergencies. - Verify that completed work is actually live, tested and working. - Make sure important work is fully closed out, not simply marked complete. - Give me a concise weekly executive update: wins, priorities, risks, what I owe, and no more than three decisions needed from me. - Help protect my time so I can focus on thought leadership, content, relationships, sales, coaching and client delivery. FOUNDER / THOUGHT LEADER EXPERIENCE Experience working directly with a founder, thought leader, coach, consultant, educator or other fast-moving creative entrepreneur is a strong plus. You should understand that your role is not to make the founder become the project manager. Your role is to create clarity around the founder, translate ideas into execution, and keep the rest of the team moving. LAUNCH EXPERIENCE Experience personally project-managing launches is strongly preferred. Examples may include: - Courses or coaching programs - Workshops, webinars or live events - Quiz or assessment funnels - Websites or landing pages - Email campaigns - Product or service launches You should understand how to work backward from a launch date, identify major workstreams and dependencies, establish approval deadlines, coordinate multiple contributors, flag risks early, and make sure everything is tested before launch. THE PERSON I AM LOOKING FOR You are naturally organized, proactive and accountable. You do not just know project-management terminology. You have actually managed projects involving multiple people, deadlines and dependencies. You are comfortable respectfully holding people accountable. You do not assume that because someone said, "I'll do it," it got done. You check. You communicate clearly, concisely and professionally. You can work with a creative, ADHD founder without requiring the founder to become the project manager. You understand the difference between: "I completed my task" and "I made sure the outcome happened." SYSTEMS We currently use tools including: - ClickUp - Google Drive - Google Calendar - WhatsApp - GoHighLevel - AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude ClickUp experience is strongly preferred, but I am NOT hiring based on who calls themselves a "ClickUp expert." I care much more about whether you know how to build and run a simple project-management system that gives everyone clarity and keeps work moving. The system should serve the business - not become another project. IMPORTANT - HOW TO APPLY Do not send me a generic cover letter. job_title: Lead Platform Engineer — Internal Operations Platform
description: Eagle Production Co. | Wall Township, NJ (Hybrid or Remote for the right candidate) | Full-Time About Eagle Production Co. Eagle Production Co. is a nationwide AV equipment rental and production company based in New Jersey, running for over a decade. We rent and support audio, video, lighting, rigging, and power equipment for events across the country — from corporate premieres to touring productions. Over the past year we’ve built something most companies our size don’t have: a full custom operations platform that runs the business — CRM, quoting, invoicing, payments, inventory availability, COI compliance, crew staffing, payroll support, fleet logistics, and customer/freelancer/driver portals. It was built fast using AI-assisted development (Lovable + Supabase), it’s live, it processes real money, and it works. Now it needs an owner. The Role You will take over our platform as its dedicated engineer and technical owner. This is not a greenfield job and it’s not maintenance-only — it’s both harder and more interesting than either. You’ll inherit a large, live, AI-built codebase (~700 files, 150+ Supabase edge functions, 100+ database tables) and be responsible for three things: 1. Keep it stable. New features have historically broken existing ones. You’ll change that — with tests around the money logic, disciplined releases, and real code review of every change, whether written by you or by AI tools. 2. Keep it moving. The feature roadmap doesn’t stop. You’ll ship new functionality weekly, working directly with the CEO, using AI-assisted development where it’s fast and hand-written code where it’s right. 3. Lead the migration off Flex Rental Solutions. Our inventory and operations still run partly on Flex. Over the next phases of our roadmap, this platform becomes the single hub for all company operations. You’ll architect and execute that migration — inventory, scanning, availability, warehouse workflows — without disrupting live operations. What You’ll Do • Own the full stack: React/TypeScript frontend, Supabase backend (Postgres, RLS, edge functions, storage, cron), and the integrations around them (payment processing, QuickBooks, Gmail, Flex API, HubSpot, shipping/logistics APIs) • Stabilize and harden the existing codebase: eliminate duplicate logic, add a test suite around pricing, tax, invoicing, and payment flows, and close security gaps (RLS coverage, endpoint auth, storage policies) • Build new features end to end from CEO-defined requirements — often same-week turnaround • Plan and execute the Flex migration in phases: data model, sync strategy, cutover plan, rollback plan • Establish engineering discipline that survives AI-assisted development: GitHub-based workflow, pre-change audits, batched changes, post-change verification • Support the team using the platform daily (sales, warehouse, finance, HR) — triage issues fast, communicate clearly with non-technical users • Document what you build so the company is never dependent on any one tool or person What We’re Looking For Required: • 5+ years full-stack experience with deep React + TypeScript • Strong PostgreSQL, including Row-Level Security, and hands-on Supabase (or equivalent: Firebase + SQL, Hasura, etc.) • Experience owning a production system that handles real money — payments, invoicing, or e-commerce — and the paranoia that comes with it • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Copilot or similar) AND the judgment to review, constrain, and correct what those tools produce. We work AI-first here; we don’t work AI-blind. • Experience integrating third-party APIs (payment gateways, accounting, email) • Ability to work directly with a fast-moving, hands-on CEO: translate business requirements into working software quickly, push back when something is a bad idea, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain English Strongly preferred: • Experience inheriting and stabilizing a large existing codebase (rescue/refactor work) • Migration experience: replacing a legacy system of record without downtime • Testing discipline: Vitest/Jest, and knowing what’s worth testing in a business app Nice to have: • Rental, events, AV, or logistics industry exposure • Flex Rental Solutions, QuickBooks API, or Cardknox/payment gateway experience • Mobile/PWA experience (our warehouse runs barcode scanning on the platform) What This Job Is Not • Not a junior role with AI doing the thinking — AI writes a lot of first drafts here; you own correctness • Not a big-company pace — decisions happen in hours, not sprints • Not siloed — you’ll talk to warehouse staff, salespeople, and the CEO in the same day Compensation & Details • Salary: based on experience,

title: Project Coordinator
description: --- Role Overview The Project Coordinator owns the operational backbone of renovation projects from pre-kickoff through close-out. Where the Project Manager owns scope, budget, and the client relationship, you own the systems, documentation, schedule tracking, and vendor follow-through that keep every project moving. This is an ownership role, not a task-taking role. You are expected to spot slippage before your PM does, chase answers without being reminded, and bring your PM a recommendation rather than a question. You will typically support two to four active projects at a time and maintain daily contact with contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to verify site activity, confirm schedule adherence, and document progress. --- Key Responsibilities ** Project Systems & Documentation 1. Own project folder structure, Slack channels, and document filing so that links, drive folders, and templates are correctly filed and accessible without prompting. 2. Maintain project trackers and proposal decks as the single source of truth, updated from Matterport scans, floorplans, and vendor bids within 24 hours of new information. 3. Build and update backyard overlays and other visual documentation using survey data, drone photos, and site imagery. 4. Keep Buildertrend and all other project systems current. You are accountable for data integrity, not just data entry. ** Schedule & Site Accountability 1. Maintain daily communication with contractors and subcontractors to confirm on-site presence and active work at assigned projects. 2. Obtain photographic progress documentation no fewer than three (3) times per week, ensuring images are clear, time-stamped, and tied to specific milestones or ongoing construction activity. 3. Compare actual site progress against the baseline schedule and flag variance early, before it becomes a client-visible delay. 4. Escalate delays, missed updates, or contractor no-shows to the Project Manager within 24 hours, paired with a proposed recovery option. ** Vendor & Permitting Support 1. Run bid requests end-to-end: issue, track, chase, and close out estimates and compliance documents (W9s, COIs, licenses). 2. Prepare permit application packets to local requirements and submit to the appropriate portals or hand off to the permitting team as a complete package that requires no rework. 3. Submit vendor payment requests using the designated SOP. Validate invoices and submit to Buildertrend. 4. Maintain vendor records and flag lapsed insurance or licensing before it blocks work on site. ** Client & Stakeholder Communication 1. Draft client recaps, kickoff materials, and bi-weekly updates by compiling inputs from the PM and vendor check-ins. 2. Monitor project Slack channels and surface urgent messages or requests to the PM with the context needed to act. 3. Schedule internal and client-facing meetings, including kickoff and proposal calls. ** Construction & Close-Out 1. Own punch list tracking from creation through sign-off and confirm completion with photo evidence. 2. Coordinate final photography, walkthrough scheduling, and close-out document packaging. 3. Collect final invoices from all contractors and audit each contract to verify that all agreed-upon work has been completed. 4. Support quality control from project initiation through close-out, ensuring all work meets established standards and specifications. --- What Success Looks Like - Day 30: Fully independent on project systems, trackers, and filing across all assigned projects. - Day 60: Running vendor follow-up and permit packet preparation without PM prompting, with zero missed photo documentation cycles. - Day 90: Your PM comes to you for project status rather than assembling it themselves. Punch lists and close-out packages are complete and audit-ready. ????‍???? Skills & Qualifications ** Required - 2+ years in project coordination, operations, or administrative support in a fast-moving environment. - Demonstrated follow-through. You close loops without being chased. - Strong written English: clear, professional, and concise. - Advanced Google Workspace skills, particularly Sheets (filters, lookups, conditional formatting). - Comfort managing three or more concurrent projects with competing deadlines. - Availability during US business hours, with reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace for calls. ** Preferred - Experience with Buildertrend, Slack, ClickUp, Asana, or comparable project management tooling. - Background in construction, renovation, design, real estate, or property operations. - Exposure to permitting, inspections, or municipal processes. --- This Role Is Not a Fit If - You need step-by-step direction to make progress. - You go quiet when you hit a blocker instead of escalating it. - You are looking for a purely administrative, ticket-taking role.

title: Senior Instructional Designer / Curriculum & E-Learning Developer LMS
job_title: Senior Instructional Designer / Curriculum & E-Learning Developer LMS
description: About the Project The National Association of Marine Vessel Surveyors (NAMVS) is developing a professional online training and certification academy at ---------- for individuals pursuing careers, certifications, and continuing education in marine vessel surveying. We are building a comprehensive professional training program designed to take students from foundational marine surveying concepts through advanced inspection, reporting, standards, systems, damage assessment, and professional practice. We already have a separate LMS / WordPress Development Specialist responsible for building and managing the website, Tutor LMS platform, student dashboards, course delivery system, payments, certificates, and technical infrastructure. This position is different. We are looking for an experienced Senior Instructional Designer / Curriculum Developer / E-Learning Course Developer who will be responsible for actually designing and developing the educational program itself. You will take marine surveying subject matter, technical references, industry standards, source materials, and guidance from subject-matter experts and turn them into a professional, structured, engaging online education program. This is essentially the educational architect and course-development role for NAMVS. Primary Responsibilities You will be responsible for developing complete online training courses from concept through final instructional content. Responsibilities will include: Develop complete course curricula, modules, lessons, and instructional sequences. Establish measurable learning objectives and competencies for every module and lesson. Determine what students should know and be able to demonstrate before advancing. Convert technical marine surveying information into clear, understandable professional instruction. Write lesson content, instructor scripts, narration scripts, student reading materials, and study guides. Develop PowerPoint/slide presentations, diagrams, illustrations, charts, inspection examples, and other instructional visuals. Design and develop training videos, including storyboards, scripts, narration plans, demonstrations, and visual sequences. Create interactive learning exercises and knowledge checks throughout each lesson. Develop quizzes, examinations, practical assessments, and final module assessments. Build professional question banks with multiple question types and appropriate difficulty levels. Develop real-world marine surveying scenarios and case studies. Create exercises requiring students to analyze vessel conditions, identify deficiencies, interpret findings, and make professional recommendations. Develop photo-based inspection exercises where students identify defects, hazards, or compliance issues. Create remediation content when students fail knowledge checks or assessments. Establish passing standards and logical progression requirements. Develop downloadable worksheets, inspection checklists, reference materials, and student resources. Develop instructor notes and answer explanations where appropriate. Ensure lessons progress logically from introductory concepts to advanced professional application. Apply sound adult-learning and instructional-design principles throughout the program. Ensure students are actively learning rather than simply watching videos or reading text. Review and improve existing course materials for clarity, accuracy, consistency, and instructional effectiveness. Work directly with marine surveying subject-matter experts to ensure technical accuracy. Research unfamiliar technical subjects and convert SME information into effective instructional content. Organize and maintain course source materials, references, scripts, graphics, assessments, and final instructional assets. Work collaboratively with our LMS developer to ensure completed educational material is properly implemented into the online academy. Course Development Philosophy We do not want courses that simply consist of long videos followed by a quiz. Each lesson should follow a professional instructional structure similar to: Learning Objective → Instruction → Visual Explanation → Demonstration → Real-World Example → Interactive Exercise → Knowledge Check → Scenario/Application → Assessment → Remediation → Mastery Students should understand not only what something is, but also: Why it matters → How to inspect it → What can go wrong → How to recognize deficiencies → How to document findings → How to report them professionally Marine surveying is a highly practical profession, so the training must continually connect theory to real-world vessel inspections. Types of Content You Will Develop The NAMVS curriculum will ultimately include subjects such as: Marine surveying fundamentals, vessel construction, hull inspection, structural systems, propulsion systems, electrical systems, fuel systems, steering systems, plumbing systems, safety equipment, fire protection, navigation equipment, corrosion, moisture intrusion, damage assessment, valuation, sea trials, inspection procedures, photography, report writing, professional standards, ethics, client communication, and surveying business practices. Courses will also incorporate applicable marine industry standards and accepted practices. The instructional designer should be comfortable developing technically oriented education and working with source material involving organizations and standards such as ABYC, NFPA, NMEA, USCG, ISO, SAE, UL and other recognized marine industry references. You are not expected to already be a marine surveyor. Marine-industry knowledge is beneficial, but we can provide subject-matter expertise. What is essential is the ability to take expert technical knowledge and turn it into excellent education. Training Video Development A significant portion of the academy will use video-based instruction. You should be capable of developing the educational side of video production, including: Storyboarding, lesson scripting, instructor/narrator scripts, screen presentations, demonstrations, diagrams, animations, visual callouts, inspection photographs, captions, knowledge checks, and supporting instructional materials. Experience with tools such as Camtasia, Adobe Premiere, Canva, PowerPoint, Articulate, Captivate, Synthesia, HeyGen, or similar e-learning/video-production tools is beneficial. Professional-level video editing experience is an advantage but is not necessarily required if you are exceptionally strong in instructional design and course development. Assessment Development Assessments are extremely important to this program. The successful candidate should understand how to develop assessments that measure genuine competency rather than simple memorization. Students should encounter: Knowledge checks, module quizzes, cumulative examinations, scenario-based questions, inspection photographs, deficiency-identification exercises, case studies, practical assignments, and final competency assessments. Assessment questions should include explanations and remediation whenever appropriate so that testing also becomes part of the learning process. Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone with professional experience in one or more of the following areas: Instructional Design, Curriculum Development, E-Learning Development, Educational Technology, Adult Education, Online Course Development, Corporate Training, Technical Training, or Higher Education. A degree in Instructional Design, Education, Educational Technology, Curriculum Development, Training & Development, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory if you have strong professional experience and an excellent portfolio. Experience developing technical, vocational, professional-certification, safety, engineering, maritime, aviation, healthcare, industrial, or trade-based education would be particularly valuable. Preferred Experience Experience with instructional-design methodologies such as ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, Backward Design, competency-based education, adult learning theory, and scenario-based learning is highly desirable. Experience with Articulate Storyline/Rise, H5P, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Canva, PowerPoint, SCORM, xAPI, Tutor LMS, LearnDash, Moodle, or similar tools is also beneficial. You do not need to be a WordPress or full-stack website developer. We already have a team member responsible for that portion of the project. What We Expect You to Produce A completed NAMVS module should be much more than a collection of documents. For each module, we expect a complete instructional package containing: Curriculum structure, learning objectives, lesson plans, instructional content, presentations, graphics, diagrams, training-video scripts, narration, demonstrations, exercises, scenarios, knowledge checks, quizzes, examinations, answer explanations, remediation materials, student resources, and final assessments. Everything should be organized so our LMS developer can implement the finished material into the NAMVS training platform. Collaboration You will work closely with: NAMVS Management / Marine Surveying Subject-Matter Experts — providing technical knowledge, standards, field experience, photographs, examples, and professional guidance. LMS / WordPress Development Specialist — implementing completed educational materials into ---------- and managing the technical learning platform. Instructional Designer / Curriculum Developer — You — responsible for transforming the subject matter into a structured, professional educational experience. You will effectively serve as the bridge between the marine surveying experts and the students. Quality Standard Our objective is not to create a basic online course. We intend to develop a professional online academy comparable in quality and structure to established vocational schools, professional-certification programs, and continuing-education institutions. Courses should be engaging, visually professional, academically structured, technically accurate, and practical. Students completing the program should feel that they have completed a serious professional education—not simply watched a collection of videos. Long-Term Opportunity This is intended to become a long-term project. The initial assignment will involve developing our core Marine Vessel Surveyor training curriculum. After the primary program is completed, NAMVS expects to continue developing: Advanced marine surveying courses, specialty certifications, damage and claims surveying courses, yacht surveying courses, commercial-vessel courses, continuing-education programs, professional-development courses, refresher training, recurring certification programs, and additional maritime education. For the right person, this could develop into an ongoing Senior Instructional Designer / Director of Curriculum Development position as NAMVS expands. When Applying Please include: A brief description of your instructional-design and curriculum-development experience. Examples of online courses or training programs you have personally developed. Your experience developing assessments, examinations, and competency-based training. Your experience developing video-based or interactive e-learning. The instructional-design software and tools you regularly use. Your educational background and/or relevant certifications. A portfolio or examples of previous course-development work. Your availability and preferred working schedule. Your expected monthly compensation. Please do not apply if your primary experience is only WordPress development, website design, or LMS administration. This position is specifically focused on curriculum, instructional design, educational content, assessment development, and course production.

This is a long-term position for someone who likes variety and can switch between projects easily. ABOUT THE ROLE This is not a one-project role. In a single week you might build an API connection with a freight carrier, set up a job service with our internal tools, fix a bug in a live application and move production data into a sandbox so a new feature can be tested. If you like solving different kinds of problems and figuring things out, you will fit in well here. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build and maintain API integrations with carriers and partners (REST, JSON, XML) - Set up and configure job services and background processes using our internal tools - Fix bugs and add new features to existing Django applications - Migrate production data to sandbox environments for testing - Write and troubleshoot SQL queries and data scripts - Document your work and keep the team updated on progress REQUIREMENTS - 3–5 years of professional Python experience - Solid hands-on experience with Django - Experience building and consuming REST APIs - Good working knowledge of SQL and relational databases - Comfortable with Git - Clear written English: able to explain issues, ask good questions and give updates - Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace - Available for 1–2 hours of overlap with US Central Time (CT) each workday NICE TO HAVE - Experience with PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server - Django REST Framework - AWS, especially S3, AWS CLI - Experience in logistics, freight or shipping (carrier APIs, shipment tracking, EDI/XML) AI TOOLS We encourage using AI in your daily work, and we will provide a paid AI license (ChatGPT Pro or Claude Pro). However you write your code, you need to understand it, test it and stand behind it. JOB DETAILS - Full time, 40 hours per week - Salary: $1,200–$1,300 USD per month - 100% remote - Long-term position HOW TO APPLY To show you read the full post, use this subject line: "CARRIER API – [Your Full Name]" We will not review applications without this subject line. In your application, please include: 1. Your resume or a short summary of your Python/Django experience 2. Short answers to these questions: a) Describe an API integration you built. What did it connect to, and what was the hardest part? b) Have you worked with PostgreSQL, SQL Server or both? Give one example of a task you did with each. c) How do you use AI tools in your development work today? d) Which hours in US Central Time can you reliably be online? 3. A GitHub profile or code samples, if you have them

title: Sportsbook Link Researcher — Remote, Pay-Per-Link
description: Company: ---------- Type: Independent contractor, part-time / flexible Location: Remote Pay: $0.03 per approved link, paid weekly (cap of $100 per week) About the work: ---------- is a sports betting information and analytics platform. We show users where to find specific bets across major online sportsbooks, and to do that we need the exact page URL ("deep link") for each bet on each sportsbook. Our system automatically finds some of these links, but most still need a human. That's where you come in. Our dashboard shows a live list of missing links (we call them bounties). You pick one, find the correct URL on the sportsbook's website, and submit it. That's the whole job. What you'll do: - Log in to our web dashboard and choose an open bounty (a specific game, bet type, and sportsbook) - Navigate the sportsbook's site to find the page that lands directly on that bet - Copy the URL and submit it through the dashboard - Repeat as many times as you like How you get paid: - You earn a fixed amount for every approved link - Every submission is reviewed (by us, with help from automated checks) to confirm it actually opens the correct bet. Links that are wrong, duplicated, or don't open the bet are not paid - There are no set hours and no minimum. Work whenever you want, as much as you want - Pay covers all approved links that you submitted during the work week (Monday–Sunday). Payment is sent after the week closes. - Weekly earnings are capped at $100. Once you reach the cap, you're free to stop for the week. - Your dashboard shows a running count of your approved and rejected links so you always know where you stand What we're looking for: - Comfortable using web browsers and navigating unfamiliar websites - Attention to detail — the link has to open the exact bet, not just the game page - Basic written English (our dashboard and instructions are in English) - Reliable internet connection - You must be able to access US sportsbook websites on your own. Many of these sites restrict access outside the US. We do not provide a VPN or any access tools — if you can't load the sites, you won't be able to do the work - Sports betting knowledge is helpful but not required; we'll provide a short guide covering bet types (moneyline, spread, total, props) and each sportsbook's layout Good to know - Some sportsbooks (for example BetMGM) use a different subdomain for each US state. You only need to find the link once — we handle the state variations - Consistently submitting incorrect links will result in removal from the program - This is a contractor role with no benefits and no guaranteed hours. You're responsible for your own taxes How to apply Send a short message with: - Your name and location - Your weekly availability (rough estimate) - One sentence on any experience with sportsbooks, data entry, or web research

We are looking for a long-term team member who is confident they can consistently produce 2+ qualified appointments per day. If you perform, your pay increases.

title: Supply Chain Manager - EU experience required
job_title: Supply Chain Manager - EU experience required
description: Olvy sells through several European marketplaces, purchases from a fixed base of suppliers in China and works with external fulfilment partners. As the number of countries, channels and partners grows, so does the complexity of the supply chain. The Supply Chain Manager holds end responsibility for the design and the performance of this chain. The role sets the inventory strategy, safeguards availability and inventory turnover, holds suppliers and fulfilment partners to measurable performance standards, and makes sure the supply chain remains scalable as we expand into new countries and sales channels. The role carries independent authority, works against clearly defined KPIs, and takes over substantive ownership of the supply chain from the Operations Manager. This creates a single, clear owner for inventory, partner performance and the further development of the chain. Responsibilities: 1. Inventory and planning - Setting and maintaining safety stock and coverage targets per product category and per channel, based on demand variability and actual lead times. - Setting reorder points and replenishment logic, including MOQ and container constraints. - Building and monthly updating of the long term forecast with a horizon of at least twelve months, including seasonal peaks and deal periods. - Determining the purchase quantity per order, subject to approval by the Operations Manager and, above the agreed threshold, by finance. - Monitoring inventory turnover and inventory health, and intervening actively in cases of overstock and slow movers. - Directing the Supply Chain Coordinator on the weekly replenishment to the fulfilment channels. 2. Network and logistics - Owning the performance of all fulfilment partners: defining SLAs, measuring them, reporting back monthly and escalating where needed. - Selecting carriers and negotiating freight rates, covering sea and road freight and, where required, air and rail. - Monitoring container utilisation and shipment consolidation, against a defined target for freight cost per unit sold. - Preparing and executing the transition of the fulfilment network towards 2027, with the Operations Manager as decision maker. - Designing the logistics chain when expanding into a new country or channel: storage, return flows, customs, the import process and VAT registration in cooperation with finance. 3. Supplier performance - Structurally measuring suppliers on actual lead time, production capacity, delivery reliability and quality deviations. - Holding periodic performance reviews with the key suppliers, at least quarterly, with recorded commitments and follow up. - Negotiating prices, payment terms and incoterms with existing suppliers, subject to approval by the Operations Manager. - Coordinating pre shipment quality inspections and following up on findings. 4. Performance and reporting - Owning the supply chain KPIs in the internal dashboard: their definition, the reliability of the underlying data and their further improvement. - Monthly reporting to the management team on availability, forecast accuracy, chain costs and risks, including a concrete proposal wherever there is a deviation. - Owning escalations towards suppliers and fulfilment partners. - Documenting and maintaining the working processes in the chain, so that execution does not depend on individuals. ***MUST HAVE/HARD REQUIREMENTS*** 1. Five to ten years of supply chain experience, including at least two years with end responsibility for inventory norms or a fulfilment network. 2. Demonstrable experience with imports from Asia into Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning, customs and the import process. 3. Demonstrable experience managing external fulfilment partners on the basis of SLAs. 4. Inventory planning at parameter level, not purely executional. Able to explain why a norm is set where it is. 5. Strong analytical ability with data, able to work through large datasets and to question the output of a tool. 6. Experience in e-commerce or marketplace fulfilment. 7. Fluent English, both written and in negotiation. Nice to have, not required 1. Lean Six Sigma or a comparable process improvement background. 2. Experience with EU product compliance and import regulations. 3. Experience building a supply chain rather than only managing an existing one. TO APPLY: Please fill out this form: ---------- Applications sent via OLJ will not be reviewed.

The better the quality of your work, the better the opportunity for higher pay over time. Quality is what we reward here. Growth Path The editor who delivers through Q4 becomes a senior editor on the team in 2027. Real progression: more responsibility, higher rates, leadership of newer editors, direct collaboration on creative direction. How to Apply Apply through our form here: ---------- The form takes 10-15 minutes. Every editor we've hired who's done well on our team has filled this form out. It clearly works, so please take the time to show us your best answers and your best work. If you're a strong fit, we'll come back to you with a paid test brief using real footage from the brand. Land the trial and you're cutting paid work within the week. Thanks, Jack

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description: About Pomelo Academy Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries. Job Description We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment. Responsibilities Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18. Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs. Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications. Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging. Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents. Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space. Qualifications Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12). Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus. Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills. Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science). Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms. Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM). Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8. Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies. Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina. Benefits Flexible working hours. Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula. Be part of an international, passionate team of educators. Access to training and professional development. Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Instagram Followers Growth Content Strategist
description: About us We are a coaching practice working with high achievers who might look like they have it all on the outside but feel privately stuck, stressed, anxious, unfulfilled, or disconnected. Our work helps them come back to themselves and build a life that actually works across all the areas that count: mental and physical health, business, relationships, and lifestyle. Our approach is based on neuroscience, nervous system work, psychology, and ancient wisdom. We are building this into something bigger. A practice, a body of work, and a community of people who want to live with more depth, clarity, and aliveness. The social media presence on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube is a core part of how we reach the people we are meant to work with. We are looking for someone who feels drawn to this mission and wants to be part of building it with us. Experience or at least strong interest in the field of mental health, neuroscience, and/or nervous system work is a big plus. ---------- Youtube: ---------- ## The role You will work closely with Patrice and Chloé as the person who proactively researches and generates fresh ideas for posts every week, leads the content team, posts the content, analyzes the results and reports them once a month. For now organic only, we are not working with paid marketing. Our goal is to go from 9,000 followers (Instagram) to 50,000 by December 2026. You will lead a small content team: our scriptwriter writes what you brief, our video editor produces it, Patrice records it. You own the process, the plan and the numbers. This is a role that starts at 10 hours per week and grows. We are ideally looking for someone who wants to grow into a larger role over time, in stages, as the business expands and as we get to know each other and both feel it is a good fit. ## What you will do - Understand our work: Finding the best positioning, learning our coaching method, the theory behind it, target group, core topics and guidelines are documented. You should be able to explain the method in your own words. This is key. Patrice will take time to explain the key elements to you. - Come up with ideas every week: We keep a database of reels and videos we like. Use it as a starting point, but what we really want are your own creative ideas. Bring 15 to 20 concrete video ideas every week across different formats: reels, carousels, infographic posts, b-roll with text. In the weekly call we d ---------- together which ones we produce. - Prepare & manage production: Brief our scriptwriter on every approved idea, review the scripts before they reach Patrice, and hand everything to our video editor after Patrice filmed it. The idea is that everything other than the filming (and feedback) is not on Patrice and Chloe’s table anymore. - Keep our Notion content database up to date: so every piece has a card and a clear status. - Report every month on what performed, where we are compare to our goal, what did not perform, and propose what we need to change. ## What we are looking for - A real track record with instagram followers growth. - Prior experience in the field of mental health, neuroscience, or nervous system work is a plus. Strong interest to really learn about this field is a requirement. - Organised, reliable, proactive, creative. You feel comfortable doing research and coming up with ideas proactively and creatively. - You can research a topic you do not know well and come back with a point of view you can defend. - Fluent in English and a good sense for language. You will be writing briefs that another writer has to work from, and review what they produce. - You are comfortable with data and social media KPIs. ## Working setup Fully remote, your own schedule mostly works. No strict overlap with Berlin (CET) time required, but we will likely have 1-2 weekly calls of 30-60 minutes. ## How to apply No CV, no long application text, no LinkedIn is needed. Just send us the following. Note: Include the word “avocado” in the title of your application otherwise your application will not be opened. We need to see: 1) Go on our instagram page, copy and past one of our hook 2) Show us accounts you worked on and what happened to the numbers as a direct consequence of your work (if you worked in the space of coaching or mental health already, please make sure to include those examples). 3) Your answer to this question in two or three sentences: what are the key elements of a viral video?

You should have a strong understanding of: * Direct-response marketing * Consumer psychology * Customer awareness stages * Funnel stages * Market sophistication * Voice-of-customer research * Personas, desires, pain points and objections * Angles, hooks, mechanisms and offers * Creative testing and iteration * Meta creative performance metrics * Static, native, UGC, video and long-form advertising You should understand that an unaware prospect needs different messaging from someone who is problem-aware, solution-aware or already product-aware, and be able to build creative strategy around those differences. You should also understand how creative and messaging should change across different stages of the funnel. And we want someone who stays on top of what is happening NOW: * Meta advertising developments * DTC creative strategy * New ad formats and creative trends * AI-assisted creative and research * Changes in consumer behaviour * New direct-response strategies and frameworks We don’t want someone applying the exact same creative playbook they learned three years ago. THIS IS NOT A DESIGNER OR VIDEO EDITOR ROLE We already have the execution team. You don’t need to spend your day in Photoshop, Canva, CapCut or Premiere. Your job is to d ---------- : * What should we create? * Who are we speaking to? * What desire or problem are we targeting? * What awareness stage are they in? * What funnel stage are they in? * What angle should we use? * What should the hook be? * Why should this concept work? * What did we learn after testing it? * What should we test next? We don’t need more ads. We need better creative decisions. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR You’ll probably be a great fit if: * You’ve developed Meta creative strategy for DTC/e-commerce brands * You can explain WHY an ad works, not just whether it performed * You’re strong at customer research and can turn raw voice-of-customer data into non-obvious creative insights and angles * You understand both creative psychology and performance data * You can turn research into clear, executable creative briefs * You can recognise winning patterns and build new iterations from them * You actively follow the latest developments in Meta and performance marketing * You have excellent written English * You think independently and challenge your own assumptions with data * You’re genuinely obsessed with advertising, psychology and why people buy HOW TO APPLY Don’t just send us a CV. Send something that shows us HOW YOU THINK. For example: 1. A creative brief you wrote and why you structured it that way 2. A Meta ad or concept you personally developed that you’d defend, including the strategy behind it 3. A winning creative you developed and any performance data you can share 4. A teardown of a Meta ad explaining the audience, awareness stage, angle, hook, psychology and why you believe it works Please also include: * Your portfolio * Examples of DTC Meta ads you personally strategized * Any performance results you can share (spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, revenue, etc.) * Your exact role in those creatives * Your expected monthly salary in USD We care much more about how you THINK than how impressive your CV looks. We’re looking for someone long-term who can eventually take full ownership of creative strategy and become a key part of our growth team.

description: Hamilton Island Boutique is an Australian women's fashion brand, founder-led and growing. We are preparing to scale over the coming months, with more markets and a second store planned. You will work directly with the founder. WHAT THIS ROLE IS This is a Personal Assistant role. You will become the founder's right hand: the person who runs day-to-day operations, keeps an overview of everything that happens in the business, and reports to the founder. We train you into that role through customer service, because that is where you learn the business, the customers and the supplier. We begin with a few hours per week, and your hours and responsibilities grow as the work grows: from customer service into disputes, supplier follow-up, admin, and eventually running operations. We are not looking for someone who answers emails. We are looking for someone who understands that the job of customer service is to keep revenue inside the company and to protect the reputation of the brand, and who genuinely cares about the result. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Handle customer emails and messages in our internal dashboard. - Handle refund requests the right way: find out what the customer actually needs and offer a real solution before a refund is ever on the table. - Handle payment disputes and chargebacks: gather the facts, respond, and resolve them in the company's favour. - Follow up with our supplier on orders that need attention. - Report to the founder at the end of every shift. - As you grow: listing checks, admin, keeping our procedures up to date, and more responsibility as the company expands. WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU - At least 1 year of customer service for a Shopify or dropshipping store, including refunds and disputes. - You have handled PayPal or card disputes before and you know how to win them. - Excellent written English: clear, warm, and written for the person in front of you, not copied from a template. - You ask when you are not sure instead of guessing. - You are structured and reliable: nothing gets forgotten, and you report without being reminded. - You are comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your work. WHAT WE OFFER - Part-time to start, growing into more hours as the business grows. - Hourly pay that grows with your responsibilities, plus bonuses tied to results. The more revenue you keep inside the company and the better things run, the more room there is for bonuses and raises. We reward good work. - Direct line to the founder, proper training, and a clear path to running operations. - A brand that is about to scale, with a second store on the way. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word BOUTIQUE on the first line, then answer these five questions. Applications that skip a question will not be read. 1. Describe a case where a customer demanded a full refund and you kept the sale. What exactly did you offer, and what was the result? 2. A customer opens a PayPal dispute for "item not received", but the tracking shows it was delivered. What do you do, step by step? 3. Which Shopify stores have you worked for, for how long, and what did you handle there? 4. Why should we NOT hire you? 5. Your earliest start date and the hours you are available per day. Everything you see in this role stays inside the company.

title: AI Creative Engineer (Storytelling & UGC Video) - No graveyard shift
job_title: AI Creative Engineer (Storytelling & UGC Video) - No graveyard shift
description: #About the scope Make short-form video that sells: UGC-style ads, product stories and social content for our own products and for the brands we work with. The difference is that we build most of it with AI. The on-camera talent, the voice, the B-roll, sometimes the whole scene, is generated, then edited so it feels native to TikTok, Reels and Meta feeds. We are a small, hands-on team based on Singapore time, and this role is the person who actually makes the videos. #Why this one's interesting Most "AI video" looks like AI video. Yours should not. The job is to take a brief, find the story inside it, and turn it into a 15 to 60 second piece that stops the scroll and makes someone want the product. You get to work across the whole stack: writing the hook, designing the look, generating the talent and scenes, cutting the edit, and then reading the numbers and doing it again, better. The tools change every month. You will be the person who knows which one to reach for. #What you'll own Writing hooks and short scripts built on direct-response structure (hook, problem, product, proof, call to action). Generating AI avatars, voiceover and lip-sync with tools like HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Arcads or Captions, and keeping a consistent bench of characters per brand. Building scenes, product shots and B-roll with image and video models such as Kling, Veo, Runway, Midjourney or Flux. Graphic design for thumbnails, overlays, captions and static ad variants. Editing in CapCut, Premiere or DaVinci Resolve to a native, platform-ready finish. Shipping variations (hook, avatar, angle, format) for testing, then reading Meta and TikTok results to d ---------- what to iterate. Keeping the asset library tidy and named so anyone can find and reuse a script, character or clip. #Portfolio (required, please read) We will not review applications without work samples. Send us three to five short-form videos you made yourself. For each, tell us which parts were AI-generated and which tools you used. We care about the hook and the storytelling more than production polish. If you have made at least one UGC-style ad with an AI avatar or AI B-roll, lead with that. #What we're looking for Hands-on with at least two AI video, image or voice tools and comfortable learning a new one in a weekend. A storyteller first: you can explain why a video worked, not just how you made it. Real editing skill in CapCut, Premiere or Resolve, with a good ear for pacing and sound. Solid graphic design fundamentals: type, layout, colour, a feel for what looks native on each platform. Good written English for scripts and captions. Comfortable with volume, you would rather ship ten strong videos a week than one perfect one a month. Basic ad literacy: you know what hook rate, CTR and ROAS mean and can read a dashboard. Fluent with AI as a professional tool. Claude especially, or a capable equivalent like ChatGPT. We mean using it to build and produce: drafting script variants, structuring prompts for video models, writing the small scripts and automations that speed up your pipeline. If you currently only use it to chat, that is fine, but we are looking for someone who uses it to ship. Self-directed, this is remote and contract, so you run your own process and hit deadlines without hand-holding. Prefer availability 9am to 6pm Philippine time. #Nice to have Motion graphics in After Effects or similar. Prompt engineering experience for image and video models. Experience on e-commerce, DTC, app or SaaS ad accounts. Familiarity with creative-testing frameworks and naming conventions in paid social. Dubbing or localisation workflows. Any Python, n8n or Make automation experience. #The engagement Type: Freelance / independent contract, ongoing. Location: fully remote, we work on Singapore time (UTC+8), so a Philippine day lines up with ours. Same hours, no graveyard shifts. Pay: in PHP, paid reliably on schedule via Wise or PayPal. Scope: ongoing production with weekly targets. Rate: tell us yours. Start: soon. #What's in it for you Hours that fit your life. A budget for the AI tools you need. Direct access to the performance data, so you see what your work does. A small English-speaking team that respects your craft and will not micro-manage. Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale. #How to apply Send four things, keep it short: links to three to five videos you made, with a note on which parts were AI and which tools (required); one new 15 to 30 second UGC-style ad for any product you like, made with AI talent, this is the main thing we judge; two lines on the best-performing piece of content you have made and why it worked; your rate and availability. No long cover letter needed.

Stay aligned with events and marketing on sponsorship packages, pricing, inventory and availability across all four shows. Report activity and pipeline progress directly to the Head of Strategy & Delivery. What we're looking for: 1–3 years of outbound B2B SDR experience. Comfort sustaining high daily call, email and LinkedIn volume — and the resilience that comes with outbound. Working proficiency with CRM hygiene and prospecting tools such as Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Clear, confident communication with senior marketing and commercial decision-makers. A track record of consistently hitting weekly meeting-booking targets — be ready to talk numbers. Self-motivated and effective working independently in a remote, target-driven environment. Reliable internet connection and a proper remote working setup. Bonus points for: experience selling event sponsorship, exhibitions or media; familiarity with the AI, Web3, gaming or trading ecosystems; exposure to GCC, APAC or European markets. Why this role: You'll sell across four distinct shows and four distinct buyer universes — which means variety, and a much faster education in enterprise selling than a single-product SDR seat gives you. title: Customer Support & Admin Specialist (Canadian Client Services)
job_title: Customer Support & Admin Specialist (Canadian Client Services)
description: Shift: Permanent Night Shift (Mon–Fri, 40 hrs/week) Total Package: PHP 52,300 / month ABOUT WINSLOW PACIFIC Winslow Pacific runs the back office for trade contractors across Vancouver Island, British Columbia. From roofers to plumbers, we answer their calls, book their appointments, and keep their schedules organized so they can stay focused on their work. We’re a registered Canadian startup with a tight-knit, fully remote team. We're looking for a dependable, articulate team member to serve as the voice and main administrative point of contact for a small portfolio of our trade clients. THE ROLE When a homeowner’s roof is leaking or their well pump stops working, you’re the calm, steady voice on the line. You’ll answer inbound calls for a few dedicated contracting companies. To the customer calling in, you aren't an outsourced center - you're a seamless part of that contractor's office. Building and maintaining that trust is central to everything we do. Your day-to-day responsibilities: - Handle inbound calls: Light-to-moderate volume (starting around 15 to 20 calls a day). - Manage schedules & follow-ups: Book appointments, confirm estimates, and handle callback promises promptly. - Take accurate messages: Capture full, clear details and route them quickly to the right person. - Provide exceptional customer care: Callers are often stressed about home repairs. Your warmth, patience, and clear communication set their minds at ease. - Use quiet hours productively: Learn our clients' services, familiarize yourself with Vancouver Island geography (towns, drive times, local names), and help with executive admin tasks (inbox management, calendars, research, data entry) as requested by the Founder WORK SHIFT & SCHEDULE Hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila Time (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time). Status: 40 hours/week, permanent night shift. This is a permanent graveyard role, so we want to be upfront about the hours. If night shifts fit your current routine and lifestyle, we’d love to hear from you. WHO WILL THRIVE HERE Clear, Warm Communicator: You speak fluent, easy-to-understand English with natural phrasing and feel confident speaking with North American customers. Meticulous & Reliable: You notice the small details and follow through on every task. In trade services, an unpassed message can cost a contractor a major job. Self-Disciplined: You work well independently without needing someone watching over your shoulder. Tech-Comfortable: You adapt quickly to modern cloud tools and software. Bonus Points: Prior experience working in Jobber and answering calls for North American clients is a plus. Background in home services/trades (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, well drilling) is an even bigger plus. REQUIREMENTS - A modern, capable computer or laptop - A reliable, wired noise-canceling headset - A quiet, private workspace free from background noise - High-speed internet with a concrete backup plan for power/internet interruptions - A working webcam (used for team and client video check-ins) Exclusive commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. We ask that your scheduled shift hours are strictly reserved for Winslow Pacific. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Total Monthly Package: PHP 52,300 - Base Pay: PHP 42,200 - Night Differential: PHP 3,570 - HMO / Health Allowance: PHP 2,000 - Remote Work Allowance: PHP 4,530 for internet/equipment needs Additional Perks: - Weekly Payouts: Paid every week via Wise - no waiting until the end of the month. - 13th Month Pay: PHP 42,200 (paid early December). - Paid Canadian Holidays: 11 BC statutory holidays per year. - Paid Leave: 4% PTO accrual (approx. 10 paid days off per year). - Birthday Off: Paid day off on your birthday. - Performance Bonuses: Bonuses tied to personal and company achievements. - Career Growth: Long-term stability with a company that prefers promoting from within. HOW TO APPLY To confirm you've read the full posting, please start your application with the word ISLAND. Please send us: A short introduction: A brief paragraph about yourself and why a permanent night shift fits your current schedule. A 60–90 second voice recording or loom video (file or link): Introduce yourself, then briefly role-play answering the phone for a company called "Coastline Roofing" and taking a message from a homeowner dealing with a roof leak. (We're listening for natural warmth, tone, and clarity - not perfection!) Your updated resume Note: We review every application that includes these three items, but we cannot move forward without a voice recording or loom video.

title: Inventory Assistant
description: ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, Scriveiner has grown to serve millions of customers worldwide, with products available through major online marketplaces and more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day. The company has grown rapidly and been recognised with numerous awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards. Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences. Applications are only accepted through our official application form — see "How to Apply" at the end of this ad. CVs or messages sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel will not be reviewed. THE OPPORTUNITY As Inventory Assistant, you will work at the operational heart of the Inventory team, keeping stock records accurate, Amazon FBA running cleanly, and our third-party logistics partners on track. This is not a passive role. You will be the person who catches discrepancies before they become customer problems, flags low stock before it becomes a lost sale, and ensures that every shipment entering or leaving the warehouse is accounted for correctly. The role covers the full operational breadth of inventory management: from daily stock reconciliation across the IM Sheet and Power BI dashboards, to managing Amazon Seller Central shipments and processing FBA reimbursements, to coordinating with 3PL partners on inbound and outbound fulfilment. New product launches, including wallets, notebooks, and leather accessories targeting Q3 2026, will add meaningful scope and pace to the role over the coming months. If you are someone who finds genuine satisfaction in a clean reconciliation, who catches errors others walk past, and who wants to understand how a premium e-commerce brand actually operates end-to-end, this role will give you exactly that. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Stock Management and Control - Maintain accurate, up-to-date inventory records across the IM Sheet, Power BI dashboards, and all active e-commerce platforms — these records are the operational source of truth for the business - Update and manage stock levels on the Faire and Turis wholesale platforms, ensuring availability is always reflected correctly for trade buyers - Conduct regular cycle counts, spot checks, and full stocktakes; investigate and resolve discrepancies, variances, and shrinkage before they escalate - Monitor stock levels proactively and flag low-inventory or overstock situations to the Inventory Manager Order Management and 3PL Coordination - Import and process orders into 3PL partner systems, double-checking previous orders for unfulfilled or incomplete items - Prepare and coordinate retail orders for dispatch, liaising with 3PL partners to ensure timely and accurate fulfilment - Process incoming shipments from suppliers and freight carriers, verifying quantities and quality, resolving delivery discrepancies, and updating stock records accurately Amazon Seller Central and FBA Operations - Create and manage Amazon FBA shipments end-to-end in Seller Central, including video verification, status tracking, and updating the Shipment Status File - Process FBA reimbursement claims for missing or lost units, maintaining accurate dispute records Reporting and Compliance - Prepare and distribute the OD Weekly Report; update, file, and manage OD dispute records for compliance charges and discrepancies - Generate inventory reports and variance summaries using the IM Sheet and Power BI - Support the Inventory Manager with inventory data for seasonal demand forecasting and buying decisions - Perform other ad hoc tasks as directed by the Inventory Manager or wider Operations team WHO YOU ARE Essential - Hands-on experience in an inventory, warehousing, or retail operations role — you have worked with stock, reconciled records, and managed order processes in a real operational environment - Confident working with inventory management tools and reporting platforms, whether that is a WMS, ERP, IM Sheet, or Power BI in combination - Practical experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA processes, including shipment creation and account management - Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors in data that others overlook, and you find reconciliation satisfying rather than tedious - Competent in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, data management, and variance analysis - A proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked Desirable - Experience with wholesale platforms such as Faire and/or Turis - Familiarity with 3PL order management, fulfilment workflows, and inbound shipment processing - Experience handling Amazon compliance charges, disputes, and FBA reimbursement claims - Understanding of FIFO stock rotation principles and inventory control best practices - Experience using AI tools to improve operational workflows or reporting efficiency WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In this role, you will be successful when: - Inventory records across all platforms are accurate and current, with discrepancies investigated and resolved promptly - Amazon FBA shipments are created, verified, and tracked without errors, and reimbursement claims are filed on time - 3PL orders are processed accurately, with fulfilment issues identified and escalated before they affect customers - The OD Weekly Report and compliance records are maintained consistently and without prompting - The Inventory Manager can rely on your data to make confident stock and buying decisions HOW TO APPLY Applications are only accepted through our official application form: ----------
