title: MANUAL QA ANALYST – MOBILE & WEB APPLICATIONS
job_title: MANUAL QA ANALYST – MOBILE & WEB APPLICATIONS
description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are a growing U.S.-based software company seeking a meticulous, experienced Manual QA Analyst to join our product-development team full-time. You will be embedded in the development workflow. You will review requirements, prepare test coverage, test exact staging and TestFlight builds, report defects in Jira, verify fixes, maintain regression coverage, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations. This is a manual testing position. You will not be expected to work as a software developer. Company and product details will be shared with shortlisted candidates. WHAT YOU WILL DO Development workflow and Jira - Review feature requirements and acceptance criteria before development is completed. - Identify unclear requirements, missing edge cases, and areas that may be difficult to test. - Prepare or update manual test cases while features are being developed. - Pick up work in Jira when a developer moves it to Ready for QA. - Move assigned work into QA In Progress when testing begins. - Record all testing against the exact staging URL, TestFlight build, application version, device, and operating-system version used. - Return failed work to Changes Required with complete supporting evidence. - Retest fixes when the developer submits a new build. - Move passing work to Ready for Release with a concise QA summary. - Keep Jira statuses and defect records current without needing repeated reminders. Manual mobile and web testing - Manually test iPhone, iPad, and browser-based application workflows. - Test complete end-to-end processes that cross between the mobile application and web platform. - Install and test prerelease iOS/iPadOS builds through TestFlight. - Perform functional, frontend, usability, exploratory, regression, integration, and release testing. - Verify screens, buttons, forms, navigation, loading states, permissions, validation, error handling, and responsive layouts. - Test different account states, user roles, network conditions, permissions, devices, and operating-system versions. - Look beyond the happy path and actively search for edge cases and unintended behavior. - Run smoke and regression testing before releases. - Perform limited post-release verification using authorized test accounts and fictional data. Bug reporting and verification Every bug report should include: - A concise, descriptive title - The exact build and environment tested - Device model, browser, and operating-system version - Preconditions and relevant account state - Numbered steps to reproduce - Expected versus actual results - Frequency or reproducibility - Severity and likely customer impact - Screenshots, screen recordings, or other supporting evidence You will also: - Distinguish release-blocking defects from minor issues. - Reproduce and investigate inconsistent problems. - Verify reported fixes rather than assuming they work. - Reopen defects that are incomplete or cannot be verified. - Create separate linked bugs when testing reveals an issue outside the original feature’s scope. - Maintain regression cases so previously fixed problems do not return. Release readiness For each release candidate, provide a clear written result: - PASS - PASS WITH KNOWN RISKS - FAIL - BLOCKED The report must identify: - The exact build tested - Devices, browsers, and operating systems covered - Test cases completed - Tests that failed or could not be completed - Open defects - Known limitations - Remaining release risks - Your GO/NO-GO recommendation QA provides the evidence and recommendation. Final merge, deployment, and production decisions remain with the authorized release owner. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - At least two years of professional manual software QA experience. - Experience testing both mobile applications and web applications. - Experience testing complete end-to-end workflows. - Strong knowledge of functional, regression, exploratory, usability, and release testing. - Experience using Jira or a similar issue-tracking platform. - Ability to create organized test plans, test cases, checklists, and release summaries. - Excellent written English. Bug-report clarity is extremely important. - Strong spoken English for meetings and defect discussions. - Excellent attention to detail and analytical judgment. - Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned testing. - Comfortable collaborating with developers, product owners, and customer-support staff. - Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, backup internet or power plan, and screen-recording capability. - Ability to handle confidential information and follow security and test-data procedures. TESTING-DEVICE PREFERENCE Preference will be given to applicants who already own an iPhone Pro or iPad Pro with LiDAR capability. Applicants must state the exact model and current iOS/iPadOS version of every Apple device they can use for testing. Do not provide a serial number or IMEI. Owning a compatible Pro device is strongly preferred but is not an absolute requirement. A company-owned testing device may be provided to an exceptional candidate after successful completion of the interview, reference-check, and paid-assessment process. Candidates will never be required to purchase company equipment using their own money. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE The following experience is helpful but not required: - TestFlight and prerelease iOS application testing - SaaS or business-software testing - Role and permission testing - File upload, camera, sensor, scanning, or LiDAR-based application testing - Testing workflows that cross between a mobile application and administrative web portal - Basic API or application-log inspection - Working directly with remote U.S. development teams SCHEDULE - Full-time, 40 hours per week - Monday through Friday - Consistent daily schedule - At least four working hours must overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours - Exact schedule will be agreed upon before employment begins - Additional coordination may occasionally be needed during major releases

title: Senior UI/UX Designer — Streaming Platform Redesign (Web + Mobile App, Figma)
job_title: Senior UI/UX Designer — Streaming Platform Redesign (Web + Mobile App, Figma)
description: We are a media and personal development company. Our streaming platform hosts documentaries, original series, masterclasses and a podcast around conscious living, health and personal growth. We have thousands of paying members, we are preparing an English-language international launch, and we are rebranding the platform. Think of us as sitting somewhere between Gaia and Masterclass curated, direct, and built around a real community rather than an endless library. Our current platform works, but the design does not match the quality of what we put on it. That is what you are here to fix. The project A complete redesign of the member-facing experience across three surfaces: 1. Desktop web — the full logged-out and logged-in experience 2. Mobile web — responsive, treated as a first-class surface and not an afterthought 3. Native mobile apps — iOS and Android The platform runs on a third-party OTT solution. We want ambitious work that our development partner can actually implement. We will give you access to the current product and technical context so you can design against real constraints. We have an existing brand: fonts, colours, tone of voice and visual direction are set. You are designing within it and sharpening it, not replacing it. Screens and flows in scope Logged-out / acquisition: * Landing and homepage (conversion-focused) * Plan selection and pricing page for three membership tiers * Sign-up, onboarding and payment flow * Free trial entry and conversion moments * Campaign landing pages driven by email and paid social Logged-in / member experience: * Browse and discover, including hero, rails and carousels * Category, collection and curated-selection pages * Title detail pages for films, series and documentaries * Video player interface and all its states * Search, filtering and empty states * Continue watching, watchlist and viewing history * Masterclass and live session pages, including registration and reminders * Community section * Account, profile and subscription management, including upgrade, downgrade and cancellation App-specific: * Native navigation patterns for iOS and Android * Downloads and offline viewing * Audio-only / podcast mode * Push notification and permission moments * Casting to TV What you will deliver * High-fidelity UI designs in Figma for every screen and state listed above, in light and dark theme. We will give you guidance in how we want it! * A design system — components with variants and auto layout, colour and typography tokens, spacing scale, iconography, states and interaction rules, documented so a developer can read it without asking you * Responsive specifications — breakpoints and behaviour rules for desktop, tablet and mobile web * Developer handoff documentation — clean, organised, annotated Figma files with naming conventions our development partner can work from Everything lives in a single well-structured Figma file or project that we own. How we work * Weekly review calls, with written async updates in between * We work in phases. Each phase is approved before the next starts. * You will get direct access to decision-makers. Feedback is fast, direct and honest. we expect the same from you. If you think a request is wrong, say so. Requirements * 3+ years designing consumer-facing digital products, both web and native mobile * Expert-level Figma — auto layout, components, variants, variables and tokens, prototyping. This is not negotiable; we will look at your file structure, not just your screens. * A portfolio showing at least a few responsive web products and at least a few native mobile apps you designed end to end * Genuine understanding of video and OTT interface patterns — content rails, player controls, browse hierarchies, continue watching, metadata density * Working knowledge of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, and the discipline to respect platform conventions rather than copy-pasting one design across both * Understanding of subscription and conversion design — you know that a pricing page is a commercial instrument, not decoration * Experience building or maintaining a design system * Accessibility fundamentals — contrast, focus states, touch targets, WCAG AA awareness * Comfortable designing inside an existing brand and within platform limitations * Strong written English and self-directed async communication * Able to overlap at least 3 hours per day with Central European Time (CET/Amsterdam) * Reliable internet, your own computer, and a stable working setup Nice to have * Experience with streaming, OTT, membership or e-learning products * Motion and micro-interaction design, Lottie * Experience designing around white-label or templated platforms and their constraints * Multi-language interface design (English and Dutch) * Basic understanding of front-end implementation, enough to know what is cheap and what is expensive to build How to apply Start your reply with the word TTS. Applications that do not begin with TTS will not be read. We want to know you actually read this. Then include: 1. A link to your portfolio. Live Figma files or full case studies tell us far more than image galleries. show us your thinking, not only your pixels. 2. One specific example of a redesign you did where you can explain the problem, your decision and the result. 3. Your answer to this question: which streaming or membership product do you think has the best user experience right now, and what is the single thing it does that most others get wrong? 4. Your rate, your availability per week, and the earliest date you can start. 5. Which time zone you work in and your normal working hours. Please do not send a generic or AI-written application. We read every reply and we can tell. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video call and a short paid test assignment. So we can both see how we work together before committing to the full project.

You'll need to be comfortable adapting to what each client requires rather than working from a fixed, unchanging list of tasks. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of problems from discovery through to resolution, who questions how things are done and pushes for a better way when something doesn't add up, and who can hold a confident, informed conversation with the CFO about the numbers. This is not a client-facing role. The CFO keeps direct client relationships and calls; your focus is on building and running the finance function itself. What You'll Be Responsible For Financial Reporting & Accounting - Month-end close and management reporting across multiple client accounts - Maintaining accurate financial records and reconciliations - Supporting year-end accounting Inventory & Operational Finance - Inventory and landed cost accounting - Retail deductions and operational finance support - Managing and reconciling large datasets across multiple systems Forecasting & Analysis - Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts and cash flow projections - Investigating and resolving discrepancies and variances independently - Ad hoc financial and operational analysis Process & Relationship Ownership - Improving finance processes and workflows across the portfolio - Running the day-to-day finance function with minimal oversight - Bringing issues and improvement ideas to the CFO with confidence, not just waiting to be asked What We're Looking For - title: Shopify Ecommerce Inventory & Merchandising Specialist

Compensation and Schedule Pay: US$280 per week Payment: Weekly Hours: 40 hours per week Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned with Australian business hours Location: Fully remote Engagement: Full-time, long-term opportunity The advertised rate is fixed. Please only apply if you are comfortable with the compensation and schedule. Key Responsibilities Ecommerce Inventory Management - You will be expected to work directly with inventory data and help maintain accurate stock information across the ecommerce business. Responsibilities include: - Maintain and monitor accurate stock-on-hand information in Shopify - Assist with inventory reconciliation between Shopify and SAP - Investigate discrepancies between systems and identify the likely cause - Monitor sell-through, weeks of cover, aged stock, out-of-stocks and overstock risks - Maintain recurring inventory health and exception reports - Support replenishment and back-in-stock processes - Identify unusual stock movements or data inconsistencies - Escalate inventory risks clearly and early - Follow inventory issues through until they are resolved We need someone who can look at inventory data, recognise when something does not make sense, investigate why, and communicate what needs to happen next. Essential Experience To be considered, you must have demonstrated experience in both Shopify ecommerce operations and inventory management. You must have: - Strong, hands-on Shopify administration experience - Practical ecommerce inventory or stock-management experience - Experience investigating and resolving inventory discrepancies - Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills - Confidence working with large product and inventory datasets - Experience creating, enriching and maintaining ecommerce product listings - Experience with Shopify collections, tags, metafields and product categorisation - Understanding of stock availability, sell-through, out-of-stocks and inventory health - Strong written and spoken English - Excellent attention to detail - Strong problem-solving skills - Full-time availability during Australian business hours Customer service experience alone will not be sufficient for this position. Excel Skills You should be comfortable using Excel or Google Sheets for inventory analysis rather than basic data entry. We are particularly interested in candidates who regularly use tools such as: - XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP - INDEX/MATCH - SUMIFS and COUNTIFS - IF statements - PivotTables - Filters and sorting - Conditional formatting - Data cleaning and reconciliation - Large CSV or product-data exports - SAP / ERP Experience SAP experience is highly regarded but is not mandatory. Strong Shopify and inventory capability is more important. The successful candidate can be trained in the company's SAP processes. Experience with another ERP, inventory-management or warehouse system is also valuable. Highly Regarded - Fashion, apparel, footwear, accessories or lifestyle-brand experience - Multi-channel ecommerce inventory experience - Shopify Plus experience - Advanced Shopify metafields - ERP or inventory-management systems - Reporting automation - Power BI or other data-visualisation tools - Ecommerce trading or merchandising experience - Product launches and promotional trading support - The Working Style We Need Technical skills alone will not be enough for this role. Because this is a remote position, you must be a clear, proactive and dependable communicator. We are looking for someone who: - Gives clear and concise updates - Raises problems early rather than waiting to be asked - Explains what they found when investigating an issue - Confirms next steps and follows through - Asks sensible questions when information is unclear - Works methodically and consistently - Takes accountability for their work - Can manage recurring responsibilities without constant reminders - Communicates professionally with different teams If you discover an inventory discrepancy, we do not want someone who simply reports that the numbers do not match. We want someone who will investigate the issue, explain what they checked, identify the likely cause, recommend the next action and follow it through to resolution. title: Shopify Junior Manager
description: Shopify Store Localization Specialist & Web Designer Full-Time Remote | $500 USD/Month Starting Salary | Fox Ecom LLC About Us Fox Ecom LLC is a US company growing an international e-commerce business in men’s hair care. Our brand, Depura, launched in Italy, and we are now expanding into markets worldwide. We are looking for someone who can transform our existing Shopify store into a fully localized, launch-ready store for each new market. You will handle translation, visual assets, design adjustments, store configuration, app setup, testing, and final quality checks. This position starts at junior-level compensation, with the opportunity to progress into a senior role over the coming months based on your performance, independence, and ability to take on greater responsibility. Your Main Responsibility Complete one fully localized, launch-ready Shopify store per working day, using our existing store, established design, and supplied assets as your starting point. You will deliver a finished store that does not require our executives or another team member to complete the setup, correct avoidable mistakes, or finish outstanding work. What You Will Do 1. Translate and Localize the Entire Store Translate product descriptions, headlines, buttons, banners, FAQs, announcements, forms, and all other customer-facing content. Use DeepL, supported by AI tools and careful proofreading, to produce natural translations that preserve the original meaning and marketing message. Maintain consistent terminology, product names, tone, formatting, and brand identity. Localize customer emails, order notifications, and app-generated content, checking the complete shopping journey for untranslated text. 2. Translate and Adapt Images Using AI Use AI image-generation and editing tools to localize infographics, promotional graphics, badges, product packaging text, and other visual assets. Preserve the original composition, colors, branding, product appearance, and design quality. Ensure translated text is accurate, sharp, readable, and correctly positioned, including text on bottles and packaging. Correct distorted letters, visual artifacts, and layout problems. Prepare images in suitable dimensions and formats, balancing quality with loading speed. 3. Configure Shopify for Each Market Set up and verify products, collections, variants, pricing, currencies, product handles, and internal links. Configure markets, languages, domains, shipping zones, shipping rates, delivery information, payment methods, and checkout settings. Apply company-provided requirements for taxes, duties, and other market-specific settings. Build and check navigation menus, footer links, contact pages, and customer support details. Adapt shipping, returns, refunds, privacy, terms, and guarantee pages using approved company policies and business information. Localize page titles, meta descriptions, and image alt text where applicable. 4. Configure and Localize Shopify Apps Kaching: Configure bundles, quantity discounts, and promotional offers. Translate customer-facing text and verify product selection, pricing, and discount behavior across product pages, the cart, and checkout. Track123: Configure and localize the order-tracking page, tracking messages, and available notifications. Add tracking links to navigation and the footer, and test the customer experience. ---------- : Configure and localize review widgets, star-rating badges, review forms, and review-request emails. Translate reviews faithfully, prepare and validate import CSVs, map reviews to the correct destination-store products, and resolve import or display errors. Other apps: Configure and localize any additional tools used for upsells, cart functionality, email marketing, customer support, or other store features. Check app integrations, language, currency display, and appearance on desktop and mobile. Identify required subscriptions or access early. 5. Test and Deliver the Finished Store Review the entire store on desktop and mobile, checking typography, spacing, image quality, and responsive behavior. Test menus, links, product options, variants, add-to-cart, bundles, discounts, shipping calculations, tracking, and checkout. Verify payment configuration and complete a test purchase using the appropriate test setup. Submit a concise handover with the store link, completed checks, and any outstanding issues. What “Completed” Means A store is complete when all required content and images are localized, Shopify settings are correct, required apps are configured, and the shopping journey has been tested successfully. There should be no unfinished sections, broken links, incorrect product associations, or unresolved issues that prevent launch. You must identify missing information or access early, clearly request what you need, and follow each issue through to resolution. We expect independent execution without constant reminders or supervision. Salary, Schedule and Daily Target Starting salary: $500 USD per month. Schedule: eight scheduled working hours per day, five days per week. Daily target: one completed, quality-checked Shopify store. Once your assigned store meets all completion criteria and you submit your handover, you may finish your working day, even if you have worked fewer than eight hours. If you anticipate missing the deadline, notify management before the end of your scheduled working hours. Explain the blocker, what remains, and your estimated completion time. A short extension can be agreed where necessary. Finishing early is welcome, provided the required quality standard is met. Required Experience and Skills At least one year of hands-on experience building, managing, or localizing Shopify stores. Strong working knowledge of Shopify themes, products, markets, languages, shipping, navigation, policies, payments, and checkout. Practical experience with DeepL and AI tools, particularly translation, image generation, and image editing. Experience configuring Kaching, Track123, ---------- , or comparable Shopify apps, including troubleshooting integrations and review imports. A good eye for web design, typography, visual consistency, and mobile usability. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic Liquid sufficient to resolve common theme and layout issues. Clear written English, reliable internet, a suitable computer, and the ability to manage your workload independently. Attitude and Growth We want someone open-minded, motivated to grow, and willing to discuss ideas, ask questions, and accept constructive feedback. You should enjoy learning new tools, improving your workflow, and taking ownership of results. Complete transparency is essential. Report mistakes, delays, uncertainties, and blockers promptly. Never hide an issue or mark incomplete work as finished. Be clear about what you have completed, what you have checked, and what still needs attention. As you demonstrate reliable execution and stronger technical skills, you may progress into a senior role helping manage Depura’s Shopify stores worldwide. Future responsibilities may include overseeing multiple stores, improving our localization processes, and helping coordinate additional team members. How to Apply Send your application via WhatsApp to ---------- . Your first message must begin with “Depura Global” to confirm that you have read the entire job posting. Please include: A brief introduction and a summary of your relevant Shopify experience. Links to two or three stores you have worked on, explaining your exact responsibilities. Examples of translated store pages or localized images you have created. The AI and translation tools you use, including your experience with DeepL, Kaching, Track123, and ---------- . A short explanation of how you would prepare an existing Italian Shopify store for a new country. Your availability, time zone, and confirmation that you understand the $500 USD starting monthly salary, work schedule, and daily delivery target.

We are not looking for a VA, assistant, coordinator or someone who simply follows instructions. We are looking for someone who can take over the operational function, manage the people and resources available to them, make decisions independently, solve problems and continuously improve the way the business operates. The ideal candidate should be able to take the operation and say: "I'll handle it." About the Role You will be responsible for the complete operational side of the business. This means overseeing everything required to keep our properties running smoothly and ensuring that guests receive a good experience. You will work with our existing on-ground team, cleaners, technicians, managers and vendors, but you will also be expected to build additional resources whenever required. You will have the authority to make routine operational decisions and will be expected to use good judgment rather than waiting for approval for every small matter. The owner should not have to become involved in routine operational problems. If something needs to be done, you are expected to make sure it gets done. Your Responsibilities 1. Overall Operations You will have overall responsibility for the operational performance of the portfolio. This includes: Managing the day-to-day operation of all properties Making sure properties are ready for every check-in Managing check-outs and turnovers Coordinating cleaners and maintenance Managing the on-ground team Monitoring operational issues across properties Following up on outstanding tasks Handling urgent situations Managing vendors and contractors Ensuring operational standards are maintained Identifying problems before they become major issues Improving operational processes and procedures You should have a clear understanding at any given time of: What needs to be done, who is doing it, when it will be completed and whether it has actually been completed properly. 2. Housekeeping & Cleaning You will take responsibility for the housekeeping operation. This includes: Scheduling cleaners according to check-ins and check-outs Ensuring every property is cleaned on time Checking cleaning quality Handling cleaning complaints Organizing deep cleaning Managing cleaner performance Building a reliable pool of backup cleaners Managing linen and towel requirements Coordinating laundry Ensuring cleaning supplies are available Conducting quality-control checks Replacing cleaners who consistently underperform If we suddenly have more bookings and don't have enough cleaners, you are expected to solve the problem. You should come back with: "I've found three additional cleaners and arranged their trial shifts." 3. Maintenance & Repairs You will oversee the entire maintenance function. This includes: AC issues Plumbing Electrical problems Appliances TVs and electronics Internet/Wi-Fi issues Furniture Locks and access systems Painting General handyman work Emergency repairs Preventive maintenance We have in-house technical resources, but you are not limited to them. If our technician cannot solve a problem, you are expected to find someone who can. For example, if an in-house technician cannot repair a television: You should be able to identify the problem, search for suitable Dubai vendors, contact them, compare availability and pricing, arrange the repair and follow up until the issue is resolved. The same applies to any other specialist service. If we don't currently have a suitable vendor, you find one. 4. Building & Managing Vendors A strong Operations Head should continuously build a reliable network of vendors. If a vendor repeatedly performs poorly, replace them. 5. Guest Support & Escalations You will not be expected to personally answer every routine guest message. However, when a guest has a serious or complicated operational issue, you are expected to take ownership. This may involve calling the guest directly. Examples include: Guest cannot access the property AC has stopped working Property has a serious maintenance problem Cleaning was not completed properly Guest is missing an essential item Guest has an urgent complaint A technician needs to be sent immediately A problem is not being resolved by the normal team You should be comfortable speaking directly with guests, understanding the problem, coordinating the appropriate resources and following the issue through to resolution. The objective is not simply to respond to the guest. The objective is to solve the problem. 6. On-Ground Team Management You will manage and coordinate the operational resources available to the business. This may include: Cleaners Technicians Property managers Inspectors Maintenance staff Laundry resources External contractors Other support staff You will be responsible for d ---------- how resources are deployed. For example: A property has a maintenance issue at 12 PM and another property has a turnover at 1 PM. You should be able to assess the situation, d ---------- which resource should go where, arrange the required support and make sure both issues are handled. You should not need management to coordinate every operational movement. 7. Procurement & Operational Purchases You will be responsible for ensuring the business has the supplies and equipment it needs. This can include: Cleaning supplies Towels Bed linen Toiletries Kitchen supplies Maintenance materials Replacement items Small appliances Property consumables Other operational requirements You will have access to company resources for legitimate operational purchases, subject to company policies and accounting procedures. If you notice that stock is running low, you should order it before it becomes an emergency. We want someone who thinks ahead rather than waiting until something is completely finished. 8. Property Inspections & Quality Control You will be responsible for maintaining standards across the portfolio. This includes ensuring: Properties are properly cleaned Furniture is in good condition Appliances are working AC is functioning properly Bathrooms and kitchens are maintained Linen is available and in good condition Consumables are stocked Maintenance issues are identified Properties are ready before guest arrival You should establish proper inspection and quality-control procedures rather than relying entirely on guest complaints to discover problems. 9. Preventive Maintenance We don't want an operation where we only repair things after guests complain. You will be expected to identify recurring problems and introduce preventive measures. For example: If an AC repeatedly develops an issue, you should investigate why. If the same appliance repeatedly fails, you should determine whether it needs replacement. If a particular property consistently has plumbing issues, you should investigate the underlying cause. The goal is to reduce recurring problems and emergency call-outs. 10. Recruitment & Building the Team As the business grows, you will be responsible for identifying operational staffing requirements. If we need more: Cleaners Technicians Handymen Inspectors Property staff Other operational resources you should be capable of finding and screening suitable people. You may use Facebook groups, referrals, recruitment platforms, agencies, local networks and other appropriate channels. You will also be expected to identify underperforming staff and make recommendations regarding replacement, training or restructuring. 11. SOPs & Operational Systems You will be expected to improve the way the company operates. This includes developing and maintaining SOPs for areas such as: Check-in preparation Check-out procedures Cleaning Inspections Maintenance Emergency situations Guest complaints Inventory Laundry Vendor management Staff responsibilities Property readiness If a process repeatedly creates problems, you should identify the reason and improve the process. The Type of Person We Want We are looking for someone who is: Proactive Independent Practical Decisive Resourceful Organized Comfortable managing people Comfortable dealing with vendors Comfortable speaking with guests Good under pressure Good at prioritizing Strong at follow-up Comfortable making decisions Focused on solving problems Most importantly, you must take ownership. If you don't know how to solve something, you find someone who does. If we don't have a vendor, you find one. If we don't have enough cleaners, you recruit them. If the existing technician cannot solve the issue, you find a specialist. If a guest has a problem, you make sure it gets resolved. Mandatory Experience Dubai holiday-home experience is required. We are specifically looking for someone who has previously held a position such as: Head of Operations Operations Head Senior Operations Manager within a holiday-home company. You should already understand the practical realities of operating holiday homes in Dubai. Experience managing properties listed on Airbnb, ---------- and other short-term rental platforms is highly relevant. Candidates without previous senior Dubai holiday-home operations experience will not be considered. General hotel experience alone is not sufficient. General office-management experience is not sufficient. Long-term property management experience alone is not sufficient. This Is NOT a VA / Assistant Position We want to be very clear about this. If you see that a vendor is unreliable, you should find an alternative. If you see that something can be done more efficiently, you should improve it. We are hiring someone to run operations, not someone to assist the person running operations. Compensation Salary: Competitive and based on experience. The final package will depend on your previous Dubai holiday-home experience, portfolio size managed, team size managed and overall operational responsibility. title: PR & Communications Executive
description: Hi there! I run a small communications consultancy working with corporate and consumer brands, and I’m looking for an experienced **PR & Communications Executive** to work alongside me across client projects. This is a hands-on role covering communications, content and project management. I’m looking for someone who already has PR or communications experience, ideally within an agency or in-house communications team, so this isn’t a role where I’ll be teaching the basics from scratch. You don’t need to be senior, but you do need to understand the work. If I give you a client brief, background documents or even a slightly chaotic set of notes, I’d like you to be able to make sense of them, do the research, ask the right questions and get a strong first draft moving. **Working hours: 2–10 PM Manila time, Monday–Friday** You’ll need to be consistently available during these hours as you’ll be working alongside me on active client projects. ### What You’ll Help Me With **PR & Content** * Drafting press releases, LinkedIn posts, internal communications, articles and other content * Researching topics, companies, industries, media and potential story angles * Turning briefs, notes and background materials into strong first drafts * Proofreading and editing content * Preparing briefing documents and other communications materials * Supporting media relations activity and coordinating with external partners where needed **Project Management** * Keeping track of multiple client projects, deadlines and deliverables * Maintaining project trackers and content calendars * Following up on outstanding actions, feedback and approvals * Keeping briefs, files and working documents organised * Helping coordinate designers, suppliers and other partners * Spotting what needs to happen next and helping keep projects moving **Presentations & General Support** * Creating and polishing PowerPoint and Canva presentations * Supporting research and new-business proposals * Helping prepare reports, meeting notes and other client materials * General communications and project support when needed ### You’ll Do Well in This Role If You: * Have at least 2 years of hands-on PR, communications, content or agency experience * Have excellent written and spoken English * Can write clear, natural copy and adapt your writing for different audiences * Understand how press releases, corporate communications and social content work * Are highly organised and comfortable managing several deadlines at once * Have strong attention to detail * Can work independently and use good judgement * Ask questions when something isn’t clear * Take initiative rather than waiting to be told every individual step * Are reliable and follow through on what you say you’ll do You should also be comfortable using AI tools. I use them myself, so I have no problem with AI being part of your workflow. But I do need someone who can think, research, write and edit independently rather than simply submitting AI-generated copy. ### Bonus Points * PR agency experience * Corporate communications experience * Experience working with international brands * Media relations experience * Strong PowerPoint or Canva skills * Experience managing multiple client accounts or projects ### What You Can Expect * Direct and supportive collaboration * Interesting work across different clients and industries * The opportunity to take on more ownership as we build trust * Steady, long-term work with room to grow * Competitive pay based on experience I’m hoping to find someone who can become a genuine long-term support to the business. Over time, I’d like to be able to hand over increasingly substantial pieces of work and trust you to get them moving. ### How to Apply Please send: * A short introduction telling me about your PR/communications experience * Your CV or LinkedIn profile * 2–3 examples of content you have personally written, ideally including a press release or corporate communications piece * Your expected monthly salary in USD * Confirmation that you can consistently work **2–10 PM Manila time, Monday–Friday** Please use this exact subject line: **“Green + [your expected monthly salary in USD] + [Your Name]”** Example: **“Green + $500 + Ana Dela Cruz”** And finally, tell me briefly about a time you were given an unclear or incomplete communications brief. How did you approach it and what did you do next? Please write this part in your own words. I’m much more interested in how you think than in a perfectly polished answer.

description: SENIOR BRAND, E-COMMERCE & MARKETING LEAD Company: SUPR Global Employment: Full-Time | Remote Level: Senior / Leadership Markets: Singapore, Malaysia & Asia ABOUT SUPR SUPR is a growing performance and lifestyle brand built for people who want more from their everyday performance — from training and sport to recovery and daily life. We are building beyond individual products. Our goal is to build SUPR into a recognised performance brand across Asia. As we scale, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Brand, E-Commerce & Marketing Lead who can take ownership of our brand, marketing and commercial growth. This is not a position for someone who only executes campaigns, posts content or waits for instructions. We need someone who can think strategically, understand the customer, build the brand, drive revenue, lead a team and execute at a high level. You will work closely with the Founder/CEO and play a key leadership role in the growth of SUPR. --- THE ROLE You will own and oversee SUPR's overall brand, e-commerce, marketing and growth direction across Singapore, Malaysia and other Asian markets. Your responsibility is not simply to generate awareness. Your responsibility is to help turn brand attention into customers, customers into repeat customers, and SUPR into a scalable regional business. You will be expected to develop the strategy, build the roadmap, lead the team, execute campaigns and continuously analyse what is working and what needs to change. --- KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. BRAND STRATEGY & MANAGEMENT Own and strengthen SUPR's overall brand positioning, identity and direction. You will: - Develop and maintain clear brand positioning across products and markets - Ensure consistent brand messaging, tone and visual direction - Understand our target customers and what drives their purchasing decisions - Develop strong product positioning and key selling propositions - Identify opportunities to differentiate SUPR from competitors - Lead campaign concepts and brand storytelling - Ensure every customer touchpoint represents SUPR correctly - Maintain consistency across website, marketplaces, social media, advertising, packaging, creators and campaigns - Conduct competitor and market analysis - Help shape SUPR into a recognisable and desirable performance brand You should understand the difference between selling products and building a brand. --- 2. E-COMMERCE & REVENUE GROWTH Take ownership of SUPR's e-commerce performance across: Shopify TikTok Shop Shopee Lazada Future marketplaces and regional channels You will: - Develop strategies to increase online revenue - Improve conversion rates - Improve average order value (AOV) - Develop bundles, upsells and cross-sells - Optimise product pages and landing pages - Improve merchandising and product positioning - Plan marketplace campaigns and promotions - Analyse customer purchasing behaviour - Identify drop-off points in the customer journey - Work on retention and repeat purchase strategies - Improve the overall online customer experience - Identify new sales channels and growth opportunities You should understand how brand, creative, advertising, pricing, promotions and customer experience work together to generate revenue. --- 3. MARKETING & GROWTH STRATEGY Develop and own SUPR's overall marketing and growth strategy. You will: - Build monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans - Create a structured marketing calendar months ahead - Develop customer acquisition and retention strategies - Plan product launches and promotional campaigns - Identify new growth opportunities - Develop strategies for new market expansion - Define marketing KPIs and targets - Allocate marketing resources based on business priorities - Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements - Continuously test new channels, offers, messaging and audiences We expect you to think beyond today's tasks. PERFORMANCE MARKETING You should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, including: - Meta Ads - TikTok Ads - Retargeting - Paid social - Creative testing - Audience testing - Landing page testing - Conversion optimisation - Campaign scaling You do not necessarily need to personally operate every campaign forever, but you must understand performance marketing well enough to lead, evaluate and challenge the people responsible for it. You should be comfortable analysing: ROAS CAC CPA CTR CPC CPM Conversion Rate AOV LTV Retention Repeat Purchase Rate You should be able to identify why performance is improving or declining and determine what the team should test next. --- 5. CAMPAIGN & PRODUCT LAUNCH MANAGEMENT Own campaigns from idea to execution. You will: - Develop campaign concepts - Build campaign timelines - Coordinate product launches - Plan promotional strategies - Define offers and messaging - Coordinate creative production - Coordinate paid advertising - Coordinate influencer and creator activation - Coordinate e-commerce execution - Ensure campaigns launch on time - Monitor performance during campaigns - Conduct post-campaign analysis Every major campaign should have a clear objective, audience, strategy, timeline, owner, KPI and expected outcome. --- 6. CONTENT & CREATIVE DIRECTION You will work closely with designers, video editors, content creators and external partners. You should be able to: - Develop strong creative directions - Write clear creative briefs - Identify strong hooks and marketing angles - Understand what content performs across different platforms - Evaluate creative quality - Provide useful feedback to designers and editors - Develop content pillars - Balance brand-building content with conversion-focused content - Identify trends without blindly following them - Turn customer insights into creative concepts You don't need to personally design everything. But you must know what good creative looks like and why it works. --- 7. CREATOR, INFLUENCER & AFFILIATE MARKETING Develop and scale SUPR's creator ecosystem. This includes: - Influencer partnerships - Athlete partnerships - UGC creators - Product seeding - Affiliate programs - TikTok affiliates - Brand ambassadors You will: - Identify suitable creators - Develop creator strategies - Build scalable outreach systems - Structure affiliate campaigns - Track creator performance - Identify high-performing UGC - Turn successful organic content into paid advertising opportunities - Build long-term relationships with creators who genuinely fit SUPR --- 8. CUSTOMER RETENTION & CRM Growth doesn't stop after the first purchase. You will develop strategies around: - Email marketing - Customer segmentation - Repeat purchases - Product replenishment - Customer lifecycle campaigns - Abandoned carts - Win-back campaigns - Loyalty and community - Cross-selling - Customer feedback Your objective is to increase customer lifetime value, not simply acquire more first-time customers. --- 9. TEAM LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT This is a major part of the position. You will lead and manage members across marketing, creative, content, e-commerce and other growth functions. You will be expected to: - Establish clear roles and responsibilities - Set priorities and deadlines - Assign ownership for projects - Set KPIs - Monitor team performance - Conduct regular marketing and growth meetings - Review progress and deliverables - Hold team members accountable - Identify blockers early - Resolve execution problems - Coach and develop team members - Improve communication between departments - Recruit or recommend additional talent when necessary - Build efficient workflows and SOPs - Ensure projects move forward without constant Founder/CEO intervention The Founder should not need to constantly chase the marketing team for updates. You should be capable of running the department, creating structure and making sure things get done. --- 10. REPORTING, ANALYTICS & FORECASTING You will provide clear visibility into marketing and e-commerce performance. You should be able to produce and explain: - Weekly performance reports - Monthly marketing reports - Revenue performance - Campaign performance - Advertising performance - Customer acquisition costs - Channel performance - E-commerce conversion - Marketing spend - Growth forecasts - Upcoming campaigns and priorities We don't want reports filled with numbers without meaning. We want someone who can explain: What happened? Why did it happen? What are we doing next? --- ASIA & SINGAPORE MARKET EXPERIENCE SUPR is building from Singapore with ambitions across Asia. Therefore, previous experience working with Asian markets is highly advantageous. Experience specifically within Singapore and/or Malaysia is a strong plus. You should ideally understand: - Singapore consumer behaviour - Southeast Asian e-commerce - TikTok Shop - Shopee - Lazada - Regional purchasing behaviour - Local promotional periods - Regional creator/influencer ecosystems - Mobile-first commerce - Differences between Western and Asian consumer marketing Candidates who have successfully grown brands within Singapore, Malaysia or Southeast Asia will have a strong advantage. --- REQUIREMENTS We are looking for someone with: - 5+ years of strong experience in marketing, brand, growth or e-commerce - Previous experience in a senior or leadership position - Proven experience managing a marketing or growth team - Strong e-commerce experience - Strong understanding of Shopify - Experience with TikTok Shop, Shopee and/or Lazada is highly advantageous - Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok advertising - Experience developing and executing marketing strategies - Strong brand-building ability - Strong understanding of DTC/customer acquisition - Experience managing product launches - Experience with creators, influencers and affiliates - Strong analytical and commercial thinking - Excellent project management - Excellent written and spoken English - Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously - Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment - High level of ownership and accountability Experience within sports, fitness, performance, wellness, nutrition, lifestyle, consumer products or DTC brands is highly advantageous. --- WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE You are strategic, but you can execute. When a campaign performs well, you want to understand how to scale it. When competitors move, you notice. When there is an opportunity, you act. You are comfortable working in a startup environment where things move quickly and priorities evolve. Most importantly, you take ownership. --- THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF - You need constant instructions before taking action - Your experience is mainly social media posting - You cannot confidently manage a team - You struggle with deadlines and accountability - You focus mainly on followers, likes and impressions instead of business outcomes - You cannot understand marketing numbers - You prefer maintaining existing systems rather than building and improving them - You wait for management to identify every problem - You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment We are not hiring someone simply to manage marketing tasks. We are hiring someone to help build the company. --- WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Success means SUPR has: A stronger and more recognisable brand. A structured marketing engine. Growing e-commerce revenue. Profitable and scalable customer acquisition. Better customer retention. Successful product launches. A clear marketing calendar. Strong creative output. A high-performing team. Clear reporting and accountability. And most importantly, a marketing department that can operate and grow without the Founder having to manage every detail. --- HOW TO APPLY Please submit: 1. Your CV/resume 2. Portfolio or examples of brands you have worked with 3. Examples of campaigns you personally led 4. Actual measurable results you achieved 5. Examples of e-commerce businesses you helped grow 6. Team size and roles you previously managed 7. Platforms and advertising channels you have experience with 8. Experience working with Singapore, Malaysia or other Asian markets 9. Your expected monthly salary 10. Your availability/start date Where possible, provide actual numbers such as: Revenue growth ROAS improvement CAC reduction Conversion improvement E-commerce growth Campaign revenue Customer growth Generic statements such as "I helped grow social media" will not be sufficient. We want to understand what you personally did and what changed because of your work. THE OPPORTUNITY This is an opportunity to join SUPR at an early growth stage and play a major role in shaping where the brand goes next. For the right person, this is more than another marketing job. We are looking for someone who can become a key leader within SUPR and help build the brand across Asia. BE SUPR.

title: Ecommerce Social Media & Creative Specialist

title: Trailer Repair Specialist
description: GH Logistics and AJG Transport operate a high-performance freight brokerage and asset-based transportation network specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, clear communication, and accountability. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup through delivery. If you have experience coordinating equipment repairs, working with drivers and repair vendors, and keeping trailer operations moving during overnight hours, this role provides an opportunity to take ownership of a critical part of our Trailer Management operation. Role Overview You are responsible for maintaining overnight control of trailer repair activity and supporting off-tour Trailer Management operations. Your primary responsibility is to coordinate trailer repairs during the night shift, including high-volume on-road repair activity, while ensuring trailer records, repair statuses, documentation, and operational updates remain accurate in real time. You will work closely with the night repair team, drivers, carriers, repair vendors, facility personnel, and the Trailer Management team to keep equipment issues moving toward resolution. The night team is also responsible for verifying and completing work handed off by the day team and delivering a fully reconciled and accurate board for the incoming day shift. This is an operations and repair coordination position. You will not physically repair trailers and you will not have authority to approve company spending. What You’ll Be Doing Overnight Trailer Repair Coordination • Serve as the primary Trailer Management point of coordination for overnight and on-road trailer repairs, working with drivers, carriers, facilities, roadside providers, mobile mechanics, and repair vendors. • Review reported trailer defects, gather photos, inspection details, diagnoses, estimates, parts information, and other documentation needed to determine the appropriate next step. • Coordinate roadside service, mobile repairs, terminal repairs, inspections, trailer swaps, or equipment repositioning and follow up on vendor status, parts availability, completion timelines, and return-to-service expectations. • Continue follow-up on repairs handed off by the day team until they are resolved or properly documented and returned to the day team. • Escalate repair costs, safety concerns, major equipment issues, and matters requiring financial approval to authorized leadership; this role has no authority to approve spending. Fleetio and Data Integrity • Maintain Fleetio records overnight in real time and enter all repair, trailer, and operational updates handled during the shift. • Ensure trailer repair statuses, locations, assignments, conditions, and related records remain accurate and current. • Conduct overnight data integrity checks and investigate missing, outdated, conflicting, or incomplete information. • Update and maintain records involving misused trailers, partner carrier trailers, repair activity, vendors, and supporting documentation. • Identify and resolve discrepancies between operational information and system records before the morning handoff whenever possible. Off-Tour Trailer Operations • Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up. • Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team. • Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements. • Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability. • Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts. Documentation and Morning Handoff • Maintain complete and organized trailer repair paperwork and supporting documentation throughout the shift. • Clearly document completed work, pending repairs, vendor responses, equipment concerns, unresolved issues, and required follow-ups. • Verify items handed off by the day team and document what was completed, remains pending, or requires escalation. • Ensure every unresolved item has clear ownership, an accurate current status, documented next steps, and a proper handoff. • Deliver the 8 AM handoff complete and on time, including a reconciled board accurately reflecting trailer locations, statuses, repairs, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups. What Success Looks Like • Overnight and on-road trailer repairs are acknowledged quickly, coordinated effectively, and consistently followed through toward resolution. • Fleetio, trailer classifications, repair records, and other operational data remain accurate and updated in real time throughout the shift. • Drivers, carriers, vendors, facilities, and internal teams receive timely and clear communication regarding repair and trailer needs. • Repair documentation, escalations, and unresolved issues are complete, organized, and properly handed off without unauthorized spending decisions. • The day team receives a complete 8:00 AM handoff with a fully reconciled trailer board showing completed, pending, and escalated items. Who We’re Looking For • Experience in trailer management, fleet operations, dispatch, transportation, roadside assistance, or maintenance coordination. • Knowledge of common trailer repairs, components, equipment defects, and maintenance terminology; repair coordination experience preferred. • Able to review driver reports, photos, inspections, diagnoses, and estimates, ask the right follow-up questions, and determine appropriate next steps. • Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through in a fast-paced overnight operation. • Comfortable working independently and using Fleetio or similar fleet systems; Samsara, LoadStop, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace experience is a plus. • Minimum 50 WPM typing speed, strong written and verbal English, and a reliable remote setup with backup internet and power. Schedule and Work Setup • Long term and full time remote independent contractor role • Direct engagement with a US company, not an agency or BPO • Current shift availability: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT • Consistent availability during the assigned US shift is required • Zoom presence with camera on throughout the shift is required • Time tracking software, including Hubstaff or another platform, may be implemented as operationally required What You’ll Get • Independent contractor setup • $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning 30 days after hire • Reliable biweekly payments • A stable, long-term opportunity that is not seasonal or project-based • Direct exposure to a live US transportation and fleet operation • Meaningful responsibility over overnight trailer repair activity • Opportunities to develop deeper experience in Trailer Management, fleet maintenance, repair coordination, and transportation operations • Potential growth within Trailer Management, Fleet Operations, Maintenance Coordination, or broader logistics operations This role is built for someone who can keep control of trailer repairs after hours. You will not simply receive repair requests and pass them along. You will coordinate the response, maintain accurate Fleetio records, follow open repairs, support overnight trailer needs, clean up operational discrepancies, document what happened, and make sure the day team receives a reliable and reconciled picture of the operation every morning. Apply Here: ---------- /team/ ---------- /GHApplicationForm Visit Us: ----------

title: Bookeeping and CRM Assistant
description: ### About us B&A Roofing is a residential and commercial roofing company in the American South. We run six sales teams across Alabama, Georgia, and Mississippi. We are growing faster than our back office can keep up with, which is the honest reason this job exists. We want someone who stays. If you do this well you will still be here in three years, with more responsibility and better pay. ### What the job actually is Our reps sell roofs. When a homeowner pays, the rep files a commission request with the payment details and photos of the check. Somebody then has to check that request against the job, confirm the money actually came in, approve it, and get it to payroll before the deadline. Right now that somebody is buried. When it slips, a rep does not get paid on Friday, and a rep who does not get paid on Friday is not knocking doors on Monday. That is the piece of this job we care about most. Around that sits the rest of it: keeping our jobs clean in the CRM, keeping the CRM and QuickBooks agreeing with each other, and taking work off our Regional Sales Manager. ### Your week - Review and approve weekly commission entries in Zoho Commission Calculator, matching every entry against the job and the payment we actually received - Chase reps for missing check photos and payment paperwork before the Saturday cutoff - Keep the commission tracker accurate so payroll runs clean every Friday - Maintain job records in JobNimbus, our CRM. Statuses, contracts, estimates, documents, photos, all filed where they belong - Move jobs along the pipeline boards and flag anything that has sat in one stage too long - Reconcile invoices and payments between JobNimbus and QuickBooks Online, including making sure each job is booked to the branch that actually sold it - Follow up on unpaid invoices - Support our Regional Sales Manager. Build his weekly reports, prep his meeting agendas, run his calendar and inbox, track what his six sales managers owe him, and go get it when they are late - Whatever else hits his desk that a sharp assistant can take instead ### What you need - Real QuickBooks Online experience. Not "I watched a course." You have worked in QBO, you understand invoices and payments and reconciliation, and when the numbers do not match you go find your own mistake - Two or more years supporting a US business remotely - You are good with numbers and you catch errors nobody asked you to look for - Written English strong enough to email a US sales manager and sound like a professional - You can work US Central business hours, which is your night. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to that - You are willing to hold people accountable. A real part of this job is politely nagging salespeople who owe you paperwork. If that sounds miserable to you, this is the wrong job ### Helps, but not required - JobNimbus, AccuLynx, ServiceTitan, or any other field service CRM - Construction, roofing, or home services background - Zoho experience - Payroll or commission calculation experience ### What you need to have set up - Computer with 8GB RAM or better - Internet at 20 Mbps or better, plus a backup connection for when the power goes out - Somewhere quiet to take calls, a headset, and a working webcam --- ## How to apply Read this part. Applications that skip it get deleted unread. Subject line: **ROOF-COMMISSION-2026** Answer these four questions in the body. Short answers are fine. Skip the cover letter. 1. How many years have you worked inside QuickBooks Online, and what did you use it for? 2. A rep submits a commission request for $2,400 on a job. The customer's check cleared for $1,800. What do you do? 3. Which CRMs have you worked in? 4. Confirm you can work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central, Monday through Friday. Attach your resume. Send your DISC profile if you have one. Everyone we shortlist hears back within a week.

title: Content & Social Media VA for a Vacation Rental Marketing Agency (20 hrs/week, long-term)
job_title: Content & Social Media VA for a Vacation Rental Marketing Agency (20 hrs/week, long-term)
description: Hi! I'm Jim, and I run a small US marketing agency called Digital Redefined. We work with vacation rental operators — people who own and manage short-term rental properties — and we help them get guests booking directly instead of handing a cut to Airbnb and VRBO every time. It's a niche most people have never thought about, and it's genuinely interesting once you're in it. I'm looking for one person to own our content and social media work, long-term. THE WORK - A bi-weekly email newsletter for one of our clients — you draft it, I review, we send - Two social media posts a week for that client (Facebook and Instagram, scheduled in Metricool) - FAQ and location content for client websites — "what's worth doing near this property", "when's the best time to visit" — genuinely researched, the kind of thing a traveler bookmarks - Keeping client listings accurate across Google, Yelp, and TripAdvisor That's the job. It's a specialist role rather than a general VA role — you'll go deep on a few things and get really good at them, instead of spreading across twenty. If that's how you like to work, I think you'll enjoy it here. WHO I'M HOPING TO FIND - You write genuinely good English. Not flawless — good. Clear, warm, no filler. - You've written for a US audience, and it sounds like one of them wrote it. - You can take a place you've never been — a beach town in Florida, say — research it properly, and write something useful about it. - You've used a scheduling tool before. Metricool, Buffer, Hootsuite, Later, any of them. - You're comfortable working independently. I'm not going to be over your shoulder. HOW I WORK I don't micromanage, and I don't want to. Instead, I'd ask that you keep me in the loop. If something's running late, or you're stuck, or a brief doesn't make sense — just tell me. I'd much rather hear about it on Wednesday than be surprised on Friday. Nobody here gets in trouble for raising a problem early. Honestly, it's one of the things I value most in the people I work with, and I'll tell you when you do it. You'll track your time per task. That's mostly so I can scope work properly — if something keeps taking twice as long as I thought, that's my brief that needs fixing, not your speed. title: Social Media Designer
description: Social Media Designer Phase · remote · part time · contract We're building Phase so people spend less of their life on a screen and more of it doing what they actually want. Not as a lecture about willpower, and not as another app asking you to try harder. A €54 device that locks your phone and then doesn't negotiate, so the decision only has to be made once. Around that we're building the part that matters more than the product: a community of people taking digital wellness seriously, who want more out of their days and are willing to be held to it. The device makes it possible. The people around it are what make it last. Instagram is where that community forms, and it's the part of Phase that hasn't caught up with the rest yet. We want one designer to take it. THE STANDARD Open Eight Sleep, Brick, etc, their IG. Calm, deliberate, unmistakably one hand, and you can tell the brand from a thumbnail. That's the level. A Phase feed with a point of view, a grid that reads as one publication rather than a stream, and a system strict enough that the fortieth post still looks like the first. WHAT YOU'D OWN Everything that goes out: carousels, statics, reel covers, the template system, the grid. Slide count, pacing, crop, hierarchy. Whether a cover works at feed size, which is yours alone because nobody else here can see it. And the right to send a storyboard back. No committee, no agency in the middle. Concepts are signed off once a week. Anything from an approved template, you ship. WHO YOU ARE You've brought a feed to life before, for a brand people know, and you can point at it and say which parts were yours. Your craft is editorial: layout, typography, sequence, image curation, restraint. You treat a carousel as an argument that expands, not as stacked ads. And the problem matters to you. That part is hard to fake and easy to spot. HOW WE'D JUDGE IT Saves and sends, read per quarter. Not followers, not likes, not how many posts you shipped. Two carousels a week that hold the argument beat ten that fill a grid. HOW TO APPLY Send two or three pieces of work you'd want to be judged on, and say what was yours in each. Then spend an hour ---------- and answer three things. 1. Their feed is recognisable from a thumbnail, and almost every frame contains something that could only come from a phone. Tell us what they're actually doing, and what it buys them. The mechanism, not the mood. 2. Phase doesn't have one yet. Propose ours: the single element that should appear in every Phase frame so a stranger can tell our post from anyone else's before reading a word. 3. Show it working. The first three tiles of the Phase grid built on it. Three covers at 1080 × 1350, plus those same three at 129 points wide, side by side as they'd sit in the grid. One line per tile on what it asks the viewer to do. We care more about your answer to two than about how polished three is. Apply and talk soon, Team Phase

title: Document Controller (Construction)
description: **The job, in one sentence:** keep the single current record of what was issued, d ---------- , promised and asked across our projects, and run the clock on everything that is waiting. **What you will own** - The transmittal register: every drawing set and revision that leaves us — to whom, when, stamped or not, what it supersedes. Sets go out through you, with a transmittal line, or they do not go out. - The RFI log and the submittal log with the designers, engineers and trades: question, owner, date asked, date due, answer, closed. - The change and scope log; the permit and inspection tracker; the vendor and authority contact of record. - The decisions register: rulings and reversals made in calls, meetings and messages, filed the same day with what they supersede. - Meeting minutes with an action list — owner, date — read at the start of the next meeting. - The chase clock: anything waiting on a vendor, a designer, an authority or one of us gets a second touch after two working days, a written escalation with a proposed default after four, and the default after seven. - The Friday picture for the founders: what is late, what is waiting on whom, and every exception to the standard by name — including the owner's. **What you will not own** - Running the project (the project manager), buying the work (procurement), designing it (the architects and engineers), managing people, or building software. You keep the record and run the clock; you close records with evidence and you name who has to act and by when. You do not do the act yourself, and you do not remind people quietly — you write it down where everyone reads it. **Who you are** - Three to eight years as a document controller, project coordinator or contract administrator at a general contractor, a consultant or an offshore AEC team. You have kept a transmittal log through a dispute and you can tell us what happened the day it was ignored. - Comfortable telling a senior person, in writing and early, that their drawing went out without a transmittal or their decision has not been filed — and doing it in a way that does not make an enemy. - Fluent enough with ClickUp, JobTread and Google Workspace to learn ours in a week; comfortable with an AI assistant for drafting and summarising. - Able to keep an overlap with Atlantic mornings [hours: e.g. 7 pm–midnight Manila = 8 am–1 pm Halifax; state honestly]. **Not this role if:** your answer to non-compliance is "I would remind them"; you want authority over people; you cannot keep the overlap. **How we hire:** one short written application (three questions below), then a one-hour work sample — a real week of one of our projects' traffic, from which you produce the transmittal register, the RFI log, the decisions register and the chase list. We score the sample, not the interview. Shortlisted candidates get a 30-minute call and an offer. **Three questions, ≤150 words each** 1. Name a log you owned. What did it track, who read it, and what happened the day someone ignored it? 2. A chase failed — the other side went silent. What did you change so it would not depend on you chasing harder? (We score whether you changed the mechanism, not whether you closed it by hand.) 3. The person who did not answer was above you. What did you do, and what happened to you? Include the word PLUMBLINE in your first line so we know you read this.
