title: Outreach & Relationship Development Specialist
description: # Outreach & Relationship Development Specialist **Company:** Smartphone Billions **Position:** Full-Time **Hours:** 25-30 hours per week **Schedule:** Must have availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours ## About Smartphone Billions Smartphone Billions helps entrepreneurs and established business owners access capital to grow their businesses. We are looking for an **Outreach & Relationship Development Specialist** who can help us create more conversations, develop relationships with bankers, and reactivate qualified leads already inside our pipeline. This is not a position where you simply send hundreds of copy-and-paste messages. We need someone who is organized, persistent, comfortable communicating with professionals, and understands how to follow up without being annoying. Your job is simple: **Start conversations. Build relationships. Follow up. Get qualified people onto our calendar.** ## Your Two Main Responsibilities 1. Banker Outreach & Relationship Development A major part of this role will be helping us build relationships with bankers and business banking professionals across the country. You will: - Research bankers, business bankers, branch managers, relationship managers, and other relevant banking professionals on LinkedIn. - Identify bankers at institutions that may be a good fit for our funding strategies. - Send personalized LinkedIn connection requests and messages. - Engage with bankers' LinkedIn content before and after reaching out. - Comment thoughtfully on posts to build familiarity. - Follow up consistently with bankers who do not respond initially. - Start conversations and identify bankers interested in working with our company and clients. - Schedule qualified banker conversations directly onto our calendar. - Keep detailed records of every banker contacted. - Maintain and organize our banker relationship database. - Follow up with existing banker relationships periodically so they stay warm. - Help us expand our network into new banks, markets, and geographic areas. The goal is NOT to immediately sell bankers. The goal is to **build real relationships that can help our clients access more capital.** ### 2. Lead Reactivation & Follow-Up We already generate leads through social media, advertising, our CRM, referrals, and other channels. Not every qualified lead books immediately. Some stop responding. Some say they are interested and disappear. Some complete part of our process but never take the next step. Your responsibility will be to bring those conversations back to life. You will: - Follow up with qualified leads who have gone cold. - Respond to and reactivate Instagram leads. - Follow up with people who previously messaged us about business funding. - Work through older leads inside our CRM. - Follow up with prospects who started but did not complete our application process. - Nudge qualified prospects who have not scheduled their funding consultation. - Send follow-up messages through Instagram, SMS, email, LinkedIn, and our CRM when appropriate. - Identify why leads stopped responding. - Answer basic questions using company-approved information. - Escalate funding-specific questions to the appropriate team member. - Schedule qualified prospects onto our sales calendar. - Maintain accurate notes so our sales team knows exactly what happened before the call. We don't want leads sitting untouched inside our CRM. If someone showed interest, we want to know whether they're still interested, not interested, not qualified, or need to be followed up with later. ## What Success Looks Like You will be measured on outcomes, not just activity. We will track things such as: - New qualified banker relationships created - Banker meetings scheduled - Banker response rate - Number of qualified bankers added to our database - Lead conversations reactivated - Qualified sales appointments booked - Follow-up response rate - Lead-to-appointment conversion rate - CRM accuracy and follow-up completion - Consistency of daily outreach Sending 100 messages means nothing if nobody responds. We care about **quality conversations and appointments.** ## Who We're Looking For You may be a strong fit if you: - Have previous LinkedIn outreach, appointment setting, lead generation, or business development experience. - Write and speak professional English. - Are comfortable communicating with bankers and other financial professionals. - Understand how to personalize outreach instead of sending obvious spam. - Are persistent with follow-up. - Know how to keep conversations moving toward a next step. - Are highly organized. - Can manage hundreds of contacts without losing track of conversations. - Are comfortable working inside a CRM. - Can follow scripts while still sounding like a real person. - Take initiative instead of waiting to be told every individual task. - Understand that most opportunities happen because of consistent follow-up. Experience with financial services, business funding, business credit, banking, GoHighLevel, LinkedIn outreach, Instagram outreach, or appointment setting is a major plus. ## Tools You May Use Depending on the workflow, you may work with: - LinkedIn - Instagram - GoHighLevel - Email - SMS - Google Sheets - Google Workspace - Calendars and appointment scheduling software - AI tools for research and message personalization Experience with every tool is not required, but you must be comfortable learning new systems quickly. ## Important We are NOT looking for someone who sends generic messages like: "Hi, I saw your profile and would love to connect." We want someone who actually looks at the person they're contacting, understands why we're reaching out, and starts a normal conversation. You should know the difference between **outreach and spam.** You should also understand that follow-up does not mean sending: "Just following up." over and over again. Every follow-up should have a purpose. ## How to Apply Please send us: 1. A short introduction about yourself using loom 2. Your previous experience with LinkedIn outreach, appointment setting, lead generation, or sales follow-up. 3. Any experience you have working with bankers, financial services companies, funding companies, or business owners. 4. The CRMs and outreach tools you have used. 5. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time. ### Mini Assessment Include answers to these two questions in your application: **Scenario 1:** You find a Business Relationship Manager at a major bank on LinkedIn. They recently posted about helping small businesses prepare for growth. Write the first message you would send them. **Scenario 2:** A business owner messaged us on Instagram two weeks ago asking about accessing $100,000 in business funding. They appeared qualified, but stopped responding after we sent them the application. Write the message you would send to restart the conversation. We will prioritize applicants who complete both scenarios. **Please do not use a generic AI-generated response. We want to see how YOU naturally communicate.**

title: Senior Video Editor & Social Media Manager - Full Time
job_title: Senior Video Editor & Social Media Manager - Full Time
description: We are looking for an exceptional full-time Video Editor & Social Media Manager to join our team long-term. This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone with significant professional experience editing high-quality video and images, excellent creative judgment, and the ability to take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging content. You will work directly with the founder of a fast-growing U.S. education company and help build our presence across YouTube and social media. What You’ll Be Doing Your primary responsibilities will include: Editing long-form YouTube videos Editing short-form content for YouTube Shorts, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc. Creating professional thumbnails and social media graphics Turning long-form content into multiple pieces of short-form content Adding B-roll, graphics, text, animations, screenshots, zooms, cuts, and other elements that improve viewer retention Improving pacing, storytelling, hooks, and overall video quality Publishing and managing content across our social media accounts Helping organize our content calendar Repurposing existing content Maintaining a consistent visual style across our brand Reviewing performance and helping identify what types of content we should create more of VERY IMPORTANT: YouTube Training Before editing our YouTube content, you will be required to complete a YouTube training program that we provide called Channel Jumpstart. You will be paid while completing the training. It will take several weeks. We have a specific philosophy around: Hooks Viewer retention Pacing Pattern interrupts B-roll Storytelling Titles Thumbnails Delivering on the promise of the title/thumbnail Keeping viewers engaged throughout a video We do NOT want an editor who simply edits based on personal preference. We want someone who is willing to learn our system, understand why it works, and then apply it consistently to every piece of content. What We’re Looking For You should have: Excellent professional video editing experience A strong portfolio of work you personally edited Experience editing YouTube content Experience creating short-form social media content Strong graphic design/image editing skills Experience creating YouTube thumbnails Excellent visual judgment Excellent attention to detail A strong understanding of pacing and viewer retention The ability to work independently without needing constant direction The ability to receive feedback without taking it personally A desire to continuously improve your work English Requirement You must have excellent written AND spoken English. You will be working directly with a U.S.-based team, reviewing English-language content, writing social media copy, communicating about edits, and occasionally making judgment calls about wording. Fluent English is a requirement for this position. Software You should be highly experienced with professional editing/design software. Experience with tools such as the following is a plus: Adobe Premiere Pro After Effects Photoshop Illustrator Canva Camtasia Other professional video, motion graphics, or image-editing tools We care more about the quality of your work than which specific software you use. This Is a Full-Time, Long-Term Position We are not looking for a freelancer handling 10 other clients. We are looking for someone who wants to become our full-time professional editor and social media manager and grow with the company. We are willing to pay a strong salary for an exceptional person. If you are extremely talented, reliable, communicate well, and consistently produce excellent work, there is significant opportunity to grow with us. How to Apply Please send: A brief introduction about yourself Your video editing experience Your social media experience A link to your portfolio Links to 3 videos you personally edited that best represent your work Examples of thumbnails or graphics you personally created Which editing/design programs you use Your current or most recent full-time salary Your expected monthly salary for this position Your availability and how soon you could start Please also answer this question: What do you believe separates an average YouTube editor from an exceptional YouTube editor? At the very beginning of your application, write: “I READ THE ENTIRE POST.” Applications that do not include this will not be reviewed. We are looking for someone exceptional and plan for this to be a long-term position.

title: E-commerce Operations Coordinator & Executive Assistant — ClickUp, Slack and Shopify
job_title: E-commerce Operations Coordinator & Executive Assistant — ClickUp, Slack and Shopify
description: I run an e-commerce and media business in Ireland, alongside several client and internal projects. I’m looking for an organised, proactive person who can turn meetings, messages and ideas into clear actions—and make sure those actions are completed. This is not just a calendar or inbox assistant role. You will help run the operating system behind the business. Your mission is: Nothing important should depend on me remembering it, forwarding it or chasing it. What you will own Review Fathom and Granola meeting notes and turn decisions into ClickUp tasks. Give every task an owner, deadline, next action and clear definition of done. Monitor ClickUp and follow up on overdue work. Review Slack and email, identify required actions and draft routine responses. Prepare one short daily update covering priorities, blockers and decisions. Organise meeting agendas and follow-ups. Maintain project boards, SOPs, decision logs and recurring checklists. Coordinate assets, information and access needed by contractors. Keep Google Drive and project documentation organised. Coordinate basic Shopify and e-commerce work, including product updates, website checks and reporting. Check completed work against briefs and QA checklists. Organise receipts, invoices and reimbursement evidence. Assist with travel, bookings, appointments and occasional personal administration. What you will not be expected to do Build funnels or write code. Run advertising campaigns. Make marketing-strategy or financial decisions. Make payments or access online banking. D ---------- tax, payroll or accounting treatment. Specialists will handle technical work. Your responsibility is ensuring they have what they need and deliver properly. You may be a good fit if you have At least two years’ experience in operations, project coordination or executive assistance. Strong hands-on ClickUp experience. Experience supporting an e-commerce business, agency or Shopify store. Excellent written and spoken English. A track record of following through without reminders. Confidence respectfully chasing contractors and team members. Strong judgment about what you can handle and what must be escalated. Excellent attention to detail. Experience with Slack, Google Workspace and Loom. Reliable internet, equipment and a backup plan. Experience with Shopify, Zapier, Make, Notion or AI productivity tools is helpful but not essential. Hours and compensation 20 hours per week, spread across Monday to Friday. Two hours of daily overlap with Dublin morning working hours. Remaining hours can be flexible. US$550 per month during a paid 60-day probation. Increased to US$650 per month when the agreed performance targets are met. Prorated 13th-month bonus. Five part-time paid-leave days annually after probation. Scope and compensation reviewed after six months. Opportunity to become full-time if the workload and fit justify it. What success looks like Within your first 60 days: Meeting actions are entered into ClickUp on the same business day. Important tasks have an owner, deadline and next action. Routine follow-ups happen without my involvement. No overdue priority task disappears silently. I receive one concise daily brief instead of checking multiple applications. Project information and documents can be found quickly. I spend significantly less time chasing, organising and remembering. How to apply Start your application with: CALM OPERATIONS – [Your name] Please answer the following: Why does this particular role suit you? Tell me about a messy business, founder or project you helped organise. What would you do if a contractor missed two deadlines and then stopped responding? Share a redacted screenshot or short Loom showing a ClickUp system you managed. What are your normal working hours in Philippine time? Confirm that you accept the advertised starting compensation. Include a two-minute Loom introducing yourself and explaining how you prevent tasks from being forgotten. Generic applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered. Hiring process Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid 90-minute exercise. You will receive anonymised meeting notes, messages and a messy project list. You will be asked to create: A prioritised action board. Two draft follow-up messages. A concise daily founder brief. A list of risks, missing information and decisions required. The exercise pays US$25, whether or not you are hired.

title: Property Management Accountant

Highly organized with the ability to manage recurring, deadline-driven tasks, Required - Ability to work independently and take initiative in a remote environment, Required - Clear and professional written communication, Required - Familiarity or interest in property management or real estate, Preferred Compensation: - $5 - $10 USD Per Hour depending on Experience - Full Time Position (40 hrs/week) - Remote Contractor Position About PIN: Passive Investor Network (PIN) is a company located in Houston, Texas, USA looking to change the way people invest in the real estate market. By becoming a member with PIN, you instantly gain access to an entire team dedicated to making your first investment property seamless. With access to acquisitions experts, an in house construction team, property management, and so much more, your possibilities are endless. Stand out through clarity, consistency, and impact. - I: Integrity Do the right thing every time, even when no one's watching. title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
job_title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description: Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form. Why strong setters join us We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real. 01 — Uncapped earning potential Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month. 02 — Experienced leadership that develops you You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow. 03 — A supportive, high-performing team We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth. Compensation — paid every week via Wise Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base Working hours 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET) That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT). This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment. Onboarding Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident. To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there. What you'll actually do Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services. Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote. Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically. Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day. Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work. Who we're looking for 2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling. A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller. Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation. Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset. Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline. What you're walking into A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term. Ready to apply? If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: # High-Volume Direct Response Video Editor — 50–60 Ads/Week
job_title: # High-Volume Direct Response Video Editor — 50–60 Ads/Week
description: We're an affiliate marketing team running paid social campaigns at scale, and we're looking for **fast, resourceful direct-response video editors** to join our creative team. **Speed is extremely important for this role.** We're testing a large amount of creative every week. We don't need someone who spends an entire day perfecting one 30-second video. We need someone who understands how to produce **good direct-response creative quickly**, identify what matters, and iterate at volume. ### Expected Output: 50–60 Ads Per Week Before that number scares you: **we are NOT expecting 50–60 completely new concepts every week.** A typical week may look more like: **10–20 new concepts + 30–40 variations/iterations** For example, you might create one core ad and then produce variations with: * Different hooks * Different opening visuals * Different B-roll * Different voiceovers * Different headlines/text overlays * Different pacing * Different CTAs * Different formats or styles You should know how to turn **one promising concept into multiple testable creatives quickly.** If producing 50–60 ads per week sounds unrealistic for your workflow, this probably isn't the right position. ## What You'll Be Doing You'll primarily create short-form performance ads for platforms like Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, and other paid social channels. We may give you: * Winning/reference ads * Scripts * Hooks or angles * Landing pages * Raw footage * Existing ads that need variations * Or simply a concept/direction From there, **we expect you to be able to run with it.** We're specifically trying to avoid a workflow where the editor needs every clip, voiceover, and creative decision handed to them. If you need B-roll, find it. If you need a voiceover, generate it. If an AI-generated clip would make the concept work, create it. If you see a way to make the reference ad better, test it. You should be comfortable using tools like **ElevenLabs and AI image/video generation tools** as part of your normal workflow. ## We're Looking for Performance Editors, Not Just Video Editors The goal isn't to make the prettiest video. **The goal is to make ads that convert.** You should understand: * Hooks and the first 1–3 seconds * Direct-response advertising * Pattern interrupts * UGC/native-style creative * Advertorial-style ads * Pacing and retention * Creating variations quickly * Iterating on winning ads * How to use reference ads without simply copying them * How to make creatives feel native to the platform Experience with affiliate marketing, lead generation, e-commerce, finance, insurance, supplements, or other direct-response verticals is a major plus. ## You Need to Work FAST We want to emphasize this because it's one of the biggest requirements of the position. **Our advantage comes from creative testing velocity.** We would rather have an editor who can create 10 strong, testable variations quickly than someone who spends days making one ad perfect. That does NOT mean sloppy work. It means having an efficient workflow, knowing what actually matters in a performance ad, and not wasting hours polishing things that won't affect performance. You should be comfortable receiving assignments and turning around creatives **the same day or within 24 hours when needed.** ## You Need to Be Independent We're looking for editors with **complete creative autonomy.** You shouldn't need to ask: “Where should I get the footage?” “What voice should I use?” “What should I put here?” We'll provide direction, references, and feedback, but we expect you to solve most creative problems yourself. That includes researching competitors, finding footage, generating AI assets, creating voiceovers, and making editing decisions. ## You'll See How Your Ads Actually Perform We're performance marketers, so your creatives will actually be tracked. Every ad will be labeled by editor, which means we'll be able to see performance by: * Editor * Concept * Hook * Angle * Variation You'll be able to see which of your ads are winning and use that information to improve future creatives. We're not interested in endless subjective feedback like: > “Can you make this look a little better?” **The numbers will tell us what works.** Editors who consistently produce winners will receive more responsibility and more creative volume. ## Paid Trial Process We're initially bringing on several editors for **paid trial assignments.** Everyone will receive similar source material and assignments so we can evaluate how each person approaches the work. We'll primarily be evaluating: * **Turnaround speed** * Creative quality * Ability to work independently * Direct-response instincts * How much you transform the source material * Ability to create genuinely different variations * Resourcefulness * Ability to use AI effectively * Communication * Ability to handle volume The strongest editors will move into ongoing positions with consistent weekly work. ## To Apply Please send us: 1. **3–5 of your best direct-response ads.** Don't send us a giant portfolio. We want to see your most relevant work. 2. What types of paid ads/verticals have you edited before? 3. What AI tools do you currently use for video, images, voiceovers, or editing? 4. **Can you realistically handle 50–60 finished ads per week, assuming roughly 10–20 are new concepts and the rest are variations?** 5. How quickly could you turn around **5 variations of an existing winning ad?** 6. How quickly could you turn around **one completely new ad concept** if you're given a reference ad, script, and landing page? title: Codex Virtual Assistant
description: # Codex Virtual Assistant ## AI Project Coordination & Quality Support MS² — My Story Studio is developing an innovative application that transforms family photos, videos, voices and memories into meaningful stories, photo books and films. A substantial part of the product is being developed with OpenAI Codex. We are looking for a careful, reliable and analytically minded Virtual Assistant who can help the founder prepare, supervise and verify this work. **Programming experience is not required.** What matters most is your ability to think logically, follow instructions accurately, maintain a clear overview and recognise inconsistencies. ## Your role You will work directly with the founder and help manage the daily collaboration with Codex. Codex performs and explains the technical work. You ensure that assignments are properly started, monitored, documented and completed. Your responsibilities will include: * Preparing clear and structured assignments for Codex * Ensuring that every assignment has a defined objective, scope and expected result * Starting Codex runs using provided instructions and templates * Monitoring active runs and responding when Codex requires additional input * Carefully reading Codex reports and completion summaries * Checking whether every question and requirement has been addressed * Comparing completed work with the original assignment * Identifying contradictions, missing information and unresolved issues * Verifying that conclusions are supported by evidence * Ensuring that Codex follows the agreed procedures * Recording decisions, progress, blockers and follow-up actions * Keeping planning sheets and project documentation accurate and current * Starting the next approved assignment when a run is complete * Escalating warnings, unexpected results and discrepancies to the founder * Maintaining a reliable overview of several parallel activities You will receive clear procedures, checklists, templates and instructions. ## Who we are looking for You are someone who: * Thinks logically and analytically * Works in a highly structured and careful way * Reads instructions completely before taking action * Pays close attention to details * Notices inconsistencies that others may overlook * Can distinguish between facts, assumptions and conclusions * Asks precise questions when something is unclear * Follows agreed procedures consistently * Keeps accurate records * Can manage several related tasks without losing the overview * Communicates clearly and concisely in written English * Follows up reliably without needing constant reminders * Is curious and comfortable learning new AI tools * Stops and asks for guidance when instructions and actual results do not match Experience in administration, project coordination, quality control, auditing, research, legal files, financial files or another accuracy-sensitive environment can be highly relevant. ## No programming experience required You do not need experience with Python, coding or software development. You should feel comfortable working with: * Written procedures and checklists * Structured reports and project documentation * Google Sheets or similar tools * ChatGPT, Codex or comparable AI applications * English-language instructions * Several open applications and tasks at the same time Training in the MS² working method and the practical use of Codex will be provided. ## Working with Windows PowerShell and Azure Cloud Shell Some assignments will involve **Windows PowerShell** and **Microsoft Azure Cloud Shell**. You may be asked to: * Open Windows PowerShell or the authorised Azure Cloud Shell environment * Copy and run commands supplied by Codex * Return the complete output to Codex * Check that the displayed repository, branch, account, subscription or starting conditions match the instructions * Capture and record the requested evidence * Keep a session open while an authorised operation is running * Stop and report any warning, error or unexpected difference Previous PowerShell, command-line or Azure experience is not required. Clear instructions and training will be provided. You must follow the supplied commands and boundaries exactly. You may never improvise commands, expand the scope of an assignment, create cloud resources, change permissions, approve spending or perform destructive actions without explicit authorisation. ## Working time and daily availability The role involves approximately **two active working hours per day**. These active hours will generally be spread across a broader agreed availability period. Codex assignments often include periods during which the system works independently. These waiting periods do not count as active working time. You must be available at regular intervals during the agreed working day to: * Check the progress of active Codex runs * Respond when Codex requests input * Report questions or unexpected results * Record completed work * Start the next approved assignment Reliable follow-up throughout the day is essential. The two active working hours will generally be divided into several shorter interventions because Codex may require input at different moments. The precise daily availability window will be agreed before the assignment begins. ## Remuneration The remuneration is intended to combine: * A **fixed base payment** for the agreed availability and core responsibilities * A **variable component** linked to the quality, reliability and successful completion of the agreed work The variable component will reward: * Careful and complete execution * Reliable daily follow-up * Accurate reporting * Correct use of the agreed procedures * Timely identification of errors, inconsistencies and blockers * Successful completion of approved assignments Speed alone will not determine performance. Quality, care and reliability remain essential. The exact fixed payment, variable component and evaluation method will be agreed before the assignment begins. ## Minimum computer requirements You must have your own reliable working equipment, including: * A Windows 11 computer * At least 16 GB of RAM * A modern Intel Core i5, AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent processor * An SSD with sufficient free storage * A stable and sufficiently fast internet connection * A reliable webcam and headset * A screen setup that allows you to work comfortably with Codex, instructions, PowerShell and Google Sheets simultaneously Two monitors are strongly preferred because several documents, shells and Codex sessions may need to remain visible at the same time. Your computer must: * Be protected with a secure password * Use current Windows and security updates * Have active antivirus protection * Be used in a private and secure working environment * Never be shared with unauthorised persons while MS² accounts or information are accessible ## About MS² MS² — My Story Studio helps people transform scattered memories into stories worth preserving. The product brings together photographs, videos, voices, people, relationships, events and personal context. Its Director uses this information to create meaningful story experiences and physical or digital products. Our guiding journey is: **Your memories. → Your story. → Your WOW.** MS² is being built around quality, privacy, human dignity and practical ownership of family memories. ## What makes this role interesting You will work closely with the founder on an ambitious new product and gain practical experience with an emerging way of building software through artificial intelligence. Your contribution will come from logical thinking, careful execution, organisation and quality control. Your work will directly influence the reliability and progress of the product. This is a remote Virtual Assistant position. ## How to apply Please send: * A short personal introduction * Your CV or LinkedIn profile * A description of your current computer and screen setup * Your normal daily availability * Your experience with ChatGPT, Codex or other AI tools * An example of work in which accuracy and structured thinking were important * A short example of a situation in which you noticed an error or inconsistency that others had missed You are welcome to use AI when preparing your application. We are especially interested in seeing how carefully and logically you think.

description: # SALES STRATEGIST / COPYWRITER – LOW-TICKET OFFERS **Work Type:** Full-Time **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST **Daily Huddle:** 8:00 AM CST **Location:** Remote **Pay:** Competitive, based on experience and proven results ## ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a **Sales Strategist / Copywriter** who knows how to sell. This is **NOT a lead generation or general VA position.** We have a **$7 digital Starter Kit** that we are preparing to aggressively promote, with a goal of selling **5,000+ units next month**. We need someone who understands how to turn attention into sales through strong messaging, compelling hooks, persuasive copy, and strategic content. You should be someone who can look at an offer and say: **"Here's the angle. Here's the hook. Here's what we should say. Here's why people will buy."** We're looking for someone who has **actually sold low-ticket digital products/offers before** and can show us measurable results. ## WHAT YOU'LL DO Your primary responsibility is to help us increase sales of our low-ticket offers. You will: * Develop high-converting **hooks and angles** * Write compelling social media captions and promotional copy * Create sales-focused content ideas * Develop CTAs that encourage people to take action * Identify customer pain points, desires, objections, and buying triggers * Turn product features into compelling sales messaging * Develop different messaging angles for the same offer * Write copy for Facebook, Instagram, email, landing pages, and other marketing channels * Help develop promotional campaigns around our $7 Starter Kit * Test different hooks, messaging, offers, and CTAs * Review performance and recommend improvements * Study competitors and identify opportunities for stronger positioning * Work with the team to continuously improve our sales messaging * Help us understand **WHY people are buying — or why they're not** You will not simply be given a script and asked to execute it. We want someone who can **think strategically and contribute ideas.** ## MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS ### 1. Proven Low-Ticket Sales Experience This is our biggest requirement. You must have experience selling **low-ticket digital products, courses, guides, memberships, templates, services, or similar offers.** We want to see **actual results**, not just claims that you're "good at copywriting." When applying, tell us: * What was the product/offer? * What was the price? * How many units were sold? * How much revenue was generated? * What was YOUR role? * What copy/content/strategy did you personally create? * What measurable results did you achieve? ### 2. Strong Direct-Response Copywriting Skills You should understand how to write copy that gets people to act. You should be comfortable creating: * Scroll-stopping hooks * Headlines * Captions * Sales posts * CTAs * Email copy * Landing page copy * Promotional messaging * Short-form sales content ### 3. Strong Understanding of Buyer Psychology You should understand concepts such as: * Pain points * Desire * Objections * Urgency * Curiosity * Social proof * Benefits vs. features * Risk reversal * Emotional triggers * Offer positioning * Conversion psychology ### 4. Strategic Thinking We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions. We want someone who can say: > "I think this offer will sell better if we position it this way." You should be comfortable testing ideas, analyzing results, and making recommendations. ### 5. Excellent English You must be able to write **clear, natural, persuasive English**. Your copy should sound human — not generic, robotic, or AI-generated. ## BIG PLUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH: * Selling $5–$20 digital products * Facebook/Instagram marketing * Organic social media sales * Paid ads * Email marketing * Funnels * Landing pages * Digital products * Info products * Courses * Real estate marketing * Direct-response marketing * A/B testing * Conversion optimization * Meta Ads * Short-form video scripts ## WHAT WE DON'T WANT Please do NOT apply if your experience is primarily: * General virtual assistance * Data entry * Lead generation * Appointment setting * Basic social media posting * Administrative work * Generic content writing * Blog writing without sales experience Being a good writer is **not enough** for this position. We need someone who understands **how to sell.** ## HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS Your success will ultimately be measured by your ability to help us generate sales. Our immediate target is: ### **5,000+ sales of our $7 Starter Kit** We want someone who is excited by that kind of goal and wants to be accountable for the messaging and strategy that helps make it happen. ## WORK SCHEDULE **Monday–Friday** **8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST** There is a **daily team huddle at 8:00 AM CST**, and attendance is required. You must be able to consistently work this schedule. ## HOW TO APPLY Please do NOT send a generic application. Answer the following questions: **1. Tell us about the best low-ticket offer you've helped sell.** Include: * Product * Price * Number of sales * Revenue * Your role * How you contributed to the sales **2. What is the best sales result you've personally achieved through copywriting or marketing?** Give us actual numbers if possible. **3. Give us 3 examples of hooks you would use to sell a $7 digital product.** **4. Imagine we are selling a $7 Starter Kit. Write ONE short Facebook/Instagram sales caption for it.** We care more about the quality of your thinking and copy than the length of your application. **5. What do you believe makes someone buy a $7 digital product instead of scrolling past it?** **6. Please provide examples of your previous sales copy, campaigns, landing pages, social posts, or other relevant work.** Portfolio/case studies are strongly preferred. **7. What are your salary expectations?** **8. Are you available to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST and attend the daily 8:00 AM CST huddle?** --- ### IMPORTANT **Please include the word "SELL" at the beginning of your application.** Applications without answers to the questions above may not be considered. title: Outbound Sales & Logistics Coordinator
description: Apply thru this link : ---------- Position Overview: At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions—we build lasting, impactful careers. As an **Outbound Sales & Logistics Coordinator**, you’ll serve as a dedicated sales and operations partner for U.S.-based moving companies, with your **primary responsibility focused on outbound calling and lead conversion**. This is not an admin or back-office role. Your job is to **create opportunities, engage potential customers, book moving estimates, and drive revenue through strategic outbound communication**. Your moving-industry experience will allow you to understand the customer journey, moving operations, scheduling, dispatch, and the urgency involved in coordinating a move. The core mission of this role is simple: **turn outbound conversations into booked moving opportunities while supporting the moving company's day-to-day logistics when needed.** --- ## Why Join Ready Roles? ### A Career Path, Not Just a Job This role is designed for growth-minded professionals who want to contribute directly to revenue and become an essential part of a U.S.-based moving company's sales and operations team. ### Independence and Opportunity to Lead You’ll take ownership of daily outbound calling, lead follow-up, appointment setting, and customer communication. You’ll be expected to manage your pipeline proactively and work the leads like they’re your own book of business. ### Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients You’ll support clients who value proactive, performance-driven team members who can generate opportunities, communicate professionally, and help the business grow. --- # Key Responsibilities: ## 1\. Outbound Calling & Lead Generation - Conduct daily outbound calls to homeowners, prospects, leads, and potential moving customers. - Follow up consistently with leads to identify and create moving opportunities. - Re-engage prospects who previously inquired but did not book. - Qualify leads and identify customers with potential upcoming moving needs. - Build rapport and establish trust with potential customers. - Ask effective questions to understand the customer's moving requirements. - Communicate the moving company's services clearly and professionally. - Maintain consistent calling and follow-up activity throughout the day. - Work toward daily and weekly outbound calling and appointment-setting goals. ## 2\. Appointment Setting & Sales Follow-Up - Book qualified moving estimates and appointments. - Follow up with customers who have received estimates or have not yet scheduled. - Confirm appointments and ensure customers have the correct information. - Maintain a consistent follow-up schedule for active prospects. - Track conversations, outcomes, and next steps in the CRM. - Identify opportunities to move prospects further through the sales process. - Communicate qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales or operations team. ## 3\. Realtor Outreach & Referral Development - Conduct outbound calls to local realtors within the client's market. - Introduce the moving company and establish professional relationships. - Follow up with realtors to create referral opportunities. - Maintain a consistent pipeline of potential referral partners. - Track realtor conversations, follow-ups, and referral opportunities. - Develop long-term relationships that can generate moving leads. ## 4\. Lead Management & Data Activation - Work through provided lead and homeowner data to identify potential moving opportunities. - Prioritize leads based on potential value and likelihood of needing moving services. - Maintain accurate and organized lead records. - Remove or flag invalid, inactive, sold, or otherwise unusable leads. - Update CRM records after calls and customer interactions. - Ensure every active lead has an appropriate next step or follow-up date. ## 5\. Moving Logistics & Customer Coordination While **outbound calling is the primary responsibility**, your moving-industry experience will also be used to support logistics and customer coordination. - Assist with move scheduling and coordination. - Communicate with customers regarding move details, confirmations, delays, and updates. - Coordinate with dispatch, movers, sales, and operations teams. - Assist with scheduling conflicts and operational issues. - Understand crew availability and moving schedules. - Ensure booked customer information is accurately communicated to the operations team. - Assist with time-sensitive customer and operational requests. ## 6\. Tracking & Reporting - Log outbound calls, conversations, follow-ups, appointments, and results. - Maintain accurate records in the client's CRM, Google Sheets, or other systems. - Track daily outbound activity and appointment-setting performance. - Provide clear updates on lead activity and pipeline progress. - Prepare daily or weekly reports as requested. - Identify patterns and opportunities that can improve outbound performance. --- # What We’re Looking For: ### Self-Driven, Proactive Mindset This role is for someone who naturally takes initiative and actively looks for ways to create opportunities. You should not need constant reminders to make calls, follow up with leads, update the CRM, or complete your daily responsibilities. ### Confident Outbound Communicator You are comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with homeowners, customers, prospects, and realtors. title: Legal Assistant
description: We are a growing U.S.-based law firm seeking a Legal Assistant to join our team and provide hands-on support with client matters and the firm's day-to-day legal operations. This is an opportunity for someone who is highly organized, exceptionally detail-oriented, and interested in learning a specialized area of law. We are interested in finding someone who is intelligent, organized, curious, dependable, and capable of learning complex processes. This position will begin at 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time, with the potential for additional hours and increased responsibility as the firm's needs grow. We are looking for someone interested in developing a long-term relationship with the firm and becoming someone we can rely on to help move client matters forward. About the Role The Legal Assistant will work closely with firm leadership and assist with a variety of legal, administrative, and client-related matters. Because our practice is highly specialized, you will learn our processes and systems over time. The successful candidate does not need to know the answers when they start, but they must be willing and able to learn, research, follow detailed instructions, ask thoughtful questions, and become increasingly independent. The role may include: - Assisting with client applications and renewals - Preparing and organizing documents for regulatory filings - Reviewing applications and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy - Organizing client information and documentation - Maintaining client files and electronic folders - Preparing forms, spreadsheets, trackers, and other work product - Reviewing documents carefully for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information - Conducting legal research at the direction of the attorney - Preparing research summaries and internal notes - Tracking applications, submissions, corrections, deadlines, and outstanding items - Communicating with clients regarding administrative and document requests - Drafting routine client correspondence based on instructions or templates - Following up with clients regarding missing information or documentation - Assisting with submissions to government agencies - Monitoring the status of pending applications and regulatory matters - Organizing correspondence and documentation received from government agencies - Maintaining internal databases, spreadsheets, and matter trackers - Following established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and drafting new ones - Assisting with the development and improvement of firm processes - Providing general support to firm leadership - Scheduling and setting appointments - Taking on additional projects and responsibilities as the candidate becomes more familiar with the firm The work requires a high level of attention to detail. A seemingly small discrepancy in a name, address, ownership document, application response, or supporting document can matter, so we are looking for someone who naturally double-checks their work rather than simply checking a box. What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is someone who is: - Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented - Reliable and consistent - A strong written and verbal communicator in English - Comfortable working with detailed information - Able to follow written and verbal instructions carefully - Comfortable working independently - Willing to ask questions when something is unclear - Proactive about identifying missing information or potential problems - Able to manage multiple matters and competing priorities - Comfortable working with confidential client information - Curious and genuinely interested in learning - Comfortable conducting internet and regulatory research - Able to learn new software, systems, and procedures - Responsive and professional in communications - Able to receive feedback and incorporate it into future work - Someone who takes ownership of assignments and follows them through to completion We are particularly interested in candidates who are analytical and naturally curious. You may be given a regulatory question or an unfamiliar application and need to figure out where to look, identify the relevant information, and organize what you find for the attorney. You should not be someone who needs every step of every assignment spelled out indefinitely. As you become familiar with our practice and systems, we expect you to become increasingly comfortable recognizing what needs to be done next. Experience Prior experience as a legal assistant, paralegal, regulatory assistant, compliance assistant, or administrative professional is helpful but not required. Law firm experience is preferred but not required. Experience working in a regulated industry, professional services environment, government agency, compliance role, or another detail-oriented position may be particularly helpful. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the ability and willingness to learn. We will teach you our practice. A candidate who has excellent organizational skills, strong writing abilities, good judgment, and a demonstrated ability to learn may be a much better fit than someone with years of legal experience who lacks those qualities. Hours - Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time - 20 guaranteed hours per week - Must be consistently available during the stated Eastern Time hours - Long-term position; this is not intended to be a short-term or temporary assignment There is potential for the position to grow in both hours and responsibility for the right person. How to Apply Please read the instructions carefully before applying. Attention to detail is an important part of this position, and failure to follow the application instructions may result in your application not being considered. Please provide: 1. A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in the position and why you believe you would be a good legal assistant. 2. A summary of your relevant experience, including legal, administrative, regulatory, compliance, customer service, or professional services experience. 3. Your current resume. 4. A link to a 2–3 minute introductory video telling us about yourself, your professional background, and why you are interested in this position. 5. Your expected hourly rate in USD. 6. Your availability, including confirmation that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time. 7. At least five (5) Apply Points. Applications submitted with fewer than five Apply Points will not be considered. 8. Include the word DESIGN in the subject line of your application. Who Will Succeed in This Role? This position is best suited to someone who enjoys learning how things work and making sure things are done correctly. You will be working in a specialized legal practice where you will encounter unfamiliar terminology, government forms, regulatory requirements, and client situations. We do not expect you to know these things when you begin. We do expect you to be willing to learn them. Over time, our goal is for you to become someone who understands our systems well enough to anticipate what is needed, identify missing information, keep matters organized, and help ensure that nothing falls through the cracks. If you are dependable, highly detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and take pride in producing accurate work, we encourage you to apply.

title: Deal Sourcing & Acquisitions Analyst - Real Estate Development
job_title: Deal Sourcing & Acquisitions Analyst - Real Estate Development
description: About the Role We are a Chicago-focused real estate development company seeking a highly resourceful, analytical, and persistent person to help us find and evaluate development opportunities. This role combines deal sourcing, owner research, direct outreach, zoning research, and real estate underwriting. It is not a traditional administrative VA role. Your job is simple to describe but difficult to master: find properties that may be valuable development opportunities, reach the decision makers, and learn how to determine whether the economics make sense. What You Will Do • Search for on-market and off-market development opportunities throughout targeted Chicago neighborhoods. • Identify vacant land, parking lots, underutilized commercial properties, redevelopment sites, distressed buildings, and properties with substantially more development potential than their existing use. • Research property ownership and find the actual decision maker, including phone numbers, emails, mailing addresses, related entities, debt information, tax information, and other useful data. • Conduct targeted phone, email, and direct-mail outreach to owners on behalf of a real estate developer. • Track follow-ups persistently and professionally. • Research Chicago zoning and calculate lot area, FAR, buildable area, approximate unit potential, parking, ARO/TOD considerations, and potential rezoning scenarios. • Screen deals using land cost per unit, location, zoning, physical feasibility, achievable rents, and development economics. • Use our underwriting model to analyze rents, NOI, development cost, financing, yield on cost, refinance proceeds, and cash recycling. • Maintain a clean CRM/pipeline of every property, owner interaction, next action, and underwriting result. • Identify smaller deals that may be appropriate to wholesale to other developers. How You Will Spend Your Time This is a full-time, eight-hour-per-day role. When there are real deals to analyze, you will analyze them. When there are not, you will source. There should always be another productive action: research a property, find an owner, send an email, make a targeted call, follow up, review zoning, research debt/taxes, or improve the pipeline. What We Are Looking For • Excellent analytical ability and comfort with numbers. • Strong internet research skills and persistence in finding hard-to-locate information. • Ability to learn complicated rules and apply them to real situations. • Strong written and spoken English. • Comfort speaking with property owners by phone and email. • Organized, detail-oriented, and disciplined about follow-up. • Independent problem solver who does not stop when the first search fails. • Comfort with spreadsheets and willingness to learn real estate underwriting. • Good judgment: you should be able to understand that a cheap property is not always a good deal and an expensive property is not always a bad deal. Helpful but Not Required • Real estate, finance, underwriting, brokerage, property research, or acquisitions experience. • Experience with zoning, GIS/maps, property databases, skip tracing, CRM systems, or cold outreach. • Experience analyzing multifamily, land, or development deals. What Success Looks Like • You progressively learn to look at an address and recognize whether it deserves attention. • You bring ownership qualified opportunities instead of simply sending random listings. • You know when a property should be rejected, followed up, wholesaled, fully underwritten, or escalated immediately. • Your pipeline stays active because every viable owner is followed up until there is a definitive answer. • Over time, you require less direction because you learn how we think about location, zoning, price, unit potential, rents, and development returns.

title: Operations & Scheduling Coordinator
description: Position Summary The VA Scheduler is responsible for coordinating and maintaining client service schedules to support Helping Hands, Orillia's transportation and community support services. The role ensures efficient scheduling of clients, staff, and volunteers using scheduling platforms such as AlayaCare, RideLink and Skedulo, while maintaining a high standard of customer service and operational accuracy. The VA Scheduler serves as a key point of coordination between clients, transportation providers, volunteers, frontline staff, and management to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with organizational policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities - Scheduling and Coordination - Schedule, modify, and monitor client service appointments and transportation requests. - Coordinate transportation bookings, rides, and related client support services. - Match client requests with available drivers, staff, and resources. - Optimize schedules to maximize operational efficiency and service capacity. - Monitor daily schedules and address scheduling conflicts, cancellations, and urgent changes. - Ensure service assignments are accurately communicated to staff and volunteers. AlayaCare Administration - Enter, update, and maintain client scheduling information within AlayaCare. - Verify service authorizations, client information, and scheduling requirements. - Monitor service delivery documentation and scheduling accuracy. - Support staff with scheduling-related inquiries within AlayaCare. - Assist with maintaining accurate client records and service data. Skedulo Administration - Create, assign, and manage workforce schedules within Skedulo. - Monitor visit assignments, routes, and workforce utilization. - Update schedules in real time to reflect cancellations, changes, and urgent client needs. - Support field staff with schedule access and assignment updates. - Generate scheduling reports and operational insights as required. Administrative Support - Maintain accurate scheduling records and documentation. - Prepare operational reports and scheduling metrics as requested. - Support quality improvement initiatives related to scheduling and service delivery. - Participate in system testing, process improvements, and scheduling optimization projects. - Communicate scheduling updates to clients, caregivers, staff, and volunteers. - Respond to inquiries regarding appointments, transportation bookings, and service availability. - Escalate concerns or service issues to management as appropriate. Qualifications - Experience in scheduling, dispatching, customer service, or administrative support. - Experience in healthcare, community support services, transportation, or a related field is an asset. - Familiarity with scheduling and workforce management systems - Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Teams, Excel, and SharePoint) - Experience with AlayaCare, RideLink and Skedulo is considered a strong asset. - Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills. - Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. - Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving abilities. - Ability to work independently in a fast-paced virtual environment.

description: Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week Schedule: Monday through Friday with availability during U.S. Central Time Compensation: $4.50 USD per hour ABOUT US We are a family-owned U.S. trucking company operating approximately 15 trucks. We are looking for a motivated, dependable, and highly organized remote employee to assist with driver recruiting and eventually take on additional fleet operations, productivity, ELD, and safety-related responsibilities. This position will begin with a strong focus on CDL driver recruiting. Your first priority will be helping us fill our available trucks with qualified drivers. As those positions are filled and you are trained in our systems, your responsibilities will expand into fleet productivity and compliance support. PHASE ONE: CDL DRIVER RECRUITING Your initial priority will be recruiting qualified CDL drivers. Responsibilities will include: * Post and maintain driver advertisements. * Actively find qualified CDL drivers through job boards, social media, Facebook groups, referrals, and other recruiting sources. * Respond promptly to calls, messages, and applications. * Call and screen potential drivers. * Explain our available positions, pay, equipment, routes, home time, and requirements. * Review applicants’ experience, driving history, qualifications, and expectations. * Identify serious candidates and move them through the hiring process. * Follow up consistently with interested drivers. * Schedule interviews, testing, orientation, and onboarding steps. * Maintain an organized recruiting spreadsheet or applicant-tracking system. * Keep candidates informed until they are hired or are no longer interested. We are not looking for someone who only posts advertisements and waits. We need someone who actively searches for drivers, follows up consistently, and produces results. EXPANDED RESPONSIBILITIES After you are trained and our immediate recruiting needs are under control, the position will expand to include the following: Driver Productivity * Review the Motive dashboard once daily to monitor driver and truck activity. * Identify drivers or trucks that are inactive, underutilized, or not generating expected revenue. * Determine why equipment is not moving and follow up with the appropriate person. * Report recurring downtime, productivity problems, or unusual driver activity to management. ELD Monitoring * Review the Motive ELD dashboard once daily. * Check for possible log issues, missing certifications, or Hours-of-Service concerns. * Identify ELD disconnections or drivers operating without being properly connected. * Review and help resolve unidentified driving trips. * Monitor Personal Conveyance usage and flag possible misuse. * Contact drivers regarding corrections or missing information when instructed. * Immediately report serious or recurring compliance concerns to management. Safety and Compliance Support * Review Motive safety data and driver behavior trends. * Monitor company safety scores and identify areas that may need improvement. * Track recurring concerns such as speeding, harsh braking, unsafe driving, Hours-of-Service violations, or maintenance issues. * Review roadside inspection and violation records for possible errors. * Identify records that may qualify for an FMCSA DataQs challenge. * Gather supporting documents and prepare potential DataQs requests for management’s review and approval. * Track the status and outcome of submitted DataQs requests. DAILY CHECK-IN You will have a brief check-in with the company owner each workday. The check-in will cover: * What you completed that day * Any qualified driver candidates * Important issues requiring attention * Your next steps * Anything you need from the owner The check-in is intended to be brief and maintain communication and accountability. QUALIFICATIONS * Strong spoken and written English * Confident and professional phone communication * Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment * Comfortable speaking with U.S. truck drivers * Organized and comfortable using spreadsheets and online dashboards such as Tenstreet * Able to work independently without constant reminders * Strong attention to detail * Able to handle a fast-paced environment and stressful situations professionally * Persistent with follow-up without being unprofessional * Willing and able to learn ELD, productivity, and safety procedures * Previous experience with U.S. trucking or CDL driver recruiting is strongly preferred * Experience with Motive or another ELD platform is a plus * Familiarity with Hours-of-Service, Personal Conveyance, CSA/SMS scores, or DataQs is a plus WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We need someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates when there is a problem, and follows through. You should be comfortable learning new systems and growing into a larger role as you demonstrate reliability and good judgment.

title: Fractional Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – E-Commerce & Inventory
job_title: Fractional Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – E-Commerce & Inventory
description: Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Fractional Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to provide strategic financial leadership for a growing, inventory-intensive e-commerce business. This is not simply an accounting or bookkeeping oversight role. We are looking for a hands-on financial executive who can ensure the accuracy of our financial reporting while helping ownership make better decisions regarding cash flow, inventory investment, profitability, purchasing, operating expenses, and long-term growth. The ideal candidate has significant experience with e-commerce, retail, distribution, or another inventory-intensive business and understands the unique relationship between inventory, cash flow, gross margin, marketing spend, fulfillment costs, and profitability. The Fractional CFO will work closely with ownership and the accounting team and will serve as a key financial advisor to the business. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership & Strategy -Serve as a strategic financial advisor to ownership and senior leadership. -Translate financial data into clear, actionable business recommendations. -Identify opportunities to improve profitability, EBITDA, cash flow, working capital, and return on invested capital. -Develop financial models to evaluate growth initiatives, major purchases, capital expenditures, hiring, new product categories, and other strategic investments. -Provide scenario and sensitivity analysis to support major business decisions. -Establish meaningful financial KPIs and management reporting for leadership . Monthly Close & Financial Reporting -Oversee and improve the monthly financial closing process to ensure accurate and timely reporting. -Review monthly P&L, balance sheet, cash-flow statements, reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses, inventory, COGS, and other material accounts. -Establish and maintain a disciplined monthly close calendar. -Review financial results for unusual trends, errors, margin changes, and material variances. -Ensure financial statements accurately reflect the economic performance of the business. -Develop monthly management reporting that clearly explains what happened, why it happened, and what management should do next. Annual Audit -Lead the company through its annual financial statement audit. -Serve as the primary financial contact with external auditors. -Coordinate audit schedules, PBC requests, supporting documentation, inventory testing, reconciliations, and other audit requirements. -Ensure the accounting team is properly prepared before fieldwork begins. -Address audit findings and proposed adjustments promptly. -Improve processes and internal controls based on audit findings and recommendations. -Inventory & Working Capital Management -Inventory management will be a major responsibility of this position. -The CFO must understand how to financially evaluate inventory across a large number of SKUs and translate inventory data into purchasing and cash-flow decisions. Responsibilities include: Analyze inventory turnover, aging, days on hand, sell-through rates, and inventory productivity. Identify fast-moving, slow-moving, excess, obsolete, and dead inventory. Develop appropriate inventory reserve and write-down methodologies. Analyze inventory profitability by SKU, product category, and other meaningful segments. Calculate and monitor GMROI / return on inventory investment. Determine how much working capital is tied up in inventory. Recommend strategies for reducing or liquidating underperforming inventory. Help establish appropriate inventory purchasing and reorder levels. Balance the financial impact of stockouts against the cost of carrying excess inventory. Analyze inventory purchasing requirements against projected demand and available cash. Improve inventory forecasting and purchasing discipline. Work with operations and purchasing teams to improve inventory efficiency and cash conversion. The CFO should be able to help answer questions such as: Which products should we buy more of? Which should we reduce or discontinue? Where is cash trapped in inventory? Which categories generate the highest return on inventory investment? How much inventory should we purchase over the next 3, 6, and 12 months? Margin & E-Commerce Profitability -Develop accurate gross margin and contribution margin reporting. -Understand and analyze all major components of e-commerce profitability, including: Product cost Landed cost Inbound freight and duties Outbound shipping Fulfillment costs Payment processing fees Discounts and promotions Returns and refunds Marketplace/platform fees Advertising and customer acquisition costs -Analyze profitability by SKU, category, channel, and customer segment where appropriate. -Identify margin leakage and opportunities to improve pricing, purchasing, shipping, fulfillment, and product mix. -Ensure management understands the difference between revenue growth, gross margin, contribution margin, and true bottom-line profitability. Cash Flow & Forecasting -Develop and maintain a 13-week cash-flow forecast. -Build annual budgets and rolling financial forecasts. -Forecast revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, inventory purchases, payroll, marketing expenditures, capital expenditures, and cash requirements. -Identify potential cash-flow constraints before they become problems. -Model different growth and profitability scenarios. -Establish appropriate cash reserves and working-capital targets. -Help management determine how aggressively the company can invest while maintaining appropriate liquidity. Budgeting & FP&A -Lead the annual budgeting process. -Provide monthly budget vs. actual and year-over-year analysis. -Develop departmental budgets and accountability. -Identify significant financial variances and their underlying causes. -Build financial dashboards and KPIs for management. -Develop forward-looking forecasts rather than relying solely on historical financial statements. Marketing & Customer Economics -The CFO should understand the economics of performance-driven e-commerce marketing. -Evaluate marketing spend from a financial and profitability perspective. -Understand metrics including ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV, AOV, conversion rate, and contribution margin. -Work with marketing leadership to determine whether incremental advertising spend is producing profitable incremental revenue. -Help establish marketing budgets based on contribution margin and cash-flow objectives rather than revenue alone. -Analyze the profitability of promotions, discounts, customer acquisition strategies, and sales channels. Internal Controls & Risk Management -Evaluate and strengthen financial and accounting controls. -Establish appropriate approval limits and financial policies. -Improve segregation of duties where appropriate. -Review purchasing, vendor payment, banking, inventory, payroll, and expense controls. -Identify financial and operational risks and recommend appropriate safeguards. -Help protect the company against fraud, financial errors, and unnecessary financial exposure. Tax & Compliance Coordination -Coordinate with outside CPA and tax professionals. -Support federal, state, and local tax compliance and planning. -Understand the financial implications of multi-state e-commerce operations, sales tax, and nexus. -Ensure appropriate financial information is available for tax filings and planning. -Coordinate with outside professionals on specialized tax matters as necessary. Systems & Data -Evaluate the reliability and integration of financial and operational data. -Be comfortable working with data from e-commerce platforms, accounting/ERP systems, inventory/WMS systems, payment -processors, banks, and business intelligence tools. -Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets is required. -Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve financial processes. -Experience with Shopify or a similar high-volume e-commerce platform is strongly preferred. -Comfortable utilizing modern technology and AI tools to improve financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, and productivity. Required Qualifications -10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience. -Significant experience serving as a CFO, Fractional CFO, VP of Finance, or comparable senior financial leader. -Strong understanding of GAAP accounting and financial statements. -Demonstrated experience successfully managing or leading annual financial statement audits. -Deep understanding of monthly financial close processes. -Strong experience with inventory accounting, COGS, inventory valuation, reserves, and working-capital management. -Experience with e-commerce, retail, consumer products, distribution, or another inventory-intensive business. -Ability to analyze large SKU portfolios and distinguish between fast-moving, slow-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory. -Strong financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and cash-flow management skills. -Strong understanding of gross margin and contribution margin. -Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to owners and non-financial executives. -Highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive. -Strong leadership skills with the ability to hold accounting and operational teams accountable. -Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment. Preferred Qualifications -CPA and/or MBA preferred but not required. -Prior CFO experience with a significant e-commerce company. -Experience with Shopify or Shopify Plus. -Experience with high-SKU-count inventory businesses. -Experience with warehouse and fulfillment operations. -Experience with multi-state tax and sales-tax environments. -Experience improving accounting systems, reporting automation, and financial controls. -Experience working with founder-led or privately held companies. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who goes beyond reporting financial results. The right CFO should be able to look at the company's financial and operational data and tell leadership: What is happening? Why is it happening? What is likely to happen next? What should we do about it? This individual must be willing to dig into the details when necessary while maintaining the perspective of a senior financial executive. We want a proactive, hands-on, highly organized financial leader who identifies issues before they become problems and brings solutions and recommendations to management—not someone who waits to be told what to analyze. Measures of Success Success in this role will include: Accurate and timely monthly financial statements. A consistent and efficient monthly closing process. Successful and well-organized annual audits. Reliable cash-flow forecasting. Improved visibility into SKU and category profitability. Reduced capital tied up in slow-moving and excess inventory. Improved inventory turns and return on inventory investment. Better gross and contribution margin visibility. More disciplined budgeting and expense management. Improved financial controls and reporting. Clear financial guidance that enables ownership to make faster, better-informed decisions. Engagement This is a fractional executive position, not a traditional bookkeeping or accounting role. The CFO will work closely with ownership and key members of the accounting, operations, purchasing, and marketing teams. The expected time commitment will be established based on the needs of the business. Candidates should have sufficient availability to become deeply familiar with the company's financial and operating model and be actively involved in important financial decisions rather than serving solely in an advisory capacity.
