title: Business Development Representative
description: # Cold Caller — Industrial B2B Appointment Setting (US Accounts, Night Shift) **This is a phone job.** You dial US manufacturers and industrial companies, five days a week. No admin work, no email support, no lead scraping, no "virtual assistant" tasks. If you are looking for a general VA role or something you can run alongside another gig, this is the wrong post. Synapse Mfg is an outsourced sales agency. US industrial and manufacturing companies hire us to place a dedicated caller inside their business and generate real buying conversations and RFQs. You are that caller. You represent one client at a time on the phone, using their name, selling their product. Our clients sell things like sensors and automation equipment, metal detection systems, custom packaging, industrial curtains, and fire safety gear. You will be calling plant managers, engineers, purchasing agents, and owners. You do not need to know manufacturing on day one. You do need to be willing to learn a technical product well enough that a plant manager takes you seriously. ## The job You start **part time on one client account.** Hit quota, stay consistent for a month, and we move you to **full time** and add a second account, then a third, then a fourth. Every account you add raises your pay. The day is relentless. You will hold dozens of live conversations, most of them ending in no. Some people will be rude. You dial the next number. ## Pay (USD) - Base: **$7.80 per hour** - Commission: **$20 per showed meeting** | Stage | Schedule | Roughly per month | |---|---|---| | 1 client | Part time, 20–25 hrs/week | $840 – $1,085 | | 2 clients | Full time | $1,670 – $1,830 | | 3 clients | Full time | $1,830 – $2,070 | | 4 clients | Full time | $1,990 – $2,310 | Caller to team lead in 3 to 6 months for the right person, with a higher rate and a piece of what your team produces. ## Who we hire You have made cold calls for a living, on the phone, to strangers, for months. Not warm follow-up. Not inbound. Not chat support. You know your own numbers without checking: dials per day, connect rate, conversations to meetings. You can get rejected 40 times before lunch and dial the same way at 3pm as you did at 8am. You fix your own problems. You listen back to your calls, you find the place the conversation died, and you change it before anyone tells you to. You want one job you grow inside. Not a portfolio of clients, not a side business, not something you do while building your own agency. ## Requirements - Excellent spoken English, neutral accent, comfortable on the phone with US owners and plant managers - Available starting 8am US Eastern (night shift in the Philippines) - No other job or client work - Proven B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience, verifiable - You have used a dialer and a CRM (OptimalDial, Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, FrontSpin, or similar) - Quiet room, wired headset, reliable computer, stable internet - **Backup power and backup internet.** Brownouts happen. Your shift does not stop because the grid did. If you do not have a UPS or power station and a mobile data backup, get one before you apply. How you work with us Two rules matter more than anything else on this list. **You are reachable during your shift.** You greet the team in the group chat when you log in, and you answer Slack within 30 minutes while you are on the clock. If we cannot reach you, we assume you are not working and we stop your timer. **You raise problems the moment they happen.** Power cut, bad lead list, you disagree with a script change, you are unhappy about something. Message us from your phone right then. Going quiet for hours and explaining it later does not work here.

title: Google Ads Specialist: Weekly Management and Reporting (Long Term, US Agency)
job_title: Google Ads Specialist: Weekly Management and Reporting (Long Term, US Agency)
description: ABOUT US We are a 9-person US marketing agency based near Seattle. We build websites and run SEO and Google Ads for local service businesses, mostly home services and trades: painters, roofers, HVAC, landscapers, concrete, fencing, electrical, flooring, remodelers. We have been doing this for years and our clients stay with us for years. Right now one person manages our entire Google Ads book. That is 56 accounts under active weekly management, with 15 more being onboarded this quarter. He is good and he is out of hours. We are hiring someone to work alongside him so the accounts get the weekly attention they are paid for. This is a long-term role, not a project. If it works, it grows. WHAT YOU WOULD DO, IN ORDER OF HOW MUCH IT MATTERS TO US 1) WEEKLY ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT Work a set of live Search accounts on a weekly rhythm. Mine search terms and build negatives. Watch performance against each account's goal and flag what is drifting. Adjust bids and targeting inside an agreed band. Pause losers, test new ad copy, keep ad groups clean. Catch disapprovals, policy notices and payment problems before the client does. 2) REPORTING Pull and assemble the monthly performance data for each account you work. You build the numbers and the observations. Our manager writes the client narrative and presents it. This needs to be accurate and on time every month without being chased. 3) ACCOUNT AND CAMPAIGN BUILDS Build new accounts and campaigns from a written spec: campaign and ad group structure, keywords and match types, geo and scheduling, budgets as instructed, ad copy drafted to a template. Built to a draft state for review, never turned on by you. 4) CONVERSION TRACKING Set up and verify conversion tracking: Google Tag, Google Tag Manager, call tracking, form conversions, and importing offline or CRM conversions where the client has them. Verify with a real submission, not by confirming the tag is present. WHAT YOU WOULD NOT DO - No client contact of any kind. No email, no calls, no meetings, no name in a client thread. Our manager is the face on every account, every time. If you want a client-facing account manager seat, this is not that job, and we will not change our mind on it. - No setting account strategy. - No changing daily budgets, and no turning campaigns on or off, without sign-off. - No publishing ads or launching campaigns yourself. That is not a comment on your skill. It is how we keep one voice in front of the client. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU TO WORK INSIDE OUR SYSTEM - Work is assigned and tracked in ClickUp. You will get a limited seat on the ads lists only. Every task gets a note on what you changed and why, in writing, in the task. We do not run this over chat messages that disappear. - Your own Google account with 2FA on. We grant Standard access per client account as work is assigned. Never a shared login. - We work from written playbooks. If the spec says build it a certain way, build it that way and raise the disagreement separately. Improvising on a client account is the one thing that ends this arrangement fast. - Async first. We are in the US Pacific timezone, which is roughly 15 hours behind Manila. We do not expect you to work our hours. We do expect work to land when you said it would, and one live video check-in each week with our paid media manager at a time that works for both of you. - Clear written English. You will be writing ad copy, task notes and reporting observations that our manager reads and acts on. - Reliable internet and a machine that can run a browser with many tabs without falling over. YOU NEED TO HAVE - Hands-on Google Ads experience managing live Search accounts on an ongoing weekly basis, not just building them once. Tell us how long and how many. - Real conversion tracking experience. You should be able to explain how you proved a conversion was recording, not just installed. - Experience with lead generation accounts. Local service and home services experience is a strong plus. Ecommerce-only experience is not a fit for most of this book. - Comfort pulling and assembling reporting data accurately, every month, without reminders. - Google Ads certification is fine to mention but it is not what we are screening on. NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED - Google Tag Manager, GA4, and call tracking platforms (we use WhatConverts) - Local Service Ads - Google Shopping and Merchant Center - Microsoft Ads - Looker Studio TERMS - Part time to start, ongoing and long term, around 20 hours a week. Hours can grow if it works. - 15 to 20 USD an hour depending on experience. The top of that range is for someone who can own conversion tracking setup as well as weekly management. - We start with a paid trial on one real account, paid at your full rate whether or not we continue. No unpaid test work. Ever. - Paid monthly by Wise or Payoneer, whichever you prefer. HOW TO APPLY Applications that skip this get deleted, and that is most of them. Put SEARCH TERMS in your subject line so we know you read this far. Then answer these four, in writing, in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished. 1) Describe two Google Ads accounts you managed on an ongoing weekly basis. What did you actually do in a typical week, and how did you d ---------- what to change? 2) Walk us through how you set up and verified conversion tracking on your last build. How did you know it was really recording? 3) An account stops converting overnight. Spend is normal. What do you check, and in what order? 4) You are handed a written build spec you disagree with. What do you do? Attach one monthly report you have produced, with client names and numbers blacked out. We want to see how you present, not who you worked for.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse Home Health Experience Required Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care. We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager. Please Read Before Applying This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position. To be considered for this role, you must: Be a licensed Registered Nurse. Have worked professionally as an RN. Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment. Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations. Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines. If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit. Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home. About the Role The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services. The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance. You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function. While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time. You will work across: Clinical Support Team Staffing Coordinator PRN Registered Nurses Client admissions Recertifications Supervisory visits Clinical documentation Clinical scheduling and assignments Compliance-related follow-up Operational tracking and reporting This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role. However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated. Primary Objective Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care. What You Will Be Responsible For Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery. Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time. Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems. Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes. Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities. Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns. Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation. The Experience We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations. Your experience may include areas such as: Home Health or Home Care clinical operations Managing or coordinating field nurses Admissions or Start of Care processes Recertifications Supervisory or reassessment visits Plans of Care Clinical documentation review Chart audits Clinical compliance Quality assurance Tracking required clinical visits Managing overdue documentation Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff Correcting incomplete clinical records Following up on missed clinical requirements Clinical scheduling Home Health EMR/EHR systems Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments You do not need to have performed every item on this list. What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations. What This Role Really Requires This position requires much more than maintaining a task list. You will be expected to know: What needs to be completed. Who is responsible for completing it. What is currently outstanding. What is overdue. What does not appear accurate. What needs follow-up. What needs escalation. What recurring problems need a better system. If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice. If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it. If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through. If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process. Leadership and Accountability We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments. The successful person will be comfortable: Taking ownership of operational outcomes. Directing and coordinating other team members. Checking whether work has actually been completed. Following up when deadlines are missed. Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation. Asking questions when information does not appear correct. Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements. Maintaining urgency around important clinical work. Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved. Following an issue through until it is fully closed. Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs. You should be comfortable having a conversation such as: "This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?" You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations. This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If... You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care. You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care. You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff. You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next. You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing. You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it. You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved. You are comfortable checking other people's work. You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations. You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy. You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows. You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes. You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items. You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent. You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening. This Role Is Probably Not for You If... Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA. You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse. You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care. Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience. You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes. You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process. You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed. You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work. You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion. You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next. You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes. You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement. You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them. Required Qualifications You must have: An active Registered Nurse license. Professional experience working as an RN. Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience. Clinical operations experience. Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel. Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements. Strong written and spoken English. Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy. Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work. The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation. Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems. Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications. The ability to work independently and take ownership. Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule. Preferred Experience The following experience would be particularly valuable: U.S. Home Health experience U.S. healthcare experience Medicaid VA Community Care Medicare-certified Home Health Private Duty/Home Care Quality Assurance Clinical compliance Chart auditing Managing remote or offshore clinical teams AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above. Systems and Technology You may work with systems including: AlayaCare Microsoft Teams SharePoint Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word ---------- Front Aircall Trainual Zoom Claude You are not expected to have prior experience with every system. We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information. Working Hours This is a full-time remote position working: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying. Compensation USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including: Home Health/Home Care experience Clinical Operations Management experience RN experience Leadership experience U.S. or PH healthcare experience Overall fit for the position How to Apply (Read Carefully) We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application. Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

We're growing fast and need someone sharp, creative, and hungry to join our team full-time. title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator
description: About EDGE Outdoors EDGE Outdoors is a growing outdoor living construction company based in Greenville, South Carolina. We design and build screen rooms, sunrooms, power screen systems, pergolas, and related outdoor living projects. We are looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant and Operations Coordinator to work directly with one of the company owners. This is not a basic data entry or task-only virtual assistant position. We need someone who can become a trusted right hand — helping the owner stay organized, follow through on commitments, communicate professionally, and keep important responsibilities from falling through the cracks. The right person will be proactive, highly organized, comfortable communicating with American customers, and confident working across email, scheduling, phone calls, customer follow-up, administrative tasks, QuickBooks, and business systems. Position Summary This role combines executive assistance, customer communication, appointment scheduling, business administration, and light bookkeeping support. The assistant will help protect the owner's time, maintain a reliable view of priorities and deadlines, and provide the administrative support that keeps the company's systems, customer follow-up, and financial records organized. As the company grows, this role will evolve toward deeper executive support and strategic operations. Primary Responsibilities Executive and Daily Support • Participate in a brief daily planning call with the owner. • Capture brain dumps, voice notes, and meeting discussions and convert them into organized tasks, priorities, reminders, and follow-up items. • Maintain the owner's daily and weekly task lists, schedule, deadlines, commitments, and outstanding decisions. Prepare daily priority lists and weekly planning summaries. • Identify scheduling conflicts, overdue items, and potential problems before they become urgent. • Follow up respectfully with the owner and team members to help ensure important tasks are completed. • Prepare meeting agendas, take organized notes, document decisions, and track resulting action items. Email and Inbox Management • Review, organize, and maintain the owner's email inbox. Identify and flag urgent or important messages and separate actionable emails from informational or low-priority messages. • Draft professional responses for review and respond directly to approved types of messages when authorized. • Track emails that require a response, decision, or follow-up so important communication is not overlooked. • Maintain organized folders, labels, and follow-up systems for customer, vendor, subcontractor, and internal communication. Phone Answering and Appointment Scheduling • Answer incoming business calls professionally during assigned U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Serve as a friendly and professional first point of contact for prospective and existing customers. • Follow company-approved call scripts and qualification standards. Gather essential information from new leads, including contact information, property details, desired service, timeline, and lead source. • Ask approved qualifying questions to determine whether the customer and project are a potential fit for EDGE Outdoors. Enter complete and accurate call notes into the company CRM. • Review the owner's availability and schedule qualified sales appointments directly on the appropriate calendar. Confirm, reschedule, or cancel appointments and keep the calendar accurate. • Follow up with missed calls, voicemails, website inquiries, and customers who have not completed scheduling. Route urgent matters to the correct person and filter spam and solicitations. Customer Communication and Sales Follow-Up • Follow up with prospective customers who have outstanding quotes or have not responded. Monitor the sales pipeline, outstanding quotes, and appointments so opportunities are not lost. • Help maintain consistent communication with active customers using approved information and templates. Answer basic customer questions and escalate urgent, sensitive, or technical issues. • Document customer communications, outcomes, and next steps in the CRM. Maintain a professional, confident, helpful, and friendly tone that represents the company well. Bookkeeping, Payroll, and Payment Support • Assist with preparing and maintaining payroll information, including employee hours, approved pay rates, reimbursements, and other payroll-related records. Help prepare payroll and subcontractor payments for owner review and approval. • Track subcontractor work orders, approved amounts, invoices, payments, and outstanding balances. Match vendor invoices and subcontractor bills to the correct customer, project, or expense account. • Enter approved bills, expenses, vendor information, and other transactions into QuickBooks Online. Collect and organize invoices, receipts, work orders, W-9s, insurance certificates, and payment records. • Monitor accounts payable and maintain a clear list of upcoming, due, and overdue payments. Follow up when invoices, receipts, approvals, or required documentation are missing. • Prepare concise weekly summaries of payroll due, subcontractor payments, vendor invoices, cash commitments, and items requiring approval. Coordinate with the company's bookkeeper, accountant, or payroll provider when needed. Business Operations, Systems, and Reporting • Keep JobTread, QuickBooks, company calendars, task lists, and other approved systems accurate and current. Review CRM records for missing notes, incomplete tasks, and inaccurate information. • Collect and organize information for KPI scorecards, financial reviews, sales reports, and leadership meetings. Assist with tracking leads, lead sources, appointment outcomes, and other approved performance measurements. • Monitor recurring workflows and automations for failures or incomplete records and report issues to the owner. Assist with customer email templates, reminders, follow-up sequences, and other approved automations. Documentation, Hiring, and File Management • Assist with company forms and maintain organized customer, project, employee, vendor, and subcontractor records. Upload, name, sort, and manage files using company naming and storage standards. • Convert recurring instructions and workflows into checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures. Help maintain company policies, training materials, and process documentation. • Assist with administrative hiring and onboarding tasks, including scheduling interviews, gathering documents, and completing checklists. Protect confidential financial, employee, customer, and company information at all times. Authority and Escalation The assistant is expected to resolve authorized administrative matters independently and bring important issues forward early. Strategic decisions, contractual commitments, hiring decisions, payment authorization, changes to approved financial information, and other consequential business decisions remain subject to owner approval. Required Qualifications • Exceptional spoken and written English. Clear, natural, confident, and easily understandable phone communication. • Comfort speaking directly with U.S.-based customers, vendors, and subcontractors. • Strong organization, attention to detail, follow-through, and personal accountability. • Ability to turn unstructured conversations and ideas into clear tasks and next steps. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and distinguish urgent matters from items that can wait. • Professional judgment, discretion, and respect for confidential information. • Comfort using email, calendars, cloud-based files, and online business software. Willingness to learn new software, procedures, and construction industry terminology. • Reliable computer, professional headset, stable internet connection, and quiet workspace with a dependable backup plan for internet or power interruptions. • Availability to work full-time during agreed U.S. Eastern Time business hours and participate in voice and video calls. Preferred Qualifications These qualifications are helpful but not mandatory: • Experience as an executive assistant, administrative assistant, operations coordinator, or customer service representative — especially working directly with a business owner or executive. • Experience supporting a construction, home service, or project-based company. • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and basic bookkeeping principles. • Experience with a CRM, project management platform, or customer scheduling system. • Customer service, inbound phone answering, lead qualification, or appointment scheduling experience. • Experience creating email templates, administrative automations, reports, or standard procedures. • Basic understanding of invoices, expenses, vendors, subcontractors, payroll records, and customer payments. Advanced accounting or complex spreadsheet expertise is not required. Basic accounting knowledge and confidence working with accurate financial records would be a strong advantage. The Person We Are Looking For • Naturally keeps people, information, and projects organized. Creates order from scattered information and incomplete conversations. • Takes ownership instead of waiting for every individual instruction. • Knows how to respectfully remind a busy owner about commitments. Communicates problems early rather than allowing them to become emergencies. • Asks thoughtful questions and verifies unclear information instead of guessing. • Is comfortable learning new systems and steadily taking on greater responsibility. • Wants to grow into a trusted, long-term role within a developing company. We do not expect this person to know everything on the first day. We do expect clear communication, fast learning, accurate notes, consistent follow-through, and a genuine willingness to take responsibility. Working Schedule • Full-time remote position based in the Philippines. • Must be available during agreed U.S. Eastern Time business hours. • Daily voice or video check-in with the owner. • Some schedule flexibility may occasionally be required based on customer or business needs. How to Apply Begin your application with the words "EDGE EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT" so we know you carefully reviewed the entire posting. Please submit all of the following: 1. A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this position interests you. 2. A resume outlining your applicable work history. 3. A 60- to 90-second voice or video introduction in English. 4. A list of business systems you have used, including QuickBooks, CRMs, email, calendars, phone systems, or project management tools. 5. Your required hourly rate or monthly compensation. 6. Confirmation that you are available to work U.S. Eastern Time hours. 7. Your internet speed and backup plan for internet or power interruptions. Application Exercises Organization Scenario The owner gives you a ten-minute voice update containing three customer follow-ups, an unpaid vendor invoice, an appointment that must be moved, and two ideas that are not urgent. Briefly explain how you would organize the information, determine what needs immediate attention, and report it back to the owner. Customer Phone Scenario Submit a brief mock response to this incoming call: "Hi, I found your company online. I am interested in screening in my back porch, but I am not sure what options you offer or what it might cost." Demonstrate how you would greet the caller, gather information, ask useful questions, and guide the customer toward the appropriate next step. Why EDGE Outdoors EDGE Outdoors is a young company with serious momentum. You would be working directly with an owner who is building something from the ground up and who values the people who help make it happen. This is an opportunity to grow with a company — not just fill a seat. We are looking for someone who can become a dependable and trusted part of the company, not someone who only completes isolated tasks. If you are proactive, organized, confident in English, comfortable communicating with customers, and capable of helping a busy business owner stay focused and accountable, we would like to hear from you.

title: Full-Time Bookkeeper
description: Senior Bookkeeper Company: Speak Your Way To Cash® (and affiliated entities) Reports to: [Director of Operations] Type: Contractor Compensation: $800 Start date: ASAP Have you managed books for a company doing $10 Million USD or more? Have you reconciled hundreds or thousands of transactions a month? Are you savvy with financial reports? Do you know how manage a large chart of accounts? ABOUT US Speak Your Way To Cash® is a three-time Inc. 5000 sales training company. We teach credentialed experts, licensed professionals, and service-based business owners how to land corporate contracts and sell from the stage. The team is 17 people and fully remote. The business runs on a launch model with one to two launches per month, plus live events, masterminds, and international retreats, so transaction volume is uneven by design — quiet weeks followed by heavy ones. There are several related entities under the same ownership, including a law firm and a holding company. Books are kept separate and clean across all of them. THE ROLE We need a senior bookkeeper who owns the numbers day to day. That means reconciling transactions daily, closing out and reporting weekly, and running a full month-end close that leaves nothing for our CPA to untangle at tax time. This is a maintenance and accuracy role, not a strategy role. The person who does well here is the one who notices that a deposit doesn't match, chases it down the same day, and tells us before we ask. WHAT YOU'LL DO DAILY • Reconcile all bank, credit card, and payment processor transactions daily • Code expenses correctly to the right entity, class, and category • Flag anything that looks off — duplicate charges, missing receipts, unusual vendor activity, deposits that don't tie to a known launch or invoice WEEKLY • Follow-up on any unpaid invoices or failed payments across stripe, paypal, and fanbasis • Deliver a written financial report covering cash position, revenue by offer, outstanding AP and AR, and any open items you need answered • Reconcile revenue across payment processors and our sales platform so what the platform reports matches what actually hit the bank • Track contractor payments and outstanding invoices MONTHLY • Run a full close: reconciliations complete, accruals recorded, journal entries posted, books locked • Produce P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements with a short written summary of what changed and why • Reconcile event and travel spend against budget ONGOING • Maintain clean, current books across multiple entities without commingling • Manage 1099 tracking and year-end contractor reporting • Prepare and hand off documentation for our CPA at tax time • Keep receipt and documentation systems organized enough that any transaction can be traced in under five minutes AI PROFICIENCY REQUIRED AI proficiency is required. Candidates must be able to use AI tools effectively in their day-to-day work, verify outputs for accuracy, protect confidential company and client information, and explain a practical example of using AI to improve work quality or efficiency. WHAT YOU NEED • Five or more years of bookkeeping experience, including at least two years at the senior level • Experience working inside a firm — an accounting or CPA firm, or a law firm. You should know what it looks like when books are held to a professional standard and reviewed by someone else. • Advanced QuickBooks skills. You should be comfortable with bank rules, class and location tracking, journal entries, undeposited funds, and cleaning up someone else's mess in QuickBooks without starting over. • Experience managing books for more than one entity at a time • Experience reconciling high-volume transactions from payment processors, not just a single business checking account • Full ownership of month-end close in a prior role, start to finish • Strong written communication. Much of this job is telling us what you found in writing, clearly, without being asked twice. • Ability to work independently on a remote team and hit recurring deadlines without reminders NICE TO HAVE • Law firm trust accounting or IOLTA experience • QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification • Experience with online course, coaching, or event-based businesses where revenue comes in launches • Familiarity with Stripe, GoHighLevel, Dubsado, or Gusto • Experience supporting a business through fast revenue growth WHO THIS IS NOT FOR • Anyone who needs daily direction to know what to work on • Anyone whose experience is limited to one small business with low transaction volume • Anyone who has never closed a month or handed off books to a CPA • Anyone who would rather do tax strategy than reconcile accounts HOW TO APPLY Email ---------- and copy ---------- with the subject line SENIOR BOOKKEEPER. Include: • A loom video detailing your bookkeeping experiece • Your resume • A short note (under 300 words) describing the most disorganized set of books you have taken over and what you did to clean them up • The number of entities you currently manage books for, and the approximate monthly transaction volume across them • Your QuickBooks certifications, if any Finalists will complete a paid reconciliation exercise using sample data before any offer is made. Applications without the subject line will not be reviewed.

title: AI YouTube Video Editor – Script to Finished Video
job_title: AI YouTube Video Editor – Script to Finished Video
description: # AI YouTube Video Editor – Script to Finished Video We are looking for a skilled and creative **AI Video Editor** who can take a completed video script and turn it into a **professional, engaging YouTube video from start to finish**. This is not simply a video-cutting position. You will receive the **finished script**, and you will be responsible for transforming that script into a complete, ready-to-upload video using AI tools, stock footage, images, graphics, sound effects, music, captions, and other visual elements. Our content is primarily **Christian/Bible-based educational and commentary content**, so the editor must be comfortable working with religious subject matter. ## What You Will Be Responsible For ### 1. Script-to-Video Production You must be able to take a written script and independently create the entire video. This includes: * Reviewing and understanding the script * Creating or selecting an appropriate AI voiceover * Finding relevant stock footage and B-roll * Finding or creating appropriate images * Using AI-generated images/video when appropriate * Adding motion graphics, text, captions, Bible verses, maps, historical imagery, and other visual elements * Adding background music and sound effects * Creating smooth transitions * Synchronizing visuals with the narration * Maintaining strong pacing and viewer engagement * Color correction and audio balancing * Producing the final video in **4K when required** * Creating both long-form YouTube videos and YouTube Shorts The goal is for me to provide you with the **script**, and for you to return a **finished, professional video ready for YouTube**. ### 2. Strong Video Editing Skills You should be proficient with professional editing software such as: * Adobe Premiere Pro * Adobe After Effects * DaVinci Resolve * Final Cut Pro * CapCut Professional Experience with AI video-production tools is highly preferred. Examples may include AI voice generation, AI image generation, AI video generation, automatic captioning, image animation, and other AI-assisted production tools. ### 3. Storytelling & Viewer Retention You must understand that YouTube editing is about more than making a video look good. You should understand: * Storytelling * Pacing * Pattern interrupts * Visual changes that maintain viewer attention * B-roll placement * Music and sound design * Emotional emphasis * Hooks and retention * When to use text, graphics, images, or video instead of leaving the same visual on screen too long The finished video should visually support what the narrator is saying rather than simply showing random stock footage. ### 4. AI Video Production You should be comfortable using AI tools to speed up production and improve quality. You should be capable of independently determining when to use: * AI-generated images * AI-generated video * AI voiceovers * Stock footage * Historical/public-domain imagery * Motion graphics * Text animation * Maps and timelines * Sound effects and music AI-generated content should look professional and intentional—not like a basic automated slideshow. ### 5. YouTube Shorts You must also be able to convert long-form content or scripts into engaging vertical videos. Shorts should include: * 9:16 vertical formatting * Strong opening hook * Fast but natural pacing * Dynamic captions * Visual changes * B-roll and/or AI-generated visuals * Sound effects when appropriate * Background music * Professional transitions ### 6. Copyright & Licensing You must understand copyright, licensing, and fair-use principles. All stock footage, images, music, sound effects, and other assets must be legally usable for a monetized YouTube channel. You must be able to identify the source or license for assets if requested. **Do not use copyrighted footage, music, images, or other material simply because it can be found online.** ### 7. Communication You must: * Communicate clearly in English * Follow written instructions * Respond to feedback professionally * Make requested revisions * Ask questions when something in a script is genuinely unclear * Be able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions for every video ### 8. Reliability & Time Management You must be able to meet agreed deadlines consistently. I am looking for someone interested in a **long-term working relationship**, not someone who will disappear after one or two projects. ## Software, AI Tools & Equipment The editor is expected to have their **own computer, reliable internet connection, professional video-editing software, and access to the normal tools needed to complete the work.** You should already have legitimate access to the editing and AI tools you normally use for your production workflow. This may include: * Professional video-editing software * AI voice-generation tools * AI image/video-generation tools * Captioning tools * Stock footage and image resources * Music and sound-effect libraries * Other tools you normally use to produce professional YouTube videos You are responsible for the tools you choose to use as part of your normal editing workflow. If I require the use of a **specific paid service, premium asset library, AI platform, or other subscription that is not normally part of your workflow**, we will discuss access or reimbursement before the expense is incurred. **Do not use pirated software, unlicensed assets, or illegally obtained content.** ## Work Requirements You must have the ability to produce approximately: **3 high-quality long-form YouTube videos per 5-day work week** Long-form videos will generally be approximately **7 minutes**. You must also be capable of producing **YouTube Shorts** as assigned. Quality is more important than simply producing videos quickly. ## What I Will Provide I will provide: * The completed video script * General channel style/direction * Examples of the editing quality and style expected * Feedback when revisions are necessary **You will be responsible for everything needed to turn the script into the finished video.** ## How to Apply Please follow these instructions carefully. Applicants who do not follow them may not be considered. **Step 1:** Watch the sample video linked below from beginning to end. ---------- The sample demonstrates the approximate editing quality, pacing, visual storytelling, and overall style I expect. **Step 2:** Leave a comment on the sample video so I know you watched it. Include your OnlineJobs.ph name or another identifier in your application so I can match your comment with your application. **Step 3:** In your application, send: * Links to **2–3 videos you personally edited** * At least **one example of a faceless/AI-assisted YouTube video**, if available * A list of the editing and AI tools you currently use * Your expected rate * How long it normally takes you to turn a 7-minute script into a finished video * Whether you can create the complete video when **only the script is provided** **Step 4:** Start your application with the words: **“SCRIPT TO VIDEO”** This lets me know you read the entire job posting. ## Important I am specifically looking for an editor who can work **independently from a finished script**. If you require me to provide all of the footage, images, voiceovers, music, and other assets before you can begin editing, this position is probably not the right fit. The ideal candidate can receive a script, understand the story being told, select or create the appropriate visual and audio assets, edit everything together, and deliver a polished video that is ready to upload to YouTube. There is potential for **consistent, long-term work** for the right editor.

description: Experience: 3+ years of Amazon / e-commerce experience Employment Type - Full-time Industry:** Amazon FBA / E-commerce / Consumer Electronics About the Role We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and reliable Amazon E-Commerce & PPC Specialist to join our growing e-commerce business. This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who understands how Amazon businesses operate and can take ownership of important areas such as **PPC optimization, product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, and performance reporting**. The ideal candidate has 3+ years of hands-on Amazon experience, preferably working with an Amazon brand or seller. Experience managing Amazon advertising campaigns and using tools such as **Helium 10 and Keepa** is a major advantage. We are looking for someone who can analyze data, identify problems and opportunities, make recommendations, and eventually take ownership of day-to-day Amazon e-commerce operations. Key Responsibilities Amazon PPC & Advertising * Review and analyze Amazon advertising performance on a regular basis. * Analyze sales, advertising spend, ACOS, ROAS, conversion rates, CPC, CTR, impressions, clicks, orders, keywords, and search terms. * Identify underperforming and high-performing campaigns, keywords, products, and search terms. * Optimize PPC campaigns based on performance data. * Recommend changes to **bids, budgets, keywords, targeting, negative keywords, and campaign structure**. * Identify opportunities to improve advertising efficiency and profitability. * Prepare clear PPC reports with actionable recommendations. * Monitor trends and identify problems before they become significant. * Assist with developing and testing new PPC strategies. Amazon Product Research * Research potential products and evaluate their market potential. * Analyze competitors, pricing, reviews, ratings, sales estimates, product trends, and market conditions. * Identify product opportunities and potential risks. * Use Amazon research tools to evaluate competition and demand. * Prepare organized product research reports and recommendations. Keyword Research * Conduct Amazon keyword research. * Analyze **search volume, competition, relevance, ranking, conversion potential, and keyword performance**. * Identify primary, secondary, long-tail, and negative keywords. * Research competitor keywords and search terms. * Use keyword data to support both PPC and organic ranking strategies. Amazon Operations Depending on experience, responsibilities may also include: * Amazon Seller Central management. * Inventory monitoring and forecasting. * Product listing analysis. * Competitor monitoring. * Pricing monitoring. * Sales and profitability analysis. * Identifying listing or account issues. * Preparing spreadsheets and reports. * Supporting general Amazon e-commerce operations. Required Qualifications Amazon Experience **3+ years of hands-on Amazon / e-commerce experience is required.** Strong preference will be given to candidates who have: * Previously worked for an **Amazon brand or established Amazon seller. * Managed or assisted with Amazon PPC campaigns. * Worked directly inside **Amazon Seller Central. * Experience with Amazon FBA. * Experience with product research and keyword research. * Experience analyzing Amazon sales and advertising data. Analytical & Technical Skills You should have: * Strong analytical and numerical skills. * Ability to work with large amounts of data. * Ability to identify trends and patterns. * Ability to recognize problems and investigate their causes. * Strong attention to detail. * Ability to make decisions based on data rather than assumptions. * Excellent Excel / Google Sheets skills. * Comfortable working with formulas, tables, filters, sorting, and data analysis. Amazon Tools Experience with the following is highly desirable: * Helium 10 — required or strongly preferred* * Keepa** * Amazon Seller Central * Amazon Ads / Advertising Console * Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel * Other Amazon research and analytics tools ### Communication Excellent **English communication skills are required**, both written and spoken. You must be able to: * Clearly communicate findings and recommendations. * Write professional reports and messages. * Explain why a campaign, product, or keyword is performing well or poorly. * Communicate problems quickly and clearly. * Work independently while keeping management informed. ## Additional Skills — Strong Assets The following are not mandatory but will make your application significantly stronger: Marketing * Digital marketing experience. * Amazon marketing experience. * Understanding of conversion rate optimization. * Understanding of customer behavior and competitive positioning. * Experience with e-commerce marketing outside Amazon. Design & Content Experience with: * Basic photo editing * Product image optimization * Video editing * Amazon listing creative/content AI & Technology We are looking for someone who is comfortable learning and using modern technology. Experience using **AI tools to improve productivity, research, data analysis, reporting, writing, or e-commerce operations** is a strong advantage. You should be comfortable learning new software and finding ways to use technology to work more efficiently. Educational Background Candidates with education or professional backgrounds in: * Engineering * Computer Science * Information Technology * Mathematics * Statistics * Data Analytics * Business / Marketing * Economics * Other technical or analytical fields are particularly encouraged to apply. ## What We Are Looking For The most important quality we are looking for is **ownership**. We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions and completes a checklist. We want someone who can say: > "I reviewed the data, found this problem, investigated the reason, and here is what I recommend we do." You should be: * Reliable and dependable. * Highly organized. * Proactive. * Analytical. * Detail-oriented. * Comfortable working independently. * Willing to learn. * Comfortable taking responsibility. * Able to meet deadlines. * Interested in building a long-term working relationship. Internet & Work Requirements * Reliable, high-speed internet connection. * Reliable computer suitable for working with multiple browser tabs, Amazon Seller Central, spreadsheets, and research tools. * Ability to work remotely without constant supervision. * Professional communication and availability during agreed working hours. Application Instructions — IMPORTANT **Applications that do not follow the instruction below will be automatically discarded.** When applying, you **MUST include the following sentence, or a clear paraphrased version of it, either in the subject line or as the FIRST sentence of your application:** **"I am interested in learning and taking ownership of Amazon e-commerce operations."** For example, you may write: **"I am excited to learn, take ownership, and grow with Amazon e-commerce operations."** Failure to include this sentence or a clear paraphrase **will result in your application being automatically rejected.** ## Please Include the Following in Your Application Please answer the following questions: 1. **How many years of Amazon / e-commerce experience do you have?** 2. **Have you previously worked for an Amazon brand or Amazon seller? Please describe your role.** 3. **What experience do you have with Amazon Seller Central?** 4. **What experience do you have with Amazon PPC / Amazon Advertising?** 5. **How comfortable are you analyzing ACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion rate, search terms, keywords, and campaign performance?** 6. **What experience do you have with Helium 10? Candidates with strong Amazon PPC, product research, Helium 10, and analytical experience may be considered for higher compensation. We are interested in finding the **right long-term person**, not simply the lowest-cost VA. ## Long-Term Opportunity This position has the potential to grow into a larger role with increasing responsibility. risks * Find products with consistent sales history and sustainable margins, not just products that are temporarily profitable * Reverse source successful Amazon listings to find additional products from the same brands, manufacturers, and distributors * Research and identify profitable wholesale distributors * Research brands and determine whether they are suitable for Amazon wholesale * Contact distributors and brands by email and phone * Assist with opening wholesale accounts * Contact brands regarding reseller applications and authorization * Assist with Amazon ungating and approval processes * Maintain organized sourcing information in Google Sheets * Track potential suppliers, products, costs, profitability, and sourcing opportunities * Communicate findings clearly and provide product sourcing recommendations SellerAmp Requirements You should be comfortable using SellerAmp SAS at an advanced level, including: * Analyzing products directly from Amazon listings * Evaluating FBA fees and true net profit * Calculating ROI and profit margins * Understanding Buy Box dynamics * Evaluating competition and seller rotation * Identifying Amazon as a seller * Identifying potentially unstable pricing * Comparing current pricing to historical pricing * Evaluating sales rank and sales-rank history * Determining whether a product has enough sales velocity to justify purchasing * Using SellerAmp to find and evaluate profitable sourcing opportunities * Understanding when SellerAmp numbers look profitable but the product may still be a poor wholesale opportunity Identifying seasonal products * Identifying price tanking * Recognizing stable vs. unstable listings * Evaluating historical sales velocity * Understanding seller rotation and competition * * Experience working with an Amazon wholesale business generating $30,000+ per month in sales * Advanced SellerAmp SAS knowledge * Advanced Keepa knowledge * Experience with reverse sourcing * description: Full Time Short Form Video Editor (Reels) With Film B Roll Sourcing Overview We are hiring a full time editor to produce high performing short form reels built around our talking head recordings, with B roll sourced from well known movies that visually match the story, emotion, and meaning of the script. This is not a basic cutting job. The output must match a specific pacing, caption style, and overall “feel” that we will provide via a reference video. What You Will Edit You will receive a raw recording of our founder speaking to camera. Your job is to turn that into a finished reel by layering in movie B roll that reinforces the message, then adding our captions in a very specific, consistent style. Output Expectations You will deliver a 60 reels per month if working full time - 30 for part time Core Responsibilities You will source B roll clips from famous movies that match the script meaning, tone, and emotion, and you will build a clean, fast paced narrative with strong retention. You will edit and time captions exactly as provided, using our required caption style with zero deviations. What Matters Most Technical ability matters. **Execution matters more.** We are specifically looking for someone who: * Finishes projects. * Meets deadlines. * Communicates without being chased. * Gives clear beginning-of-day and end-of-day updates. * Works priorities one at a time through completion. * Tests their work before saying it is finished. * Identifies problems proactively. * Researches solutions independently. * Asks questions when necessary instead of sitting stuck. * Documents systems so someone else can understand them. * Can manage their own workload and commitments. * Tells us BEFORE a deadline when there is a problem — not after the deadline passes. This means the systems you build won't simply be internal projects. As BBV grows, many of these systems may ultimately be deployed across client businesses. We therefore care about building things **cleanly, repeatably and correctly.** ## What We Want to See When You Apply Please send: 1. A short introduction about yourself. 2. Your years of GoHighLevel experience. 3. Examples/screenshots or Loom videos of GHL systems you personally built. 4. Websites or funnels you personally built. 5. Examples of automations or integrations you created. 6. SEO work you've performed and the results. 7. Examples of video/content work you've produced. 8. Your experience with Meta, Google or YouTube advertising. 9. The AI tools you currently use and how you use them. 10. Your expected monthly compensation in PHP/USD. ### And answer these three questions: **1. Tell us about a technical problem you didn't know how to solve when it was assigned to you. How did you figure it out?** **2. Tell us about a project where you were going to miss a deadline. When did you tell your manager, and what did you do about it?** **3. You are given five projects Monday morning, but realistically you can only finish three by Friday. What do you do?** Please do not use AI to give us the answer you think we want. We would rather hear an imperfect answer from you than a perfect answer from ChatGPT. ## Hiring Process Qualified applicants will complete: **Step 1:** Application review **Step 2:** Technical interview **Step 3:** Practical skills test **Step 4:** Final interview The practical test will involve completing real-world GHL/automation tasks so we can evaluate how you think, build, troubleshoot, communicate and finish work. description: Bright Future Digital is a UK digital marketing and lead-generation agency. We're hiring an appointment setter who can; - Work our leads properly — nurture them, - Follow up relentlessly, - Book qualified sales calls. Our founder closes; you fill his calendar. There are three sides to the role: 1. Book qualified sales calls for our new-client pipeline. You set the appointment, our founder closes it. 2. Make outbound and cold calls to prospect lists we provide or that you source yourself — open the conversation and book the appointment. 3. Call and qualify leads coming into our lead-generation websites, then hand the hot ones over to our clients as premium, ready-to-buy leads. Day to day, that means: • Respond to every new lead FAST — within 15 minutes during working hours. • Make consistent outbound/cold calls to provided and self-sourced prospect lists. • Follow up persistently across call, SMS, email and WhatsApp until you get a yes or a clear no. • Qualify every lead: right decision-maker, genuine need, budget capacity, timeline. • Book appointments into our calendar, then confirm and remind so people actually show up. • Keep our GoHighLevel CRM spotless — every lead dispositioned with clear notes. • Report your numbers to us every week. What good looks like (the standard your base pays for) This is a proactive, high-activity seat, not a wait-for-the-phone one. To hold the role you’ll consistently: • Hit the 15-minute response time on inbound leads during UK hours. • Make a steady daily volume of outbound dials and structured follow-ups (we’ll agree the number in week one based on the lists — but this is a phone-first role, every day). • Keep every lead moving through the pipeline with clean, current CRM notes — no lead left untouched. We track this because our last arrangement failed when leads were left to go cold. Working the leads is the job. Quality beats volume: we cap booked closing calls at a manageable number per week, so your focus is on booking the right meetings that convert, not filling a calendar. You’re a great fit if you • Have 2+ years in appointment setting, sales, or outbound. • Know GoHighLevel well (or a very similar CRM and can learn GHL fast). • Speak and write excellent English. • Can work UK business hours (9am–5pm UK time). • Are organised, genuinely persistent, and understand how lead gen and digital marketing work. • Have a reliable computer, a good headset, and fast, stable internet. Compensation (USD) — base plus uncapped commission We reward closed business, not just a full calendar. The money is weighted toward deals that actually land: • Base: $500/month, paid bi-weekly, for meeting the daily activity and response standard above. • + $15 for every appointment that is genuinely qualified and attends. “Qualified” is objective and agreed up front: confirmed decision-maker, stated budget, genuine need, booked and attended — all logged in the CRM. • + 10% of the first invoice (setup + first month) on every deal that closes, or a flat $150 per close, whichever is higher. • Uncapped. The more deals you help close, the more you earn — there is no ceiling. What to realistically expect: in a normal month a productive setter earns $300–$800 in commission on top of base — around $800–$1,300 total. The real upside is on closes, so a setter who books well-qualified meetings that convert earns considerably more, and the strongest push toward $1,500+. We won’t quote you an inflated “guaranteed” number — your work rate and the quality of your bookings d ---------- it, and we’ll be straight with you about volumes from day one. How this starts — a paid trial with a real gate The first 30 days is a paid trial on live leads. We’ll agree clear activity and booked-appointment targets in week one. Hit them and you move into the ongoing role with a clear path toward a closing seat and higher commission. It’s a genuine working trial for both of us — we’re building a long-term seat, not filling a gap. How to apply (read carefully) 1. Send a 2–3 minute audio or Loom recording introducing yourself and telling us about a time you turned a cold or difficult lead into a booked meeting. 2. Tell us which CRMs you’ve used and your experience with GoHighLevel. 3. Start your application with the word “TRADES” so we know you read this properly. Applications without it are deleted. We reply to every serious applicant.

title: Marketing Associate
description: ABOUT US We're a US-based financial planning firm. Publishing content across our social platforms from a calendar we'll give you. - Helping with webinars and email. Setting up registration pages, loading email copy into templates, checking that links work, and scheduling sends. We'll train you on our tools. - Keeping things organized. Uploading and labeling video files and images, following our file-naming conventions, maintaining simple trackers. - Light reporting. Pulling a few numbers each week into a standing report. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required: - Excellent written English. This is the most important requirement. You'll be writing replies that American readers see publicly, so your writing needs to be clear, warm, and error-free. - Comfortable on social media platforms, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube at minimum. You should know your way around comments, posts, and basic account settings. - Comfortable learning new software. We use HubSpot, WebinarGeek, and a few other tools. You do not need to know any of them already. You do need to be the kind of person who can watch a tutorial, read a help doc, and figure things out. - Detail-oriented and reliable. Much of this job is doing small things correctly and consistently. If you're the person who notices the broken link or the typo, we want to talk to you. - Good judgment about when to ask. We'd much rather you ask a question than guess. - Reliable internet and a backup option, plus availability during our morning hours. HOW TO APPLY We read every application that follows these instructions. Please start your message with the word ORANGE so we know you read the whole post. Then answer these three questions briefly: 1. Tell us about a time you had to learn a new software tool on your own. How did you go about it? 2. Someone leaves this comment on one of our YouTube videos: "Really enjoyed this one. Is there any way to get a copy of the chart you showed around the 12 minute mark? I'd like to go over it with my wife." Write the reply you'd send. 3. What are your available hours in US Mountain Time, and how many hours a week are you currently committed to other clients? Please include a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile or a short resume. Our process: Application review, then a short paid exercise (about an hour), then a 30-minute video call, then a paid trial period, then a permanent offer. We reply to everyone we move forward with. Thanks for reading this far.

title: Creator Partnerships & Production Coordinator Remote
description: 6FT CLUB® is a men’s confidence and footwear brand based in Los Angeles. We are hiring a highly organized, proactive Production Coordinator to help us consistently find creators, coordinate product-content shoots, and manage creator partnerships from outreach through final delivery. This is not a general administrative assistant position. Your primary responsibility will be helping us produce a reliable stream of high-quality video content featuring our height-increasing insoles and shoes. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES: 1) Coordinate Los Angeles Studio Shoots Our height-increase shoes are stored at our creative studio in Downtown Los Angeles and cannot be mailed to creators. You will: Find male models, actors, UGC creators, and lifestyle creators located in the Los Angeles area. Identify talent who can travel to our DTLA studio. Contact candidates and confirm their interest, rates, availability, clothing sizes, and shoe sizes. Coordinate shoot dates between the brand owner, studio availability, creators, photographers, and videographers. Send confirmations, call sheets, reference images, shot lists, and reminders. Maintain backup talent in case someone cancels. Help make sure each shoot is properly prepared before anyone arrives. Track payments, content deliverables, releases, and usage rights. You will coordinate these shoots remotely from the Philippines. You will not be expected to attend them in person. 2) Recruit U.S.-Based UGC Creators Our height-increase insoles can be mailed to creators throughout the United States. You will: Find TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and UGC creators who match the brand. Conduct personalized outreach through email and direct messages. Explain the collaboration and negotiate reasonable creator rates. Collect shipping information and product-size requirements. Coordinate product shipment with our team. Provide creators with clear briefs, references, deadlines, and talking points. Follow up until the content is delivered. Organize finished content, creator information, agreements, and usage rights. Build ongoing relationships with reliable creators. 3) Evaluate Brand Fit Our ideal audience includes men interested in confidence, dating, style, fitness, grooming, self-improvement, and personal presentation. Strong creator candidates will generally be: Male, approximately 21–35 years old. Based in the United States. Comfortable creating authentic, natural short-form video. Visually aligned with a modern men’s lifestyle brand. Able to communicate the product benefit without making the content feel embarrassing, deceptive, or overly promotional. Followed by an audience that includes young professionals and men interested in improving their appearance and confidence. Many of our customers are Latino and Asian men, but creators from all backgrounds should be considered when they naturally fit the brand. Follower count is less important than content quality, audience fit, communication, and reliability. We are generally interested in creators with approximately 10,000–150,000 followers, as well as talented UGC creators who may have smaller audiences. Creators with an Amazon Storefront or experience producing Amazon video content are especially valuable. REQUIRED SKILLS -------------------------------------- Strong written English. Excellent organization and follow-up. Experience with influencer outreach, UGC coordination, talent sourcing, social-media research, casting, or production coordination. Comfortable communicating with creators through email, TikTok, Instagram, and other platforms. Able to evaluate whether a creator genuinely fits a brand. Able to manage several creator conversations and deadlines simultaneously. Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Drive, Notion, and project-management tools. Proactive and capable of moving projects forward without waiting for instructions every day. Detail-oriented when recording rates, deliverables, product sizes, deadlines, and contact information. WORKING HOURS -------------------------------------- This is a part-time remote position of approximately 20 hours per week. Most work can be completed during normal daytime hours, but you must have some availability overlapping with Los Angeles business hours for creator communication, scheduling, and occasional meetings. We can establish predictable overlap hours rather than requiring you to remain online throughout the U.S. workday. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE -------------------------------------- Within your first 60–90 days, you should be able to: Build an organized database of qualified creators. Maintain a steady outreach pipeline. Present a shortlist of genuinely brand-appropriate candidates each week. Consistently move creators from initial contact to confirmed collaboration. Coordinate Los Angeles studio shoots with minimal scheduling confusion. Reduce cancellations through confirmations and backup talent. Track every creator, negotiation, shipment, deadline, deliverable, and usage agreement. Identify dependable creators we can hire repeatedly. COMPENSATION -------------------------------------- Starting compensation will depend on experience and availability. We anticipate approximately 400 to 500 USD per month for 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase compensation based on performance and expanded responsibilities. This role may begin with a paid trial period. HOW TO APPLY -------------------------------------- Please include the following: A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience. Examples of creator outreach, influencer marketing, casting, talent coordination, or production work you have completed. The tools you have used to find and manage creators. Your expected monthly salary for 20 hours per week. Your availability for overlap with Los Angeles business hours. A sample link to one TikTok or Instagram creator you believe would be a strong fit for 6FT CLUB®, along with two or three sentences explaining why. The word “ELEVATE” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete listing. *Generic or AI-generated applications that do not include a specific creator recommendation will not be considered.

title: Social Media Manager & Content Strategist

Publishing & Community Management: -Schedule and publish approved content -Maintain a consistent posting schedule -Monitor comments, messages, and audience engagement -Create opportunities for conversation and community engagement -Identify comments or messages that require our team's direct attention -Help maintain an active and responsive online presence Platforms: Our primary platforms are: -Instagram -Facebook We would also like lighter support or growth in: -TikTok -LinkedIn -Google Business Profile -Nextdoor We do not expect completely unique content for every platform. What Success Looks Like: We want our social media presence to become: -More consistent -More intentional and strategic -More recognizable -More locally relevant -More engaging and useful -Better organized -Less dependent on the owners to constantly come up with content ideas -More effective at keeping Postal People top-of-mind when someone needs one of our services How to Apply: Please include the following with your application: -A short introduction and why you're interested in working with Postal People. -Your resume/CV. -Your portfolio and/or links to social media accounts you've professionally managed. -For the accounts you share, tell us what you personally handled: strategy, research, content planning, graphics, video editing, captions, scheduling, engagement, analytics, etc. -Briefly describe how you would approach your first 30 days managing social media for a local business like Postal People. -After taking a quick look at Postal People online, tell us one content or social media opportunity you immediately see for our business. -Which platforms have you professionally managed? Historical accuracy is also important. Images should be appropriate to the period and subject being promoted. ## Hours Initially approximately: **10 hours per week** The hours can be reasonably flexible. The initial engagement will be a **30-day paid trial**. If the system proves successful and the right person demonstrates they can handle the work reliably, hours may increase. ## Pay Starting rate: **US$5-US$8 per hour depending on experience and ability.** I am willing to pay more over time for someone who becomes highly productive, reliable and valuable to the publishing operation. This is intended to become an ongoing position rather than a one-off freelance project. ## Paid Video Test Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a PAID practical test. I will provide: * One book cover * The book subject * A short script * A suggested video concept * Basic instructions You will create one approximately 15-second vertical promotional video suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. At the beginning of your application, please write the words: **HISTORY VIDEO VA** Applications that do not include these words will not be considered. ## Future Opportunity This publishing catalogue contains hundreds of books and continues to grow. If the short-form video strategy works, there is substantial ongoing work available.
