The existing QuickBooks Online file contains incomplete historical records, reconciliation issues, duplicate transactions, A/R and A/P discrepancies, equity issues, and other bookkeeping errors. We need someone who can investigate the underlying transactions, reconstruct missing activity, reconcile the books against source documents, and produce accurate financial records that can subsequently be reviewed by the company's CPA. Responsibilities: The selected bookkeeper will be responsible for: • Reconstructing missing historical bookkeeping activity • Reviewing and correcting existing QuickBooks Online transactions • Reconciling bank and credit card accounts against statements • Investigating Undeposited Funds balances • Investigating and correcting Accounts Receivable discrepancies • Reviewing and correcting Accounts Payable balances • Identifying duplicate and missing transactions • Reviewing revenue and customer transactions • Reviewing owner contributions and distributions • Correcting expense categorization • Reconciling payroll-related transactions using supporting records • Reviewing sales-tax-related bookkeeping records as needed • Documenting significant adjustments and unresolved items for CPA review • Preparing accurate and reliable financial statements Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone with proven experience in: • QuickBooks Online • QuickBooks cleanup and reconstruction • Historical bookkeeping corrections • Bookkeeping rescue or catch-up projects • Bank reconciliation • Accounts Receivable cleanup • Accounts Payable cleanup • Owner equity, contributions, and distributions • Duplicate transaction cleanup • Reconstructing missing transactions using bank statements and supporting documents • Working with messy or incomplete books • Working with CPAs or tax professionals • Preparing books for tax preparation Strong analytical skills and attention to detail are essential. Important We are not looking for someone who simply makes QuickBooks balances appear correct. Significant discrepancies need to be investigated using available bank statements, invoices, receipts, vendor records, payroll records, and other supporting documentation. For example, we do not want unexplained balances simply eliminated through arbitrary journal entries. The goal is to identify the underlying cause of discrepancies and make properly supported corrections wherever possible. Any unresolved items should be clearly documented and brought forward for review. -Fixed-Price Project -This project will be handled on a fixed-price basis only. Applicants should provide: • Proposed fixed project fee • Estimated completion timeline • What is included in the fixed fee • Assumptions included in the quote • Any circumstances that could require additional work outside the agreed scope The final fixed price may be confirmed after the selected candidate reviews the QuickBooks file and understands the full scope. Application Questions Please include answers to the following in your application: -How many years of QuickBooks Online experience do you have? -How many QuickBooks cleanup or reconstruction projects have you completed? -Have you reconstructed books where several months of activity were missing or incomplete? Please describe your experience. -Have you handled significant A/R, A/P, equity, and bank reconciliation discrepancies? -How would you approach a messy or incomplete QuickBooks Online file? -How would you investigate a large Undeposited Funds balance? -How would you investigate a negative Accounts Receivable balance? -How would you investigate potentially overstated Accounts Payable? -Do you work directly from bank statements and supporting documentation when reconstructing books? -Have you worked directly with CPAs or tax professionals? -What is your proposed fixed project fee? -What is your estimated completion timeline? -What exactly would be included in your fixed fee? -What circumstances, if any, could require additional work outside the agreed scope? -When can you start? Please provide examples, testimonials, or references from relevant QuickBooks cleanup or reconstruction projects. Selection Criteria Candidates will be evaluated based on: Technical QuickBooks Expertise Cleanup & Reconstruction Experience Ability to Investigate Historical Discrepancies Bank Reconciliation Experience A/R and A/P Experience Quality of Proposed Approach Fixed-Price Proposal Timeline References and Previous Work We are looking for the best qualified specialist, not simply the cheapest quote. How to Apply Please send your application to: ---------- Subject line: QuickBooks Cleanup & Reconstruction Specialist Application Please include your relevant experience, answers to the screening questions above, proposed fixed project fee, estimated timeline, and examples or references from similar projects. Only candidates with relevant QuickBooks cleanup/reconstruction experience will be considered.

Editing will typically include: * Removing pauses, mistakes, and dead space * Clean jump cuts * Improving pacing * Adding readable captions/subtitles * Highlighting important words * Light punch-ins and zooms * Occasional B-roll, screenshots, or graphics * Light sound effects when appropriate * Background music when appropriate * Basic color correction * Formatting everything vertically in 9:16 * Exporting finished videos in high quality The editing should feel **clean and engaging without being over-edited**. ### EDITING SOFTWARE CapCut Desktop / CapCut Pro is preferred. I plan to send footage in batches so you can work efficiently instead of receiving random videos throughout the day. ### COMPENSATION Starting compensation is **$300 USD/month for approximately 20 short-form videos per month**. If you consistently produce high-quality work, communicate well, and help me increase content output, there will be opportunities for: * Increased monthly compensation * More videos * YouTube editing * Additional responsibilities * Long-term work as the business grows I'm looking for someone I can work with for years, not weeks. ### PAID TEST Before hiring someone permanently, I will select a small number of applicants for a **paid 2-video test edit**. You will receive raw footage and an example of the editing style I'm looking for. ### HOW TO APPLY Please send: 1. Your name 2. Your location in the Philippines 3. Your editing software 4. How long you've been editing short-form videos 5. Links to your **3 best short-form videos** 6. Your usual turnaround time for a 30–90 second Reel 7. Your internet speed 8. Your computer specifications 9. Why you think you'd be a good fit for this position Also answer this question: **What makes a talking-head Reel boring, and what would you do in the edit to fix it?** At the very beginning of your application, write: **COMEBACK** Applications that don't include the word COMEBACK at the beginning will not be considered.

description: Social Media Content & Growth VA | Viral Research + Video Editing I’m a U.S.-based TikTok Shop affiliate creator looking for a creative, proactive Social Media Content & Growth VA to join me long-term. I currently create product-focused content primarily for TikTok Shop, particularly in the home, lifestyle and beauty spaces, and I’m expanding my content across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Pinterest. This is not a traditional administrative VA position. I’m looking for someone who genuinely understands short-form content, enjoys studying what is performing online, and can turn that research into actual content ideas. My Goal My goal is to build a content system where I can focus primarily on filming, creating and going LIVE, while you help handle the research, content planning, editing, repurposing, distribution and organization behind the scenes. Ideally, our workflow eventually looks like this: You research → tell me what to film → I batch-film → you edit → we approve → you distribute → we analyze what worked → you use that data to help plan the next content. I want someone who can eventually become a real creative partner in that process. What You’ll Be Doing * Research viral and high-performing TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts and Pinterest content * Study successful product videos and identify hooks, formats, angles, trends and selling strategies that are working * Bring me specific content ideas rather than simply saying, “You should post more” * Create hooks, scripts, concepts and simple shot lists so I know exactly what footage to film * Take my raw footage and turn it into multiple short-form videos with different hooks and angles * Edit videos using CapCut or similar software * Help create AI-assisted product/lifestyle content when appropriate * Repurpose my existing TikTok content for other platforms * Help set up and optimize my Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and Pinterest accounts * Create an efficient cross-posting and scheduling system * Optimize captions, titles, descriptions, keywords and hashtags for each platform * Organize raw footage, finished videos and previously posted content * Track performance and identify which videos, hooks and concepts we should repeat or improve Who I’m Looking For You do not need to be an expert in every platform. I’m much more interested in finding someone who is creative, curious, organized and resourceful and who understands what makes people stop scrolling. I especially want someone who can work independently. I don’t want to have to come up with every idea and then give you step-by-step instructions to execute it. I want someone who can research what’s working and come to me saying: “I found this format that’s performing really well. I think we can adapt it for your product. description: Land Acquisition Caller — Commission Only, No Earnings Cap (Philippines, Remote) We buy vacant land in Florida. We're building a small team of outbound callers to work prepared owner lists, follow a short qualification script, and book calls with our acquisitions manager. You will not negotiate, quote prices, or close — your job is to find the owners who genuinely want to sell and hand them over cleanly. We handle the offer, the contract, and the closing. 1. You get paid on every deal you source. A fixed amount, every time, when the property closes and funds: Assignment under $5,000 → $500 $5,000–$9,999 → $1,000 $10,000–$19,999 → $1,750 $20,000+ → $2,500 There is no cap and no quota. Source two deals in a month and you're paid for both. Source five and you're paid for five. Nobody takes a cut of what you earn, and your payout never shrinks because the team grew — how much you make is d ---------- by how much you close, and nothing else. 2. You also share a team bonus every time anyone on the team closes. This is separate money, funded by us — it is never taken out of the sourcing contractor's payout. If you put in real work that month, you get paid when the team wins, even if your own deal hasn't landed yet. The bonus is split by how much you actually produced, so the people who worked hardest get the biggest share, and it isn't divided among people who didn't show up. Payment within 5 business days of funding. Any seller you source stays credited to you for 180 days — if your lead closes three months later, it's still your deal. Calls are recorded and activity is logged, so credit and bonus shares are calculated from real numbers, not from anyone's memory or opinion. Strong performers may later be offered an hourly track with a guaranteed base. That's a choice we'll put in front of you, not something imposed. Please be honest with yourself before applying: this is commission work. It may take several weeks of consistent effort before your first payout, and there is no guaranteed income. If you need reliable money every week right now, this isn't the right fit — we'd rather you skip it than start and stop. What you need: excellent spoken English · comfortable talking to Americans · follows a script exactly · handles rejection without deflating · reliable internet and headset · Google Sheets · available during US business hours. No real estate experience required — we train the rest. Include all four of these in your application — applications missing any of them won't be reviewed: A short introduction Your outbound calling background A link to a 60-second voice recording introducing yourself as if you were calling a US homeowner (Google Drive, Loom, or Vocaroo is fine) Your written answer to this: "An owner says: 'How much would you give me for it?' What do you say?"

title: Service Coordinator
description: About Pro Coffee Gear Pro Coffee Gear is a fast-growing e-commerce company based in Austin, Texas, specializing in professional coffee equipment for home enthusiasts, cafés, restaurants, and hospitality businesses. We combine online sales with hands-on local service, helping customers select, install, maintain, and troubleshoot their coffee equipment. We operate in a fast-paced environment where things move quickly, priorities can change, and taking ownership matters. We’re looking for someone who is genuinely interested in coffee and equipment — whether you’re a coffee lover, an equipment expert, a technical-minded problem solver, or simply someone who enjoys learning a niche industry and becoming an expert in it. We’re Hiring a Service Coordinator We’re looking for a *Service Coordinator* to own the end-to-end coordination of all service requests — including installations, preventative maintenance (PM), and technical support. You’ll be the operational link between customers, technicians, and internal teams, ensuring every request is properly understood, quoted, scheduled, and completed without delays or confusion. This is a fast-paced role that requires strong organization, technical curiosity, and the ability to accurately triage service requests — including diagnosing the issue, coordinating the right technician, and ensuring the correct parts are identified before the visit. What You’ll Do * Manage incoming service requests (Front → Jobber flow) * Coordinate service communication in Front and Quo * Schedule installs, PMs, and service visits using Google Calendar * Create and manage service jobs in Jobber * Ensure all service work is paid before execution * Identify service type: install, PM, or troubleshooting * Conduct pre-installation checks with customers * Work with technicians to define required parts kits * Prepare and send service quotes * Collect payment or card-on-file after approval * Coordinate scheduling between customers and warehouse techs * Triage basic troubleshooting requests * Support parts listing creation with the listings team * Build strong knowledge of Pro Coffee Gear equipment What We’re Looking For * Customer service / support experience *required* * Experience working in fast-paced, high-volume environments * Strong English communication and organizational skills * Experience with Front, Jobber, and Google Calendar is preferred, but we strongly value fast learners who can quickly adapt to new systems and tools * Calm, structured, and empathetic under pressure * Basic technical troubleshooting ability or a strong willingness to learn * Proactive about improving and automating processes — someone who naturally thinks, “There has to be a better way to do this,” will be a great fit * Experience coordinating across multiple teams * Remote work experience preferred **Parts-oriented and interested in developing deeper parts knowledge** We’d especially value someone who wants to become an expert in coffee equipment and can eventually identify the parts needed from machine diagrams or troubleshooting calls, take ownership of sourcing the part from the vendor, placing the order, and following up with the customer through completion. Who Would Thrive Here? You don’t need to come from the coffee industry. You might be: * A coffee lover who wants to learn the equipment side of the industry * Someone with strong coffee equipment knowledge looking to move into an operational role * A technical or mechanically curious person who enjoys troubleshooting * A customer service professional who loves solving problems and coordinating moving pieces * Someone who enjoys niche industries and becoming the person everyone goes to for answers *The most important thing is curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to learn.*

title: YouTube Content Producer / Video Editor – Long-Term VA
job_title: YouTube Content Producer / Video Editor – Long-Term VA
description: ### Important – Starting Salary Please read this section carefully before applying. The starting salary for this position is **$350 USD per month**. This is **non-negotiable at the start**. The reason is quite straightforward. The company and YouTube channel are still at an early stage and are not currently generating income, so the budget I have available for the role at the moment is $350 per month. The role is based around approximately **4 hours per working day**, so please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable with the starting salary and the responsibilities outlined in this advert. I don't want people applying with the expectation of negotiating the starting salary, as I would rather be completely upfront about this from the beginning. That said, I don't see this as a $350/month position forever. The main goal initially is to build the YouTube channel to monetisation. Once we achieve that, I plan to increase the salary to: **$650 USD per month** The important thing is that your creative workload will **not increase** when the salary increases. The expected production will remain around: * 2 main/long-form videos per working day * Around 30–45 minutes per main video * 9 Shorts per working day The reason for the salary increase is that, once the channel is generating income, I will want to give you more responsibility across the digital side of the business. This could include things like: * Managing the YouTube channel * Instagram * TikTok * Social media scheduling * Website management * Amazon * eBay * Other online marketplaces * Organising content * Looking at analytics and performance * General digital support for the business So the additional $300 isn't because I want you to simply produce more content. It's because I will be trusting you with more areas of the business and giving you more responsibility. There may also be some flexibility with the workload The YouTube channel will always be the main priority. However, if we have a really productive week and we've managed to get enough videos created and scheduled in advance, I may d ---------- that we don't need to spend every working day that week purely producing YouTube content. If we are already well ahead with the YouTube schedule, I may use **up to two of the working days that week** to work on another project of mine called **Hot Pepper Cool**, which is a hot sauce company I launched earlier this year. This could involve things such as helping with the website, social media, product content, online marketplaces, research or other general digital work. The important thing is that I'm not looking to give you extra hours or simply add more work to the role. If we've already achieved what we need to achieve for YouTube that week, I'd rather use that available time productively on another part of the business. I also think this makes the role more interesting because you won't necessarily be doing the exact same thing every single day. The YouTube channel is the starting point, but if things go well, there is an opportunity to become involved in other parts of the business as they develop. Why I'm being so open about the salary I want to be completely honest about where the business is right now. You would be joining at an early stage, which means the starting salary is lower than I would like it to eventually be. At the same time, it also means you have the opportunity to grow with the business rather than joining something that is already fully established. If you need a position paying more than **$350/month from day one**, then I completely understand, but this probably isn't the right position for you. If you're comfortable starting at $350, enjoy creative work, want to help build something from the ground up and like the idea of potentially taking on more responsibility as the business grows, then I'd be very interested in hearing from you. I'm looking for someone who wants to become part of the business long term, rather than someone who is simply looking to complete a few tasks and move on.

title: Program Assistant
description: Program Assistant Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | $800 USD/month | 40 hours/week | U.S. time-zone hours REQUIRED WRITTEN INTERVIEW — COMPLETE TO MOVE FORWARD ---------- You must complete the written interview to move forward in the hiring process. Submit your resume as instructed below. We are not looking for someone who needs to be reminded about every detail. We are looking for a responsive, resourceful Program Assistant who can help us deliver an organized, supportive, and high-quality experience to hundreds of clients—while moving quickly and communicating with genuine warmth. Speak Your Way To Cash® currently supports nearly 100 Mastermind clients and approximately 400 Academy clients. With another major launch approaching, we expect to welcome an additional 100–200 students. This is a critical role for someone who can help our Program Manager and Lead Coach support that growth without allowing important details or client needs to fall through the cracks. ABOUT SPEAK YOUR WAY TO CASH® Speak Your Way To Cash® helps experts, entrepreneurs, and professionals turn their knowledge, voice, and expertise into profitable offers, speaking opportunities, and scalable businesses. We are a fast-growing, high-performance company with a global team. We move quickly, care deeply about our clients, and expect team members to take ownership of their responsibilities. POSITION OVERVIEW The Program Assistant will support the day-to-day administration and communication needs of our coaching programs. You will work closely with the Program Manager and serve as an extension of the Lead Coach. You will help prepare and distribute client emails, maintain accurate program communications, respond to client questions, and ensure important information reaches the right people at the right time. Although you will not be solely responsible for client retention, your work will directly influence the client experience and our ability to retain and support members. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Upload, format, review, and schedule client emails in Kartra. • Build and distribute emails to the correct lists and audience segments. • Format linked text, buttons, and other email elements accurately. • Use GoHighLevel to support program communication, client follow-up, and administrative workflows. • Review emails and links carefully before they are distributed. • Monitor designated program inboxes and respond to client questions. • Communicate with clients in a warm, kind, supportive, and professional manner. • Escalate sensitive, urgent, or complex client concerns to the appropriate team member. • Assist the Program Manager with program announcements, reminders, resources, and recurring communications. • Maintain organized records, trackers, and client information. • Follow up on open items without waiting to be reminded. • Identify missing information, potential errors, or communication gaps before they become problems. • Help the program team prepare for launches, enrollment periods, coaching calls, and client events. • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and responsiveness. • Complete assigned work on time and communicate promptly when clarification is needed. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • AI proficiency is required. Candidates must be able to use AI tools effectively in their day-to-day work, verify outputs for accuracy, protect confidential company and client information, and explain a practical example of using AI to improve work quality or efficiency. • Hands-on experience using Kartra to create, format, and send emails. • Experience working in GoHighLevel. • Experience communicating directly with customers, clients, students, or program members. • Excellent written and spoken English. • Strong proofreading skills and attention to detail. • Ability to communicate with warmth, professionalism, patience, and sound judgment. • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities. • Ability to work independently and take initiative. • Ability to follow established procedures while recognizing when a situation requires additional judgment. • Strong organizational and follow-through skills. • Ability to learn quickly and perform effectively in a fast-moving environment. • Reliable access to a computer and stable internet connection. • Ability to protect confidential company and client information. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Experience supporting a coaching, consulting, education, membership, or online-program business. • Experience supporting a Program Manager, Lead Coach, Customer Success Manager, or executive. • Experience with email marketing, client onboarding, learning-management systems, or membership platforms. • Experience working successfully as part of a remote or international team. • Familiarity with online launches, virtual events, coaching calls, or high-volume enrollment periods. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE You will be successful in this role when: • Client emails are accurate, properly formatted, and sent on time. • The correct clients consistently receive the correct information. • Links, dates, instructions, and audience segments are checked before distribution. • Clients receive timely, thoughtful, and professional responses. • The Program Manager does not have to repeatedly follow up on assigned work. • Open questions and potential problems are escalated early. • Program records and communications remain organized as enrollment grows. • You can manage recurring responsibilities while responding calmly to changing priorities. • Clients feel supported, respected, and confident in their experience with our company. YOU MAY BE A STRONG FIT IF YOU • Naturally notice what needs to be done and take appropriate action. • Are comfortable asking thoughtful questions and then moving forward. • Can balance speed with accuracy. • Take ownership of mistakes and correct them quickly. • Keep track of details without requiring constant supervision. • Enjoy supporting clients and helping people feel seen and cared for. • Communicate proactively instead of disappearing when something becomes difficult. • Can receive direct feedback without becoming defensive. • Want to contribute to a growing company where your work has a visible impact. PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU • Need repeated reminders to complete routine responsibilities. • Struggle to meet deadlines or respond promptly. • Are uncomfortable communicating directly with clients. • Regularly overlook details in emails, links, dates, or instructions. • Wait for step-by-step directions before taking action. • Cannot manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. • Do not have hands-on experience with Kartra and GoHighLevel. • Are looking for a role where expectations and responsibilities rarely change. • Are unwilling to accept feedback, take ownership, or correct mistakes quickly. LOCATION This is a remote position, and qualified international candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates located in the Philippines are strongly encouraged to apply because Speak Your Way To Cash® has an established Philippines-based team lead and a significant team presence there. Qualified candidates from Nigeria, the United States, and other locations may also be considered. HOW TO APPLY — WRITTEN INTERVIEW REQUIRED Please submit: • Your current resume. • Complete the written interview here: ---------- Applications must include both a resume and a completed written interview to move forward in the hiring process.

title: Sourcing & Project Coordinator: Promotional Products — Remote, Full-Time Contractor
job_title: Sourcing & Project Coordinator: Promotional Products — Remote, Full-Time Contractor
description: South Sun Solutions is a branded merchandise company. We work with agencies, mission-driven brands, and corporate clients, and our positioning is simple: we translate moments, ideas, and initiatives into gifts that last. Most of our industry is catalog-and-logo. Our value is in creative origination, product judgment, and anticipating the details before they become problems so people get items they keep. Sometimes that means designing something from scratch. Sometimes it means finding the right elevated object. And sometimes a client simply needs hats — done right, on time. Sustainability, for us, means product longevity and material intentionality, not greenwashing. With that in mind, we’re also offering tech-enabled products that connect keepsake physical pieces with lasting digital experiences. We’re a small team: two co-founders, plus a Strategic Account Manager (SAM) based in the Philippines. This role works directly with the SAM. It’s a full-time, long-term contractor role for someone who already knows the promotional products industry from the distributor side and wants to grow within a company that takes the work seriously and believes in consistency over intensity: some weeks have a heavier workload, some weeks are lighter; the goal is steady, high-quality execution over time, not constant urgency. ----------------------------------- *What you’ll do* In your first three months, your work centers on research, sourcing, and keeping our systems accurate and up to date. ~Product research and sourcing support~ • Research and recommend products against project requirements, with a focus on proactive projects and longer lead times • Communicate with vendors on availability, pricing, and specs to prepare preliminary quotes • Verify vendor payment details by phone before new or changed banking information is used — a standard fraud-prevention step we take whenever the timeline allows • Keep ClickUp current so we have a truly robust project management system. This includes, but isn’t limited to: uploading all mockups to each project, linking email threads to their corresponding projects, updating all quick-look fields, and maintaining the AR tracker (we plan to dedicate a knowledge transfer day to ClickUp during the onboarding phase) • Set up the sync agenda doc for each call from our template — new doc, correct dates, labeled with the two-week span — at least a week ahead so everyone can add items as they come up • Final product selection and project direction stay with the SAM. Rush projects stay with the SAM during this period. • Other miscellaneous (but work-related) research and projects as they come up (for example: looking into freight forwarders, comparing options, and making recommendations) ~Client research~ • Research clients and prospects from lists we provide, using LinkedIn, Google, our database, and whatever else works: upcoming events, programs, past purchases, and where a merch opportunity could exist (get creative!) • Add to the prospect list when you spot a good opportunity • Gather and organize what you find early enough for us to act on it — ideally, the team knows about upcoming events three or more months out, when possible ~Product library and trend research~ • Review vendor product suggestions (these typically arrive by email) and organize the products that look like a good fit for our clients into product libraries by category (apparel, hard goods, etc.) • Separately, maintain running lists of new and trending products. These can come from supplier sites, trade show recaps, industry news, or anything else that catches your eye ~Content and creative support~ • Build and maintain a bank of ready-to-post LinkedIn assets showcasing completed projects, so there’s always something to pull from. This is an ongoing responsibility, not something you wait to be assigned. The SAM directs this work and is the first point of contact for any questions; if you need further context on a project or the client, the Executive Creative Director is your resource • Create visual templates and simple social graphics in Canva • Contribute content ideas and support initiatives that help people see our work ----------------------------------- *What you won’t own* We value transparency, so clear role definitions matter to us. The SAM owns final client communication, product selection, pricing and margin decisions, quote approval, project prioritization, major vendor decisions, and anything that requires judgment about the overall client relationship. As Sourcing & Project Coordinator, you work alongside the SAM. When the SAM requests support with live client work, that comes first; the rest of your time goes to ongoing, mostly self-directed work like building product libraries and researching prospects. Your research, sourcing, and organization make the team’s work stronger and directly support the growth of the business. ----------------------------------- *Where we see this role going* After three months, if we both want to move forward together, the role expands: • Supporting all project types, including rush and time-sensitive work • Responding to new inquiries and gathering initial project details (quantity, budget, timeline, product direction) before handing off to the SAM • Flagging missing information, deadline risks, opportunities, and more before they become problems or we're too close to an event to pitch a client or prospect • Building client-ready decks once product selection and direction are finalized • Supporting concept-first outreach to target agencies and past clients • Keeping our living documents current, especially upcoming client projects and events Compensation grows with the role. The path we’re building toward is Coordinator → Senior Coordinator → Strategic Account Manager: growing into a second SAM role as the business grows. ----------------------------------- *Who you’ll work with* You’ll take day-to-day direction from our SAM. He sets your priorities, reviews your work, and is your first stop for questions about projects. Our Executive Creative Director handles the personnel side: your onboarding, compensation, regular check-ins, and your 90-day evaluation. If something isn’t working — with your workload, how you’re being supported, or the working relationship itself — you can go to her directly. You’ll join the company sync call every other week, and during your first 90 days you’ll have 1:1 check-ins with the Executive Creative Director on the weeks when there isn’t a sync call. ----------------------------------- *What we’re looking for* ~Required~ • At least one year of experience at a promotional products distributor • Working familiarity with Sage or ESP/ASI • Experience with supplier portals (SanMar, alphabroder, or similar) • Experience with a project management tool, and willingness to learn ClickUp • Clear, professional English, spoken and written • Comfortable working with direction, and comfortable working without it when the task calls for it — prospect research and product libraries are largely self-directed • Available full-time during US Eastern business hours (roughly 9pm–6am Philippine time) ~A plus~ • Canva, Adobe, or other graphic design experience • LinkedIn research experience • University degree ~And the things that matter more than any tool~ Our clients expect higher-end pieces, and the question we start from isn’t “what do we put a logo on?” but “what object makes sense for this moment?” • You’re curious about who’s receiving the item and why. You’ll research the brand and the event before suggesting what the object should be. • You have an eye for quality. You can tell a basic item from an elevated one, and a “good-enough” item from the right one — and you’ll keep looking/reaching out until you find the vendor(s) who can make the elevated version. • You notice what others miss — a material that’s off, a lead time that doesn't actually work, a detail the client would catch (and you catch it before the client does!). • You’re reliable. When you take on a responsibility, no matter how small the task, it gets done. • You make educated guesses where possible (we love to foster creative, independent thinking), and you ask when you’re unsure — there is no stupid question. • You’re looking for a long-term role with growth, not a gig. ----------------------------------- *Working structure and compensation* • Full-time contractor role, 40 hours per week, fully remote • US Eastern business hours • $600–$800 USD per month, with a defined ramp over the first 90 days based on milestones our ECD will suggest, and we'll agree upon together • A formal evaluation at 90 days, where we both d ---------- whether to move forward together • Compensation continues to grow with expanded responsibility and performance as the business grows ----------------------------------- *How we work* Five principles shape everything we do, including how we treat the people we work with: • People over profit, while staying profitable • Structure that serves everyone, not just the business • Consistency over intensity • Accountability as normal, not as punishment • People as partners, not resources If this sounds like how you want to work, please follow the directions below to apply. ----------------------------------- *How to apply* Please start your application with the word LONGEVITY so we know you’ve read the full posting. Then include: 1. A short introduction (3–5 sentences) 2. Why this role interests you 3. One sourcing request you handled: what the client asked for, what you recommended, and what you’d do differently now, if anything 4. Two suppliers you’ve worked with regularly, and one thing you learned about each (lead times, quality, service — whatever stood out) 5. One process, system, or responsibility you fully owned, not assisted with 6. Confirmation that you can work US Eastern business hours full-time ----------------------------------- *What happens next* We’ll review applications through September 19 and schedule first interviews the following week. Depending on how those go, we may invite a small number of candidates to a second conversation and/or a short paid sourcing exercise. Target start date is early-to-mid October, knowing we may need to work around a notice period. We look forward to hearing from you!

We want someone who thinks: "They didn't respond. Technical: Color correction, multi-speaker dialogue matching, brand design language, media management, and timeline sharing. QC & delivery: Count against scope, watch every second, verify every name, check specs. Revisions upload over the original in ---------- . Handle every note. Performance: Review the numbers after posting. Know how each piece did out of ten for that client. System: ClickUp status against the WBS, Connect Team hours, a daily end-of-day report, and SOP improvements when you find a better way. What You Bring 2+ years editing professionally, with a reel showing event, interview, or documentary work — not just motion graphics. DaVinci Resolve proficiency; Resolve Studio preferred. This is our primary NLE and we will not retrain you mid-project. Story instinct, audio competence, and color fundamentals — including skin tones across a range of complexions. A real information diet: you watch what performs, and it shows in your work. A machine and connection that handle 4K workflows, proxies, and large uploads. Reliable U.S. Eastern overlap, with dependable internet and power and a backup for both. Who You Are You are a storyteller who respects a checklist. You can find the moment in a 90-minute keynote and explain why it is the moment, and you can also count to twelve before you hit export. You take direct feedback without flinching and give it the same way. You would rather protect clean capture than rescue it in post, and you already watch what performs before anyone asks you to. How To Apply Submit your reel, one full-length piece you cut end to end, a one-paragraph cover letter, and a Loom video (max 5 minutes) breaking down one piece from your reel: its hook, what the middle is doing, and why it ends where it does. Walk us through your first two hours of work, in order. * A client returns a revision with fourteen notes, three of which you believe would make the cut worse. What do you do? * You are about to export and notice the lav audio on the main testimonial has a hum nobody caught on set. Walk us through what you do and who you tell. * Describe your philosophy as it relates to excellence and accountability. * What are your full-time salary expectations? * Please upload your resume. *

title: Project Manager/Operations Manager
description: What Winning Looks Like Every active project has one owner, a WBS, a schedule, and a status in ClickUp that matches reality. No critical component is ever coin-flipped: crew confirmed with a backup day, gear planned, vendors tracked with proof of progress weeks out. The team runs on the system — Connect Team, EOD reports, ClickUp, SOP-first — and the SOPs move from "In review" to "Validated." Deliverables ship on time at the counts sold, and every one has cleared the QC tracker before the client sees it. The founder gets one weekly view: what shipped, what is at risk, and your recommendation — never a pile of problems. Nothing operational routes to the founder by default. Your First 30 Days Days 1–7 — Extraction & Baseline. Interview the founder and every team lead. Audit every active project: WBS against ClickUp, crew and gear status, open client items, critical components at risk. Read the playbook and every SOP, noting which are validated and which are not. Days 8–14 — The Pipeline. Install the weekly pipeline review. Fix WBS-to-ClickUp drift. Put one owner and one date on every open item. Deliver a prioritized list of what is leaking time, money, or momentum. Days 15–30 — The Operating Rhythm. Set the internal pre-production meeting cadence, the crew confirmation standard, and the vendor tracking standard. Validate the ten SOPs the team touches most. Present the founder the first weekly ops view and your 90-day plan. Key Responsibilities Pipeline: Own the production pipeline end to end. Confirmed events in within 24 hours. Every project staged, scoped, and scheduled before planning begins. Pre-production: Run internal pre-production meetings. Shooting schedules from the client run of show. Equipment planning. Crew confirmed with a backup day. Call sheets out early. Crew & vendors: Confirm, brief, and hold crew to the Production Policy. Track every vendor to the deadline with proof of progress. Invoiced hours match Connect Team. Communication: Enforce the communication lines: up and then over, one owner per thing, client communication through the project lead. Model the three-channel, daily-until-received standard. Quality & delivery: Own the video review tracker. Nothing ships without the QC pass. Revision rounds and scope creep handled as the changes they are. Systems & SOPs: Own the operations manual. Turn recorded processes into SOPs, move SOPs to Validated, and retire the ones the team has outgrown. People: Run training assignments and onboarding. Screen and coordinate hires. Process contractor payments on payday. Reporting: One weekly operations view for the founder with insight and a recommendation. What You Bring 5+ years running operations, production management, or project management in a production company, agency, events business, or other deadline-driven services company. Proven ownership of a multi-project pipeline with remote crew and contractors. Fluency in ClickUp or an equivalent PM system, and the discipline to keep it matching reality. Vendor and crew management with a track record of catching problems weeks out, not days. Clear, direct written and verbal communication; comfortable holding people to the standard. Familiarity with video production is a strong advantage. You do not need to shoot or edit, but you need to understand what the editor needs from the shooter and what the client was promised. Who You Are You are an owner of outcomes, not a scheduler of tasks. You look people in the eye and tell them they are your bottleneck. You check in daily and it does not feel like nagging to you, because the alternative is a project quietly dying. You dig when something sounds too good, and you never take a vendor’s word for it. You can take a company that runs on the founder’s memory and make it run on a system. How To Apply Reply with your resume, a one-paragraph cover letter, and a Loom video (max 5 minutes) explaining why you are the right Operations Manager for RDM.

title: Web Developer

Integrations: Experience integrating third-party tools, including e-commerce platforms, booking/ticketing systems, and email service providers. ● Comfortable working within an existing site/CMS rather than only building from scratch ● Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and at least one modern framework or CMS Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing and fixing issues on a live site ● Basic understanding of SEO and site performance best practices ● Proficiency with ClickUp, or strong project-management software experience You Go to the Top of Our List If You: ● Have experience building or maintaining an e-commerce store (Shopify or similar) ● Have worked on a hospitality, tourism, or events-based website before ● Have integrated a booking/ticketing system into a website ● Have experience with HubSpot or similar marketing/CRM platforms ● Are comfortable working independently with minimal day-to-day oversight Good Vibes Only Company We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation, and fun as a company culture. We celebrate birthdays, we laugh a lot, and we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. What We Offer ● [$ TBD]/hr USD + bonus potential tied to project delivery ● A direct, collaborative relationship with the founder and operations team — your work ships fast and matters immediately ● A good-vibes culture where we value and respect our team, hold ourselves to excellence, and have fun along the way ● Fun (optional, unpaid) virtual team events — snack bonuses, birthday parties, and the occasional beatboxing party ● Real growth opportunity as our website, store, and booking systems expand Our Hiring Process 1. Application Review — we read every application, in full. 2. Short Survey — a quick survey about you and your development background. 3. Round 1 Interview — up to 30 minutes on Zoom (CDT scheduling). 4. Paid Test Project — a small, paid task on our actual site to see how you work. 5. Offer — we extend an offer to join the team. How to Apply To be considered, please answer these 3 questions in your application: 1. Your portfolio — links to 2–3 websites you've built or maintained, noting your specific role and any e-commerce or booking-system integrations. 2. Your approach — briefly, how would you approach maintaining and building out a small business's website while it's actively adding an e-commerce store and booking features? 3. Your availability and rate — weekly hours you can commit, your ability to overlap 9 AM–5 PM CDT, and your rate (hourly or retainer). Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Bonus (optional, but prioritized): 1. What's your favorite ice cream flavor? 🍦 2. Film a simple, short video (30–60 seconds) telling us why you love web development and why you love ice cream — share the link with your application. As Ice Cream Sunshine grows, this role may expand to include additional responsibilities and hours. Essential qualities: you love to learn and you love to have fun. The team at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always. 🍦

description: Umbrella Property Services is a building services company based in Vancouver. We’re on a mission to attract, develop, and empower people from around the world to become better leaders. I’m Ryan, the Founder, and I move fast. I think in ideas and loose ends. Your job is to turn those into clear plans, tight calendars, and closed loops. You report directly to me and act as the primary leverage point for my time and attention. This is not a basic VA role. I’m looking for a true Executive Assistant who creates structure around me. Someone who wants to become exceptional at executive support, systems, prioritization, and follow-through over the foreseeable future. This role is not intended to be a short-term stepping stone while you immediately pursue a different career or business. About Ryan & How We Work - I’m not a micromanager. I’m not looking over your shoulder or nitpicking details. My style is “good enough, ship it, keep moving.” - I’m chaotic by nature: lots of ideas, lots of moving pieces, and I’d rather be doing deals, strategy, and sales than admin. Your job is to: - Put just enough structure around me so my days are sane, - Protect my calendar so I have real focus time, - Own the admin and follow-through so I don’t have to chase you or the work. If you like bringing order to a fast-moving founder and being trusted to run with things, you’ll fit here. Your Core Outcome - Give me back time, focus, and mental space. - When I hand you something, you own it until it’s done. I should not have to chase updates, remember details, or manage follow-through. If you need clarity, you ask. If you don’t, you just get it done. What Success Looks Like in the First 60 Days - You fully own my calendar: no double bookings, protected focus time, realistic days. - My inbox is consistently triaged; I only see what actually needs my brain, with drafts ready where appropriate. - Recurring admin and follow‑ups are handled without me chasing you, and I’m spending noticeably more time on sales, strategy, and deals. What You’ll Own 1. Calendar & Communication - Protect and manage my calendar; no double bookings, clear buffers, realistic days. - Triage inbox and messages; draft replies and summarize what needs my decision. - Ensure follow-ups and responses don’t fall through the cracks. 2. Follow-Up & Accountability - Capture commitments from meetings and conversations. - Turn discussions into clear next actions with owners and deadlines. - Follow up with internal and external stakeholders and push (respectfully) when things stall. 3. Problem Solving - Bring solutions, not just problems. - When something blocks you, come back with: “Here’s what happened, here are options, here’s what I recommend.” - Ask smart clarifying questions instead of waiting passively. 4. Projects & Operations - Coordinate small projects and initiatives. This is light operational coordination, not a general operations manager role. - Prepare agendas, documents, and materials for meetings. - Maintain simple systems for tasks, SOPs, and follow-ups. - Improve or automate repetitive admin where possible, including with AI tools. - Handle personal admin (bookings, reservations, personal tasks) so I can stay focused on high‑value work. You’ll Succeed Here If You Are - Highly proactive and self-directed; you don’t wait to be told what to do next. - Strong at follow-through and holding others accountable. - Comfortable “managing up” to a busy, idea-driven founder. - Clear, concise written communicator. - Calm when priorities change and things are a bit chaotic. - Detail-oriented and reliable; you take pride in clean work. - Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning it into structure. - AI-literate and hungry to keep learning. This Role Is Not For You If - You need step-by-step instructions for every task. - You get stressed by someone who moves fast and changes priorities. - You wait to be chased for updates instead of closing the loop yourself. Non-Negotiables (Read Carefully) - Based in the Philippines and able to work 7:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. PST, Monday–Friday (40 hrs/week). - Minimum 2 years supporting a founder / CEO / executive as an EA, PA, or similar role. - Excellent written and spoken English. - Comfortable using Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Slack for daily communication. - Quiet, distraction-free workspace (no cafés). - Reliable computer setup with two monitors (or laptop + external screen), headset, mouse, and keyboard. - High-speed internet (100 Mbps or faster) for video and calls. If you do not meet the above, your application will not be considered. Compensation & Setup - Fixed retainer of $1,250 USD per month, paid bi-weekly. - 30 days paid time off per year, aligned with the Canadian calendar (not PH public holidays). - Bonus opportunities after 3 months, based on reliability, quality, and ownership. - $500 USD annual tech allowance to support your equipment and connectivity. How to Apply - Complete this application: ---------- /recruit-ph-ea - If shortlisted, complete a short video response and a series of email-based tasks - Finalists will be invited to complete a paid trial day in a simulated work environment - Before any written offer is finalized, the selected candidate must provide two verifiable professional references from people who directly supervised their work or worked closely with them.

description: We are seeking high-performing Inbound Sales Closers to handle inbound calls and web inquiries for our fast-paced Christmas light installation business. Schedule: Coverage needed 12 hours/day, 7 days/week (multiple shifts available). Pay: $6.00/hour base + uncapped sales performance bonuses. Key Responsibilities: -Lead Handling: Answer incoming phone calls and follow up immediately with newly submitted web inquiries. -Sales & Pitching: Deliver a natural, engaging introduction to explain our full-service offering without reading off a rigid script. -Budget Screening: Pre-screen potential clients by establishing our $700 minimum project starting price early in the call. -Live Custom Mockups: Locate property photos via Google Maps and Zillow to generate live design mockups while on the line with the customer. -Closing Deals: Walk clients through their customized proposals, address objections, and secure deposits on the spot. -Pipeline Management: Maintain and update contact records and deal stages inside GoHighLevel (GHL). Requirements & Qualifications: -Flawless Spoken English: Native or near-native English fluency with zero to minimal accent to ensure effortless, high-trust communication with US homeowners. -Sales Competency: Confident handling price objections, guiding conversations, and directly asking for the sale. -US Home Familiarity: Ability to visually identify standard American home architectural features (e.g., rooflines, dormers, peaks, gutters) from photos. -Software Proficiency: Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) and navigation of Google Maps/Zillow (design/mapping tool experience is a major plus; training provided). -Home Office Setup: High-speed internet connection, quiet dedicated environment, and a noise-canceling headset. How to Apply (Mandatory Instructions) To be considered for this position, please submit: 1. Your Resume 2. Weekly Availability: State your preferred working hours and available days per week (e.g., 5 days/week, weekends, M-F). 3. 1-2 Minute Audio Audition: Submit a recording (via Vocaroo or Google Drive link) performing the roleplay script below. Note: Applications submitted without a voice recording will be automatically disqualified. [Roleplay Audition Script] Read the script below as the VA. We are evaluating tone, clarity, pacing, and conversational flow—do NOT read like a robot! VA: "Thanks for calling Fresh Christmas Lights, how can we brighten up your day?" (Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "Hi, I saw your yard sign down the street and wanted to get a quote for Christmas lights on my house.") VA: "Great! We’d love to help light up your house. We put lights on thousands of homes every year, so you’re in great hands! Do you mind if I share a quick outline of how our service works so we can see if we're a good fit?" (Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "Sure, go ahead.") VA: "Awesome! We’re a full service Christmas light company. That means we custom fit the lights directly to your house by cutting wires and attaching custom plugs and bulbs. You won't have any messy cords hanging down—it looks extremely clean and professional. We also provide automated timers set to your schedule, and all high quality materials are included under our light leasing program, so you never have to buy or store the lights yourself. That means full maintenance is included free of charge—if a bulb or plug ever goes out, you just call us and we come fix it at zero extra charge. Then in January, we reach out, take all the lights down, and store them safely in our warehouse for next season. Plus, while we're out there, we offer discounts on our other business services like gutter cleaning! How does all that sound?" (Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "That sounds really great.") VA: "Wonderful! Our custom projects start at $700 and go up from there depending on the home size and design complexity. If that's within your starting budget, I’d love to take down your address right now and pull up a live picture of your house with lights on it in just a couple of minutes!"

title: Social Media & Content Manager

job_title: Full-Time Surplus Funds Cold Caller / Client Acquisition Specialist
description: I am hiring a full-time Cold Caller / Client Acquisition Specialist to work on a U.S.-based surplus funds recovery operation. This is a sales and client-acquisition position, not a general administrative VA role. You will work with leads provided through our business platform and CRM. Your primary responsibility will be contacting potential claimants, identifying the correct person, explaining the reason for the outreach, determining interest, qualifying potential clients, following up consistently, and moving qualified opportunities through our acquisition process. You are not responsible for purchasing or independently sourcing the lead database. Leads and the necessary business tools will be provided. What You Will Do Make outbound calls to provided U.S. leads Contact individuals who may be entitled to surplus funds Identify and verify the appropriate claimant/contact Follow provided scripts while communicating naturally and professionally Clearly explain the basic reason for the outreach Determine whether potential claimants are interested Qualify interested potential clients Obtain and verify necessary contact information Handle common initial objections professionally Consistently follow up with leads who do not initially respond Re-engage previously contacted prospects Schedule appointments or escalate qualified opportunities when owner involvement is required Maintain accurate information and detailed notes in the CRM Update pipeline stages and follow-up dates Use available calling, email, SMS, and CRM tools according to company procedures Prioritize promising opportunities Track calls, contacts, conversations, interested claimants, qualified leads, appointments, and conversions Protect confidential information and follow company procedures and applicable outreach/compliance requirements Your primary goal is to consistently turn provided leads into qualified, interested potential clients and ensure that promising opportunities are properly followed through rather than forgotten. Compensation $600 USD/month guaranteed base salary PLUS $100 USD for every successfully completed and collected deal attributable to a client you originated or materially handled through the acquisition process. There is no fixed maximum on performance bonuses. A performance bonus becomes payable after the company has successfully completed the applicable claim and received its corresponding fee. Example Earnings 2 successful deals: $600 base + $200 bonuses = $800/month 5 successful deals: $600 base + $500 bonuses = $1,100/month 10 successful deals: $600 base + $1,000 bonuses = $1,600/month 15 successful deals: $600 base + $1,500 bonuses = $2,100/month 20 successful deals: $600 base + $2,000 bonuses = $2,600/month The base salary provides guaranteed compensation while the uncapped performance bonus gives strong performers the opportunity to earn substantially more. Who I Am Looking For You should have: Excellent spoken English A clear, confident, and professional speaking voice Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telesales, lead-qualification, or client-acquisition experience Confidence speaking with U.S.-based consumers Strong follow-up skills Professional objection-handling ability Persistence and comfort with high-volume outbound calling CRM experience Excellent organization and attention to detail Reliable high-speed internet Backup internet preferred Quiet working environment Quality headset/microphone Availability during agreed U.S. business hours Experience with surplus funds, excess proceeds, tax overages, foreclosure, real estate, financial services, legal intake, insurance, or similar industries is highly preferred. Previous surplus-funds experience is a major advantage, but it is not mandatory for an exceptional U.S. cold caller who is willing and able to learn the process. What I Care About I am not looking for someone who simply makes calls to complete a daily quota. I want someone who actively manages the pipeline and takes ownership of follow-up. If someone doesn't answer, you follow the appropriate follow-up process. If someone expresses interest, you make sure the opportunity continues moving forward. If an important opportunity requires my involvement, you escalate it quickly. If a prospect needs another follow-up, you make sure it happens. Your performance will ultimately be measured by the quality of opportunities and clients generated, not simply by the number of calls made. Experience Requirements Minimum 1 year of professional cold-calling, telesales, appointment-setting, lead-qualification, or client-acquisition experience Previous experience calling U.S.-based consumers is strongly preferred Experience with high-volume outbound calling and CRM/power-dialer systems Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills Proven ability to turn cold leads into interested or qualified prospects Experience with surplus funds, excess proceeds, tax overages, foreclosure, real estate, financial services, legal intake, insurance, or similar industries is a major advantage Candidates with 2+ years of relevant sales/cold-calling experience will be strongly preferred, but exceptional candidates with at least 1 year of experience are encouraged to apply. About the Company You will be hired to work with Exyllion LLC, a U.S.-registered company that operates and develops multiple business initiatives. This position will initially focus specifically on our surplus funds recovery business line, with your work centered on outbound calling, client acquisition, qualification, pipeline management, and follow-up. Long-Term Opportunity This is intended to be a stable, long-term position. As the business grows, strong performers may have opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility, including training other callers and eventually moving into sales or client-acquisition leadership. I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the operation rather than someone looking for a short-term project.

title: AI Research & Operations Virtual Assistant
description: Hi! 👋 I’m looking for a full-time Virtual Assistant to join my early-stage software/IT company, Exyllion LLC, long term. This is NOT a sales or appointment-setting position. I’m looking for someone who can become a combination of an AI power user, researcher, operations assistant, content manager, organizer, and creative problem-solver. I don't need someone who simply waits for a checklist every morning. I want someone who eventually understands the company well enough to identify problems, opportunities, better tools, and better ways of doing things. 🚀 ABOUT EXYLLION Exyllion is an early-stage software/technology company. I will share our company website with you so you can get a general feel for Exyllion. If you visit the website and don't completely understand what the company does yet — that's actually okay! The website was intentionally designed not to explicitly reveal the full idea and long-term direction behind the company. Some parts of what we're building and exploring are intentionally kept broad at this stage. So please do not feel like you aren't qualified simply because you can't immediately figure out the entire business from the website. If anything, being curious and asking "What exactly is behind this?" is a good sign. 😊 Once hired, I'll provide much more context about the company, the ideas we're evaluating, our projects, and what we're trying to build. Right now, one of my biggest priorities is determining which opportunity should become the company's primary long-term focus. This will actually be one of your first important projects. I currently spend around 3 hours per day researching ideas, competitors, markets, technology, business models, and opportunities using ChatGPT and other AI tools. The problem? AI can hallucinate. It can miss competitors. It can present assumptions as facts. It can tell me an idea sounds amazing without enough real-world evidence. That's why I need a human researcher who knows how to use AI AND knows when not to trust AI. You should be able to research the actual internet, verify information using multiple sources, investigate competitors, read customer discussions and reviews, organize everything clearly, and help me determine whether an opportunity is actually worth pursuing. 🔎 RESEARCH WILL BE A MAJOR PART OF YOUR JOB You may research: New software/startup ideas Existing competitors Market demand Customer pain points Pricing and business models Industry trends Potential customers SaaS products and AI companies APIs and software infrastructure New technology Reviews and customer complaints Reddit, forums, and social media discussions New AI tools Automation opportunities Potential vendors and partners Software subscriptions and pricing tiers Ways to reduce our software/AI costs Ways to automate or eliminate repetitive work Sometimes I may simply tell you: "Here's an idea. Find out if this is actually worth building." I want you to investigate it like a researcher — not just ask ChatGPT whether it's a good idea. I LOVE people who can come back and say: "I don't think this version will work, and here's the evidence. BUT while researching it, I discovered another opportunity that might be much stronger. Here's what I found." That is exactly the type of thinking I'm looking for. 🤖 AI IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT You do NOT need to be an AI engineer or programmer. However, you should be at least intermediate with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms. Approximately 80% of our workflow will involve AI in some way. You should know how to use AI for research assistance, brainstorming, data organization, content creation, writing, summarization, comparing information, improving prompts, analyzing information, creating reports, and automating repetitive tasks. But most importantly, you need to understand: AI output ≠ verified fact. If ChatGPT tells you something important, I expect you to verify it. 🛠 FIND BETTER TOOLS & BETTER WAYS OF WORKING I also want you to continuously look for tools that could make our company faster, cheaper, or more efficient. For example, if we're paying for a tool and you discover another tool that does the same thing better or cheaper, tell me. If we're considering purchasing software, I may ask you to compare features, pricing, subscription tiers, reviews, limitations, integrations, API availability, and alternatives. Then recommend which option or tier makes the most sense. If you discover something and think: "This could save us 10 hours every week." I WANT to hear about it. 😊 📧 BUSINESS EMAIL & COMMUNICATION You may also help manage and organize our business email. This can include: Organizing emails Identifying messages that need my attention Drafting responses Sending approved routine emails Following up when someone hasn't responded Contacting software companies or vendors Requesting information, pricing, or quotes Scheduling calls Keeping track of important conversations Over time, this could potentially expand into vendor and partnership communication. For example, in the future we may communicate with cloud/software/technology vendors such as AWS or other providers. You might research available programs, credits, pricing, partnership opportunities, or discounts; contact the appropriate team; ask questions; compare offers; and potentially help with preliminary negotiations. I would make the final decisions and approve important commitments, but you may help move conversations forward. 📚 ORGANIZATION & DOCUMENTATION I have LOTS of ideas. 😅 I need someone who can help turn those ideas into organized information. You may help maintain idea documents, research reports, competitor databases, business plans, tool lists, vendor information, project documentation, meeting notes, decisions, important links/resources, content calendars, research archives, and follow-ups. If I send you a messy collection of ideas, links, screenshots, or notes, I want you to turn it into something structured, searchable, and useful. Ideally, six months later we should still understand what we researched, what we decided, and WHY we made that decision. 🔍 FIND PEOPLE/EXPERTS WHEN NECESSARY Sometimes internet research isn't enough. You may occasionally help find industry experts, freelancers, consultants, potential users, developers/designers, researchers, or other specialists. If we need real human feedback, you may help identify appropriate people or platforms where we can get it. This could include finding paid research participants or experts when necessary. You would NOT spend company money without approval. Your job would be to find the best options, compare them, and recommend what makes sense. 📱 SOCIAL MEDIA & AI CONTENT You will also help with several content projects. Our faceless YouTube content is heavily AI-generated. The goal is NOT to manually edit videos for hours. AI handles most of the production. You may help with topic and competitor research, hooks, scripts, titles, thumbnails, keywords/SEO, uploading/scheduling, analytics, CTR, retention, and finding better content opportunities. For TikTok/UGC, you may help create AI-assisted content, research trends and products, test hooks, prepare content, and analyze performance. You may also help with Instagram and other platforms, including content creation, scheduling, research, and analytics. IMPORTANT: TikTok and YouTube are NOT intended to become Exyllion's main business. They're additional projects, experiments, marketing channels, and potential revenue streams. Once we validate the strongest core opportunity for Exyllion, the software/technology business will become our primary focus. 🧠 WHO I'M LOOKING FOR I care much more about how you think than having the perfect resume. You should be extremely good at internet research, detail-oriented, creative, curious, comfortable with technology, comfortable using AI every day, able to verify AI-generated information, organized, flexible, able to learn new software quickly, comfortable with social media, good at written communication, able to organize messy information, comfortable contacting companies/vendors, and proactive. Most importantly: I want someone who THINKS. If I tell you my idea, don't automatically tell me it's amazing. Research it. Challenge it. Try to find reasons it could fail. Find competitors I don't know about. Read what real customers are saying. Look for evidence. And if you discover something better: Tell me. 🌱 ABOUT WORKING WITH AN EARLY-STAGE STARTUP My ambition is to build Exyllion into a multimillion-dollar technology company. But I want to be transparent: this is an early-stage startup, and obviously nobody can guarantee that outcome. What I can offer is the opportunity to join extremely early and potentially grow with the company. Your responsibilities today may be very different from your responsibilities a year from now. If the company grows, I would love for this person to grow with it and eventually take on significantly more responsibility. I'm looking for someone who wants to become a long-term team member, not someone looking for a temporary one-month project. 💻 DO I NEED TO KNOW HOW TO CODE? No. You do NOT need to be a programmer. However, Exyllion is a software/IT company, so you need to be genuinely comfortable around technology, software, SaaS, AI, websites, apps, APIs, and digital businesses.
