title: Lead Short-Form Video Editor — Australian Surf & Streetwear Brand (Founding Editor)
job_title: Lead Short-Form Video Editor — Australian Surf & Streetwear Brand (Founding Editor)
description: GRVLN — FOUNDING LEAD SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR Start your application with: GRVLN CUT WHO WE ARE GRVLN (Graveylane) is an Australian surf, swimwear and underground streetwear brand from Sydney's Northern Beaches. ---------- We make long, old-school-inspired performance boardshorts, women's swim, and streetwear. The brand lives where surf, skate, graffiti, punk, rave and editorial fashion overlap. Two founders — Blake and Dylan. Nearly AUD $300,000 in around nine months, with no editor. That last part is the problem. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS We film constantly. Surf trips, fashion, studio, rave, street, long-form talking pieces, UGC from customers. Then it sits on a hard drive because the two people who shot it are also the two people who would have to cut it. We want an editor who is genuinely good — taste, not templates — so that footage becomes content within hours instead of never. You will be the founding editor, and if you are as good as we hope, you will eventually train and quality-control the clippers and editors we hire under you. This is a taste hire. We are not looking for someone to churn out 200 subtitled clips a month. THE LOOK * Surfcore * Underground streetwear * Graffiti, punk, rave * Editorial fashion * Raw iPhone, dad-cam, VHS and archival textures where they suit * Real, energetic, culturally aware Never corporate. Never generic dropshipping-ad energy. Never over-polished just because the effect exists. If you have watched good surf and skate edits, good fashion film, and good music content, you already know what we mean. If you have not, this is not your role and that is fine. WHAT YOU WILL DO * Edit Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and paid-social variations * Cut founder talking-head content * Cut surfing, fashion, lifestyle, rave, art and adventure footage * Pull the strong moments out of long-form video and podcasts * Build multiple genuine hook variations — different opening shots, text hooks, captions, pacing, endings — not the same edit with a new first frame * Protect the GRVLN visual identity in everything * Use only B-roll we supplied or approved * Keep projects and file naming organised to a convention * Upload exports and project files correctly, every time * Work in CapCut Teams or approved shared editing software * Move fast when new footage drops — same-day response to an upload * Deliver first drafts by the agreed deadline * Keep a revision log with the reason for every rejection * Turn our feedback calls into reusable training examples * Maintain the GRVLN editing bible * Read organic and ad performance feedback and act on it * Remake winners intelligently, without producing pointless near-duplicates * Eventually train and QA additional editors HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED * Percentage of first drafts approved without revision * Average turnaround from upload to first draft * Revision rate, broken down by reason * Hook quality — do the first two seconds hold * File and timeline organisation * Number of genuinely usable creative variations per package * Organic retention and performance * How many of your cuts become paid-ad candidates * Training examples documented * Whether you can raise the standard of the editors who come after you WHAT YOU MUST HAVE * A strong short-form portfolio — and it has to be relevant * CapCut and/or Premiere Pro * Real understanding of hooks and retention, not just terminology * Excellent footage selection — knowing what to leave out * The ability to explain why one opening is stronger than another. We will ask. * Fast turnaround that does not destroy quality * Clean, consistent file organisation * Coachable. You will get repeated feedback and we need you to want it. * Comfortable using AI to speed up work without handing over your aesthetic judgement NICE TO HAVE * Fashion, lifestyle, surf, skate, music or culture editing experience * After Effects or DaVinci Resolve * Sound design instinct * Experience cutting paid social ads and reading their performance * Experience giving other editors feedback SCHEDULE AND HOW IT STARTS * Paid editing test first — about 90 minutes, paid PHP 2,500 on submission whether or not you get the role. We do not use candidates for free work and we do not publish test edits. * Short probation paid per approved video (PHP 1,100 per approved short-form edit) or clearly tracked hours — your choice * Then full-time for the right person * At least 4 hours overlap with 9am–5pm Sydney time preferred * Reliable internet and a real backup plan PAY * PHP 50,000–75,000 per month full-time, depending on portfolio quality, speed and leadership potential * We are publishing a range because editor value genuinely varies that much. If your reel is exceptional, apply to the top of it and we will pay it. * 13th-month pay * Review at 30 days, pay review at 90 days, tied to approval rate and turnaround * Path to PHP 90,000 as founding editor running other editors WHERE THIS GOES Founding editor means the editing bible is yours to write. The revision log you keep and the feedback you record become the training material for every editor we hire after you. The strongest system-builder here becomes our Content Team Lead. Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Every role is open to all qualified applicants and we select on the published scorecard only. WHAT WE ACTUALLY OFFER * A real Australian brand with real product, real surf, real trips — not stock footage * Direct creative work with the two founders who shoot it * Long-term work, and credit for the look you help build * Clear feedback, quickly. You will never be guessing what we want for long. * AI is part of the workflow; your taste is the part we are paying for * Paid tests are paid. No speculative work. * Tell us when something did not work. We prefer that. WE WILL REJECT, IMMEDIATELY * Portfolios dominated by gaming, corporate explainers, or work with nothing to do with culture, fashion or sport * Template-and-effect showreels with no restraint * Anyone who cannot identify the hook in their own edit * Anyone who cannot show a project file or timeline * Careless use of copyrighted music or footage * "One long video = 100 quality clips" claims * Export volume prioritised over approved quality * Inability to follow a naming convention * Defensiveness about revisions * Unedited AI-written applications. We read a lot of them and it is an instant no. TO APPLY Start your message with: GRVLN CUT Then send: 1. Your three best relevant short-form examples (links) 2. One shared editing timeline or a short screen recording showing how you actually work 3. Software you use 4. Your normal turnaround time 5. Your expected pay per approved edit 6. Your expected monthly full-time salary in PHP 7. Current clients and your availability 8. Your internet speed and computer specifications And answer this: "You receive a 45-minute founder vlog, 20 raw iPhone clips and a folder of approved B-roll. Explain how you would turn it into a master content package, how you would select hooks, and how you would keep every asset easy for another editor to find." Be specific. We would rather read three sharp paragraphs than a page of adjectives.

title: Shopify CX & Ecommerce Operations Lead — Australian Surf/Streetwear Brand (Founding Hire)
job_title: Shopify CX & Ecommerce Operations Lead — Australian Surf/Streetwear Brand (Founding Hire)
description: GRVLN — FOUNDING CX & ECOMMERCE OPERATIONS LEAD Start your application with: GRVLN CX WHO WE ARE We are GRVLN (Graveylane) — an Australian surf, swimwear and underground streetwear brand out of Sydney's Northern Beaches. ---------- Our thing is long, old-school-inspired performance boardshorts, plus women's swim and streetwear. The brand sits where surf, skate, graffiti, punk, rave and fashion overlap. It is not a dropshipping store and it is not a faceless catalogue — there are two of us, Blake and Dylan, we design the product, we shoot the content, and we have done nearly AUD $300,000 in about nine months while running the business badly on purpose because there was no one else to run it. That is the honest pitch. The brand works. The operations do not yet. We are building a real team to fix that, and you would be the first person on it. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS Right now customer emails and Instagram messages land on the two founders. That means a customer who is three weeks into a delayed order waits for one of us to finish a photoshoot before anyone answers them. It is bad for the customer and it is the single biggest thing stopping us from growing. You are being hired to take customer experience off us completely and run it properly. This is not a ticket-closing job. You will own the customer-facing side of the business: the inbox, the investigations, the registers, the follow-through, and eventually the training and quality control of the CX people we hire after you. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY OWN * Our customer service inbox ---------- — you run it, not us * Reviewing AI-generated draft replies, correcting them, and sending only what is accurate * Instagram customer-service escalations that come through from ManyChat * Investigating Shopify orders properly — line items, fulfilment status, tracking, notes, history * Checking order status across Shopify, carrier tracking and our 3PL (Williams) systems * Coordinating with our 3PL on missing, short-shipped and stuck orders * WISMO ("where is my order") enquiries — the bulk of the volume * Approved returns, exchanges and refunds * Faulty, damaged, incorrect and missing-item cases, including photo evidence * Address changes and cancellations before dispatch * Preorders and backorders — knowing what is actually coming and when * Maintaining the list of customers owed a product we did not have in stock, and making sure they are contacted the day it lands * Returns register and exceptions register — accurate, current, no gaps * Triaging the queue by urgency and by longest wait, every single day * Escalating serious complaints, chargebacks, threats, and anything legal or privacy-related to us immediately * Logging every AI mistake and every missing SOP so the system gets better instead of repeating itself * Improving the reply templates and the CX knowledge base * A short daily report and a real weekly report WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (this is how you will be measured) * Urgent cases are spotted the same day they arrive * Routine enquiries answered inside the agreed service level * The oldest unresolved customer wait gets shorter week after week * Zero fabricated order information — ever * Zero unauthorised refunds or promises * Exception registers are accurate enough that we trust them without checking * AI errors logged daily * Repeat enquiries turn into SOP improvements, not repeat work * Founder involvement in CX decreases every week * Customers get replies that are warm, brief and correct WHAT YOU MUST HAVE * Real Shopify admin experience — orders, fulfilments, refunds, customer records * Ecommerce customer service over email, at volume * Order investigation experience — you can find out what actually happened to a parcel * Returns and exchanges experience * Tracking and fulfilment understanding * Experience working with a warehouse, supplier or 3PL * Excellent written English — natural, warm, brief. Not stiff, not corporate, not "Dear valued customer" * Good judgement under pressure with angry people * Spreadsheet and register accuracy — you do not lose things * Comfortable using Claude or ChatGPT as a drafting tool while independently verifying every fact before it goes out * Ability to write in an Australian brand voice: relaxed, direct, human NICE TO HAVE * Fashion, apparel, surf, skate or streetwear brand experience * Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Tidio or similar helpdesk * ManyChat * Meta Business Suite * Airtable * Slack * 3PL / WMS software * Experience training or QA-ing other support staff TOOLS YOU WILL USE Shopify · Google Workspace · a helpdesk · ManyChat · Meta Business Suite · Google Sheets · Airtable · Slack · our 3PL's portal · Claude / ChatGPT WHAT WE DO NOT WANT YOU TO DO You will not invent policy, promise compensation, or issue high-value refunds on your own. Those come to us. Everything else, we want you to d ---------- and move. SCHEDULE * Full-time, 5 days per week, after the paid trial * At least 4 hours overlapping 9am–5pm Sydney time * Reliable internet, and an actual backup plan for internet and power * Be honest with us about your existing clients and commitments — we would rather know PAY * PHP 50,000 per month to start * PHP 60,000 per month from the 90-day review, based on documented outcomes — not on time served * 13th-month pay * Further increases as you take on training and supervising additional CX operators * If you arrive with verified 3PL/WMS experience and evidence you have supervised support staff before, tell us and we will talk about starting higher HOW WE HIRE 1. Application (see below) 2. A paid practical test — about 75 minutes, paid PHP 1,500 on submission whether or not you get the role. We do not ask for free work. 3. A 20-minute interview 4. 14-day paid probation at full pro-rata salary. We use TimeProof during probation only, and we tell you that up front. After probation we measure your scorecard, not your mouse. 5. 30-day performance review, 90-day pay review WHERE THIS GOES This is the first hire in GRVLN's operations team, not a seat in an existing one. The person who does this well trains and quality-controls the next CX operators and becomes our Operations Lead. The SOPs you write will be how this department works for years. We are looking for someone who wants that, not someone waiting to be told what to do next. Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Every role is open to all qualified applicants and we select on the published scorecard only. WHAT WE ACTUALLY OFFER * A real, growing Australian brand with real products and real customers * Direct work with the two founders * Long-term work — we are building a team, not filling a gap * Clear expectations, real feedback, and credit when you do good work * AI is part of the job, but your judgement and your verification are the point * Paid tests are paid. We do not ask for speculative work. * We would rather you tell us you made a mistake than hide it. Honesty here is a job requirement. WE WILL REJECT, IMMEDIATELY * Generic copy-paste applications * Obvious unedited AI applications — we read a lot of them, we can tell, and it is an instant no * Applications that do not start with GRVLN CX * Anyone who thinks AI output can be sent to a customer without checking it * Anyone whose first instinct is a discount or a partial refund before investigating * Anyone who cannot explain how they would investigate an unfulfilled order * Anyone who needs a founder to prioritise every task for them * Claims of experience with nothing to back them up TO APPLY Start your message with: GRVLN CX Then answer the scenario (this is the part we actually read): "A customer writes: 'Where the hell is my order? I ordered three weeks ago and nobody has replied. If it isn't coming, refund me immediately.' In no more than five sentences, write your response, and then list the exact systems or records you would check before d ---------- what happens next." And tell us: 1. Your current employment 2. Any existing clients or commitments 3. Your weekly availability 4. Your expected monthly salary in PHP 5. Your availability in Sydney time 6. Your Shopify experience — what you actually did in the admin 7. Your 3PL / WMS experience, if any 8. Which AI tools you use and how you check their output 9. Your internet speed 10. Your backup internet and power arrangement Short, specific and honest beats long and polished. We read every application that starts with the code.

job_title: Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer — Educational YouTube Channel

title: Outgoing & Chill VA For A Creative Agency
job_title: Outgoing & Chill VA For A Creative Agency

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description: Social Media & Content Manager Role Overview We are looking for a highly organised, creative and commercially minded Social Media & Content Manager to take ownership of our day-to-day social media and content activity. This role will be responsible for turning the activity, ideas, projects and stories happening across the business into consistent, engaging content across Instagram, ---------- and Facebook. The role goes beyond simply posting content. You will own the content process from planning through to publication, building a clear content calendar, writing copy, managing approvals and ensuring content is published regularly. You will work closely with the owner to capture what is happening within the business and translate it into content that strengthens the brand, tells the story and grows our audience. Key Responsibilities Content Planning & Strategy * Build and manage a rolling monthly and quarterly content calendar. * Develop clear content pillars and recurring themes aligned with the wider brand and business strategy. * Identify opportunities for content across projects, company activity, people, partnerships, and events. * Maintain a healthy pipeline of content so activity is planned rather than reactive. Social Media Management Take day-to-day ownership of our presence across: * Instagram * LinkedIn * Facebook This includes scheduling and publishing posts, Reels, Stories, carousels and other relevant formats. Ensure each piece of content is adapted appropriately for the platform rather than simply posting identical content everywhere. Maintain consistency in tone of voice, messaging, presentation and brand standards. Copywriting * Write engaging social media copy that reflects our tone of voice. * Turn rough ideas, voice notes, project updates and conversations into polished content. * Write strong hooks, captions, headlines and calls to action. * Adapt copy depending on the audience and platform, particularly between LinkedIn and more visual/social platforms. * Proofread and quality-check all content before publication. Content Coordination Maintain an organised content library of photography and video, graphics. Identify gaps in the content calendar and proactively request or arrange the content required to fill them. Performance & Reporting * Monitor performance across each social platform. * Track key metrics including reach, engagement, follower growth, website traffic and enquiries where appropriate. * Identify which topics, formats and creative approaches perform best. * Use these insights to continually improve the content strategy. What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who combines creativity with organisation. You should be: * A strong and confident copywriter. * Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple pieces of content simultaneously. * Proactive rather than waiting to be given something to post. * Naturally interested in brands, culture, design and social media. * Comfortable working closely with the owner * Able to understand a brand’s tone of voice and protect it consistently. * Detail-focused with high standards for what gets published. * Commercially aware and able to understand that content ultimately needs to support the wider objectives of the business. Experience using social media scheduling, content planning and project management is required What Success Looks Like Success in this role means we move from social media being something that needs to be continually thought about and chased, to having a well-run content engine operating consistently in the background.

description: We're looking for creative, naturally curious writers to join our team for a long-term, full-time position. This is not a traditional SEO writing role. What We're Looking For Strong, natural writing Excellent research skills Genuine curiosity and willingness to learn Creative and independent thinking Ability to make unfamiliar or technical subjects interesting Good judgment when evaluating sources and information Attention to detail and fact-checking Ability to explain complicated ideas clearly Ability to take feedback and improve Reliability and consistency You don't need to be an expert in any particular niche. In fact, being comfortable researching subjects you've never encountered before is an important part of the job. We're especially interested in writers who naturally ask questions, go down research rabbit holes, and look beyond the first few results they find online. From there, we expect you to think like a writer and researcher rather than simply follow an SEO template. That might mean finding original sources, studies, reports, datasets, expert opinions, community discussions, firsthand information, or other useful material depending on the topic. You must understand who follows each creator, how their content performs and whether they have the communication skills required to produce effective paid social ads. You will be expected to conduct in-depth research across TikTok and Instagram rather than simply building large, unqualified creator lists. Creator Profiles You Will Research You will build creator pipelines across three primary groups: 1. Heterosexual Male Creators Men with relevant male audiences interested in topics such as: Men’s grooming Skincare Fragrances Fitness Lifestyle Dating and relationships Confidence Personal development Men’s hygiene and wellness 2. Gay Male Creators Gay men who authentically communicate with male or LGBTQ+ audiences and produce relevant content related to: Grooming and personal care Skincare and beauty Lifestyle Dating and relationships Confidence Intimacy LGBTQ+ male interests 3. Female Creators with a Relevant Male Audience Women with a meaningful male audience who are followed by men because of: Relationship or dating advice Lifestyle content Male grooming recommendations Entertainment Commentary on topics relevant to men A distinctive communication style that strongly appeals to male viewers Every creator must be comfortable discussing men’s intimate hygiene in a natural, credible and commercially effective way. Your Responsibilities Conduct in-depth creator research across TikTok and Instagram. Identify creators whose audience, content, personality and communication style align with UNDRA. Analyse approximately 15–30 recent posts from each promising creator. Calculate and interpret engagement rates. Review median views, average views, view-to-follower ratios, comments, shares and posting consistency. Analyse performance trends rather than relying on a single viral video. Evaluate audience gender, age, location and relevance to the target market whenever this information is available. Assess the quality and authenticity of comments and interactions. Identify suspicious followers, artificial engagement, irrelevant audiences and unusual performance patterns. Review sponsored content separately to understand how the creator performs when promoting products. Evaluate each creator’s presence on camera, delivery, storytelling ability, hooks, credibility and authenticity. Determine whether the creator can naturally interpret a script and communicate personal or sensitive topics. Assess each creator’s potential to produce persuasive direct-response video ads. Request audience insights, media kits and previous campaign results when necessary. Ability to calculate and interpret engagement rates, median views and content performance. Ability to evaluate audience demographics and recognise artificial or low-quality engagement. Strong judgment when assessing creator quality and paid-ad potential. Experience researching and contacting creators directly through email, Instagram or TikTok. Experience with DTC e-commerce, skincare, grooming, wellness, beauty or related consumer categories. Understanding of direct-response advertising and performance creative. Ability to maintain an accurate creator database or CRM. Comfortable working with men’s intimate skincare products. Able to work independently and take ownership of the creator pipeline. Experience with creator research platforms such as TikTok One, Meta Creator Marketplace, Modash, Upfluence, HypeAuditor or similar tools is an advantage. job_title: Part-Time Unity Game Developer – Long-Term Indie Game Project (HabitQuest)
description: About the Project: I'm looking for a Unity developer to help me continue building an indie game called HabitQuest. HabitQuest is a game that turns real-world habits, goals, and personal development into RPG progression. The idea is that activities you complete in real life improve attributes and unlock progress inside the game. This is not just an idea or a game design document. I already have a working Unity prototype. The current prototype includes a splash screen, navigation between areas/NPCs, a basic character/progression concept, and a playable 2D tower-defense minigame. I am building it in Unity for mobile, primarily Android initially. The prototype is rough, but the core concept is working. What I'm Looking For: I'm looking for a Filipino Unity developer who would be interested in working on HabitQuest with me long term, rather than completing one small freelance job and disappearing. I am currently a full-time neuroscience PhD student, so my available development time is limited. I need someone who can take clearly defined features, work independently, communicate when there are problems, and steadily improve the game. I don't expect you to know everything. I care much more about reliability, communication, problem-solving ability, and actually completing features. You should be comfortable working with: • Unity • C# • 2D games • UI and menus • Prefabs and ScriptableObjects • Game mechanics and progression systems • Debugging existing Unity projects • Git or another version-control system Experience developing Android/mobile games, RPG systems, tower-defense games, multiplayer systems, APIs, or AI integration would be a major plus, but is not required. How We Will Work: I want to begin with a paid two-week trial project. I will give you access to the existing HabitQuest project and a clearly defined feature or group of features to implement. During those two weeks, I'm mainly evaluating: • Quality of work • Ability to understand an existing Unity project • Communication • Reliability • Ability to solve problems independently • Whether we enjoy working together If the trial goes well, I would like to continue at approximately 10 hours per week / $500 USD per month. The schedule can be flexible. I care much more about consistent progress than what hours you work. I would like to have one video call each week where we review what was completed, look at the game together, discuss problems, and decide what should be built next. I want the development process to be transparent. Code will be maintained in the project's repository, and I should always be able to see what has been completed and what is currently being worked on. Potential Long-Term Opportunity: I'm specifically looking for someone who might become genuinely invested in HabitQuest over time. If we work together successfully for an extended period, you become an important part of developing the game, and HabitQuest eventually generates revenue, I would be open to discussing a small profit-sharing arrangement in addition to your normal pay. I'm not asking anyone to work for free or in exchange for hypothetical future profits. The position is paid. Profit sharing would only be an additional opportunity for the right long-term person. Communication: Good spoken and written English is important because we will be discussing game mechanics and new ideas together. You should also be comfortable telling me: “I don't understand this.” “I think there is a better way to build this.” or “This feature will take longer than expected because of X.” I would much rather hear about a problem early than discover several weeks later that no progress was made. Compensation: Initial two-week paid trial: approximately 20 hours / $250 USD Ongoing part-time work after a successful trial: approximately 10 hours per week / $500 USD per month I care more about consistent progress and communication than rigid work hours. How to Apply: Please send me, 1. A brief introduction about yourself. 2. How long you have been developing games with Unity. 3. Links, screenshots, videos, or playable examples of Unity games you have personally worked on. 4. For each project you show me, briefly explain what you personally programmed or created. 5. Your experience with C#. 6. Whether you have experience developing Unity games for Android/mobile. 7. Your normal weekly availability. (include what day/times you can meet on zoom) 8. A link to GitHub or another code portfolio if you have one. 9. Please also send a short 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and showing me one Unity project you have worked on. -It doesn't need to be professionally produced. A simple Loom recording, screen recording, or phone/video introduction is fine. -Show me something you built and briefly explain: a. What did you build, what was difficult about it, and how did you solve the problem? This is important because I'm looking for someone I can communicate and collaborate with regularly, not just someone who can write code. Finally, please begin your application with the words: “I read the HabitQuest description.” Applications that do not include that sentence may not be reviewed. Thanks for reading. I'm looking forward to meeting some talented developers and hopefully finding someone who wants to help build this project with me for a long time.

title: Bookkeeper — US Month-End Close (Remote)
description: We provide monthly close services to US small businesses. Our production process is automated: transaction coding, bank and card matching, reconciliation, and recurring month-end entries are completed systematically, with an AI layer performing the initial categorisation before any file is assigned. We are hiring a bookkeeper to take ownership of the close on an assigned portfolio of client books. This is not a conventional bookkeeping position. The seat does not involve coding a month from scratch or manual transaction entry. Files reach you with the mechanical work complete. Your responsibility begins where judgement is required: identifying what the automation has classified incorrectly, resolving what it could not determine, and establishing whether the month is accurate enough to release. The position carries a second area of responsibility of equal weight: the accuracy of the automation itself on your portfolio. Where it consistently misclassifies a category, where a rule breaks and under what conditions, where it fails to identify something it should have. Establishing this is part of closing the month, and it determines how the system processes those files in subsequent periods. Bookkeepers accustomed to performing every step personally generally do not find this arrangement satisfying. Bookkeepers who have spent years building out their own automation generally do. Responsibilities - Own the monthly close on an assigned portfolio, from automated draft through to delivery - Review automated output in full and correct every misclassification before release - Resolve edge cases and transactions the automation could not settle, including obtaining client clarification where required - Prepare month-end entries outside the automated process: accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and client-specific adjustments - Reconcile all accounts: bank, credit card, and balance sheet accounts with supporting documentation retained - Deliver financial statements strictly to the agreed monthly schedule - System feedback: Maintain a record of where the automation failed, the categories involved, and the time each correction required Requirements - Minimum five years of professional bookkeeping experience, of which at least the most recent two years have been on an automated workflow: bank feeds, rules, and at least one tool beyond the ledger itself. Both the total experience and the automation experience are required. - Demonstrated expertise operating an automated bookkeeping stack. You configure and maintain bank rules rather than accept defaults, understand the conditions under which they break, and can state which transaction categories your software handles reliably and which require review without exception. - Substantive hands-on use of AI within bookkeeping itself: classification, coding, document extraction, or transaction review, not correspondence or administrative tasks. You should be able to describe specific instances where an AI tool produced an incorrect result and how you identified it. - Full monthly closes completed end-to-end for US, UK, or Australian clients. - QuickBooks Online or Xero as your primary ledger. What is NOT required: - Certifications or accounting degrees Not suitable for: - Manual data entry roles or candidates who code a full month by hand - Candidates whose experience is limited strictly to AP/AR or payroll without full month-end closes - Candidates who have not worked on an automated bookkeeping stack Schedule: - Ability to work with direct overlap during US business hours (Night shift). How to Apply: - To be considered, you must complete our technical screening form. - Apply: tally. so/r/pbp12B Selection Process - Application form (above link, ~5 minutes) - A detailed questionnaire on your close process and how your tools behave, sent to those who qualify at stage two. - Practical close assessment, extended to shortlisted candidates only. - Final Interview. Note: All applications receive an outcome notification within 48 hours. Cover letters are not reviewed. Benefits: - Flexible schedule - Flextime - Opportunities for promotion - Pay raise - Work from home Work Location: Remote

Our internal software creates videos from scratch and performs significant processing locally on your computer. Your computer will effectively become part of our production infrastructure. For reference, on a MacBook Air M5, our system currently takes approximately 1.5–2 hours to fully generate/build a typical video. Because you will be responsible for a high-volume pipeline and may need to process multiple videos throughout the day, we are ideally looking for a computer that meets or exceeds the performance of an M5 MacBook Air. A significantly more powerful machine is strongly preferred, particularly because you may need to manage multiple jobs and batch processing efficiently. If your computer is substantially less powerful than an M5 MacBook Air, this position is unlikely to be suitable. Do not apply simply because your computer can edit videos. This role involves sustained local processing and rendering. Windows PCs and Macs are both welcome. We care about the actual performance of your machine, not the brand. When applying, you MUST provide your exact computer specifications. DAILY VIDEO VOLUME On a typical day, you may be responsible for generating/rendering, quality-checking and uploading approximately 5–10 videos across our channels. This is not a fixed maximum. Production volume will vary and may increase as we scale. You should be comfortable managing a high-volume pipeline rather than expecting a set number of videos each day. You may have several videos being processed while other completed videos need checking, uploading or fixing. Your responsibility is to keep the pipeline moving. WHAT YOU'LL DO * Generate/build videos using our internal AI video software * Run and manage local video processing/rendering * Batch process multiple videos throughout the day * Manage multiple videos at different stages simultaneously * Typically handle around 5–10 videos per day, with volume potentially increasing * Monitor jobs and make sure they complete successfully * Identify failed or incorrect outputs * Re-run videos when necessary * Quality-check completed videos before publication * Make small video editing fixes when required * Organise completed video files correctly * Upload videos to the correct YouTube channels * Add the correct thumbnails, titles and descriptions * Schedule videos according to our content calendar * Make sure upcoming videos are ready before their deadlines * Keep our production tracker updated * Troubleshoot basic technical problems * Report issues quickly when you cannot resolve them yourself * Provide clear updates on the status of the video pipeline You will receive full training on our internal software and processes. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR You must: * Have a very powerful computer suitable for sustained local video processing * Ideally meet or exceed the performance of an M5 MacBook Air * Have some previous video editing experience * Have experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude * Have excellent written and spoken English * Be technically confident and quick to learn new software * Be extremely organised * Have excellent attention to detail * Be comfortable managing multiple videos simultaneously * Be able to prioritise when several things need attention * Be reliable and consistent * Be proactive when something goes wrong * Be capable of troubleshooting basic problems yourself * Communicate quickly when there is a problem * Be able to work independently once trained * Have fast and reliable internet * Be available full-time with good availability during UK GMT/BST working hours * Be comfortable attending Zoom or Google Meet calls We do not want someone who needs to be constantly reminded to check whether a video has finished processing or whether something has been uploaded. If a job fails, we expect you to notice. If a video looks wrong, we expect you to investigate it. If multiple videos need to be processed, checked and uploaded, we expect you to organise the workload and keep everything moving. VIDEO EDITING EXPERIENCE You do not need to be an advanced professional video editor. However, you must have some basic video editing experience so that small problems do not stop the entire pipeline. AI EXPERIENCE You must already be comfortable using AI. Our business uses AI heavily, and you will be working directly with our own AI-powered video production software. Experience with ChatGPT and Claude is expected. Experience with AI video tools, AI image tools, automation software or other AI systems is a bonus. You do not need to be a programmer, but you should be technically switched on and comfortable learning unfamiliar systems. YOUTUBE EXPERIENCE Experience with YouTube Studio is strongly preferred. You should ideally be comfortable with: * Uploading videos * Scheduling videos * Adding thumbnails * Adding titles and descriptions * Checking publishing settings * Managing videos across multiple channels Previous YouTube channel management experience is a bonus but is not essential if you are technically capable and learn quickly. VIRTUAL ASSISTANT / OPERATIONS EXPERIENCE Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Manager or similar is a bonus. This is particularly useful if you have previously managed daily workflows, production trackers, uploads, spreadsheets, deadlines or multiple tasks simultaneously. SALARY & HOURS $350 - $400 USD per month depending on experience. This is a FULL-TIME remote position. You should have good availability during UK GMT/BST working hours, generally around 11 AM–7 PM UK time. We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and can take increasing ownership of our video operations as we scale. HOW TO APPLY Please answer ALL of the following questions. 1. What video editing software have you used, and how much video editing experience do you have? 5. What AI tools do you regularly use? title: Project Lead: You Get a Transcript, Not a Spec
job_title: Project Lead: You Get a Transcript, Not a Spec
description: You can be handed a mess and find the shape in it. You separate signal from noise without being told which is which. You come back with the three questions that matter, not thirty. You don't wait to be pushed. You DRIVE. And if a list needs building, you build it yourself and enjoy it. You've probably run projects for people who handed you a spec and a deadline. This isn't that. This is a seed. What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED. What can be taught, I'll teach. THE WORK I build marketing systems for service companies, and I'm making a big move: getting hired by a multi-location company that needs what I've built. This is a project, not a job. It ends when I'm hired. Between now and then, the work is yours. Build the map of the people who place marketing leaders in that world. Get the right ones eager to sell me. Keep the follow-up alive. Handle the logistics. Run whoever we bring in to help build lists, unless that's you, which it might be. You'll start with a raw transcript of how the plan came together, a research report, and a framework. You'll sketch the picture and come to me for what you need to finish it. My hours go to the calls, the video, and the deals. Yours go to everything that gets us there. THE OFFER Everything on the table. You'll see the whole picture: the numbers, the targets, the plan, and me, directly, with weekly recorded feedback. When we land it, a bonus, and I'm generous with people who actually made it happen. What comes after is earned, not promised. I build things, and I reward those who build with me. TO APPLY One question. If I handed you an hour-long transcript and said "this is the project," what are the first three things you'd ask me? Answer that, and nothing else. If your questions are valid, insightful and constructive, you'll get the transcript. IN CLOSING If you need a spec before you can start, this isn't for you. If a transcript and a clear outcome is all you've ever needed, I've been looking for you. Bring your three questions. I'll come ready to answer.

I want someone who has actually built systems inside a business, and ideally someone who has worked in or around insurance, finance or professional services, because the details matter more in that world and you'll already understand why. **The stack you'll be living in** GoHighLevel. Calendly. Zapier. ---------- . Notion. Slack. Google Drive. Miro. Lovable. Appointwise. Whop. Meta Business Manager (access and tracking setup only — you won't be running campaigns). You don't need to be an expert in every one on day one, but you need to genuinely know most of them and be the kind of person who learns the rest in a weekend rather than asking me for a tutorial. **What the job actually is** For each new client, you build the system: - Spin up the GoHighLevel sub-account, load our snapshot, and check everything came across connected and correct. - Map the lead form into the pipeline — field mapping, routing, nothing landing in the wrong place. - Build the booking calendars. Availability, buffers, round robin when there's more than one advisor, and confirmed two-way sync so appointments land in the advisor's own diary and their busy time blocks out. Calendly workflow experience matters here — if you've built booking flows with routing, reminders and reschedule logic, say so. - Build the confirmation and reminder sequences. Show rate is the number our whole offer is judged on, and these are what protect it. - Configure the 60-second speed-to-lead response so a new lead gets contacted inside a minute. - Build the AI booking agent per client — qualification questions, booking logic, tone. - Load the email and SMS nurture sequences into the account. - Set up the reporting dashboard, conversion tracking and internal notification rules. - QA the whole thing yourself. Submit a real lead through the funnel. Confirm the 60-second response fires, the appointment books into the right calendar, the reminders go out, every form and redirect works. Then send me a screen recording of it working. Alongside that, you keep the machine itself running: Zapier and ---------- scenarios connecting GHL, Slack, Notion and our payment system, the Notion workspace (client portals, task database, filtered views, SOP library), system maps in Miro, and short screen-recorded SOPs so the next person doesn't have to ask. **How I work, and what I expect** To be clear about the scope: you are not writing ad copy, making creatives or running ad accounts. Other people handle that side. This role is purely backend — the systems, the automations, the builds, the QA and the admin that sit behind everything. The brief arrives with you clean. Your job is to build it properly and make sure it works. I give clear tasks. In return I expect them acknowledged quickly during your hours, and I expect to be told before a deadline that something is going to overrun, not after. If a task is going to take three days, tell me on day one. Nothing gets marked done unless you have tested it yourself, on desktop and mobile. When you send your application, title it "Backend Ops — [the tool you are strongest in]" so I know you read this far. I would much rather have someone who asks one good question up front than someone who disappears for two days and comes back having built the wrong thing. Speed matters here because of the five-day clock, but a fast sloppy build costs me a client. I need both. **What I'm looking for** - Excellent written and spoken English. Non-negotiable. You'll be writing SOPs, documenting builds and communicating with me every day. If your English is only okay, you will struggle here. - Real hands-on GoHighLevel. Tell me what you've built in it, not that you're familiar with it. - Calendly and calendar/booking workflow experience — routing, reminders, sync. - Genuine automation experience in Zapier — multi-step workflows with error handling and proper filtering, not one-step Zaps. ---------- on top of that is a real plus, since some of our scenarios already run there. - Strong Notion: databases, relations, filtered views, templates. - Comfortable building in Miro. - Experience in insurance, finance or corporate professional services is a big advantage and puts you near the top of the pile. - Self-directed. I'm hiring so there's less on my plate, not more. **The terms, plainly** Starts part-time, around 20 hours a week, on my hours (Ireland time). We're launching a new offer right now so the workload builds over the next couple of months, and I expect this to go full-time within roughly two months, replacing my current backend person entirely. Pay starts at $5/hour. I'm not going to dress that up — that's the starting rate while we find out whether you're good. If you are, the hours go up first and the rate goes up after. This role grows into running operations here. If you're looking for short-term work or juggling five other clients, please don't apply. **How to apply** 1. A Loom video, 2 to 3 minutes, unscripted, walking me through one system or automation you personally built. Show the actual build. What it does, why you built it that way, and what broke while you were building it. No Loom, no review. 2. A short list of what you've built in GoHighLevel. 3. Which of the tools above you've used, and which you haven't. Be honest — I'd rather know. 4. What kind of businesses you've worked with. 5. Your available hours per week now, and whether you can go full-time in two months. I read every application that follows the instructions. Copy-paste applications and AI-written cover letters are obvious and go straight in the bin.

description: Local Launchpad helps UK local service businesses; landscapers, roofers, electricians, plumbers, cleaners and similar trades, dominate Google through high-converting websites, SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation. We launched in June, already have paying clients, and are building this to scale toward hundreds. Everything runs on systems. We have our own AI copy system that generates website copy, meta titles and descriptions, schema and GBP content for every client, with content pushed directly into WordPress. Sites can go live in days, not weeks. At least that is the aim, we are not quite there just yet. We're now looking for someone to own SEO across the entire business. Not a task-doer. Not someone waiting for an SEO checklist. We want the person who d ---------- what good looks like, builds the methodology behind it, and makes sure every website and GBP we ship is technically and strategically right from the ground up. Feel free to take a look at our landing page to get a better understanding of Local Launchpad: ---------- —- YOUR FIRST JOB: TELL US WHAT WE'RE GETTING WRONG We already run a documented SEO methodology — H1 formulas, page architecture rules, mandatory on-page signals, GBP category handling. It works well enough to get clients ranking. But it was largely inherited and has never been stress-tested by someone who genuinely knows their stuff. Your first task is to audit it honestly and tell us what's right, what's outdated, and what's actively costing our clients rankings. We'd rather hear it now than in six months. —- WHAT YOU'LL OWN Site architecture and keyword strategy Keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitor and SERP research, keyword-to-page mapping, URL structure and internal linking. D ---------- how homepage, service, category, location and service × location pages should be structured and targeted and what copy belongs to each page, where, how long it should be and what it needs to say — and critically, d ---------- which pages shouldn't exist at all. We don't want to create hundreds of pages just because we can. You need to know when a page has genuine value and how to build scalable local architectures without producing thin or duplicate content. On-page and copy frameworks Working directly with our WordPress designer to define what every page type needs before it's built, so SEO is designed into the templates rather than bolted on later. You won't hand-write hundreds of pages — our copy bot handles generation at scale and can be tailored to your suggestions. What you will own is the framework behind it: section mapping, keyword targeting, heading structure, copy briefs, local relevance, entity coverage, FAQs, alt text, anchor text, and quality control on what comes out the other end. Technical SEO Crawling and indexing, Search Console, sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, redirects, duplicate content, index/noindex decisions, Core Web Vitals, schema, breadcrumbs, crawl depth. You don't need to be the developer, you need to identify issues, explain the fix, and work with our developer to get it implemented correctly. Existing website migrations Many clients arrive with an existing site. You'll audit it before anything is replaced and d ---------- which URLs have real value (rankings, traffic, backlinks), which must be preserved, which get consolidated or removed, and how to sequence the switch. We will not wipe out years of a client's SEO value because a migration was done carelessly. Google Business Profile and local This is central to the offer. Setup and optimisation, category selection, services, service areas, photo strategy, review generation and response, NAP consistency, GBP-to-website alignment, Local Pack and Maps rankings, citations, competitor analysis, and resolving GBP issues when they arise. UK knowledge is a real advantage — some categories carry protected-title or accreditation traps. We use or plan to use tools like LeadSnap and are open to whatever you'd recommend. Off-page and authority Citations, local and niche-relevant links, competitor backlink analysis, partnerships and outreach where it makes sense. We are not interested in buying hundreds of low-quality links a month. We want a repeatable, commercially sensible authority strategy. Measurement Search Console, Analytics, GBP data, rank tracking, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog. What's improving, what's declining, what's sitting just outside the top positions, and what's actually generating leads. We don't care about vanity metrics — we care about qualified calls for our clients. We also need to be able to show our clients on a monthly/quarterly basis the results we have generated for them, this task will sit with you. —- WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU - Real, demonstrable local SEO experience, ideally with trades and home services — landscapers, roofers, plumbers, electricians, HVAC, cleaning, pest control, drainage and or similar. UK experience is a advantage, but we're open to exceptional candidates anywhere. - Strong technically, strong on-page, and genuinely hands-on with Google Business Profile — not theoretical. - Comfortable with WordPress and able to work directly with a designer/developer, setting requirements they implement. - Able to work at our speed. Sites go live within days of onboarding, so if your process needs three weeks of research per client, this won't be a fit. - The confidence to tell us we're wrong. We've had people give us confident answers that turned out to be incorrect, and it cost us real time and money. Push back. - Proactive communication. Daily or near-daily updates, a weekly call, and a heads-up when something slips before it slips — not after. - Excellent written English. You'll be working directly with me. Interested in building systems, not just completing tasks. - Most importantly: think like an owner of the result. If something isn't ranking, we don't want "I completed all my SEO tasks." We want "why isn't it ranking, and what are we doing about it?" This is crucial! —- THE OPPORTUNITY This isn't a freelance gig where we send you random tasks. The right person becomes the SEO Lead behind Local Launchpad. You'll start by working closely with me and our designer to audit and rebuild our delivery model. From there, the goal is a repeatable SEO system deployable across hundreds of businesses — architecture standards, keyword processes, page mapping, content frameworks, technical checklists, GBP and review systems, migration procedures, QA and reporting. As we grow, there's scope to lead SEO team members beneath you rather than executing every repetitive task yourself. For the right person this becomes a significant long-term role, with genuine profit share as we scale. $1000 for the set up of our SEO system with an ongoing monthly retainer and profit share agreed once the set up project has been completed! A paid test task before either side commits may be required. —- HOW TO APPLY Start your reply with "RANKINGS" so I know you've read the whole post, and open with 2–3 specific results you've achieved for local service businesses — the situation, what you did, and what actually changed. This comes first, before anything else. Applications without it won't be considered. Then: 1- Your local SEO background — how long, what markets, what types of business 2- Your GBP experience, including tools you use for posting, reviews or rank tracking 3- A client serves 10 locations and offers 8 services. How would you structure that site, and how would you avoid thin or duplicate content? (Be specific — this is the question that matters most to us.) 4- A client comes to us with an existing 20-page site that ranks reasonably well. Walk me through your migration process. 5- Your availability and hours per week Looking forward to finding the right person and building something great together.

title: CRO Specialist / Growth Designer (A/B Testing)
description: We are a growing DTC e-commerce group and are hiring one person to own our conversion program: build product pages, landing pages, and offers, A/B test them, read the data, and ship the winners, every week. You will work directly with the founders, our media buyer, and our ad creative team. We have enough traffic to run several real tests every month, so you will see results fast. This is not a "make it look pretty" job. We care about revenue per visitor. What You Will Do: Build pages and funnels: - Design product pages, advertorials / pre-landers, listicles, bundle pages, and upsell / cross-sell flows - Build landing pages that match the ad angles that are scaling - Set up post-purchase upsells, the cart drawer, and checkout settings - Keep a library of proven page templates and sections Design and test offers: - Test bundles, tiered pricing, quantity breaks, free-gift and free-shipping thresholds, and discount framing - Run price and offer tests - Calculate the margin impact before any offer goes live, no offer ships without a profit-per-order calculation Run A/B tests: - Keep a prioritized test backlog (hypothesis, expected impact, effort) - Launch multiple tests per week, each with a written hypothesis and a clear success metric - Calculate sample size before launch and run tests to statistical significance - Keep a test log: what changed, dates, traffic, result, decision, learning - Roll out winners everywhere they apply; document losers so we never re-test them Analyze: - Weekly review Shopify analytics: funnel drop-off by step, device, traffic source, landing page - Review heatmaps and session recordings to find friction - Mine customer support tickets, reviews, and surveys for objections and copy angles - Monthly competitor check (pages and offers) Report: - Weekly report: tests running, tests finished, results, next launches, RPV / CVR / AOV trend - Monthly report: total lift, learnings, next month's backlog, recommendations for ads and creative - Tell the media buyer which landers get traffic and at what split; feed winning hooks and objections back to the creative team Your KPIs: - Revenue per visitor - Profit per visitor / margin per order - Conversion rate and AOV - Tests launched per month and win rate - Add-to-cart rate and checkout completion rate Requirements: - Experience building Shopify pages for e-commerce brands (DTC, dropshipping, or CRO / e-commerce agency) - Built advertorials / pre-landers matched to specific ad angles - You have run real A/B tests and can show results with numbers (CVR, RPV, AOV), including tests that lost - You have run at least one price or offer test - Comfortable with GA4, Shopify analytics, and Clarity - You can explain sample size and statistical significance in simple words - Good understanding of direct-response basics: hook, proof, objections, urgency - Strong written English; clear, short reports - Reliable internet, a good computer, and a quiet workspace - Shopify Liquid / theme development knowledge What We Offer: - Full-time, long-term remote position - Salary depending on experience, with room for increases based on results - Real traffic, real budget, and real ownership of the test program - Direct access to the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy - Room to grow as the team grows How to Apply: 1) Send your CV 2) 3 to 5 A/B tests you have run, at least one that LOST. For each test, include: - Context: niche, page type, and rough traffic (sessions/day or orders/day) - What data gave you the idea (heatmap, drop-off, survey, reviews, tickets) - Your hypothesis in one sentence - What you changed (control vs. variant, screenshots or a Loom are welcome as support) - Tool used, traffic split, how long it ran, and sample size - Result: CVR / RPV / AOV before and after, and whether it reached significance - Decision: rolled out, killed, or iterated, and what you learned You can hide brand names for NDA reasons. Relative numbers (for example "+11% RPV") are required. 3) Links to 2–3 live pages you built 4) A short answer to this question: "Tell us about a test you were sure would win, and it lost. What did you learn?" 5) A screenshot of a test log or weekly report you keep (redacted is fine) 6) If possible, a 3–5 minute Loom video walking us through one of your tests Applications with no screenshots and no numbers will not be considered.

You're looking for a role where you: Own the problem, not just the task Design systems that actually work when they scale 2x, 5x, 10x Can propose new tools, kill inefficient processes, and implement better ones without micromanagement Want your work to matter, to help young adults find direction, mentorship, and life-changing experiences Are excited by the challenge of expanding operations into the Philippines using your cultural and local knowledge Have experience (or strong aptitude to learn) with n8n, Make.com, Zapier, GHL, AI agents, API integrations, and workflow automation Think in systems: Where is the bottleneck? Your Growth Path Phase 1: Execute 3 paid trial tasks @ $3.00/hr Phase 2 (Month 1 to 3): Full-time implementation role Phase 3 (Month 4+): Review for AI Tech Team Leader Role and increased salary and performance bonuses tied to organizational growth metrics (members served, communities reached, lives impacted). Your thoughts on our stack. What's one high leverage integration or automation you'd propose on Day 1 for a mentoring/adventure travel operation? Your availability When can you start the trial tasks? We're hiring fast. If you're a empathic team player, a systems thinker, who wants to build something meaningful that benefits young people who need your/our support apply now. We value reliability, documentation, and systems that don't create dependency. Build something that helps us mentor more young adults through the life-changing experiences we provide.

title: Video Editor for Youtube Faceless Channel
job_title: Video Editor for Youtube Faceless Channel
description: YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Term Role (Script, Voice-Over & Music Provided — No French Required) Quick note before you read further: this is a French-language YouTube channel, but you do NOT need to speak, read, or write French to apply. We provide the complete script, a professional voice-over, and the music for every video. Full details are in “What We Provide” and “Requirements” below. Compensation We are looking for a partner who can combine production quality with a strong value-for-money ratio. This is not a "low-cost" budget: we invest in polished, professional editing. We are keeping the budget controlled today simply because the channel is still in its early growth phase — that's the honest situation right now, not a reflection of how much we value the work. We prefer a fixed monthly rate for a long-term collaboration. To be transparent about how this can evolve: to the extent that the channel's growth comes from the quality of the videos you deliver, we will revisit the compensation together — monthly or per-video — and increase it accordingly. Your work has a direct impact on that growth, and it's important to us that this be reflected in how you're paid over time. Please include your expected monthly or per-video rate in your application (in USD or PHP). Applicants seeking significantly higher compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to candidates offering the best balance between work quality and rate. Expected Workload At least 3 long-form videos per week (a minimum of approximately 12 videos per month), around 30 minutes each. Workload may increase depending on channel needs. This is intended as a long-term, ongoing role — not a one-off project. About Us We run a French-language, faceless YouTube channel focused on: • Historical mysteries and archaeology • Ancient civilizations • Megaliths and unexplained discoveries • Documentary-style storytelling We are working to bring our channel to a more polished, immersive, and visually refined level than our current content — while keeping a reasonable and responsible budget. We are looking for a genuine win-win partnership, not the lowest rate on the market. Important This position is not for basic video editing. We are looking for an editor who can turn a script and voice-over into a truly immersive documentary experience, combining visual research, footage sourcing, animation, motion design, and pacing — with an excellent value-for-money ratio rather than a premium rate. Strict deadline compliance and responsive communication are eliminatory criteria. An editor who is late on deliveries or unreachable for several days will not be retained, regardless of the artistic quality of the edit. What We Provide • Complete script • Voice-over recording (AI-generated, professional quality, in French) • Background music (provided by us for each video) • Reference video(s) to illustrate the expected style • Clear written instructions and timing/pacing notes in English for every video • Creative direction and feedback at every stage Your Responsibilities • Edit high-retention YouTube videos (long-form, around 30 minutes) • Independently source all necessary visuals: stock footage, photos, maps, graphics, animations, AI-generated images (good quality), and B-roll • Add motion graphics, zooms, transitions, and visual storytelling elements • Integrate the provided music and add sound effects suited to the documentary tone • Follow the editing style of our reference videos • Consistently deliver projects on the agreed schedule (ideally 48–72 hours per video, depending on complexity) — any unannounced delay will be considered a serious issue • Respond quickly to messages (within 24 hours max on weekdays) regarding progress, feedback, or any project-related question, in English • Revise videos based on feedback when necessary Requirements • Strong experience editing YouTube videos, ideally documentary, history, or storytelling content • No French language skills required. We provide the complete script, professional voice-over, and music for every video — your role is 100% visual and technical, not linguistic. You do not need to write, translate, or speak French • Excellent storytelling and pacing skills, with a good ear for rhythm and timing: you will be cutting to a professional voice-over track, the same skill used to edit to music or any voice-over — even in a language you don't speak • Ability to keep viewers engaged throughout long-form content • Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software (your choice of tool — only the result matters) • Ability to independently source visuals and assets • Absolute reliability on deadlines and responsive communication in English (eliminatory criterion in case of repeated failure) • Attention to detail • Stable internet connection for exchanging large files • Ability to deliver a quality result within a reasonable production budget Note on French: this channel targets a French-speaking audience, but the script, voice-over, and music are already written, recorded, and composed for you. Basic French reading ability is a nice-to-have (it can help when matching on-screen text to timing cues) but is absolutely not required. English is our working language for all communication, feedback, and instructions. Preferred Experience Experience editing channels similar to: • Uncharted Mysteries ( ---------- ---------- ) — very close to our own niche and target style: ancient civilizations, archaeology, and unexplained mysteries • Fern • Wendover Productions • MagnatesMedia • RealLifeLore • Or French-language documentary channels such as Underscore_, Nota Bene, Passé Sauvage, Le Précepteur — you don't need to understand French to study their pacing, structure, and visual style (feel free to mention your own references) Important Application Instructions To confirm you have read this entire job posting: 1 Include the word MEGALITHE as the second line of your application. 2 Record a short 30–60 second Loom video (or equivalent) introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit for this position. This video must be recorded in English. 3 Provide a short 50–60 second editing sample (existing, or made specifically for this application) in the style of our reference channel, Uncharted Mysteries ( ---------- ---------- ) — showcasing your visual sourcing, pacing, motion design, and sound design. 4 Answer all application questions below. Applications that do not follow these instructions will be automatically rejected. Application Questions 1 Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited and explain your role in each project. 2 Which editing software do you use? 3 How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have? 4 Have you edited documentary, history, or storytelling channels before? 5 If I provide only a script, a voice-over, and background music, can you source all footage, images, maps, and graphics yourself? Please explain your process. 6 What YouTube channels inspire your editing style? 7 How many 25–35 minute documentary videos can you realistically edit per month? 8 How many hours per week are available for this project? 9 What is your internet speed? 10 What monthly or per-video compensation are you seeking (USD or PHP)? Please provide a rate that reflects a strong value-for-money balance, suited to a growing project. 11 Can you guarantee a 48–72 hour delivery turnaround per video and a response to our messages within 24 hours max? If not, please specify your actual availability. 12 Have you ever edited video or audio content in a language you don't speak or aren't fluent in? If yes, briefly describe how you approached pacing and timing without understanding the words. Final Selection Process Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a roughly 2-minute sample edit using a script, voice-over recording, music, and reference video that we provide. The purpose of this test is to evaluate: • Storytelling ability • Editing style • Visual sourcing skills • Pacing and viewer retention • Sound design (music integration + sound effects) • Attention to detail • Ability to follow instructions • Respect of the test deadline (a direct indicator of future reliability) Please do not apply if you are unwilling to complete the sample edit. Due to the expected volume of applications, only candidates selected for the next stage will receive the test materials. Long-Term Opportunity We are building a French-language YouTube channel with the ambition to grow in both quality and volume, following a progressive growth strategy and a controlled budget. We are looking for a reliable editor to grow with us long-term. The channel is starting out today, but the video quality you deliver is one of the direct drivers of that growth — better editing means better retention, and better retention means a channel (and a budget) that grows faster. As it grows, so does what we can offer the editor behind it. Strong performers will receive: • Higher monthly or per-video compensation as the channel's growth and budget allow • Performance bonuses • Additional editing projects • Opportunities to work across multiple future channels If you are passionate about creating engaging documentary-style content, reliable on deadlines, responsive in communication, and looking for a trust-based partnership with a strong value-for-money balance, we would love to hear from you. Note on language (please read): this is a French-language channel, but as explained above, you do not need to speak, read, or write French. We provide the finished script, a professional voice-over, and music for every video. English is our working language for all communication, feedback, and instructions. What matters most is your editing skill: pacing, visual storytelling, and attention to detail

description: World Famous Puppies is seeking an experienced, highly organized Puppy Sourcing & Inventory Coordinator to support our sales operation. This is a critical position inside our company. Our sales team speaks with customers every day who are actively looking for specific breeds, colors, genders, sizes, and delivery timelines. Your responsibility is to make sure our customer service representatives and closers always have fresh, currently available puppy options ready to send immediately. This is not a general virtual assistant position. We need someone who understands dogs, recognizes popular breeds, works extremely quickly online, pays close attention to details, and can manage puppy inventory without mistakes. Primary Responsibilities You will research and identify available puppies from our approved puppy sources, including websites such as Lancaster Puppies, Greenfield Puppies, and other approved breeders or marketplaces. You will: Search for puppies based on the breeds we are actively advertising. Maintain fresh inventory throughout the day. Find attractive, high-quality puppy options that match customer demand. Organize puppy photographs and information. Record the exact source of every puppy. Save the breeder/seller contact information. Save the original puppy listing URL. Record the puppy's asking price/cost. Record breed, gender, color, age/date of birth, and location. Track whether the puppy is currently available. Record when availability was last checked. Remove or mark puppies that are no longer available. Verify availability again when a customer becomes seriously interested. Coordinate with our inbound customer-response team. Coordinate with our three sales closers. Make it possible for our closer to immediately locate and purchase the correct puppy after a customer makes a decision. Keep all inventory records accurate and current. Example If World Famous Puppies is advertising Golden Retrievers today, you should already have several strong Golden Retriever options organized and ready before customers begin asking for them. If a customer is sent puppy GR-104, our sales team must be able to immediately find: GR-104 → breed → gender → photographs → cost → breeder/seller → source website → direct listing link → seller contact → location → availability → delivery information There should be no confusion and no searching from scratch after the customer chooses the puppy. Breeds You Should Understand You should already be familiar with popular breeds including: Golden Retrievers, Pomeranians, Shih Tzus, Yorkshire Terriers, Maltese, Poodles, Mini Poodles, Goldendoodles, Cavapoos, Dachshunds, French Bulldogs and other popular companion breeds. Experience with different colors, sizes, coat types and designer breeds is highly valuable. Required Skills You must be: Extremely organized Fast at online research Comfortable working with spreadsheets Excellent at data entry Able to manage many puppy listings at once Detail-oriented Familiar with dog breeds Comfortable contacting sellers when necessary Able to follow systems exactly Reliable and consistent Comfortable working independently Able to communicate clearly in English Comfortable using translation tools when needed Experienced using Google Sheets or Excel Comfortable working with Facebook, websites, WhatsApp and online marketplaces Dog Knowledge Is Required We strongly prefer applicants who have previous experience with: Pet businesses, breeders, kennels, pet stores, veterinary businesses, animal rescue, puppy sales, pet e-commerce or dog ownership. You must genuinely understand dogs. If you cannot quickly identify common dog breeds or have no interest in the pet industry, this position is probably not appropriate for you. Accuracy Is Critical One mistake can cost the company a customer. You must never confuse: One puppy with another One breeder with another Male versus female Puppy cost Location Customer Source link Availability status We expect accurate records at all times. Inventory System You will maintain a master inventory sheet containing information such as: Puppy ID | Breed | Gender | Color | DOB/Age | Photos | Source Website | Listing URL | Breeder/Seller | Seller Contact | Cost | Selling Price | Location | Availability | Last Checked | Delivery Information | Customer Assigned | Notes We will train you on the exact World Famous Puppies system. What We Are Looking For We want somebody who thinks ahead. If our advertising team tells you tomorrow's campaign is focused on Pomeranians and Golden Retrievers, we should not have to wait until customers arrive to start looking for puppies. You should already be preparing the inventory. The goal is: Customer asks → puppy options are already ready → customer selects one → availability is verified → closer closes → puppy is purchased. Speed is extremely important. Compensation I would start this position at: $4.50–$5.50 USD per hour At 40 hours per week, that's roughly $780–$950 USD per month, depending on experience and the exact schedule. For an exceptional candidate with significant pet-industry or puppy-sourcing experience, you can pay more. I would use a 30-day paid probation period, then review performance and compensation. Performance Will Be Measured We will monitor: Accuracy of inventory Number of usable puppies sourced Speed of sourcing Availability accuracy Number of expired listings removed Response time when sales asks for a puppy Quality of puppy options Accuracy of breeder/source information Organization of photographs and records Communication with the sales team This is a results-oriented position. How to Apply Contact World Famous Puppies directly: WhatsApp / Phone: ---------- Start your message with: WFP SOURCING TEAM Please include: 1. Full name 2. City in the Philippines 3. Previous employment experience 4. Experience working with dogs or pets 5. Dog breeds you know best 6. Experience with online research 7. Experience using Google Sheets or Excel 8. Internet speed 9. Computer/laptop specifications 10. Confirmation that you can work hours overlapping U.S. Eastern Time Also send a 30–60 second English voice introduction explaining why you would be a good fit. We are interviewing immediately and want to hire the right person as soon as possible. The interview test I would give them Don't hire this person without testing them. Put them into a Google Sheet with puppy name/ID, sex, color, price, location, source URL and seller information. Organize the puppy photos so I can immediately tell which photos belong to which listing. That test will tell you almost everything. You don't need the candidate who's best at interviewing. You need the person who comes back fast, organized, accurate, and with zero mixed-up puppies. Then your initial World Famous Puppies team is very lean: 1 Puppy Sourcing Coordinator → 2 Inbound Lead Reps → Gabriel + 2 Closers → purchase/delivery operations. Off-Tour Trailer Operations • Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up. • Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team. • Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements. • Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability. • Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts.
