title: DREAM MEDICAL CLAIM & DETAILS SAVIOR!
description: SYNERGY RISING ~ Job Ad: DREAM CLAIM & DETAILS SAVIOR Medical Claims Submission & Reimbursement Tracking Support Pretty Please Are you a detail-obsessed, heart-led VA who actually ENJOYS medical paperwork? Does a clean, color-coded, perfectly-tracked spreadsheet make your whole day better? Do you have experience with insurance billing, medical bookkeeping, claims submission, or medical records... and do you understand that ACCURACY here is not a nice-to-have, it is everything? If you said YES, please read on! WHO I AM Hello, brilliant soul! I'm Kama, RN and Nurse Coach, founder of Synergy Rising LLC and host of the Dancing With Dementia™ & Caregivers Rising™ Podcast. I've spent over 20 years in healthcare, and years now caregiving for my mom. My work centers on empowering young, young-at-heart, and atypical caregivers through coaching, holistic tools, and real talk. We are in a BIG launch season... a new website, our signature membership, and a growing podcast... and I need a steady, meticulous person to take one very important piece off my plate so I can keep building. WHAT THIS WORK ACTUALLY IS Here is the honest heart of it, so you know exactly what you'd be stepping into... This is supplemental insurance claim submission and reimbursement tracking for a family navigating a long health journey while caring for a sick loved one. Years of records, real benefits that were paid for and never claimed, and money that belongs back in the hands of the family caring for someone they love. Doing this work well does TWO beautiful things at once... it helps a caregiving family recover what is rightfully theirs, AND it directly funds a service-based company launching resources for caregivers everywhere. Because this involves private medical information, this role requires a signed NDA and a signed agreement to follow HIPAA guidelines. That is a HARD gate ~ nothing begins until that is complete. Full details are shared after signing, not before. The role in one line: read medical records carefully, identify every claimable benefit, build and maintain a clean claims tracker, prepare and submit claim forms, and track every submission through to payment. A note on the team: this is a TEAM. You'll work with me directly, and alongside my EA and the rest of our crew, so clear communication and collaboration are part of the magic. WHAT YOU'LL DO FIND the money. Read through years of medical records and spot every visit, procedure, radiology exam, lab, and service that is claimable... then cross-reference each one against what the policy ACTUALLY covers, and how many times per year it can be used. TRACK it beautifully. Keep our Google Sheets tracker current and self-calculating... policy coverage on one tab, the claims log on the other. Formulas do the counting, never you. BUILD the claim. One clean supporting-documentation PDF per claim, a completed claim form with every single field filled, and file names matched to our exact standard format... no improvising, no "close enough." SEND it and log it. Fax each claim as it is finished, one at a time, never saved up in a batch... then log the submission, the payment, and the amount, so we ALWAYS know what is still owed. FLAG what looks off. A number that does not match, a benefit you are unsure about, a date that does not line up. Flagging beats guessing, ALWAYS. THE ACCURACY THING (please read closely) A wrong number here quietly becomes a wrong claim. A mislabeled benefit quietly becomes a denial. A sloppy file name quietly becomes an hour of somebody's life spent looking for a document. So I need someone who slows down where it counts, double-checks their own work before it reaches me, and treats "I verified it against the source document" as the standard, not the exception. We start with ONE complete claim, start to finish, reviewed together... so if anything is off, we catch it after ONE claim instead of after forty! WHO YOU ARE ~ EXCELLENT digital organization... this is a MUST-have, not a nice-to-have. Folder structures, file naming conventions, version control, and a system you can hand to someone else and have them understand it instantly ~ Comfortable reading medical documentation... visit notes, itemized bills, EOBs, procedure and diagnosis language ~ Confident in Google Sheets... formulas, filters, and building something that stays accurate on its own ~ Meticulous with numbers, dates, and matching wording EXACTLY ~ Discreet and trustworthy with private information, always ~ Willing to sign an NDA and follow HIPAA guidelines ~ Organized, proactive, and resourceful... you find answers and ask great questions ~ Warm, reliable, and genuinely kind (this is a heart-forward brand and team) ~ Strong English skills for clear written communication ~ A consistent, reliable internet connection ~ Excellent with follow-through and feedback ~ Able to provide references BONUS GLOW (nice, not required) ~ Direct experience with insurance billing, medical billing, or medical bookkeeping ~ Familiarity with supplemental / voluntary benefit policies (AFLAC-type a ---------- , hospital, wellness, and disability benefits) ~ Experience working with EOBs, claim forms, denials, appeals, or timely-filing rules ~ Medical coding exposure (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS) ~ Experience with PDF tools, merging, redaction, and online fax services ~ Caregiving lived experience or a heart for this mission THE LOGISTICS ~ Rate: $3 per hour to start, with ROOM TO GROW as the company grows! PLEASE VERIFY THIS FEELS ALIGNED BEFORE YOU APPLY! ~ This begins as a GIG ~ one focused project, with a clear finish line ~ AND ~ if you are excellent, communicative, and a joy to work with, there is real possibility to grow into an ongoing seat with Synergy Rising and Affiliates on other projects. ~ Hours: FLEXIBLE ~ work whenever works for YOU, as long as deadlines are met and communication stays clear ~ Start: immediately, beginning with ONE complete claim as a paid trial ~ Fully remote TO BE CONSIDERED Please reply with "DREAM CLAIM & DETAILS SAVIOR!" in your subject line, and answer these questions. You can apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph, or email me directly at ---------- answer in your OWN words. I am reading for how you think and how you explain... not for perfect textbook definitions. 1. A short intro about you and your experience... especially with insurance billing, medical billing, medical bookkeeping, medical records, or claims work of any kind. 2. In plain language, as if you were explaining it to a patient: what is the difference between an EOB and an itemized bill? Which one tells you what was actually PAID? 3. What do CPT and ICD-10 codes each describe, and why does it matter that they match up on a claim? 4. A claim comes back DENIED. Walk me through the first four things you would check, in order. 5. Here is a scenario... the policy document says a benefit pays $200 and can be used twice per year. Your tracker shows it was already submitted twice this year, but only paid once. What do you do next, and what do you tell me? 6. Show me your DIGITAL ORGANIZATION. How do you name files, structure folders, and keep track of a large multi-year project so nothing gets lost? Screenshots or examples are very welcome! 7. What is your experience level in Google Sheets? Tell me about a tracker or system you have built. 8. How do you handle private and confidential information? Have you signed an NDA or worked under HIPAA guidelines before? Are you comfortable doing both here? 9. Have you ever submitted claims by FAX or used an online fax service? Which one? 10. You are unsure whether a service qualifies under a policy. What do you do... and how do you communicate that to me? 11. How do you like to receive and act on feedback? Tell me about a time you took a note and made something even better. 12. WHY does this work matter to YOU? What draws you to a mission built around caregivers? 13. Are you good with starting at $3/hour, with the goal of GROWING with us? 14. Can you provide references? Please have them ready. 15. Bonus: any experience with coaching, health, or wellness brands, memberships, or online courses? Let's build something meaningful, heart-centered, and wildly impactful... together! And if you know someone who'd be a great fit, please send them our way. When one rises, we all rise. SKILL REQUIREMENT: Medical Billing ~ Insurance Claims ~ Bookkeeping ~ Data Entry ~ Google Sheets ~ Medical Records Management

description: I run a UK-based creative agency working with e-commerce brands spending millions per month on ads. You'll be the person who keeps track of every dollar coming in and going out, makes sure payments are processed on time, and gives me clear visibility on my financial position at all times. This role is part bookkeeper, part financial analyst, part personal finance manager. If you love spreadsheets, cashflow forecasting, and making sense of messy numbers — this is for you. What You'll Do: Business Finance: Track all agency income across multiple clients — retainers, percentage of spend invoices, and any other revenue Track all business expenses — editor payments, strategist payments, software subscriptions, tools, and operational costs Calculate monthly profit and loss per client and for the agency overall Process payments to editors, strategists, and contractors via Revolut Business (you will be added as a Team Member) Send client invoices via Revolut Business and track payment status Chase outstanding invoices and flag overdue payments Calculate monthly editor payroll based on output data provided by the operations team Maintain a clean, up-to-date financial dashboard in Google Sheets showing revenue, expenses, profit, and cash position Personal Finance: Track all personal income and spending across bank accounts and credit cards Categorise every personal transaction weekly — food, dining, travel, rent, subscriptions, entertainment, transport, clothing, health, etc. Create visual spending breakdowns — pie charts or bar charts showing where money is going each month Flag areas where spending is too high and recommend where to cut back Track personal net worth monthly — bank balances, investments, assets, debts Help set and monitor monthly personal budgets Cashflow & Forecasting: Maintain a rolling cashflow forecast — what's coming in over the next 30, 60, 90 days based on client contracts and expected payments Flag any upcoming cash crunches before they happen — e.g. if a big invoice hasn't been paid and payroll is due Forecast monthly income based on current client retainers and projected ad spend percentages Track progress towards financial targets and goals — I'll share my targets and you tell me if I'm on pace or falling behind Model scenarios — e.g. "if I sign 2 more clients at $10K, what does my monthly P&L look like after team costs?" Reporting: Send a weekly financial summary every Monday — total income, total expenses, net position, outstanding invoices, upcoming payments due Send a monthly financial report — full P&L, spending breakdown, personal vs business analysis, progress towards targets, cashflow forecast update All reports should be visual and easy to read — charts, colour coding, clear summaries. Not walls of numbers Requirements: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills — formulas, charts, pivot tables, conditional formatting, dashboards Experience with bookkeeping, financial tracking, or management accounting Excellent attention to detail — every number must be accurate, every transaction categorised correctly Reliable and consistent — the weekly report must arrive every Monday without being chased Good written English for clear communication Comfortable handling sensitive financial information with complete confidentiality Proactive — if you see a problem in the numbers, flag it immediately, don't wait for me to ask Comfortable learning new tools — you will be using Revolut Business to process payments and send invoices Strong Preference For: Experience working with agencies, freelancers, or small businesses managing multiple income streams Experience with Revolut Business, Stripe, Xero, or QuickBooks Experience with cashflow forecasting and financial modelling Experience managing multi-currency finances (USD, GBP, EUR) Ability to create clean, visual financial dashboards and reports Working Hours: Flexible, but must be available for a weekly 15-minute check-in call during UK business hours (9am-5pm GMT/BST). job_title: UK B2C Outbound Sales & Qualification Specialist | Full-Time | Great Commission
description: UK B2C Outbound Sales & Qualification Specialist | Full-Time | Great Commission Build your career with a fast-growing UK brand—not just another VA job. Are you confident on the phone, naturally good with people and motivated by achieving great results? Do you want to work with a company that values your contribution, supports your development and gives you the opportunity to grow into a long-term career? Care Claim Line is a growing UK customer support business helping older people and their families understand and access support they may be entitled to. We are now expanding our operations and building our Philippines-based FRT team. We are looking for ambitious, professional and customer-focused Filipino team members who want to be part of something bigger than a standard freelance role. This is your opportunity to work directly with a growing UK company, join a supportive international team and help build the customer experience as our business continues to expand. This is not a general Virtual Assistant position. This is a professional, phone-based B2C customer qualification role for someone who enjoys meaningful conversations, takes pride in helping customers, loves working towards targets and wants to be rewarded for strong performance. Most importantly, this is not a cold-calling role. Every customer you contact has already opted in, made an enquiry or requested that Care Claim Line contact them. You will be speaking with people who are expecting to hear from us and have already shown an interest in finding out more. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING You’ll speak with UK customers who have made an enquiry with us or specifically asked to be contacted, then guide them through our initial qualification process. Your role will include: • Making outbound calls to UK customers who have opted in or requested contact • Speaking confidently, warmly and professionally with older customers • Creating a positive first impression of Care Claim Line • Following our structured qualification process • Asking thoughtful questions and listening carefully to each customer • Understanding the customer’s situation and identifying whether they may be suitable for our service • Completing customer information accurately in our system • Passing qualified customers to our UK sales team • Following up with customers when required • Working towards clear daily and weekly KPIs • Contributing ideas and feedback as our Philippines operation develops You will never be expected to cold-call random or purchased lists. The people you contact will already have engaged with Care Claim Line and asked to hear from us. Your role is to respond promptly, build trust, understand their needs and help them take the next step. You are not responsible for completing the full customer application. Your job is to make the customer feel listened to, qualify them accurately and create a high-quality handover to our UK team. WHY JOIN CARE CLAIM LINE? This is more than a remote calling job. You’ll be joining a growing UK company at an exciting stage of its development. We are building our Philippines team from the ground up, which means the people who join us early will have the opportunity to make a real impact and grow alongside the business. You’ll work with a team that values energy, professionalism, accountability and a great customer experience. We want our team members to feel proud of the work they do, supported by the people around them and excited about where the company is going. As we expand, high-performing team members will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, support new starters, help improve processes and progress into senior, training and team leadership positions. If you are ambitious, reliable and ready to build something with us, this could be the beginning of a long-term opportunity—not just another online job. WHO WE WANT We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience in: UK B2C outbound sales UK call centres / BPO Lead qualification Appointment setting Telesales Customer service Inbound enquiries and warm outbound follow-up CRM systems and diallers Previous experience speaking with UK customers is highly desirable. Experience handling warm leads, opted-in enquiries or callback requests is especially valuable. Please note that this is fundamentally different from cold calling. Customers have already expressed interest and are expecting contact from the business. We’re looking for someone who is: Confident and engaging on the telephone Warm, friendly and naturally personable Excellent at spoken English Easy for UK customers to understand Patient and respectful when speaking with older customers A strong listener who can ask the right questions Competitive and motivated by targets Reliable, punctual and professionally presented Comfortable following structured processes Accurate when recording customer information Open to feedback and committed to improving Motivated by commission, progression and long-term growth WORKING HOURS This is a full-time position working UK business hours, so please make sure you are comfortable working the corresponding Philippines hours before applying. You’ll work remotely from the Philippines as part of our wider UK customer team. We value professionalism, consistency and communication, while also understanding the benefits of working remotely. You’ll have the flexibility of a home-based role while being part of a structured, supportive and ambitious international team. WHAT WE PROVIDE You’ll receive: • Full training and ongoing support • A clear and structured call process • Professional cloud phone and customer management systems • Existing opted-in customer enquiries and callback requests to contact • UK management and support • Regular feedback and coaching • Clear performance targets • Base pay plus performance-related earning opportunities • The opportunity to work directly with a growing UK company • A supportive team culture built around professionalism and development • Opportunities to progress as our Philippines operation grows • The chance to help shape and build our FRT team from the beginning We’re not looking to build a team of temporary freelancers. We’re looking for people who want to grow with the company. As the Philippines operation expands, there will be opportunities for high performers to progress into senior, training and team leadership positions. The people who join us early will have the chance to help shape how the team works, support future colleagues and become an important part of Care Claim Line’s growth story. IMPORTANT – VOICE SAMPLE REQUIRED The quality of your spoken English is extremely important for this position. When applying, please send us: 1. A short introduction about yourself and your outbound/BPO experience. 2. Details of any experience working with UK customers. 3. Details of your experience handling warm leads, opted-in enquiries or customer callback requests. 4. Your previous sales or qualification KPIs, if you know them. 5. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you think you would be a strong fit for Care Claim Line. 6. Your expected hourly or monthly base salary. Applications without a voice recording may not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an online interview and a short mock customer call based on a warm customer enquiry. We’re recruiting a small initial team now, with plans to expand significantly based on performance. If you’re confident on the phone, naturally good with people, motivated by results and excited by the opportunity to help build a growing UK company’s Philippines operation, we’d love to hear from you. Join us early. Grow with us. Help shape what comes next.

title: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator
description: Position: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator We are seeking an experienced CAD drafter and estimator who can transform architectural plans, designer renderings, elevations, and field measurements into accurate, fabrication-ready shop drawings for natural stone projects. The ideal candidate understands natural stone slabs, wall cladding, flooring, countertops, large-format panels, fireplaces, exterior façades, and custom architectural stonework. Primary Responsibilities * Review architectural plans, designer renderings, specifications, and field measurements. * Create detailed 2D and 3D shop drawings for client approval and fabrication. * Develop elevations, sections, details, dimensions, joint locations, anchoring details, and installation layouts. * Prepare slab-layout drawings showing how each piece will be cut from full slabs. * Determine the number of slabs required for each project. * Create accurate material takeoffs, cut lists, piece schedules, and square-foot quantities. * Optimize slab usage to reduce waste while maintaining proper color and vein continuity. * Lay out book-matched, vein-matched, and sequentially installed stone when required. * Identify missing dimensions, conflicts, and constructability issues before fabrication. * Coordinate drawing revisions with designers, architects, estimators, fabricators, and installers. * Maintain organized drawing files, revision records, and project documentation. * Assist the estimating department with labor, material, waste, and fabrication requirements. Required Experience * Strong proficiency in AutoCAD. * Experience with SketchUp, Revit, Rhino, SolidWorks, or another 3D modeling platform. * Previous drafting or estimating experience in natural stone, tile, countertops, architectural cladding, millwork, metal fabrication, glazing, or a similar fabrication industry. * Ability to read architectural and structural plans. * Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, joints, substrates, installation conditions, and fabrication limitations. * Ability to calculate square footage, linear footage, piece quantities, slab requirements, and waste factors. * Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently. Preferred Qualifications * Direct experience creating natural-stone shop drawings and slab-cutting layouts. * Experience with Slabsmith, Moraware, AlphaCAM, EasySTONE, or similar stone-industry software. * Knowledge of marble, granite, quartzite, limestone, travertine, and thin natural stone veneer. * Understanding of vein direction, slab sequencing, book matching, dry layouts, and material variation. * Experience creating CNC-ready information is a plus. * Familiarity with exterior cladding, mechanical fastening, adhered veneer, and large-format stone installation is highly desirable. Required Work Samples Applicants must provide examples of: * AutoCAD shop drawings * Architectural elevations and details * Slab layouts or cutting diagrams * Material takeoffs or cut lists * Relevant 3D models or renderings Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who combines drafting ability with practical fabrication and estimating knowledge. This person should understand not only how to draw the project, but also how the stone will be selected, cut, matched, fabricated, delivered, and installed.

Your work will include hands-on SEO improvements, keyword and competitor research, backlink and guest-post outreach, reputation monitoring, digital PR opportunities, and finding new websites, communities, creators, and partnerships that can help grow the brands. You’ll work closely with our content team and marketing supervisor. ## Key Responsibilities * Perform on-page SEO improvements across existing website content * Research keywords, search trends, competitors, and new content opportunities * Identify pages that should be updated, expanded, or better optimized * Find and pursue quality backlink and guest-post opportunities * Conduct outreach to relevant websites, publishers, newsletters, and partners * Monitor backlinks, brand mentions, lost links, and opportunities for link reclamation * Help identify digital PR and expert contribution opportunities * Monitor reviews, Reddit, forums, and other online conversations around our brands and industry * Help manage citations, profiles, directories, and other offsite brand assets * Research potential influencers, affiliates, creators, and partnership opportunities * Maintain organized outreach and opportunity pipelines * Track results and identify new SEO and authority-building opportunities * Use AI and modern research tools to work faster, improve research, and increase the quality of your work ## Requirements * Experience with SEO, link building, outreach, or digital marketing * Good understanding of on-page and off-page SEO * Strong research skills and attention to detail * Strong written English and professional communication skills * Comfortable reaching out to websites, publishers, creators, and potential partners * Able to stay organized while managing multiple outreach opportunities and follow-ups * Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of results * Interested in learning and testing new SEO and marketing strategies * Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow ## description: ABOUT US We own and operate Hometown Meadows, a 40-acre residential community in Nashville, Arkansas. Stocked fishing pond, playground, dog park, on-site laundry. Real families live here, and how they are treated on the phone is most of their first impression of us. We are a small US company. You would be one of about eight people. THE ROLE You are the voice of our community. You answer the phone, help residents, and turn enquiries from people looking for a home into booked showings for our operations manager. When the phone is quiet, you go out and create the next call - posting available homes and keeping our online presence active. You will report directly to Zo, and Dane our operations manager on site in Arkansas. DAY TO DAY - Answer the community phone line on Dialpad. Warm, patient, unhurried. - Take enquiries from people looking for a home. Answer their questions about availability, rent, pets, and the application, and book them a showing. - Log every maintenance request and route it to the operations manager. - Take payment questions and pass them on. You will not negotiate anything. - Return every voicemail and text the same shift. No message sits overnight. - Keep a simple call log so we can see what people are calling about. WHEN THE PHONE IS QUIET - THIS IS THE IMPORTANT PART This is not a job where you sit and wait. On a slow day you: - Post and refresh our available homes on Facebook Marketplace, MHVillage, Craigslist and our Google Business Profile. - Publish scheduled posts and photos from our marketing folder. - Reply to comments and messages on our listings and social pages. - Keep listing photos, prices and availability accurate and current. All templates, photos, logos and captions are provided. You will have a written content plan so you always know what to post next. You will not be waiting on anyone for instructions. WHO WE WANT - 2+ years on the phone with US customers. Property management, hospitality, healthcare scheduling or inbound customer service all count. - Clear, warm, easily understood spoken English. Neutral accent. You sound like a person, not a script. - Genuine patience. Some callers are stressed about money or a broken water heater. You stay kind. - Comfortable posting listings and basic social content from templates. Canva experience is a plus, not a requirement. - You solve small problems yourself and ask about big ones. If you need someone to tell you what to do every hour, please do not apply - you will be unhappy. - Reliable power and internet, and a quiet place to take calls. WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT - You do not chase people for money or negotiate payment arrangements. - You do not approve applications or make promises about repairs. - You do not answer housing-assistance or fair-housing questions from memory. We give you an approved answer sheet, and anything not on it goes to Zo. We will train you on this properly in your first week. SCHEDULE - PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING This is a NIGHT SHIFT. Our community is in the US Central time zone. - Your hours: 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday. (That is 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM in Arkansas.) - One hour paid break inside the shift. - We pay above market because we know what a night shift costs you. If the schedule does not fit your life, please do not apply - we want someone who is still here in two years. COMPENSATION TBD depending on experience. Paid twice monthly. Bonus of USD 25 for every showing you book that becomes a signed lease. We are looking for a long-term teammate, not a temporary one. HOW TO APPLY - FOLLOW EVERY STEP Applications missing a step are not read. 1. Begin your message with the word: MEADOWLARK 2. Record a 60-second voice message (any recorder, send a link) where you: - introduce yourself, and - pretend I am a caller asking "do you have any 2-bedroom homes available, and how much?" Answer me the way you would answer a real caller. You do not need to know our real prices - make them up. 3. In writing, 3-5 sentences: it is a slow night, the phone has not rung in three hours, and nobody has given you a task. What do you do? 4. Confirm you can work 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine time. 5. Describe your internet speed and where in your home you would take calls.

title: META Lead Gen Specialist — Roofing

We go deeper on one industry than any generalist agency ever could, and we beat them on every front: the offer, the creative, the landing pages, the follow-up, the automation. It is not close, and we can prove it. We run on five values, and we hire and fire on them: - Own It. If the number is down, it is ours until it is fixed. Your number is our number. - Protect the Spend. Every dollar of budget gets guarded like it is our own money on the line. - Be the Gorilla. Out front and dominant. We go further than the average agency, every time. - Speed Wins. Fast to answer, fast to launch, fast to fix. Slow is losing. - No BS. You always know what we are doing, where every lead came from, and what it cost. The last line matters most for this seat. We refuse to settle for the industry status quo. Average is not in us. If you are the kind of person who looks at any task and asks "how could this be done better, and can AI do it," you will fit here. If you are comfortable running things the way they have always been run, you will not. WHAT YOU WILL OWN You help roofers win by running their Meta ads. That is the job. The goal on every account is the same: booked appointments with homeowners who want a new roof. That number is yours to hit. When it is good, that is you. The offers, the conversion sequences, the self-learning targeting, all of it is built and proven on our own roofing company before it ever touches a client. - A full team behind you. You run the ads. title: Distressed Property Research Analyst
description: We buy distressed property in Florida. Most of our leads come from county delinquent tax lists. This job is working through those lists one property at a time, looking each one up in the county records, and telling us which ones are worth our attention. The list goes on a ---------- board, one property per row. For each one you are building a fact pattern: what happened to this property and the people who own it, from the county records, with the documents to back it up. You start in the county Official Records. The list already tells you the taxes are unpaid, so that is not the signal. If nothing in the records suggests a problem, there is no fact pattern to build. You score it poorly and move on. A lot of rows end there. When something is there, you keep pulling until you have the picture: every document that is part of the story downloaded and attached to the row, who owns it on paper and how they got it, court records for probate and divorce and judgments, heirs researched through obituaries and other tools if an owner has died, and skip tracing on the people who would have to sign. What we want at the end is a short account of what happened, the documents that show it, and a note on what you could not determine. We train you on all of it. We buy all property types. Houses, land, mobile homes, small commercial. You will not contact owners. You will find phone numbers, but you will not call them. No sales, no offers. Preferred: paralegal, title, or real estate experience. Not required. Strong written English is required. The most important thing: we need someone who will write "I could not find this" instead of guessing. We make decisions based on what you write. About 15 hrs/week, flexible schedule, paid weekly, ongoing. To apply, answer these: (1) Something difficult you had to track down and how you did it. (2) Any experience with deeds, court records, or contracts. (3) What you do when a long list starts to blur together. Paid one-hour exercise for anyone who gets past this stage.

Scope, trust, and pay grow with performance. Our lead engineer walked this exact path here. If you want a finished senior title handed to you on day one, this isn't it. If you want to EARN one, keep reading. ABOUT THE WORK We run our business on internal operating systems — the same repeatable pattern (data masters, dashboards, review queues, health checks, logs, automations) running across several ventures. The core is built in Google Sheets + Apps Script, and it connects out to the tools we run the business on: HubSpot (CRM/pipeline), QuickMail (cold email), Quo (voice/SMS), Slack (team + alerts), and Stripe (payments). Our engineering lives in GitHub. It all works and it's good — but it was built piece by piece, it's not standardized, and it's not in version control (Git/clasp). Right now the founder is the only person who fully knows how it all runs. Your job is to change that. Important boundary: This is our INTERNAL operations layer. It is NOT the customer-facing product — that's engineering's world. You won't write product features. You WILL own how the internal machine runs, connects, and ships. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Standardize our systems: take the best version of each pattern (queues, logs, health checks, automations) and make everything match it. Solve it once, not five times. - Own the connections between tools: data flows out to HubSpot / QuickMail / Quo, and signals (opens, replies, deal outcomes, payments) flow back to our systems, all keyed to one identity. Keep those adapters clean and swappable. - Get our Apps Script into clasp + Git and own the versioning/release (DevOps) process. - Run the daily rhythm: work the review queues, watch the health-check alerts, keep everything clean and current so the founder is out of daily operation. - Read across systems to catch duplication and broken handoffs before they cause problems. You're the person who notices "wait, we already built this." WHO YOU ARE (this matters more than your résumé) - You SURFACE PROBLEMS. You hit something broken, confusing, or duplicated and you raise it — WITH a recommendation, not just a complaint. You can't walk past a mess. This is the #1 trait we're hiring for. - You're CURIOUS FIRST, then honest. You understand WHY something exists before proposing to change it, then you say the true thing directly. - You're PROACTIVE. You fill your own queue. Nobody should have to tell you what to work on. - You TEACH YOURSELF. If you don't know a tool yet but you'll have it down in two weeks, that counts. WHAT YOU NEED TO START - Advanced Google Sheets. - Can read and write Apps Script (JavaScript) — enough to fix a function, edit a config, set up a trigger, connect an API, and run a change carefully. - Comfortable working with tools like HubSpot and connecting APIs between systems. - Familiar with Git, OR a fast learner who will pick up Git + clasp quickly. - The character above — especially the instinct to catch problems and bring a fix. BONUS (not required — these move you toward the senior end of the pay range faster) - MySQL / SQL databases. - Laravel / PHP. - Experience connecting or automating between SaaS tools (HubSpot, Stripe, email/SMS APIs, Zapier/Make/n8n, etc.). - Any DevOps / CI / deployment experience. We're heading toward an owned platform (MySQL + Laravel) over time — if you can grow into that, this seat grows a lot. HOW TO APPLY Reply with: 1. The word "APEX" at the top of your application (so I know you read this). 2. A short description of an internal system, tool, or automation you built — in Google Sheets/Apps Script, or connecting tools like HubSpot/Stripe/APIs — what problem it solved and how you built it. 3. One time you noticed something was broken or being done inefficiently, and what you did about it. Applications without these three things won't be reviewed. There is a short paid test as part of hiring.

title: CLEANING SERVICE REMOTE RECEPTIONIST & OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATOR (MALE PREFERRED)
job_title: CLEANING SERVICE REMOTE RECEPTIONIST & OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATOR (MALE PREFERRED)
description: # REMOTE RECEPTIONIST & OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATOR **Company:** thenycmaid **Location:** Remote **Starting Pay:** $250 USD/week **Pay:** Weekly or daily automatic payments available **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM New York/Eastern Time **Openings:** 2 **Start:** Immediately / Ready to start Monday ## 🚨 INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED **DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT AN INTRODUCTION VIDEO.** Applications without the requested video will not be reviewed. --- # ABOUT THENYCMAID thenycmaid is an established and growing cleaning service serving New York City. This is not a startup trying to figure out how to find customers. Our business currently: - Generates approximately **5–10 new organic leads every day** - Operates a network of **100+ websites** - Generates business organically without relying on paid advertising - Has earned **100+ Google reviews** - Works with approximately **10 cleaners**, with plans to significantly expand our cleaner roster - Recently completed **200+ cleaning services in a single month for the first time** - Historically closes approximately **80% of qualified leads** Our operation is heavily automated through **Full Loop CRM**, and we're looking for people who can oversee that system, provide excellent customer service, solve problems, and help us continue growing. **Previous cleaning-service industry experience is required.** # THE POSITIONS We are hiring **two people**. ### Weekday Position **Monday – Friday** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time ### Weekend Position **Saturday – Sunday** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time Please clearly indicate which schedule you are applying for. # WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS This isn't a traditional receptionist position where you simply answer a telephone. You will essentially be the **human operator overseeing an automated cleaning-service system**. Our technology handles much of the repetitive work automatically. Your responsibility is to **monitor the operation, communicate with customers and cleaners, and step in when human attention is required.** # HOW OUR AUTOMATED SYSTEM WORKS Our normal workflow looks like this: **1. A lead comes in organically.** We currently receive approximately 5–10 new leads per day. **2. The system processes the lead.** Bookings and jobs move through Full Loop CRM. **3. Jobs are automatically assigned to cleaners.** Our cleaners have their own portals where they manage their assigned work. **4. Cleaners receive notifications about upcoming jobs.** They receive a 30-minute notice before their scheduled service. **5. Cleaners check in and check out through their portals.** **6. Customer payments are collected automatically.** **7. Cleaner payments are processed automatically.** **8. Review requests and customer follow-ups are automated.** When automation isn't enough, **you step in.** Your job is to keep an eye on the entire operation and make sure things are running correctly. # YOUR COMMAND CENTER: COMHUB Most of your working day will be spent inside **ComHub**. ComHub brings all of our incoming communications into one place: - Phone calls - Emails - Text messages - Website chats You will stay logged into ComHub throughout your shift and actively monitor incoming communications. ## 60-SECOND RESPONSE STANDARD Our goal is simple: **Incoming communications should be acknowledged or responded to within 60 seconds whenever reasonably possible.** You're not expected to completely solve every problem in 60 seconds. You **are** expected to acknowledge the customer or cleaner quickly and begin handling the situation. This is not a position where you check messages every 15 minutes. Monitoring communications **is the job**. # YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You will be responsible for: - Answering incoming customer calls - Responding to texts - Responding to emails - Responding to website chats - Following up with new leads - Scheduling cleaning services - Reviewing bookings - Approving bookings when necessary - Monitoring automatic job assignments - Communicating with cleaners - Handling scheduling changes - Handling cancellations - Resolving routine customer concerns - Resolving routine cleaner issues - Updating customer and job information - Monitoring cleaner check-ins and check-outs - Following up after services - Helping satisfied customers leave Google reviews - Helping convert one-time customers into recurring customers - Identifying problems in the automated workflow - Taking action when automation requires human assistance - Helping recruit additional cleaners - Helping grow and improve the company # WE WANT PROBLEM SOLVERS This requirement is extremely important. **We do not want someone who runs to the boss every time something goes wrong.** Of course, management is available when something genuinely requires escalation. But if every minor scheduling issue, customer question, or cleaner problem results in: **“Boss, what should I do?”** this will not be a good fit. We want someone who can: **Identify the problem → Gather the information → Think → Make a reasonable decision → Solve it.** As you learn the business, you should become increasingly independent. We value people whose first thought is: **“How can I solve this?”** not: **“Who can I give this problem to?”** # CUSTOMER SERVICE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT Fast responses alone aren't enough. We want customers to feel that they're dealing with a professional company that actually cares about their experience. That means: - Being friendly - Communicating clearly - Taking ownership - Solving problems - Following up - Keeping customers informed - Turning unhappy customers into satisfied customers - Asking satisfied customers for reviews We don't just want a customer to book once. Our ideal customer journey is: **LEAD → BOOKING → GREAT SERVICE → RECURRING CUSTOMER → GREAT REVIEW → REFERRAL** Your job directly influences that process. # PERFORMANCE & KPIs We believe employees should know exactly what success looks like. You'll have **individual performance standards** as well as **company growth targets**. ## KPI #1 — RESPONSE TIME **Target: 60 seconds** Incoming calls, texts, emails, and chats should be acknowledged or responded to within approximately **60 seconds whenever reasonably possible during your active shift**. ## KPI #2 — LEAD CLOSE RATE **Target: 80%+ of qualified leads** thenycmaid historically averages approximately an **80% close rate**. We want to maintain or exceed that. This doesn't mean aggressively selling people. It means: - Answering quickly - Understanding what the customer needs - Knowing our services - Answering questions confidently - Handling reasonable objections - Following up - Making booking easy When someone contacts us looking for a cleaning service that we can provide, our goal is to turn that opportunity into a booking. Spam, duplicate inquiries, services we don't provide, out-of-service-area inquiries, and other clearly unqualified contacts do not count as qualified leads. ## KPI #3 — MONTHLY COMPLETED SERVICES We recently exceeded: **200 SERVICES/MONTH** for the first time. Our current target is: **225+ SERVICES/MONTH** Then we'll continue raising the target as the company grows. This is a company-wide goal rather than something one employee controls alone. ## KPI #4 — RECURRING CUSTOMER RATE Current: **~32%** Target: **40%+** We want more customers choosing recurring cleaning services. When appropriate, you should help customers understand their recurring-service options and follow up with satisfied customers about booking again. ## KPI #5 — AVERAGE TICKET Previous average: **~$228** Recent average: **~$210** Target: **$225+** Part of the recent decline came from offering customers a $20 review incentive. We're moving that incentive toward **$10** while continuing to grow our reviews and customer satisfaction. ## KPI #6 — REVIEWS & REPUTATION We already have **100+ Google reviews**. We want that number to keep growing. Satisfied customers should be encouraged to share their experience. We care about both: **Quantity of reviews AND quality of customer experience.** ## KPI #7 — ATTENDANCE & RELIABILITY Attendance is critical. This isn't work that can simply wait until tomorrow. Customers and cleaners are communicating with us in real time. You must: - Log in on time - Be ready to work at the beginning of your shift - Remain available throughout your shift - Monitor ComHub consistently - Communicate immediately if a genuine emergency occurs Repeated lateness, disappearing during shifts, or regularly missing communications will not work in this position. ## KPI #8 — INDEPENDENT PROBLEM SOLVING We will also evaluate how effectively you solve normal operational issues **without unnecessarily escalating everything to management**. As you gain experience, we expect you to become increasingly capable of running day-to-day operations independently. # BONUSES We believe people who help grow the company should have opportunities to participate financially in that success. There will be opportunities for **performance bonuses in addition to base compensation**. Bonus opportunities may be tied to: - Maintaining or exceeding an 80% close rate - Exceeding monthly service targets - Increasing recurring-service percentage - Generating positive reviews - Increasing customer retention - Improving average ticket - Recruiting quality cleaners - Reducing missed opportunities - Improving operational efficiency - Creating successful new processes - Identifying additional revenue opportunities Our bonus structure will continue evolving as the company grows. # BRING US IDEAS We don't want someone who simply follows instructions forever. We want someone who learns the business and eventually starts noticing things we don't. If you see something that could improve: - Customer experience - Conversion - Scheduling - Recurring bookings - Reviews - Cleaner recruiting - Cleaner retention - Pricing - Average ticket - Communication - Automation - Efficiency - Revenue **Tell us.** We're open to listening. Good ideas are valuable. And when someone's ideas produce measurable results for the company, we're open to rewarding that contribution. # CLEANER RECRUITING & GROWTH We currently work with approximately **10 cleaners**, and we're looking to expand. Part of this position may include helping us: - Find additional cleaners - Communicate with applicants - Screen candidates - Help with onboarding - Maintain cleaner information - Assist cleaners with the system - Monitor cleaner reliability As the company grows, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibility. # REQUIRED EXPERIENCE ### Cleaning-Service Experience Is Required We're specifically looking for someone who already understands the service industry, preferably residential or commercial cleaning. You should understand situations involving: - Customers - Cleaners - Scheduling - Rescheduling - Cancellations - Late cleaners - No-shows - Service complaints - Quality issues - Customer expectations - Reviews - Recurring services You must also have **previous customer-service experience**. Experience involving any of the following is highly valuable: - Cleaning companies - Home-service companies - CRM systems - Dispatching - Scheduling - Reception - Phone support - Call centers - Customer retention - Sales Experience with **Full Loop CRM** is a plus. # EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS You must have: - Reliable laptop/computer - Quality headset - Reliable Wi-Fi/internet connection - Quiet environment for customer calls - Reliable access to your equipment throughout your shift Because this is a live customer-service position, your equipment and internet connection need to be dependable. # WORK SCHEDULE & LUNCH Working hours are: **8:00 AM – 5:00 PM New York/Eastern Time** You may take a: **30-minute paid lunch break** We will coordinate coverage so customer communications continue to be monitored. # COMPENSATION Starting compensation: ## $250 USD PER WEEK This is starting compensation—not necessarily where we expect a strong employee to remain. When we see someone succeeding, taking ownership, becoming independent, and helping grow the company, we're comfortable increasing compensation. Raises are commonly: **+$50 to +$100 per week** as we see successful performance. And we're comfortable going higher from there as someone's responsibilities and contribution increase. **Performance bonuses are additional.** # PAYMENT Payments are handled automatically through **Stripe**. You'll receive a secure link where you enter your name and Philippine banking information. Payments are automatically issued: **Every Thursday** In most cases, funds are received by: **Friday** If you prefer to receive your compensation **daily instead of weekly**, automatic daily payment can also be arranged. # APPLICANT PREFERENCE **Male applicants are preferred for this opening.** Qualified applicants will ultimately be evaluated based on their experience, communication skills, reliability, problem-solving ability, customer-service skills, and ability to perform the position successfully. # 🚨 INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED **WE WILL ONLY REVIEW APPLICANTS WHO SUBMIT THE REQUIRED INTRODUCTION VIDEO.** No video = no interview. Your video does NOT need: - Professional editing - Special lighting - Fancy equipment - Professional production A normal phone or webcam recording is perfectly acceptable. We want to see **you**. ## In Your Video, Answer ALL of the Following: **1. Introduce yourself.** Tell us your name and where you're located. **2. Tell us about your previous work experience.** **3. Describe your cleaning-service experience.** Be specific about the company, your responsibilities, and what you actually did. **4. Describe your customer-service experience.** **5. Tell us about your experience answering customer phone calls.** **6. Tell us about any CRM, scheduling, dispatching, or booking systems you've used.** **7. Tell us about a time you had a problem at work and solved it yourself instead of immediately asking your manager what to do.** **8. Tell us why you believe you'd be successful in this position.** **9. Tell us whether you're applying for:** **WEEKDAY — Monday through Friday** or **WEEKEND — Saturday and Sunday** **10. Confirm that you can consistently work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time.** # VIDEO SCENARIO #1 — ANGRY CUSTOMER Pretend we're the customer. A customer calls and says: **“My cleaner was supposed to arrive 20 minutes ago. Nobody is here. What's going on?”** The customer is frustrated. **Show us exactly how you would respond to that customer.** Don't tell us what customer service means. **Show us.** # VIDEO SCENARIO #2 — CLEANER CANCELLATION A cleaner contacts you and says: **“I can't make it to my next job.”** The customer is expecting someone shortly. Explain: **Exactly what would you do next?** Walk us through your thought process. # VIDEO SCENARIO #3 — SALES / BOOKING A potential customer contacts us and says: **“I'm comparing a few cleaning companies and haven't d ---------- who I'm going to use yet.”** Show us how you would handle the conversation and attempt to turn that lead into a booking **without being pushy or unprofessional**. # WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY TESTING The introduction video allows us to evaluate: - Spoken English - Communication - Confidence - Customer-service instincts - Sales ability - Professionalism - Problem-solving - Ability to think independently - Ability to remain calm - Understanding of the cleaning industry We care much more about these things than whether your video looks professionally produced. # HOW TO APPLY Your application must contain: **✓ Resume** **✓ Introduction video** **✓ Weekday or Weekend position preference** **✓ Description of cleaning-service experience** **✓ Description of customer-service experience** **✓ Internet speed** **✓ Computer/laptop specifications** **✓ Confirmation that you have a headset** **✓ Confirmation that you have a quiet workspace** **✓ Confirmation that you can work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time** **✓ Confirmation that you are available to begin promptly** # APPLICATION TITLE Use exactly one of the following: **NYC MAID RECEPTIONIST – WEEKDAY** or **NYC MAID RECEPTIONIST – WEEKEND** This is also an attention-to-detail test. If you can't follow the application instructions, this probably isn't the right position for you. # WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE? You'll probably do very well here if you're someone who: - Shows up - Shows up on time - Communicates clearly - Likes helping customers - Thinks independently - Doesn't panic when something goes wrong - Takes ownership - Learns quickly - Likes technology - Understands service businesses - Wants responsibility - Wants to make more money as you become more valuable - Notices opportunities - Suggests improvements - Wants to grow with a company We aren't looking for someone who simply wants to clock in and wait for instructions. We're looking for someone who eventually understands the operation well enough that management can trust them to **handle business**. If that's you, send us your video. **We're hiring now and are ready for the right people to start Monday.**

title: WordPress / Elementor Expert Needed to Set Up Blog Post Templates

description: I’m looking for an experienced WordPress/Elementor freelancer to clean up and properly configure the blog post templates on an existing website. This is a relatively small, defined project. I am not looking for someone to write content or format individual blog posts on an ongoing basis. The goal is to create a system where I can write or paste articles into the standard WordPress block editor, add images, headings and links, and have the finished article automatically display correctly using the Elementor template. I do not want to use Elementor to build or format each individual blog post. What I Need I currently have three blog/post templates that need to be created or properly configured in Elementor. I will provide examples of the look and layout I want. The templates should control the overall design while allowing the actual article content to be created entirely through the standard WordPress post editor. Each template should include the appropriate Elementor Post Content widget and dynamically pull in the post title, featured image, article content and other applicable post information. Article Formatting This is particularly important. I publish long-form articles, generally between 1,000 and 2,500 words. I need consistent formatting for: * Paragraphs * H2 headings * H3 headings * Bulleted and numbered lists * Hyperlinks * Bold and italic text * Blockquotes, if used * Images inserted within the article * Image captions, if used Paragraph and heading spacing should be controlled by the template/CSS rather than by manually adding blank lines to every article. For example, paragraphs should automatically have appropriate spacing beneath them. H2 and H3 headings should automatically have appropriate spacing above and below them. If I change a paragraph to an H2 in the WordPress editor, it should not affect or reset the formatting elsewhere in the article. Images Within Articles I frequently use images throughout an article in addition to the featured image. A typical 1,200-word article may have a featured image plus two images within the article. A 2,000-word article may have a featured image plus three or four images within the article. I need to be able to insert these images directly into the WordPress block editor wherever I want them. The template should automatically display these images properly, including consistent width, spacing and responsive behavior. Mobile and Tablet All three templates need to be tested and formatted properly for: * Desktop * Tablet * Mobile Typography, margins, images and spacing should remain clean and readable at each size. The Most Important Deliverable When the project is finished, I should be able to: 1. Go to WordPress → Posts → Add New 2. Enter the post title 3. Paste an article into the WordPress block editor 4. Assign H2 and H3 headings 5. Insert images wherever I want them 6. Add hyperlinks and internal links 7. Select the appropriate featured image 8. Publish I should NOT need to click "Edit with Elementor" or manually adjust paragraph spacing, headings or formatting for each new article.** That is the main purpose of this project. Testing Before Completion Before considering the project complete, I want each applicable template tested with an actual sample article. The test article should include: * Approximately 1,500+ words * Multiple paragraphs * Several H2 headings * At least one H3 heading * A bulleted list * Internal/external hyperlinks * Featured image * At least three images inserted throughout the article I want to see that the post displays correctly on desktop, tablet and mobile without manually formatting the individual post in Elementor. Existing Website This is an existing WordPress/Elementor website. I am not looking for a website redesign. Please do not make unrelated changes to the website, theme, plugins, global styling or existing pages without discussing them with me first. Please work carefully so existing pages and posts are not affected unexpectedly. If CSS or global settings need to be changed, please explain what you intend to change before making changes that could affect other parts of the website. Documentation / Handoff At completion, I would like a short walkthrough, either live or a brief screen recording, showing me: * How to create a new post * How to select/use the appropriate template * How to add H2/H3 headings * How to insert article images * How to add internal links * How to change the featured image * Anything I should avoid doing that could break the formatting The system should be simple enough that I can publish future articles myself. Our initial focus is: 1. SPC/LVP Flooring 2. RTA Kitchen Cabinets If the relationship is successful, additional construction products may be added later. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You will be responsible for researching, locating, verifying, negotiating with, and comparing Chinese manufacturers. We do NOT simply want the cheapest supplier. We want the best combination of price, quality, reliability, certifications, shipping cost, and manufacturer credibility. You will: • Locate actual manufacturers/factories rather than unnecessary middlemen or trading companies. • Search Alibaba, 1688, Chinese manufacturer directories, and other appropriate sourcing channels. • Communicate directly with factories. • Determine whether each supplier is a manufacturer, trading company, or sourcing agent. • Obtain and negotiate factory pricing. • Negotiate MOQ requirements. • Request samples. • Obtain product specifications and technical documentation. • Obtain available U.S.-market certifications and testing reports. • Compare several manufacturers rather than recommending the first supplier you find. • Investigate the supplier's history, factory capabilities, production capacity, export experience, and reputation. • Determine production lead times. • Obtain packaging specifications, carton/pallet dimensions and weights. • Determine how much product fits into 20-foot and 40-foot containers when applicable. • Obtain FOB and other relevant shipping quotations. • Help coordinate freight-forwarding quotations to New Jersey, USA. • Help calculate the approximate landed cost in New Jersey, not simply the factory purchase price. • Assist with quality-control inspections before final payment/shipment. • Maintain organized records of suppliers, quotations, samples, specifications and communications. FLOORING SOURCING We are particularly interested in quality SPC/LVP waterproof flooring suitable for residential and light-commercial construction. You should be able to compare manufacturers based on items including: • SPC construction • Overall plank thickness • Wear-layer thickness • Attached underlayment/padding • Click-lock system • Residential/commercial warranty • Scratch and wear resistance • Waterproof performance • Available colors/designs • Packaging • Square footage per carton • Pallet quantities • Container quantities • Certifications/testing • MOQ • Factory price per square meter/square foot • FOB price • Production time • Sample availability We will determine final specifications after reviewing factory options. CABINET SOURCING We are primarily interested in RTA (Ready-to-Assemble) kitchen cabinets because shipping efficiency is important. We want manufacturers capable of producing cabinet lines appropriate for the U.S. remodeling market. You should compare: • Cabinet-box construction • Plywood vs. particleboard/MDF components • Box thickness • Door construction • Painted and stained finishes • Shaker-style availability • Soft-close hinges • Soft-close drawer slides • Drawer-box construction • Hardware quality • Standard U.S. cabinet dimensions • Available cabinet sizes/SKUs • Matching panels, fillers, moldings and accessories • Packaging quality • Replacement-part policy • Warranty • MOQ • Sample/demo cabinet availability • Container capacity • Factory pricing • FOB pricing • Production lead time WHAT WE DO NOT WANT We do not want someone who simply searches Alibaba, copies several links and sends them to us. We can do that ourselves. Your value is in finding the factory behind the product, communicating with the manufacturer, negotiating, verifying information, identifying problems, and determining the true cost of getting the product to us in the United States. We expect you to question suppliers and verify claims rather than simply accepting what a salesperson tells you. EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR Strong candidates should have experience with several of the following: • China product sourcing • 1688 sourcing • Alibaba sourcing • Factory verification • Supplier negotiation • Procurement • Import/export • Quality control • Freight forwarding • Container shipping • U.S. imports • Building materials • Flooring • Kitchen cabinets Mandarin/Chinese-language ability is a major advantage. Experience specifically sourcing construction materials, SPC flooring, LVP flooring, cabinetry, furniture or building products is highly preferred. PAID/TRIAL SOURCING ASSIGNMENT Before selecting someone for ongoing work, qualified applicants may be given a sourcing assignment. You may be asked to identify: 3 legitimate SPC/LVP flooring manufacturers and 3 legitimate RTA kitchen-cabinet manufacturers. For each manufacturer, we want a comparison showing: 1. Factory/company name 2. Factory location 3. Manufacturer vs. trading company 4. Years in business 5. Main products 6. Export experience to the United States 7. Product specifications 8. Certifications/testing documentation 9. MOQ 10. Sample cost 11. Unit/factory price 12. FOB price 13. Production lead time 14. Packaging information 15. Container capacity 16. Payment terms 17. Quality-control options 18. Freight estimate to New Jersey, if available 19. Approximate landed cost 20. Your assessment of the supplier and any concerns/red flags Simply submitting Alibaba links will NOT qualify as completing the assignment. HOW TO APPLY Please begin your application with the words: “FACTORY DIRECT” This lets us know you read the entire posting. Then answer these questions: 1. How many years have you worked in China sourcing/procurement? 2. Do you personally use 1688? 3. Can you communicate with suppliers in Mandarin/Chinese? 4. Have you sourced products for U.S. companies before? 5. Have you sourced flooring, cabinets, furniture, construction materials or similar products? 6. How do you determine whether a supplier is an actual manufacturer rather than a trading company? 7. How do you verify a Chinese factory before a buyer sends a substantial deposit? 8. What methods do you use to negotiate better pricing and MOQ? 9. Have you coordinated third-party factory inspections? 10. Have you worked with freight forwarders and container shipments to the United States? 11. Provide an example of a sourcing project you completed and explain how you reduced the buyer's cost or prevented a sourcing problem. 12. What is your hourly or project-based rate? IMPORTANT We are looking for a long-term sourcing relationship, but we will start small. Our goal is to establish reliable direct relationships with manufacturers that can supply our construction company at pricing that makes financial sense after product cost + freight + duties/tariffs + customs/brokerage + inspections + inland transportation + all other import expenses. We care about the number that matters: THE FINAL LANDED COST IN NEW JERSEY. If you are experienced in finding legitimate Chinese manufacturers, negotiating factory-direct pricing and protecting buyers from sourcing mistakes, we would like to hear from you.
